attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Demux Mismatch Metrics; bcl2fastq Documentation

attributes.name: index_sequence
attributes.description: The nucleotide index sequence (i7 and optionally i5 dual-index) matched to assign reads to this library during demultiplexing. Supports single-index (e.g., ACGTACGT) and dual-index (e.g., ACGTACGT+TTGGCCAA) formats. Critical for multiplexing validation and index collision analysis.
attributes.references: Illumina Index Adapter Sequences; NGS Library Preparation Standards

attributes.name: instrument_platform
attributes.description: The sequencing instrument platform model used for the run (e.g., NovaSeq 6000, NovaSeq X, NextSeq 2000, MiSeq). Determines flow cell format, lane count, and applicable demux parameters. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NovaSeq_6000|NovaSeq_X|NextSeq_2000|MiSeq|HiSeq_4000|PromethION|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina Instrument Specifications; LabVantage LIMS — Instrument Registry

attributes.name: lane_number
attributes.description: The physical lane number on the flow cell from which reads were demultiplexed. Flow cells may contain 1, 2, 4, or 8 lanes depending on instrument type (e.g., NovaSeq, HiSeq). Required for per-lane QC analysis and troubleshooting.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Lane Metrics; Illumina Flow Cell Specification

attributes.name: mean_phred_score_r1
attributes.description: Mean Phred quality score across all bases in Read 1 for this library. Phred score (Q score) represents base call accuracy (Q30 = 99.9% accuracy). A key NGS QC metric; values below Q30 threshold may trigger QC failure.
attributes.references: Phred Quality Score Standard (Ewing & Green, 1998); Illumina BaseSpace QC Metrics; CLIA — Analytical Quality Requirements

attributes.name: mean_phred_score_r2
attributes.description: Mean Phred quality score across all bases in Read 2 for this library. Typically lower than R1 due to signal degradation in paired-end sequencing. Null for single-end runs.
attributes.references: Phred Quality Score Standard (Ewing & Green, 1998); Illumina BaseSpace QC Metrics

attributes.name: min_read_count_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum number of assigned reads required for this library to pass QC, as defined by the applicable assay protocol or SOP. Stored at the record level to capture the threshold in effect at the time of demultiplexing, supporting historical QC audits.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 — QC Acceptance Criteria; CAP — NGS Checklist; Internal SOP

attributes.name: mismatch_tolerance
attributes.description: Number of allowable base mismatches permitted when matching a read's index sequence to the expected library index during demultiplexing. Typically 0 or 1. Higher values increase assignment rate but risk index cross-contamination between libraries.
attributes.references: bcl2fastq User Guide; DRAGEN BCL Convert Documentation; Illumina Demultiplexing Best Practices

attributes.name: pct_q30_r1
attributes.description: Percentage of Read 1 bases with a Phred quality score of 30 or higher (≥Q30). Industry-standard NGS QC threshold; Illumina specifies ≥75–80% Q30 as passing for most platforms. Used in run-level and library-level QC reporting.
attributes.references: Illumina Sequencing Quality Metrics; CLIA — Analytical Performance Standards; CAP — NGS Checklist

attributes.name: pct_q30_r2
attributes.description: Percentage of Read 2 bases with a Phred quality score of 30 or higher (≥Q30). Null for single-end runs. Compared against run-specific QC thresholds for paired-end quality assessment.
attributes.references: Illumina Sequencing Quality Metrics; CAP — NGS Checklist

attributes.name: qc_failure_reason
attributes.description: Descriptive reason for QC failure when qc_pass_flag = False. Examples include: 'low_read_count', 'high_undetermined_rate', 'index_collision', 'low_q30'. Populated by automated QC rules or manual review. Null when qc_pass_flag = True.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 — Non-Conformance Documentation; CLIA — QC Failure Reporting; CAP — NGS QC Checklist

attributes.name: qc_pass_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the demultiplexing result for this library passed all defined QC thresholds (read count, percentage assigned, undetermined rate). True = QC passed; False = QC failed. Authoritative gate for downstream bioinformatics pipeline processing.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 — Quality Control; CLIA — Laboratory QC Requirements; Illumina BaseSpace QC Metrics

attributes.name: read_length_r1
attributes.description: Length in base pairs (bp) of Read 1 sequences produced for this library. Determined by the sequencing run configuration. Critical for downstream alignment and variant calling pipeline compatibility.
attributes.references: Illumina Sequencing Run Parameters; NGS Read Length Standards

attributes.name: read_length_r2
attributes.description: Length in base pairs (bp) of Read 2 sequences produced for this library. Null for single-end runs. Used to confirm paired-end symmetry and pipeline input validation.
attributes.references: Illumina Sequencing Run Parameters; NGS Read Length Standards

attributes.name: reprocessing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this demux result was generated by reprocessing a previously demultiplexed run (e.g., due to sample sheet correction, software update, or QC failure remediation). True = reprocessed; False = original demux. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: GxP (21 CFR Part 11 — Audit Trail); ISO 15189 — Corrective Action Records

attributes.name: total_lane_read_count

attributes.name: undetermined_read_pct

attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Demux QC Metrics; NGS QC Thresholds

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: fastq_file

SSOT for raw sequencing data file inventory — the primary output artifact of the sequencing domain.

attributes.name: fastq_file_id

attributes.name: research_protocol_id

attributes.name: sample_specimen_id

attributes.name: sequencing_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing run that produced this FASTQ file. Links the file to its originating instrument run for traceability and run-level quality assessment.

attributes.name: adapter_trimming_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether adapter sequences were trimmed from reads during or after demultiplexing. Adapter trimming affects downstream alignment and variant calling accuracy. Relevant for pipeline configuration validation.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — DRAGEN Adapter Trimming; NGS Bioinformatics Best Practices

attributes.name: basespace_dataset_code
attributes.description: The unique dataset identifier assigned by Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub to the dataset object containing this FASTQ file. Used for cross-referencing and API retrieval from BaseSpace.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Dataset API v2

attributes.name: basespace_file_code
attributes.description: The unique file-level identifier assigned by Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub to this specific FASTQ file object. Enables direct file-level API operations and provenance tracking within BaseSpace.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — File API v2

attributes.name: compression_format
attributes.description: The compression algorithm applied to the FASTQ file. Standard for NGS data is gzip (.gz). Determines decompression requirements for bioinformatics pipeline ingestion and storage cost calculations.
attributes.references: FASTQ Format Specification; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — File Storage Standards

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: The informed consent status of the subject associated with this FASTQ file's sample. Governs permissible uses of the genomic data (research, clinical, secondary use). Withdrawn consent triggers data deletion or de-identification workflows per GDPR and HIPAA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (Consent); HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR Part 164; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; ICH E6 GCP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this FASTQ file record was first created in the sequencing data inventory (Silver Layer). Audit trail timestamp for data governance and lineage tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 — Audit Trails; GxP Data Integrity Guidelines; ISO 27001

attributes.name: data_classification
attributes.description: The data sensitivity classification level assigned to this FASTQ file per Genomics Biotech data governance policy. Restricted = highest sensitivity (PHI/PII), Confidential = sensitive business data, Internal = general internal use, Public = no restrictions. Drives access control, encryption, and retention policies.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Classification; HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR Part 164; GDPR Article 32; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: encryption_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this FASTQ file is encrypted at rest in cloud storage. Encryption is mandatory for PHI-containing files under HIPAA Security Rule and for GxP-regulated data. Supports security compliance auditing.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR Part 164.312; ISO 27001 — Cryptography Controls; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: file_name
attributes.description: The full file name of the FASTQ output file including extension (e.g., SampleA_S1_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz). Follows Illumina naming conventions encoding sample, lane, read number, and index.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — FASTQ File Naming Convention; FASTQ Format Specification (Cock et al., 2010)

attributes.name: file_path
attributes.description: Cloud storage URI indicating the full path to the FASTQ file on BaseSpace or Amazon S3 (e.g., s3://genomics-biotech-seq/runs/RUN001/SampleA_R1.fastq.gz). Serves as the authoritative location reference for downstream bioinformatics pipeline access.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Storage API; AWS S3 Object Naming

attributes.name: file_size_bytes
attributes.description: The size of the FASTQ file in bytes as stored in cloud storage. Used for storage capacity planning, data transfer cost estimation, and file integrity verification. Compressed (gzip) size is recorded.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — File Metadata; AWS S3 Object Metadata

attributes.name: file_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the FASTQ file in the sequencing data inventory. Pending = demultiplexing in progress, Available = ready for pipeline consumption, Archived = moved to cold storage, Deleted = purged per retention policy, Failed = generation error, Quarantined = held for QC investigation.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — File Lifecycle Management; GxP Data Integrity Guidelines

attributes.name: generation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this FASTQ file was generated by the demultiplexing process. Represents the principal business event timestamp — the moment raw sequencing data became available as a FASTQ artifact. Used for TAT (Turnaround Time) calculations and data lineage.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — File Metadata; GxP Data Integrity Guidelines; CLIA TAT Requirements

attributes.name: index_sequence
attributes.description: The nucleotide index sequence (barcode) used to identify and demultiplex this sample from a multiplexed sequencing run. Composed of ACGT bases. Critical for validating correct sample assignment and detecting index hopping or cross-contamination.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Sample Sheet; Multiplexing and Demultiplexing Standards

attributes.name: intended_use_class
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the intended use of this sequencing data. RUO = Research Use Only, IVD = In Vitro Diagnostic (FDA-cleared/approved), LDT = Laboratory Developed Test (CLIA-regulated). Governs data handling, access controls, and regulatory reporting obligations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; IVDR EU 2017/746; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; FDA IVD Guidance

attributes.name: md5_checksum
attributes.description: The MD5 cryptographic hash of the FASTQ file used to verify file integrity during transfer, storage, and archival. Mandatory for data integrity validation in GxP-regulated environments and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records; GxP Data Integrity Guidelines (MHRA, EMA); ISO 27001

attributes.name: mean_phred_quality_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mean Phred Quality Score (Base Quality Score)
attributes.description: The mean Phred quality score (Q-score) across all bases in this FASTQ file. Phred scores represent the probability of a base call error (Q30 = 99.9% accuracy). A key QC metric for raw sequencing data quality assessment per NGS best practices.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — QC Metrics; Phred Quality Score Standard (Ewing & Green, 1998); ISO 15189

attributes.name: mean_read_length_bp
attributes.description: The mean length of sequencing reads in this FASTQ file measured in base pairs (bp). Reflects the sequencing chemistry and run configuration. Relevant for alignment pipeline parameter selection and quality benchmarking.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Parameters; FASTQ Format Specification

attributes.name: pct_bases_q30
attributes.business_glossary_term: Percentage of Bases at Q30 or Above (Phred Score ≥30)
attributes.description: The percentage of bases in this FASTQ file with a Phred quality score of 30 or higher (≥Q30), indicating ≥99.9% base call accuracy. Industry-standard QC threshold for NGS data quality; typically ≥80% Q30 is required for clinical-grade sequencing.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — QC Metrics; FDA Guidance on NGS-Based IVD Devices; ISO 15189

attributes.name: pct_reads_passing_filter
attributes.description: The percentage of reads in this FASTQ file that passed the Illumina chastity filter (PF reads). Reads failing the filter are excluded from analysis. A key indicator of cluster quality and flow cell performance.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Demultiplexing Statistics; Illumina Cluster Density and PF Metrics

attributes.name: phi_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this FASTQ file is associated with Protected Health Information (PHI) as defined under HIPAA. When True, the file is subject to HIPAA Privacy and Security Rule requirements, access restrictions, and audit logging obligations. Drives data governance and access control enforcement.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR Part 164; GDPR Article 9 (Special Category Data); NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: pipeline_ready_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this FASTQ file has passed all QC checks and is cleared for ingestion into bioinformatics analysis pipelines. When True, the file is eligible for alignment, variant calling, and downstream processing. Prevents failed or quarantined files from entering production pipelines.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Pipeline Trigger Logic; LabVantage LIMS — Workflow Automation

attributes.name: qc_failure_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for QC failure when qc_status is 'fail' or 'review'. Documents specific quality issues (e.g., low Q30 percentage, insufficient read count, adapter contamination) for root cause analysis and CAPA processes.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP NGS Checklist; GxP CAPA Requirements

attributes.name: qc_status
attributes.description: The QC assessment outcome for this FASTQ file based on Phred scores, read counts, and other quality metrics. Pass = meets all QC thresholds, Fail = below minimum thresholds, Review = borderline requiring manual review, Not Assessed = QC not yet performed. Governs eligibility for downstream bioinformatics processing.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 — Medical Laboratories Quality; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP NGS Checklist; FDA NGS IVD Guidance

attributes.name: read_number
attributes.description: Designates the read type of this FASTQ file within a paired-end or indexed sequencing run. R1 = forward read, R2 = reverse read, I1 = index 1 (i7), I2 = index 2 (i5). Critical for demultiplexing validation and downstream alignment pipeline configuration.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — FASTQ File Naming Convention; NGS Library Preparation Standards

attributes.name: retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: The calculated date on which this FASTQ file becomes eligible for deletion or archival based on the applied retention policy. Enables automated data lifecycle management and compliance with regulatory retention mandates.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493.1105; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.530; GDPR Article 5(1)(e)

attributes.name: retention_policy
attributes.description: The data retention policy applied to this FASTQ file, governing how long the file must be retained before eligible for deletion or archival. Clinical data typically requires 10-year retention per CLIA/CAP; RUO data may follow shorter policies. Drives automated lifecycle management.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493.1105; CAP Accreditation Standards; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.530; GDPR Article 5(1)(e); FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sequencing_assay_type
attributes.description: The type of NGS sequencing assay that produced this FASTQ file. Determines applicable bioinformatics pipelines, QC thresholds, and regulatory classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WGS|WES|targeted_panel|amplicon|RNA-seq|metagenomics|single_cell — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on NGS-Based IVD Devices (2018); Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Application Types

attributes.name: storage_tier
attributes.description: The cloud storage tier in which this FASTQ file currently resides. Hot = frequently accessed (active analysis), Warm = infrequent access, Cold = rare access, Archive = long-term retention (e.g., AWS Glacier). Drives storage cost management and retrieval SLA expectations.
attributes.references: AWS S3 Storage Classes; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Storage Management

attributes.name: total_read_count
attributes.description: The total number of sequencing reads contained in this FASTQ file after demultiplexing. A primary indicator of sequencing yield for this sample-lane combination. Used to assess whether minimum coverage depth thresholds are met for downstream analysis.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Demultiplexing Statistics; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this FASTQ file record was most recently modified in the sequencing data inventory. Tracks status changes, QC updates, and metadata corrections for audit compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 — Audit Trails; GxP Data Integrity Guidelines; ISO 27001

attributes.name: upload_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this FASTQ file was successfully uploaded to cloud storage (BaseSpace or S3). Distinct from generation_timestamp; captures the transfer completion event for data availability tracking and SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Upload API; AWS S3 Object Metadata

products.name: coverage_stat
products.description: Transactional record storing per-library sequencing coverage statistics computed post-demultiplexing. Captures mean coverage depth (X), median coverage depth, coverage uniformity (%), fraction of bases at ≥10X, ≥20X, ≥30X, ≥100X thresholds, on-target rate (% for targeted/WES), duplication rate (%), insert size mean and standard deviation, GC bias metric, and coverage QC pass/fail against assay-specific thresholds. Enables assessment of whether a library meets minimum coverage requirements for downstream bioinformatics analysis.

attributes.name: coverage_stat_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each coverage statistic record computed post-demultiplexing for a sequencing library. Primary key for the coverage_stat data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: bioinformatics_pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bioinformatics pipeline run that computed these coverage statistics post-demultiplexing. Enables data lineage tracing from raw FASTQ to coverage metrics.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Analysis Run; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: experiment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.experiment. Business justification: Coverage statistics are analyzed per-experiment to assess whether sequencing depth meets experimental objectives (e.g., variant detection sensitivity requirements). Drives resequencing decisions, expe

attributes.name: gene_annotation_track_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.gene_annotation_track. Business justification: Coverage over genes and exons requires specific annotation track for coordinate mapping. Enables gene-level coverage reporting for clinical assays and research applications, critical for interpreting

attributes.name: gene_model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.gene_model. Business justification: Coverage statistics are often reported at gene level for clinical and research applications. Enables gene-level coverage reporting, identifies genes with coverage gaps, and supports clinical interpret

attributes.name: genome_assembly_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.genome_assembly. Business justification: Coverage statistics are inherently reference-genome-dependent (coordinates, target regions, mappability). Essential for clinical reporting, QC assessment, and comparing coverage across different refer

attributes.name: genomic_region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.genomic_region. Business justification: Coverage statistics for targeted assays are calculated over specific genomic regions. Enables region-level coverage reporting, identifies coverage gaps in target regions, and supports clinical assay v

attributes.name: library_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing library for which this coverage statistic record was computed. Links to the library preparation entity in the sequencing domain.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Library Entity

attributes.name: pharmacogenomics_marker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.pharmacogenomics_marker. Business justification: PGx assays require coverage verification over specific markers for clinical reporting. Essential for validating that all required PGx markers have adequate coverage for FDA/EMA-compliant pharmacogenom

attributes.name: sample_specimen_id
attributes.description: Reference to the biological sample associated with the library. Enables traceability from coverage statistics back to the originating sample in the Sample Management domain.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Sample Entity; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: sequencing_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing run that produced the raw reads from which this coverage statistic was derived. Enables traceability from coverage metrics back to the instrument run.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Entity; ISO 13485 Section 7.5

attributes.name: test_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical or research assay definition against which coverage QC thresholds are evaluated. Determines the minimum coverage requirements applicable to this library.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault — Assay Specification; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ISO 15189

attributes.name: variant_database_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.variant_database. Business justification: Coverage over clinically relevant variants (from databases like ClinVar) is a key QC metric for clinical assays. Ensures adequate coverage of actionable variants for clinical reporting and regulatory

attributes.name: approved_for_analysis
attributes.description: Indicates whether this library's coverage statistics have been reviewed and approved for downstream bioinformatics analysis (variant calling, annotation). Set to True only when qc_status is Pass and any required manual review has been completed.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Sample Disposition; ISO 15189 Section 5.6; CAP Checklist GEN.55500

attributes.name: assay_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sequencing assay type for which coverage statistics are computed. Determines applicable QC thresholds and on-target rate relevance. WGS (Whole Genome Sequencing), WES (Whole Exome Sequencing), Targeted panel, Amplicon, or RNA-Seq. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WGS|WES|Targeted|Amplicon|RNA-Seq|Other — promote to reference product if additional assay types are added]
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ISO 15189

attributes.name: computed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the coverage statistics were computed by the bioinformatics pipeline post-demultiplexing. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this record. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Analysis Completion; ISO 15189 Section 5.5; GxP 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: coverage_uniformity_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of target bases covered at greater than or equal to 20% of the mean coverage depth. Measures how evenly reads are distributed across the target region. Higher uniformity indicates more consistent library preparation and hybridization efficiency.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Uniformity Metric; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this coverage statistic record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2; GxP 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5(1)(e)

attributes.name: duplication_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of mapped reads identified as PCR or optical duplicates. High duplication rates reduce effective coverage depth and can introduce variant calling artifacts. Computed by duplicate-marking tools (e.g., Picard MarkDuplicates) during bioinformatics processing.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Duplicate Metrics; Picard Tools Documentation; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: gc_bias_metric
attributes.description: Quantitative measure of GC content bias in coverage distribution, typically expressed as the normalized coverage deviation across GC content bins. Values near zero indicate minimal GC bias; large deviations indicate systematic under- or over-representation of GC-rich or GC-poor regions.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — GC Bias Metrics; Picard CollectGcBiasMetrics; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: insert_size_mean_bp
attributes.description: Mean insert size of the sequencing library in base pairs (bp). Reflects the average length of the DNA fragment between adapter sequences. Deviations from expected insert size indicate library preparation issues affecting coverage uniformity and read alignment.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Insert Size Metrics; Picard CollectInsertSizeMetrics; ISO 15189

attributes.name: insert_size_std_dev_bp
attributes.description: Standard deviation of the insert size distribution in base pairs (bp). High standard deviation indicates heterogeneous fragment sizes, which may affect coverage uniformity and paired-end alignment efficiency.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Insert Size Metrics; Picard CollectInsertSizeMetrics; ISO 15189

attributes.name: mapped_reads
attributes.description: Number of reads successfully aligned to the reference genome. Used to compute mapping rate and assess library quality. Low mapped read counts relative to total reads indicate contamination, adapter issues, or reference mismatch.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Alignment Metrics; SAMtools flagstat; ISO 15189

attributes.name: mapping_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total reads that successfully aligned to the reference genome. A key indicator of library quality and sample integrity. Typically expected to be >95% for high-quality human genomic libraries.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Alignment Metrics; ISO 15189 Section 5.5; ACMG Sequencing Guidelines

attributes.name: mean_base_quality_score
attributes.description: Mean Phred quality score across all bases in the library. Phred scores represent the probability of a base call error (Q30 = 99.9% accuracy). Used to assess sequencing chemistry performance and overall run quality.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Quality Metrics; Phred Quality Score Standard (Ewing & Green 1998); ISO 15189

attributes.name: mean_coverage_depth
attributes.description: Average number of times each base in the target region (or genome for WGS) is sequenced, expressed in fold-coverage (X). Primary metric for assessing sequencing depth adequacy. Computed as total aligned bases divided by target region size.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Coverage Metrics; ISO 15189 Section 5.5; ACMG Sequencing Guidelines

attributes.name: median_coverage_depth
attributes.description: Median number of times each base in the target region is sequenced, expressed in fold-coverage (X). Less sensitive to outlier regions than mean coverage; used alongside mean to assess coverage distribution skewness.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Coverage Metrics; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: min_coverage_threshold
attributes.description: Assay-specific minimum mean coverage depth threshold (in X) that must be met for the library to pass QC. Defined in the assay specification and used to evaluate the qc_status determination. Varies by assay type (e.g., 30X for clinical WGS, 100X for somatic oncology panels).
attributes.references: Veeva Vault — Assay Specification; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Checklist MOL.37600; ISO 15189

attributes.name: min_pct_bases_threshold
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Percentage of Bases Coverage Threshold (%)
attributes.description: Assay-specific minimum percentage of target bases that must achieve the defined coverage depth threshold (e.g., ≥95% of bases at ≥20X) for the library to pass QC. Defined in the assay specification document.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault — Assay Specification; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Checklist MOL.37600

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for laboratory scientists or bioinformaticians to record observations, exceptions, or contextual information about this coverage statistic record. Used during manual QC review to document borderline cases or special circumstances.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Section 4.13; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493.1445; CAP Checklist GEN.55500

attributes.name: on_target_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of aligned reads that map to the intended target region (capture panel or amplicon targets). Applicable for WES and targeted sequencing assays. Low on-target rate indicates poor hybridization capture efficiency or library quality issues.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Enrichment Metrics; ISO 15189 Section 5.5; CAP Checklist MOL.37600

attributes.name: pct_bases_at_100x
attributes.description: Fraction of target bases (expressed as a percentage) achieving a minimum coverage depth of 100X. Relevant for somatic variant calling in oncology panels where high depth is required to detect low-frequency variants (low LOD applications).
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Coverage Metrics; ACMG/AMP Somatic Variant Guidelines; ISO 15189

attributes.name: pct_bases_at_10x
attributes.description: Fraction of target bases (expressed as a percentage) achieving a minimum coverage depth of 10X. Standard threshold for variant calling sensitivity in WES and targeted sequencing panels.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Coverage Metrics; ACMG/AMP Variant Interpretation Guidelines; ISO 15189

attributes.name: pct_bases_at_20x
attributes.description: Fraction of target bases (expressed as a percentage) achieving a minimum coverage depth of 20X. Common minimum threshold for clinical-grade variant calling in WES and targeted panels per CAP and CLIA guidelines.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Coverage Metrics; CAP Checklist MOL.37600; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: pct_bases_at_30x
attributes.description: Fraction of target bases (expressed as a percentage) achieving a minimum coverage depth of 30X. Recommended threshold for high-confidence germline variant calling in clinical WGS and WES workflows.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Coverage Metrics; ACMG Sequencing Guidelines; ISO 15189

attributes.name: pct_q30_bases
attributes.business_glossary_term: Percentage of Bases with Q30 or Higher (Phred Score ≥30)
attributes.description: Percentage of bases in the library with a Phred quality score of 30 or higher (Q30), indicating 99.9% base call accuracy. Industry-standard metric for sequencing run quality assessment. Illumina typically specifies ≥80% Q30 as a run quality threshold.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Quality Metrics; Illumina Run Quality Specifications; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: qc_failure_reason
attributes.description: Descriptive reason for QC failure when qc_status is Fail or Borderline. Documents which specific coverage metric(s) fell below assay-defined thresholds, supporting root cause analysis and resequencing decisions.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Section 5.6; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Checklist GEN.55500

attributes.name: qc_status
attributes.description: Overall QC pass/fail determination for this library's coverage statistics evaluated against assay-specific thresholds. A Pass status indicates the library meets minimum coverage requirements for downstream bioinformatics analysis. Borderline indicates marginal coverage requiring manual review.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Section 5.6; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Checklist GEN.55500

attributes.name: reference_genome_version
attributes.description: Version of the reference genome used for read alignment and coverage computation (e.g., GRCh38, GRCh37/hg19, GRCm39). Critical for reproducibility and cross-sample comparability of coverage statistics. Must match the reference used in downstream variant calling pipelines.
attributes.references: NCBI Reference Sequence Database; Ensembl Genome Browser; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: resequencing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this library has been flagged for resequencing due to insufficient coverage or QC failure. When True, the library must be re-run on the sequencer before downstream bioinformatics analysis can proceed.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Sample Disposition; ISO 15189 Section 5.6; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the manual QC review of this coverage statistic record was completed. Supports audit trail requirements under CLIA, CAP, and GxP regulations. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493.1445; CAP Checklist GEN.55500; GxP 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 15189 Section 4.13

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the laboratory scientist or bioinformatician who performed the manual QC review of this coverage statistic record. Required for clinical assays under CLIA and CAP accreditation to maintain an auditable review trail.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493.1445; CAP Checklist GEN.55500; ISO 15189 Section 4.13

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this coverage statistic record originated. Supports data lineage and provenance tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer. Typically Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub for automated pipeline outputs or LabVantage LIMS for manually entered records.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2; GxP 21 CFR Part 11; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: stat_identifier
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for this coverage statistic record, following the COVSTAT-{alphanumeric} naming convention. Used for cross-system referencing and audit trail purposes in LIMS and BaseSpace.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Analysis Report; ISO 13485 Section 4.2

attributes.name: target_region_bed_file
attributes.description: Name or path of the BED file defining the target genomic regions used for on-target coverage calculations. Applicable for WES and targeted sequencing assays. Ensures coverage metrics are computed against the correct capture or amplicon panel definition.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Panel Definition; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: target_region_size_bp
attributes.description: Total size of the target genomic region in base pairs as defined by the BED file. Used as the denominator for coverage depth calculations. For WGS, this represents the effective genome size used in analysis.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Panel Metrics; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: total_reads
attributes.description: Total number of sequencing reads generated for this library after demultiplexing. Represents the raw read count before any filtering or alignment steps. Used to assess sequencing yield and library loading efficiency.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Demultiplexing Report; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this coverage statistic record was last modified, such as after a QC review decision or recomputation. Supports audit trail requirements under GxP and ISO 13485. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2; GxP 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5(1)(e)

attributes.name: use_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory use classification of the assay producing this coverage statistic. RUO (Research Use Only), IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic), or LDT (Laboratory Developed Test). Determines applicable regulatory reporting and QC requirements under FDA, CLIA, and IVDR frameworks.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; IVDR EU 2017/746; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

products.name: index_set
products.description: Controlled reference master for sequencing index (barcode) sets used in library multiplexing. Captures index set name, manufacturer, index type (single/dual/UDI/combinatorial), i7 and i5 sequences, index length (bp), compatible library prep kits and instruments, Hamming distance from nearest neighbor in the set, color balance properties, and approval status. Managed by sequencing operations to prevent index collisions during pool design and ensure reliable demultiplexing. Updated when new index chemistries are validated.

attributes.name: index_set_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the sequencing index set record in the Genomics Biotech lakehouse. Primary key for the index_set master resource.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2 — Document and Record Control

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.batch. Business justification: Index kits are batch-managed. Link enables lot traceability for quality investigations (index hopping, demux failures), recall management, expiry tracking, and GMP documentation. Removes denormalized

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.catalog_item. Business justification: Index/adapter sets are sold as catalog items with specific SKUs. Critical for ordering, compatibility validation with library prep kits, regulatory documentation, and ensuring correct product versions

attributes.name: coa_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the Certificate of Analysis (COA) document associated with this index set lot, stored in Veeva Vault or MasterControl. Provides traceability to quality release documentation including purity, concentration, and sequence verification results.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault — Quality Document Management; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.4; GxP Guidelines

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material. Business justification: Index kits are materials. Link enables inventory management, demand planning based on multiplexing forecasts, MRP planning, and supply chain integration for procurement and stock level optimization.

attributes.name: nonconformance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.nonconformance. Business justification: Index sets can be nonconforming (failed validation, incorrect sequences, manufacturing defect, contamination). Labs track NCRs for supplier quality management, lot disposition, and regulatory reportin

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: Index kit supplier tracking. Enables supplier quality management for index-related issues (index hopping, low demux rates), performance evaluation, and supplier qualification. Removes denormalized man

attributes.name: validation_study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.validation_study. Business justification: Index sets are validated for use in multiplexed sequencing (cross-contamination testing, demultiplexing accuracy, color balance verification). Labs link index sets to validation studies for regulatory

attributes.name: adapter_sequence_read1
attributes.description: Full adapter sequence flanking the i7 index on the Read 1 side, used for adapter trimming in bioinformatics preprocessing pipelines. Stored in 5'→3' orientation per IUPAC convention.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Sample Sheet Specification; IUPAC Nucleotide Nomenclature

attributes.name: adapter_sequence_read2
attributes.description: Full adapter sequence flanking the i5 index on the Read 2 side, used for adapter trimming in paired-end bioinformatics preprocessing pipelines. Null for single-end or single-index configurations.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Sample Sheet Specification; IUPAC Nucleotide Nomenclature

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the index set was formally approved for production use by the sequencing operations quality authority. Null if not yet approved. Triggers availability for pool design and run scheduling.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.5 — Production and Service Provision; MasterControl — Document Approval Workflow; Veeva Vault QMS

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle and approval status of the index set within Genomics Biotech sequencing operations. 'pending_validation' = under internal validation; 'validated' = technically validated but not yet formally approved; 'approved' = approved for production use; 'deprecated' = superseded by a newer set, no new runs; 'retired' = fully decommissioned.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.5 — Production and Service Provision; Veeva Vault — Quality Document Control; MasterControl — Document Approval Workflow

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the quality authority or sequencing operations manager who granted formal production approval for this index set. Required for GxP and ISO 13485 audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 5.5 — Responsibility and Authority; Veeva Vault QMS; MasterControl — Approval Workflow

attributes.name: basespace_index_set_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub Index Set ID
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned to this index set within Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub. Enables direct cross-reference between the Genomics Biotech lakehouse master record and the operational sequencing data management platform for run configuration and demultiplexing.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Index Set Registry API

attributes.name: color_balance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the index set provides adequate color (fluorescence channel) balance across all sequencing cycles on two-channel or four-channel chemistry instruments. 'balanced' = no spike-in required; 'unbalanced' = color imbalance detected; 'requires_spike_in' = PhiX or other spike-in control is mandatory. Prevents base-calling failures on patterned flow cells.
attributes.references: Illumina Technical Note — Color Balance for Indexed Sequencing; Illumina NovaSeq/NextSeq System Guide

attributes.name: compatible_instruments
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of sequencing instrument models validated for use with this index set (e.g., 'NovaSeq 6000, NextSeq 550, MiSeq'). Ensures that run configuration and read cycle parameters are compatible with the index chemistry.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Instrument Compatibility; Illumina Instrument System Guides

attributes.name: compatible_library_prep_kits
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of library preparation kit names or catalogue numbers validated for use with this index set (e.g., 'TruSeq DNA PCR-Free, TruSeq Stranded mRNA, Nextera DNA Flex'). Managed by sequencing operations to prevent incompatible kit-index pairings during run setup.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Library Prep Compatibility Matrix; LabVantage LIMS — Reagent Compatibility

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this index set record was first created in the Genomics Biotech lakehouse data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and GxP record integrity requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2.4 — Control of Records; GxP Guidelines; ISO 27001 — Audit Logging

attributes.name: deprecation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the index set was deprecated or retired from active use. Null if still active. Used to enforce that no new sequencing runs are configured with deprecated index sets and to support historical traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2 — Document and Record Control; MasterControl — Change Control

attributes.name: gmp_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the index set was manufactured under Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) conditions as required for IVD or clinical use. True = GMP-manufactured; False = non-GMP (RUO grade). Drives quality management and supplier qualification requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820 — Quality System Regulation; ISO 13485 Section 7.5; GxP Guidelines

attributes.name: i5_sequence
attributes.description: Nucleotide sequence of the i5 (read 2 side) index used in dual-index configurations. Null or empty for single-index sets. Stored as a representative or consensus sequence; individual per-sample i5 sequences are tracked at the library level.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Sample Sheet Specification; IUPAC Nucleotide Nomenclature

attributes.name: i7_sequence
attributes.description: Nucleotide sequence of the i7 (read 1 side) index used for sample identification during demultiplexing. Stored as a representative or consensus sequence for the set; individual per-sample i7 sequences are tracked at the library level. Validated against IUPAC nucleotide codes.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Sample Sheet Specification; IUPAC Nucleotide Nomenclature

attributes.name: index_count
attributes.description: Total number of unique index sequences (barcodes) available in the set. Determines the maximum multiplexing capacity — i.e., the maximum number of samples that can be pooled in a single sequencing run using this index set.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Pool Design; Illumina Multiplexing Guidelines

attributes.name: index_length_bp
attributes.description: Length of the index sequence in base pairs (bp), typically 6, 8, 10, or 12 bp. Determines the read cycle configuration on the sequencer and affects the number of unique indices available in the set. Must match the sequencing run setup parameters.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Setup; Illumina Sequencing System Guide

attributes.name: index_type
attributes.description: Classification of the indexing strategy used in the set. 'single' = single-end index (i7 only); 'dual' = dual-index (i7 + i5, may be combinatorial); 'UDI' = Unique Dual Index (each sample has a unique i7+i5 pair, preventing index hopping); 'combinatorial' = combinatorial dual index (i7 and i5 drawn from independent pools). Critical for demultiplexing configuration and index-hopping risk assessment.
attributes.references: Illumina Technical Note — Indexed Sequencing Overview; SEQC2 Consortium Guidelines

attributes.name: intended_use
attributes.description: Regulatory intended use classification for the index set. 'RUO' = Research Use Only; 'IVD' = In Vitro Diagnostic; 'LDT' = Laboratory Developed Test; 'research' = internal research; 'clinical' = clinical genomics applications; 'agricultural' = agricultural genomics; 'both' = dual RUO and clinical use. Governs which workflows and regulatory submissions this index set may support. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RUO|IVD|LDT|research|clinical|agricultural|both — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820 — Quality System Regulation; IVDR EU 2017/746; ISO 13485 Section 7.3

attributes.name: lims_index_set_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Index Set ID
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this index set in LabVantage LIMS, the system of record for sample tracking and laboratory workflow management. Enables traceability between the lakehouse master record and LIMS-managed library preparation and pool design workflows.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Reagent and Index Management Module

attributes.name: max_multiplex_samples
attributes.description: Maximum number of samples that can be pooled (multiplexed) in a single sequencing run using this index set while maintaining the minimum Hamming distance threshold. Derived from the validated index set design; used in pool design planning and run capacity management.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Pool Design; Illumina Multiplexing Guidelines

attributes.name: min_hamming_distance
attributes.description: The minimum Hamming distance between any two index sequences within the set. A higher value (typically ≥3) reduces the risk of index misassignment during demultiplexing. Critical quality parameter for pool design validation and collision prevention.
attributes.references: Illumina Technical Note — Index Collision and Hamming Distance; SEQC2 Consortium Guidelines

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for sequencing operations scientists to record additional context, known limitations, special handling instructions, or validation observations for this index set that are not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Notes Field; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.4

attributes.name: phix_spike_in_pct
attributes.description: Recommended percentage of PhiX control library to spike into the pool when using this index set, to correct for color imbalance or low-diversity libraries. Expressed as a percentage of total library pool volume (e.g., 1.00, 5.00, 20.00). Zero if no spike-in is required.
attributes.references: Illumina Technical Note — PhiX Control Library; Illumina Sequencing System Guide

attributes.name: read_orientation
attributes.description: Specifies the orientation in which the i5 index is read on the sequencer. Critical for correct demultiplexing on instruments with different flow cell orientations (e.g., NovaSeq v1.5 flow cells require reverse complement of i5 vs. standard orientation). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: forward|reverse_complement|forward_reverse|reverse_complement_forward — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina Technical Note — Index Read Orientation; Illumina NovaSeq System Guide

attributes.name: regulatory_clearance_number
attributes.description: FDA 510(k) clearance number, CE-IVD certificate number, or equivalent regulatory authorization number if the index set is part of a cleared or approved IVD product. Null for RUO-only index sets. Required for regulatory submissions and audit trails.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 807 — 510(k) Premarket Notification; IVDR EU 2017/746 Article 26; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.4

attributes.name: sequencing_chemistry
attributes.description: The sequencing chemistry type for which this index set is designed. Determines color balance requirements and base-calling algorithm compatibility. 'two_channel' = Illumina two-channel SBS (e.g., NextSeq, NovaSeq); 'four_channel' = Illumina four-channel SBS (e.g., MiSeq, HiSeq); 'ion_semiconductor' = Ion Torrent; 'nanopore' = Oxford Nanopore; 'other' = other chemistry.
attributes.references: Illumina Technical Note — Sequencing Chemistry Overview; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: set_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code or catalogue number assigned to the index set by the manufacturer or internally by sequencing operations. Used as the business key for cross-system lookups and BOM references in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master; ISO 13485 Section 7.4

attributes.name: set_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the sequencing index set as defined by the manufacturer or sequencing operations team (e.g., 'Illumina TruSeq CD Index Set A', 'IDT xGen UDI-UMI Adapters'). Used as the primary display label in library preparation workflows and pool design tools.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Index Set Registry

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Manufacturer-specified shelf life of the index set reagents in months from the date of manufacture. Used for expiry tracking, inventory management, and ensuring reagents are not used beyond their validated stability window.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.5.5 — Preservation of Product; SAP S/4HANA MM — Batch Expiry Management; GxP Guidelines

attributes.name: sop_reference
attributes.description: Document number or identifier of the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) governing the use, handling, and storage of this index set. Links to the controlled document in MasterControl or Veeva Vault. Ensures procedural compliance during library preparation.
attributes.references: MasterControl — Document Control; Veeva Vault — SOP Management; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.3; GxP Guidelines

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: Required storage temperature for the index set reagents in degrees Celsius (e.g., -20.0, 4.0). Critical for reagent integrity, shelf-life compliance, and cold-chain management in the laboratory.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.5.5 — Preservation of Product; SAP S/4HANA MM — Warehouse Management; GxP Guidelines

attributes.name: superseded_by_set_code
attributes.description: Set code of the newer index set that replaces this one when it is deprecated. Enables migration guidance for sequencing operations teams transitioning from legacy to current index chemistries. Null if not superseded.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2 — Document and Record Control; MasterControl — Change Control

attributes.name: umi_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the index set includes Unique Molecular Identifiers (UMIs) integrated into the adapter design. UMIs enable PCR duplicate removal and error correction in downstream bioinformatics pipelines, critical for low-input and cfDNA applications.
attributes.references: Illumina Technical Note — UMI Sequencing; SEQC2 Consortium Guidelines

attributes.name: umi_length_bp
attributes.description: Length of the UMI sequence in base pairs when UMIs are included in the index set design (e.g., 8, 12 bp). Null if umi_included is False. Required for configuring UMI extraction steps in bioinformatics pipelines.
attributes.references: Illumina Technical Note — UMI Sequencing; Benchling R&D Notebook — Adapter Design

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this index set record in the Genomics Biotech lakehouse. Tracks the last modification event for change control, data freshness monitoring, and GxP audit trail compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2.4 — Control of Records; GxP Guidelines; ISO 27001 — Audit Logging

attributes.name: validated_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the sequencing operations scientist or engineer who performed and signed off on the internal technical validation of this index set. Supports GxP audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 5.5 — Responsibility and Authority; GxP Guidelines; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the index set completed internal technical validation by Genomics Biotech sequencing operations, confirming that demultiplexing performance, Hamming distance, and color balance meet acceptance criteria. Null if validation is pending.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.3.6 — Design and Development Verification; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the index set definition, following semantic versioning convention (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.1', 'v1.0.3'). Incremented when index sequences, Hamming distance parameters, or compatibility matrices are updated. Supports change control and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2 — Document and Record Control; MasterControl — Version Control
