attributes.description: Comma-separated list of sequencing instrument models validated for use with this protocol (e.g., 'NovaSeq 6000, NovaSeq X Plus, NextSeq 2000'). Ensures run parameters are only applied to compatible hardware. Validated against instrument qualification records in LabVantage LIMS.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Instrument Compatibility; ISO 13485 Section 6.3; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sequencing protocol record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. Populated automatically on insert and immutable thereafter. Supports GxP audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: GxP (Good Practice Regulations); FDA 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); ISO 13485 Section 4.2.4; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: demultiplexing_tool
attributes.description: Approved software tool used to demultiplex raw BCL files into per-sample FASTQ files for this protocol. Governs the bioinformatics pipeline entry point. BCL Convert is the current Illumina-recommended tool; DRAGEN provides accelerated on-instrument demultiplexing.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Demultiplexing Configuration; NGS Best Practices

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this protocol version became (or becomes) effective for use in sequencing operations. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_FROM category. Protocols may not be used in regulated runs before this date. Managed through GxP change control in MasterControl.
attributes.references: GxP (Good Practice Regulations); ISO 13485 Section 4.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; MasterControl

attributes.name: flow_cell_type
attributes.description: Specific flow cell cartridge type required by this protocol (e.g., 'S4 Flow Cell', 'SP Flow Cell', 'P2 Flow Cell', '25B Flow Cell'). Determines lane count, cluster capacity, and maximum data output. Must match the instrument model and run configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: S1|S2|S4|SP|P1|P2|P3|25B|nano — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Flow Cell Configuration; NGS Best Practices

attributes.name: gxp_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory practice classification applicable to runs executed under this protocol. GMP = Good Manufacturing Practice (production reagents); GLP = Good Laboratory Practice (non-clinical studies); GCP = Good Clinical Practice (clinical trials); non-GxP = research use. Determines documentation, validation, and audit requirements.
attributes.references: GxP (Good Practice Regulations); FDA 21 CFR Parts 210/211 (GMP); ICH E6 (GCP); OECD GLP Principles

attributes.name: index1_cycle_count
attributes.description: Number of cycles for the Index 1 (i7) read used in multiplexing to demultiplex samples on a shared flow cell. Typically 8 or 10 cycles. Required for all multiplexed library pools. Null for non-indexed single-sample runs.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Multiplexing Configuration; NGS Demultiplexing Standards

attributes.name: index2_cycle_count
attributes.description: Number of cycles for the Index 2 (i5) read used in dual-index multiplexing schemes. Typically 8 or 10 cycles. Null for single-index or non-indexed protocols. Dual indexing reduces index-hopping artifacts in high-multiplex runs.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Multiplexing Configuration; NGS Demultiplexing Standards

attributes.name: intended_use
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the protocol's intended use. RUO = Research Use Only; IVD = In Vitro Diagnostic (FDA-cleared); LDT = Laboratory Developed Test (CLIA-regulated); CE-IVD = EU Conformité Européenne In Vitro Diagnostic. Determines applicable regulatory framework, labeling requirements, and permissible clinical use.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820 (IVD); IVDR EU 2017/746 (CE-IVD); CLIA 42 CFR Part 493 (LDT); ISO 13485

attributes.name: max_cluster_density
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable cluster density on the flow cell surface in K/mm². Exceeding this threshold causes cluster overlap (over-clustering), degrading base call quality and Q30 scores. Paired with min_cluster_density to define the acceptable loading range.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Flow Cell QC; NGS Best Practices

attributes.name: max_insert_size_bp
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable DNA insert size in base pairs for library fragments. Inserts exceeding this threshold may indicate insufficient fragmentation, leading to reduced cluster density and read-through artifacts. Paired with min_insert_size_bp to define the acceptable library size range.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Library QC; NGS Library Preparation Best Practices; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: min_cluster_density
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable cluster density on the flow cell surface, expressed in thousands of clusters per square millimeter (K/mm²). Below this threshold, insufficient data yield is expected. Used as a pre-run and mid-run QC gate in Illumina BaseSpace.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Flow Cell QC; NGS Best Practices

attributes.name: min_insert_size_bp
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable DNA insert size in base pairs for library fragments sequenced under this protocol. Insert sizes below this threshold indicate over-fragmentation and may degrade paired-end alignment quality. Used as a library QC acceptance criterion in LabVantage LIMS.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Library QC; NGS Library Preparation Best Practices; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: min_q30_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable percentage of bases with a Phred quality score of 30 or higher (Q30), indicating ≥99.9% base call accuracy. Industry-standard QC gate for sequencing run acceptance. Runs falling below this threshold are flagged for investigation or resequencing. Typically ≥75% for most NGS applications.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — QC Metrics; Phred Score Standard; ISO 15189 Section 5.5

attributes.name: min_yield_gb
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable total sequencing data yield in gigabases (Gb) per run or per sample lane, as required to achieve the target coverage depth. Runs not meeting this threshold trigger a QC failure and potential resequencing. Derived from target coverage, genome size, and read length.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run QC; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: mismatch_tolerance
attributes.description: Number of allowable base mismatches in the index sequence during demultiplexing before a read is assigned to the 'undetermined' bin. Typically 0 or 1. Higher values increase sample assignment rates but risk index cross-contamination in high-multiplex pools.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Demultiplexing Parameters; NGS Best Practices

attributes.name: multiplexing_max_samples
attributes.description: Maximum number of samples that can be pooled and multiplexed on a single flow cell lane under this protocol while maintaining the target coverage depth per sample. Governs library pooling decisions in LabVantage LIMS and run planning in BaseSpace.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Multiplexing Guidelines; NGS (Next-Generation Sequencing) Best Practices

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the scientist or team lead responsible for maintaining and updating this sequencing protocol. The protocol owner initiates change control requests and is accountable for scientific validity. Sourced from Oracle Cloud HCM.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 5.5; GxP (Good Practice Regulations); Oracle Cloud HCM

attributes.name: phi_data_generated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Protected Health Information (PHI) Data Generated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether sequencing runs executed under this protocol generate Protected Health Information (PHI) as defined by HIPAA. True = PHI is generated (clinical patient samples); False = no PHI (research/RUO samples). Governs data handling, storage, and access control requirements for resulting FASTQ and downstream files.
attributes.references: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) 45 CFR Parts 160/164; GDPR Article 9 (Special Category Data); NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: protocol_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique code identifying this protocol and version (e.g., WGS-PCR-v2.1). Used as the business identifier across LIMS, BaseSpace, and regulatory submissions. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for MASTER_RESOURCE role.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Protocol Configuration; ISO 13485 Section 4.2

attributes.name: protocol_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the sequencing protocol (e.g., 'Whole Genome Sequencing PCR-Free 150bp Paired-End'). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL category for MASTER_RESOURCE role. Used in reporting, SOP references, and customer-facing documentation.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Protocol Configuration; MasterControl Document Control

attributes.name: r1_cycle_count
attributes.description: Number of sequencing cycles for Read 1 (R1), determining the read length in base pairs for the forward read. Common values include 75, 100, 150, 250 cycles. Directly impacts data quality, coverage, and FASTQ file size. Serves as the MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE category for MASTER_RESOURCE role.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Parameters; NGS (Next-Generation Sequencing) Best Practices

attributes.name: r2_cycle_count
attributes.description: Number of sequencing cycles for Read 2 (R2) in paired-end configurations. Null for single-end protocols. Must match R1 cycle count for symmetric paired-end runs or may differ for asymmetric configurations. Governs reverse read length in base pairs.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Parameters; NGS Best Practices

attributes.name: read_configuration
attributes.description: Specifies whether the sequencing run is configured for single-end or paired-end reads. Paired-end reads generate two reads per fragment (R1 and R2), improving alignment accuracy and variant calling. Directly governs flow cell programming and FASTQ output structure.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Configuration; NGS Best Practices

attributes.name: reference_genome_build
attributes.description: Standard reference genome assembly version used for alignment and variant calling under this protocol (e.g., GRCh38 for human, GRCm39 for mouse). Ensures reproducibility and comparability of genomic results across runs and cohorts. Aligns with NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy requirements.
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; NCBI Reference Sequence Database; ACMG Variant Interpretation Standards

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date on which this protocol version was retired or superseded and is no longer approved for new sequencing runs. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category. Null for currently active protocols. Historical runs executed under this protocol remain valid after retirement.
attributes.references: GxP (Good Practice Regulations); ISO 13485 Section 4.2; MasterControl Document Control

attributes.name: sequencing_application_type
attributes.description: Classification of the genomic sequencing application this protocol supports. Serves as the CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category for MASTER_RESOURCE role. Drives downstream bioinformatics pipeline selection and QC thresholds. WGS = Whole Genome Sequencing; WES = Whole Exome Sequencing; RNA-seq = RNA Sequencing.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Configuration; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: sequencing_protocol_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the sequencing protocol, including its scientific rationale, key distinguishing parameters, intended sample types, and any special handling requirements. Authored by the protocol owner and reviewed during the GxP approval process.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2; MasterControl Document Control; Benchling R&D Notebook

attributes.name: sop_version
attributes.description: Version of the SOP document referenced by sop_document_id that is current and approved for use with this protocol version. Ensures the protocol record is always linked to the correct procedural revision, supporting GxP change control.
attributes.references: GxP (Good Practice Regulations); ISO 13485 Section 4.2.3; MasterControl Document Control

attributes.name: strand_specificity
attributes.description: Specifies the strand orientation of the sequencing library for RNA-seq and methylation protocols. Unstranded = no strand information preserved; Forward = sense strand; Reverse = antisense strand. Critical for accurate transcript quantification and differential expression analysis. Null for DNA-based protocols.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — RNA-seq Configuration; ENCODE RNA-seq Standards

attributes.name: superseded_by_protocol_code
attributes.description: Protocol code of the newer version that replaces this protocol upon retirement. Null for the current active version. Enables forward navigation in the protocol version chain for change control traceability and migration of active runs.
attributes.references: GxP (Good Practice Regulations); ISO 13485 Section 4.2.3; MasterControl Document Control

attributes.name: target_coverage_depth
attributes.description: Recommended mean sequencing coverage depth (in X, e.g., 30X for WGS, 100X for WES) required to meet analytical sensitivity thresholds for this protocol. Used to calculate required cluster density and flow cell loading. Governs pass/fail criteria for sequencing run QC.
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; ACMG Sequencing Standards; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: target_panel_bed_file
attributes.description: File path or artifact identifier for the BED (Browser Extensible Data) file defining the genomic target regions for targeted panel or WES protocols. Null for WGS protocols. Used by bioinformatics pipelines for on-target coverage calculation and variant calling region restriction. Stored in genomic artifact repository.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Panel Configuration; UCSC Genome Browser BED Format Standard; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this sequencing protocol record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated automatically on every write. Supports change detection, incremental ETL processing, and GxP audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: GxP (Good Practice Regulations); FDA 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); ISO 13485 Section 4.2.4

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Semantic version number of the sequencing protocol (e.g., 2.1.0). Incremented upon any approved change to run parameters, kit compatibility, or QC thresholds. Supports GxP change control traceability.
attributes.references: GxP (Good Practice Regulations); ISO 13485 Section 4.2.3 — Document Control; MasterControl

products.name: run_sample_sheet
products.description: Transactional record representing the sample sheet submitted to configure a sequencing run on an Illumina instrument. Captures sample sheet format version (v1/v2), associated run and instrument, flow cell type, operator, submission timestamp, sample manifest (sample IDs, index assignments, project groupings), override cycles string, adapter sequences, application settings, and validation status. The sample sheet is the authoritative GxP-controlled input document that drives both instrument run setup and downstream demultiplexing configuration.

attributes.name: run_sample_sheet_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the run sample sheet record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this transactional entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing instrument (e.g., NovaSeq, NextSeq, MiSeq) on which this sample sheet is loaded and executed. Drives instrument-specific configuration parameters.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Instrument Registry

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory operator or scientist who submitted and authorized the sample sheet for the sequencing run. Required for GxP audit trail and operator accountability under CLIA and GMP regulations.
attributes.references: GxP (GMP/GLP); CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ISO 13485 Section 6.2

attributes.name: flow_cell_id
attributes.description: The unique serial or barcode identifier of the physical flow cell cartridge used in this sequencing run. Enables traceability from sample sheet to physical consumable for GxP lot tracking and COA reconciliation.
attributes.references: GxP Traceability; ISO 13485 Section 7.5; SAP S/4HANA MM — Batch Management

attributes.name: sequencing_protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sequencing.sequencing_protocol. Business justification: Sample sheets configure sequencing runs according to approved protocols. run_sample_sheet currently has application_type, read_type, and cycle counts but no FK to sequencing_protocol. Adding sequencin

attributes.name: sequencing_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing run that this sample sheet configures. Links the sample sheet to the parent run record in the sequencing domain.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Management

attributes.name: adapter_read1
attributes.description: The adapter sequence to be trimmed from the 3' end of Read 1 during BCLConvert processing (e.g., AGATCGGAAGAGCACACGTCTGAACTCCAGTCA for TruSeq). Correct adapter specification is critical for accurate read trimming and downstream alignment quality.
attributes.references: Illumina Adapter Sequences Document; Illumina BCLConvert User Guide

attributes.name: adapter_read2
attributes.description: The adapter sequence to be trimmed from the 3' end of Read 2 in paired-end runs (e.g., AGATCGGAAGAGCGTCGTGTAGGGAAAGAGTGT for TruSeq). Null for single-end runs. Must match the library preparation kit adapter chemistry.
attributes.references: Illumina Adapter Sequences Document; Illumina BCLConvert User Guide

attributes.name: application_type
attributes.description: The genomic sequencing application configured for this run. Drives pipeline selection, adapter trimming, and analysis settings. Examples: WGS (Whole Genome Sequencing), WES (Whole Exome Sequencing), Targeted Panel, Amplicon, RNA-Seq, Methylation, 16S rRNA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WGS|WES|Targeted Panel|Amplicon|RNA-Seq|Methylation|16S rRNA|Custom — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina Application Notes; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Genomics Checklist

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the sample sheet received final approval (electronic signature) for use in a GxP-controlled sequencing run. Distinct from submission timestamp; captures the authorization event in the document lifecycle.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GxP Audit Trail; Veeva Vault Quality Management; ISO 13485 Section 4.2

attributes.name: basespace_run_code
attributes.description: The unique run identifier assigned by Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub upon run registration or upload. Enables direct cross-reference between the internal data platform record and the BaseSpace cloud environment for FASTQ retrieval and run monitoring.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub API; Illumina Run Monitoring Documentation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this run sample sheet record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking per GxP and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GxP Electronic Records; ISO 27001

attributes.name: demultiplexing_software
attributes.description: The software tool configured to process this sample sheet for demultiplexing BCL files into per-sample FASTQ files. Options include BCLConvert (current Illumina standard), bcl2fastq (legacy), or DRAGEN (on-instrument or cloud). Determines compatible sample sheet sections and parameter keys.
attributes.references: Illumina BCLConvert User Guide; Illumina DRAGEN Documentation; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: demultiplexing_software_version
attributes.description: Version string of the demultiplexing software (BCLConvert, bcl2fastq, or DRAGEN) specified in the sample sheet settings. Critical for reproducibility, pipeline validation, and regulatory submission documentation.
attributes.references: Illumina BCLConvert Release Notes; GxP Software Validation; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: electronic_signature
attributes.description: The electronic signature identifier or hash of the authorized signatory who approved this sample sheet for GxP-controlled runs. Required under 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records in regulated environments. Stored as a reference token, not the raw signature credential.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records and Signatures; GxP Document Control; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: experiment_name
attributes.description: The experiment identifier or label captured in the [Header] section of the Illumina sample sheet. Provides a human-readable label for the run experiment, used for BaseSpace project organization and LIMS cross-referencing.
attributes.references: Illumina Sample Sheet Header Specification; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: flow_cell_type
attributes.description: The specific flow cell cartridge type loaded on the instrument for this run (e.g., SP, S1, S2, S4 for NovaSeq; P1, P2, P3 for NovaSeq X; High Output, Mid Output for NextSeq). Determines lane count, cluster density, and total output capacity.
attributes.references: Illumina Flow Cell Specifications; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: gxp_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sample sheet is subject to GxP (Good Practice Regulations) document control requirements, including version control, electronic signature, and audit trail obligations under 21 CFR Part 11 and applicable GMP/GLP/GCP frameworks.
attributes.references: GxP (GMP/GLP/GCP); 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Electronic Records; ISO 13485 Section 4.2

attributes.name: index1_cycles
attributes.description: Number of cycles for Index 1 (i7 index read) used in multiplexed library demultiplexing. Typically 8 or 10 cycles. Determines the length of the i7 barcode sequence read during the indexing phase.
attributes.references: Illumina Dual-Index Sequencing Guide; Illumina Sample Sheet v2 Specification

attributes.name: index2_cycles
attributes.description: Number of cycles for Index 2 (i5 index read) used in dual-indexed multiplexed library demultiplexing. Typically 8 or 10 cycles. Null for single-indexed runs. Required for dual-index demultiplexing workflows.
attributes.references: Illumina Dual-Index Sequencing Guide; Illumina Sample Sheet v2 Specification

attributes.name: index_adapter_kit
attributes.description: The specific index adapter kit used for multiplexing (e.g., IDT for Illumina DNA/RNA UD Indexes, Nextera DNA CD Indexes). Defines the index sequence set and ensures correct barcode assignment during demultiplexing.
attributes.references: Illumina Index Adapter Kit Documentation; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: instrument_platform
attributes.description: The Illumina sequencing instrument platform model for which this sample sheet is configured. Determines supported flow cell types, read lengths, and chemistry parameters. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NovaSeq 6000|NovaSeq X|NextSeq 550|NextSeq 2000|MiSeq|HiSeq 4000|iSeq 100 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina Instrument Specifications; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: investigator_name
attributes.description: Name of the principal investigator or study lead responsible for the samples in this run. Captured in the [Header] section of the Illumina sample sheet. Used for accountability, reporting, and GxP traceability.
attributes.references: Illumina Sample Sheet Header Specification; GxP Audit Trail; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: lane_count
attributes.description: Number of flow cell lanes configured in this sample sheet. Determines how samples are distributed across lanes for multiplexing. Varies by flow cell type (e.g., 2 lanes for SP, 4 lanes for S2/S4 on NovaSeq 6000).
attributes.references: Illumina Flow Cell Lane Configuration Guide; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: library_prep_kit
attributes.description: The name and version of the library preparation kit used to prepare samples for sequencing (e.g., Illumina DNA Prep, TruSeq DNA PCR-Free, Nextera DNA Flex). Determines adapter sequences, index compatibility, and recommended run parameters.
attributes.references: Illumina Library Prep Kit Documentation; LabVantage LIMS — Library Preparation Workflow

attributes.name: lims_request_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Request ID
attributes.description: The work order or sequencing request identifier from LabVantage LIMS that initiated this sample sheet. Provides bidirectional traceability between the sample sheet and the originating laboratory workflow request.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Sequencing Request Management; ISO 15189 Section 5.4

attributes.name: mask_short_reads
attributes.description: The MaskShortReads BCLConvert setting specifying the read length threshold below which reads are masked (replaced with Ns) rather than discarded. Complements minimum_trimmed_read_length to control short-read handling behavior in FASTQ output.
attributes.references: Illumina BCLConvert User Guide — MaskShortReads Parameter

attributes.name: minimum_trimmed_read_length
attributes.description: The MinimumTrimmedReadLength BCLConvert setting specifying the minimum acceptable read length (in base pairs) after adapter trimming. Reads shorter than this threshold are discarded. Impacts FASTQ output quality and downstream alignment performance.
attributes.references: Illumina BCLConvert User Guide — MinimumTrimmedReadLength Parameter

attributes.name: override_cycles_string
attributes.description: The OverrideCycles parameter string in Illumina sample sheet v2 format (e.g., 'Y151;I8;I8;Y151') that explicitly defines the cycle allocation for each read and index segment. Overrides default cycle settings and is used by BCLConvert for precise demultiplexing configuration.
attributes.references: Illumina BCLConvert User Guide; Illumina Sample Sheet v2 Specification

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: The project or study name associated with the samples in this sample sheet. Used for grouping FASTQ output files by project in BaseSpace and downstream bioinformatics pipelines. Maps to the 'Sample_Project' column in the sample manifest.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Project Management; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: read1_cycles
attributes.description: Number of sequencing cycles for Read 1 (forward read). Directly determines the read length in base pairs for the primary read. Typical values range from 50 to 300 cycles depending on application and instrument platform.
attributes.references: Illumina Sample Sheet v2 Specification — [Reads] Section; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: read2_cycles
attributes.description: Number of sequencing cycles for Read 2 (reverse read) in paired-end runs. Null for single-end runs. Must match Read 1 cycles for symmetric paired-end configurations or may differ for asymmetric designs.
attributes.references: Illumina Sample Sheet v2 Specification — [Reads] Section; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: read_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the sequencing run is configured as single-end (one read direction) or paired-end (forward and reverse reads). Paired-end reads improve alignment accuracy and are standard for WGS and WES applications.
attributes.references: Illumina Sequencing Technology Guide; NGS Best Practices

attributes.name: reagent_kit_lot_number
attributes.description: The lot number (LOT) of the sequencing reagent kit used for this run. Critical for GxP traceability, COA verification, and investigation of run failures attributable to reagent quality. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA QM batch records.
attributes.references: GMP Lot Traceability; ISO 13485 Section 7.5.3; SAP S/4HANA QM; COA Standards

attributes.name: run_sample_sheet_description
attributes.description: Free-text description field from the [Header] section of the Illumina sample sheet. May include run purpose, special instructions, or notes relevant to the sequencing configuration. Supports operational context for lab staff.

attributes.name: sample_count
attributes.description: Total number of samples listed in the sample manifest section of this sample sheet. Represents the multiplexing depth for the run. Used for capacity planning, lane loading calculations, and demultiplexing validation.
attributes.references: Illumina Multiplexing Guidelines; LabVantage LIMS — Sample Tracking

attributes.name: sample_sheet_format_version
attributes.description: Version of the Illumina sample sheet format used (v1 or v2). v2 supports multi-section configuration including [Header], [Reads], [BCLConvert_Settings], and [BCLConvert_Data] sections. Determines downstream demultiplexing compatibility and parser behavior.
attributes.references: Illumina Sample Sheet v2 Specification; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: sample_sheet_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title assigned to the sample sheet file, typically following the Illumina naming convention (e.g., SampleSheet_RunID_YYYYMMDD). Serves as the externally-known business identifier for this document. Aligns with Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub sample sheet naming standards.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Sample Sheet Specification

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the sample sheet was submitted to the instrument or uploaded to Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; GxP Audit Trail Requirements; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this run sample sheet record. Supports change tracking and GxP audit trail requirements for controlled documents.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GxP Electronic Records; ISO 13485 Section 4.2

attributes.name: use_type
attributes.description: Regulatory intended use classification for the samples in this run. RUO (Research Use Only) indicates non-clinical research; IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic) indicates regulated diagnostic use; LDT (Laboratory Developed Test) indicates a lab-specific validated test; GMP indicates manufacturing-grade production run.
attributes.references: FDA IVD Regulations 21 CFR Part 809; IVDR EU 2017/746; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ISO 13485

attributes.name: validation_error_summary
attributes.description: Free-text summary of validation errors or warnings identified during automated sample sheet validation (e.g., index collision detected, invalid cycle count, missing required fields). Populated when validation_status is 'failed_validation'. Supports rapid troubleshooting by lab operators.
attributes.references: Illumina BCLConvert Validation Rules; LabVantage LIMS QC Workflow; GxP Non-Conformance Handling

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle and validation state of the sample sheet. 'draft' indicates in-preparation; 'pending_validation' awaiting automated or manual QC check; 'validated' passed all checks and approved for run execution; 'failed_validation' contains errors blocking run start; 'superseded' replaced by a corrected version; 'cancelled' withdrawn before use. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_validation|validated|failed_validation|superseded|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GxP Document Control; ISO 13485 Section 4.2; 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault Quality Management

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Document version number of this sample sheet (e.g., v1.0, v1.1, v2.0). Incremented upon each revision or correction. Supports GxP document version control and supersession tracking. The combination of sample_sheet_name and version_number uniquely identifies a document revision.
attributes.references: GxP Document Control; ISO 13485 Section 4.2; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl Document Control

products.name: run_failure_event
products.description: Transactional record documenting a sequencing run failure or abort event. Captures failure event ID, run ID, failure category (instrument error, reagent failure, sample quality, operator error, software error), failure code, failure description, cycle at which failure occurred, affected lanes, estimated data loss (Gb), corrective action taken, rerun required flag, CAPA reference, and resolution timestamp. Feeds into quality management and instrument reliability tracking. Supports GxP deviation management.

attributes.name: run_failure_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each sequencing run failure or abort event record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this transactional entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 8.3 — Control of Nonconforming Product; GxP Deviation Management

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing instrument on which the failed run was executed. Supports instrument reliability tracking, mean time between failures (MTBF) analysis, and preventive maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.6 — Control of Monitoring and Measuring Equipment; GxP Equipment Qualification

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory operator or technician who initiated or was responsible for the failed sequencing run. Required for GxP deviation management and operator error root-cause analysis.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493 — Personnel Requirements; GxP Good Laboratory Practice

attributes.name: flow_cell_id
attributes.description: Reference to the flow cell loaded on the instrument during the failed run. Supports flow cell lot-level failure trending, reagent quality investigation, and consumable reliability analysis.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Flow Cell Object; LabVantage LIMS Consumable Tracking

attributes.name: primary_sequencing_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing run that experienced the failure or abort event. Links this failure record to the parent run entity for traceability and root-cause analysis.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Object; LabVantage LIMS Run Tracking

attributes.name: support_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.support_case. Business justification: Run failures generate customer support cases for service labs. Links failure events to customer incident tracking, CAPA, rerun coordination, and SLA impact assessment. Essential for customer-facing op

attributes.name: affected_lanes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or range notation of flow cell lane numbers affected by the failure event (e.g., '1,2,3' or '1-4' or 'ALL'). Enables partial-lane failure analysis and assessment of sample impact scope. Null if failure affected the entire flow cell uniformly.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Flow Cell Lane Metrics; NGS Flow Cell Architecture

attributes.name: affected_sample_count
attributes.description: Number of samples whose sequencing data was lost or compromised as a result of this failure event. Drives impact assessment, customer notification decisions, and rerun prioritization. Sourced from the pool/library manifest associated with the failed run.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Sample Impact Assessment; ISO 15189 Section 5.8 — Reporting of Results

attributes.name: basespace_run_code
attributes.description: The run identifier assigned by Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub for the failed run. Enables direct cross-reference to the BaseSpace run record for diagnostic log retrieval, run metrics review, and support case filing with Illumina.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Object Identifier; NGS Data Management Integration

attributes.name: capa_reference
attributes.description: Reference number linking this failure event to a formal Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) record in the quality management system (e.g., Veeva Vault). Null if no formal CAPA was initiated. Supports GxP deviation-to-CAPA traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 8.5.2 — Corrective Action; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100 — CAPA; Veeva Vault Quality Management

attributes.name: cluster_density_at_failure
attributes.description: Flow cell cluster density (in thousands of clusters per mm²) measured at or near the time of failure. Abnormal cluster density (too high or too low) is a key diagnostic indicator for library preparation issues, loading concentration errors, or flow cell defects.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Cluster Density Metrics; NGS Library Preparation QC Standards

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken
attributes.description: Free-text description of the immediate corrective action taken in response to the failure event (e.g., instrument restart, reagent replacement, operator retraining). Distinct from the formal CAPA process; captures the on-the-spot remediation steps.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 8.5.2 — Corrective Action; GxP Deviation Management; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this run failure event record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for audit trail and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2.5 — Control of Records; GxP Audit Trail Requirements; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: customer_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the customer or project owner was formally notified of the failure event. Used to measure notification turnaround time (TAT) against SLA commitments and regulatory reporting timelines.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Customer Communication Timestamp; ISO 13485 Section 7.2.3; SLA TAT Measurement

attributes.name: customer_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer or project owner was formally notified of the sequencing run failure and its impact on their samples or data deliverables. Supports SLA compliance tracking and customer communication audit trails.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Customer Communication Log; ISO 13485 Section 7.2.3 — Customer Communication; SLA Management

attributes.name: deviation_report_number
attributes.description: Formal deviation report number assigned in the quality management system (e.g., Veeva Vault) for this failure event. Distinct from the CAPA reference; the deviation report documents the non-conformance event itself, while CAPA tracks the systemic corrective action.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 8.3 — Control of Nonconforming Product; Veeva Vault Deviation Management; GxP Deviation Reporting

attributes.name: downtime_duration_min
attributes.description: Total duration of instrument downtime in minutes attributable to this failure event, from failure detection to instrument return-to-service. Key input for instrument availability KPI calculation, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) reporting, and maintenance cost analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 7.6 — Equipment Maintenance; GxP Instrument Qualification; OEE Industry Standard

attributes.name: estimated_data_loss_gb
attributes.description: Estimated volume of sequencing data (in gigabases, Gb) lost as a result of the failure event. Calculated based on cycles completed, affected lanes, and expected yield per lane. Key metric for assessing business impact and prioritizing rerun decisions. Serves as the QUANTITATIVE_RESULT for this non-monetary transaction.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Yield Metrics; NGS Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: failure_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the root cause category for the sequencing run failure. Used for trend analysis, quality KPI reporting, and directing corrective action. Categories align with standard GxP deviation classification taxonomy.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 8.5.2; GxP Deviation Classification; FDA 21 CFR Part 820 — Quality System Regulation

attributes.name: failure_code
attributes.description: Structured alphanumeric code identifying the specific failure mode within the failure category. Sourced from the instrument error code library or quality management system codebook (e.g., INS-00142, REA-00031). Enables precise failure mode trending and FMEA alignment.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Instrument Error Codes; ISO 13485 Section 8.3; FMEA Best Practices

attributes.name: failure_cycle
attributes.description: The sequencing cycle number at which the failure or abort event occurred during the run. Critical for diagnosing instrument or chemistry issues at specific cycle positions (e.g., early cycles vs. late cycles). Null if failure occurred before sequencing commenced.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Cycle Metrics; NGS Run Quality Monitoring

attributes.name: failure_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the sequencing run failure event, including observed symptoms, error messages, and contextual details captured at the time of detection. Supports root-cause investigation and deviation report authoring.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 8.3; GxP Deviation Report Content Requirements; Veeva Vault Quality Event Description

attributes.name: failure_detected_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the sequencing run failure or abort event was detected or reported. This is the principal real-world business event timestamp (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP) for this transaction, distinct from record audit timestamps.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 8.3; GxP Deviation Management — Event Date/Time Recording

attributes.name: failure_event_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this failure event, used in deviation reports, CAPA references, and quality management system cross-references (e.g., RFE-20240315-0042). Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this transaction.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 8.3; Veeva Vault Quality Event Numbering; GxP Deviation Management

attributes.name: failure_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the failure event record within the quality management workflow. Tracks progression from initial detection through investigation, resolution, and closure. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this transaction.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 8.5.2 — Corrective Action; Veeva Vault Quality Management; GxP Deviation Lifecycle

attributes.name: gxp_impacting
attributes.description: Indicates whether this failure event occurred in a GxP-regulated context (e.g., GMP, GLP, GCP) and therefore requires formal deviation management, CAPA, and regulatory documentation per applicable GxP guidelines. Drives regulatory reporting workflow routing.
attributes.references: GxP Good Practice Regulations; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; ICH Q10; ISO 13485 Section 8.3

attributes.name: instrument_error_message
attributes.description: Verbatim error message or fault code string reported by the sequencing instrument at the time of failure. Sourced directly from instrument logs or Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub run diagnostics. Essential for instrument engineering root-cause analysis.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Instrument Diagnostics Log; GxP Instrument Qualification Records

attributes.name: ivd_run
attributes.description: Indicates whether the failed sequencing run was performed as part of an In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) or Clinical Laboratory Developed Test (LDT) workflow, as opposed to a Research Use Only (RUO) application. Determines applicable regulatory reporting obligations (FDA, IVDR, CLIA).
attributes.references: FDA IVD Regulation 21 CFR Part 809; EU IVDR 2017/746; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ISO 13485

attributes.name: lims_event_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Event ID
attributes.description: The event or non-conformance record identifier from LabVantage LIMS corresponding to this failure event. Supports bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational LIMS system of record.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Non-Conformance Event Tracking; ISO 15189 Section 4.9 — Control of Nonconforming Work

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or observations recorded by the investigator, quality team, or instrument engineer during the failure event lifecycle. Captures supplementary context not covered by structured fields, such as environmental conditions, shift notes, or escalation history.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2.5 — Control of Records; GxP Deviation Investigation Notes

attributes.name: phred_score_at_failure
attributes.description: The mean Phred base quality score (Q-score) recorded at the cycle of failure or at the last completed quality checkpoint before failure. Provides quantitative evidence of data quality degradation leading up to the failure event. Null if failure occurred before quality metrics were generated.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Quality Metrics; NGS Phred Score Standard (Ewing & Green, 1998); ISO 15189

attributes.name: reagent_lot_number
attributes.description: Lot number of the sequencing reagent kit used during the failed run. Critical for reagent failure root-cause analysis, lot-level quality investigations, and supplier corrective action requests. Aligns with GMP lot traceability requirements.
attributes.references: GMP 21 CFR Part 211 — Lot Traceability; ISO 13485 Section 7.5.3 — Traceability; SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management

attributes.name: rerun_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the failed sequencing run must be repeated to recover the lost data or meet the required coverage depth and quality thresholds. Drives rerun scheduling, resource allocation, and customer communication workflows.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Run Requeue Workflow; NGS Quality Management SOP

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the failure event was formally resolved and the record was closed in the quality management system. Used to calculate mean time to resolution (MTTR) and compliance with deviation closure SLA targets.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 8.5.2; GxP Deviation Closure Requirements; Veeva Vault Quality Event Closure

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Confirmed root cause category determined after investigation of the failure event. Distinct from failure_category (which is the initial classification at detection); this field is populated after root-cause analysis is complete. Aligns with standard fishbone/Ishikawa root cause taxonomy.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 8.5.2; ICH Q10 Root Cause Analysis; FDA CAPA Root Cause Classification

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the confirmed root cause identified through formal investigation. Populated after root-cause analysis is completed. Supports CAPA authoring, regulatory submission documentation, and institutional knowledge capture.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 8.5.2; Veeva Vault Root Cause Analysis Documentation; GxP Investigation Reports

attributes.name: sample_quality_issue
attributes.description: Indicates whether a sample quality problem (e.g., degraded DNA, low input concentration, contamination) was identified as a contributing factor to the run failure. Supports sample management quality trending and upstream LIMS feedback.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Sample QC Flags; ISO 15189 Section 5.4 — Pre-examination Processes

attributes.name: servicenow_ticket_number
attributes.description: Reference to the ServiceNow incident or field service ticket created to manage the instrument repair or technical support response associated with this failure event. Enables cross-system traceability between quality events and IT/field service workflows.
attributes.references: ServiceNow IT Service Management — Incident Management; ISO 13485 Section 7.6 — Equipment Maintenance

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Severity classification of the failure event based on its impact on data quality, patient safety, regulatory compliance, and business operations. Drives escalation workflows, notification requirements, and CAPA prioritization.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 8.3; ICH Q10 — Pharmaceutical Quality System; FDA 21 CFR Part 820 — Risk-Based Classification

attributes.name: software_version
attributes.description: Version of the instrument control software or run control application active at the time of the failure event. Required for software error root-cause analysis and version-specific defect tracking.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Software Version Metadata; GxP Computer System Validation (CSV)

attributes.name: total_cycles_planned
attributes.description: The total number of sequencing cycles that were planned for the run at the time of setup. Used in conjunction with failure_cycle to calculate the proportion of the run completed before failure, informing data loss estimation.
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub — Run Setup Parameters; NGS Read Length Configuration

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this run failure event record was last modified. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for audit trail and change tracking purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 Section 4.2.5 — Control of Records; GxP Audit Trail Requirements; SOX Section 404

products.name: file_quality_evaluation
products.description: This association product represents the Quality Evaluation event between fastq_file and quality_rule. It captures the execution and results of automated data quality checks applied to FASTQ files during bioinformatics pipeline processing. Each record links one FASTQ file to one quality rule execution with measured values, pass/fail status, and pipeline version context that exist only at the intersection of a specific file being evaluated against a specific rule.. Existence Justification: In genomics bioinformatics operations, each FASTQ file is evaluated against multiple quality rules (minimum read count, Q30 threshold, contamination detection, duplication rate limits, adapter content checks), and each quality rule is applied to many FASTQ files as they are generated. The business actively manages these quality evaluation results as operational records - bioinformatics teams query which files failed which rules, track pass rates over time, and trigger remediation workflows based on specific rule failures.

attributes.name: file_quality_evaluation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this quality evaluation execution record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: fastq_file_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: File Quality Evaluation - Fastq File Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the FASTQ file being evaluated in this quality check execution

attributes.name: quality_rule_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: File Quality Evaluation - Quality Rule Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the quality rule definition applied in this evaluation

attributes.name: evaluated_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the system, service, or user that executed this quality evaluation. Typically an automated pipeline service account, but may be a bioinformatician for manual QC review.

attributes.name: execution_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The time in seconds required to execute this quality rule against this FASTQ file. Used for pipeline performance monitoring and optimization.

attributes.name: failure_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of why this rule failed or produced a warning for this file. Populated when rule_result is FAIL or WARNING. Supports troubleshooting and remediation.

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: The actual measured metric value from this FASTQ file that was compared against the rule threshold. For example, if rule checks minimum read count, this is the actual read count observed. Unit and interpretation depend on the rule type.

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this file passed this specific quality rule. True = passed, False = failed. Simplified binary version of rule_result for filtering and aggregation.

attributes.name: pipeline_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the bioinformatics QC pipeline that executed this rule evaluation. Enables tracking of rule results across pipeline version changes and supports reproducibility.

attributes.name: remediation_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of any automated or manual remediation action taken in response to this rule failure. Examples: file re-sequenced, sample flagged for review, data excluded from analysis.

attributes.name: rule_execution_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this quality rule was executed against this FASTQ file. Tracks when the evaluation occurred in the pipeline workflow.

attributes.name: rule_result
attributes.description: The outcome of this quality rule evaluation. PASS = rule criteria met, FAIL = rule criteria not met, WARNING = borderline result, ERROR = execution error, SKIPPED = rule not applicable to this file type.

attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Accreditation; LabVantage LIMS; ISO 15189

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the specimen was received and accessioned into the Genomics Biotech laboratory, recorded in LabVantage LIMS. Used to calculate transit time, pre-analytical cold-chain compliance, and TAT (Turnaround Time) SLA metrics.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Section 5.4; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493.1241; CAP Accreditation; LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Coded reason for specimen rejection at accessioning or QC review. Populated only when lifecycle_status is 'rejected'. Used for pre-analytical quality monitoring, root cause analysis, and SOP improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: insufficient_volume|hemolyzed|lipemic|clotted|wrong_container|mislabeled|temperature_excursion|expired|contaminated|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Section 5.4.6; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493.1241; CAP Checklist; CLSI GP44-A4

attributes.name: rin_score
attributes.description: RNA Integrity Number (RIN) score on a scale of 1-10 as measured by Bioanalyzer or TapeStation, indicating RNA quality. A RIN score ≥7 is typically required for RNA-Seq library preparation. Null for non-RNA specimens.
attributes.references: Agilent Bioanalyzer RIN Standard; ISO 15189; CLSI MM13-A; Illumina RNA-Seq Guidelines

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Classification of the biological material type collected from the subject. Drives downstream workflow routing, extraction protocols, and storage conditions in LabVantage LIMS. Serves as the CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: blood|tissue|saliva|urine|plasma|cfDNA|FFPE|bone_marrow|buccal_swab|stool|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SNOMED CT Specimen Hierarchy; HL7 FHIR R4 Specimen.type; ISO 15189; CAP Checklist

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Coded identifier for the physical storage location of the specimen within the biorepository (e.g., freezer ID, rack, shelf, box, position). Enables physical retrieval, inventory management, and chain-of-custody tracking in LabVantage LIMS.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; ISO 20387 (Biobanking); CAP Biorepository Checklist

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: Required or actual storage temperature for the specimen in degrees Celsius (e.g., -80, -20, 4, 25). Used for cold-chain compliance monitoring, specimen integrity assessment, and deviation management.
attributes.references: ISO 20387; ISO 15189; CAP Biorepository Checklist; CLSI GP44-A4

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Further granular classification of the specimen within its primary type (e.g., for blood: whole_blood, PBMC, serum; for tissue: fresh_frozen, FFPE_block, FFPE_section; for cfDNA: cell_free_plasma). Enables precise protocol selection and QC thresholds in bioinformatics pipelines.
attributes.references: SNOMED CT; HL7 FHIR R4 Specimen.type; CAP Checklist; ISO 15189

attributes.name: tumor_content_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of tumor cells (neoplastic cellularity) in the specimen as assessed by pathology review. Critical for somatic variant calling sensitivity, LOD (Limit of Detection) calculations, and clinical oncology reporting. Null for non-oncology specimens.
attributes.references: CAP Oncology Checklist; ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; College of American Pathologists

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the specimen record was most recently modified in LabVantage LIMS or the data lakehouse. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trail compliance, and Silver layer incremental processing in Databricks.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; GxP; SOX; ISO 27001; LabVantage LIMS; Databricks Delta Lake

attributes.name: use_restriction_code
attributes.description: Coded data use restriction applicable to this specimen and its derived genomic data, aligned with GA4GH Data Use Ontology (DUO) codes (e.g., GRU: General Research Use, HMB: Health/Medical/Biomedical, DS: Disease-Specific). Governs permissible downstream research and data sharing activities.
attributes.references: GA4GH Data Use Ontology (DUO); NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GDPR Article 9; HIPAA

attributes.name: use_type
attributes.description: Intended use classification for the specimen: clinical diagnostic testing (IVD), research (RUO), internal QC (Quality Control), assay validation, proficiency testing (CAP/CLIA), or Research Use Only (RUO). Determines applicable regulatory framework, data handling requirements, and reporting obligations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Accreditation; ISO 13485; IVDR 2017/746

attributes.name: volume_ul
attributes.description: Volume of the specimen in microliters (µL) at the time of accessioning or most recent measurement. Used for aliquot planning, minimum volume QC checks, and assay feasibility assessment. Applicable to liquid specimens (blood, plasma, urine, saliva, cfDNA). Null for solid specimens where mass_mg is used instead.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLSI EP25-A; LabVantage LIMS; CAP Checklist

products.name: aliquot
products.description: Represents a physical sub-division of a parent specimen created during aliquoting workflows, including the container holding it. Tracks aliquot volume, concentration, unit of measure, container identity (barcode, type, manufacturer, lot number, material, volume capacity), position in storage rack/plate/well, aliquot purpose (sequencing, QC, archive, backup), current lifecycle status, and container status (in-use, empty, discarded). Maintains parent-child lineage back to the originating specimen and supports multi-level aliquot hierarchies (aliquot-of-aliquot). Also serves as the master record for empty container inventory when pre-registered in LabVantage. Managed with barcode-driven tracking.
products.reference: ISBER Best Practices for Repositories / LabVantage Aliquot Module

attributes.name: aliquot_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the aliquot record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the aliquot data product within the sample domain. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a physical sub-divided specimen unit managed as an independent trackable resource in LabVantage LIMS.

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.audit_finding. Business justification: Audit findings may cite specific aliquots (e.g., labeling errors, storage violations). Labs link findings to aliquots for evidence and corrective action.

attributes.name: change_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.change_control. Business justification: Change controls may affect aliquots (e.g., new container types, storage condition changes). Labs link change controls to affected aliquots for traceability and audit trails.

attributes.name: complaint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.complaint. Business justification: Complaints about aliquot quality (insufficient volume, wrong concentration) require linking to the specific aliquot for root cause analysis and corrective action.

attributes.name: container_id
attributes.description: FK to sample.container

attributes.name: deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_deviation. Business justification: Aliquots trigger deviations (volume discrepancies, labeling errors, storage violations). Labs link aliquots to deviations for traceability and corrective action. Critical for GxP compliance.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_header. Business justification: Aliquots are prepared and consumed for specific customer service orders (sequencing runs, array processing). Required for inventory consumption tracking, billing reconciliation, and linking lab materi

attributes.name: instrument_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to instrument.instrument_run. Business justification: Aliquots are loaded into specific instrument runs for sequencing/array analysis. Critical for sample-to-data lineage traceability, correlating aliquot QC with run performance, and investigating failed

attributes.name: nonconformance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.nonconformance. Business justification: Aliquots failing specifications (concentration out of range, purity issues) are nonconformances requiring disposition decisions. Labs link aliquots to NCRs for traceability and corrective action.

attributes.name: parent_aliquot_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediate parent aliquot when this record represents a secondary or tertiary sub-division (aliquot-of-aliquot). Null for first-generation aliquots derived directly from the specimen. Enables multi-level aliquot hierarchy traversal.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Aliquoting Workflow; ISO 15189 Chain of Custody

attributes.name: preparation_reagent_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.reagent_catalog. Business justification: Aliquots are prepared using specific reagent types (extraction kits, normalization buffers, stabilization reagents). Needed for protocol compliance verification, method validation studies, and ensurin

attributes.name: reagent_kit_catalog_item_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reagent Kit Catalog Item Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.catalog_item. Business justification: Aliquots are created using specific reagent kits (extraction, library prep). Business need: protocol compliance verification, batch effect analysis in sequencing QC, reagent lot traceability for faile

attributes.name: sample_consent_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) consent record governing the permissible uses of this aliquot. Ensures that downstream workflows (sequencing, research, clinical) are authorized under the applicable consent scope. Critical for HIPAA, GDPR, and NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy compliance.
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; HIPAA 45 CFR Parts 160 and 164; GDPR Article 9; ICH E6 GCP

attributes.name: sample_specimen_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating parent specimen from which this aliquot was derived. Supports parent-child lineage traceability back to the source biological specimen. Null if this aliquot is a top-level sub-division directly from the primary specimen.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Sample Tracking; ISO 15189 Traceability Requirements

attributes.name: stability_study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.stability_study. Business justification: Stability studies use aliquots as test samples at each time point. Labs maintain traceability to aliquots tested for regulatory compliance and shelf life determination.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storage location record defining the physical storage unit (freezer, refrigerator, ambient rack) where this aliquot is currently housed. Supports chain-of-custody and cold-chain compliance tracking.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Storage Management; ISO 15189; GxP Good Practice Regulations

attributes.name: validation_study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.validation_study. Business justification: Validation studies use aliquots as test samples for repeatability, reproducibility, and accuracy studies. Labs maintain traceability to aliquots used for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.work_order. Business justification: Aliquots are direct inputs to manufacturing processes (library prep, QC runs, sequencing). This link supports material consumption tracking, work order costing, batch genealogy, and regulatory traceab

attributes.name: aliquot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the aliquot within the sub-division hierarchy. 'primary' indicates first-generation aliquot from specimen; 'secondary' and 'tertiary' indicate downstream sub-divisions; 'pooled' indicates a combined aliquot from multiple sources; 'reference' indicates a reference material aliquot.

attributes.name: aliquoting_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this aliquot was physically created from the parent specimen or parent aliquot. Represents the principal real-world business event timestamp for this entity. Used for pre-analytical variable tracking, stability calculations, and chain-of-custody documentation.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Aliquoting Workflow; ISO 15189; GxP Good Laboratory Practice (GLP)

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Unique barcode label affixed to the physical container holding this aliquot. Used for barcode-driven tracking, scanning at workstations, and chain-of-custody verification throughout laboratory workflows in LabVantage LIMS.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Barcode Tracking; ISO 15189 Sample Identification

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the original biological specimen was collected from the subject. Inherited from the parent specimen record. Critical for calculating specimen age, assessing pre-analytical variable impact, and meeting regulatory reporting timelines under CLIA and CAP.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Specimen Metadata; ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Accreditation

attributes.name: concentration
attributes.description: Measured concentration of the biological analyte (e.g., DNA, RNA, protein) in the aliquot. The unit of measure is captured in concentration_unit. Critical for library preparation normalization in Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) workflows and Quality Control (QC) acceptance criteria.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Concentration Tracking; ISO 15189; GxP Good Laboratory Practice (GLP)

attributes.name: concentration_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the concentration value recorded in the concentration field. Common units include ng/µL (nanograms per microliter) for DNA/RNA quantification, nM (nanomolar) for library quantification, and copies/µL for digital Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) applications.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Unit Standards; ISO 15189; SI Units

attributes.name: container_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the physical container holding the aliquot. 'in_use' indicates container holds active aliquot material; 'empty' indicates container has been emptied; 'discarded' indicates container has been disposed of; 'pre_registered' indicates container registered in LabVantage LIMS prior to receiving material (empty container inventory management).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this aliquot record was first created in the source LabVantage LIMS system and ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports audit trail requirements under GxP, CLIA, and SOX financial reporting for laboratory operations.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Audit Trail; GxP Good Practice Regulations; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; ISO 27001

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the aliquot was physically disposed of or destroyed per retention policy, consent withdrawal, or regulatory requirement. Populated when lifecycle_status transitions to 'disposed' or 'destroyed'. Required for audit trail completeness under GxP and HIPAA.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Disposal Workflow; ISO 15189; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; GxP Good Practice Regulations

attributes.name: disposal_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the disposal or destruction of the aliquot. Supports regulatory audit trails and consent management reporting. 'consent_withdrawn' is critical for GDPR Article 17 right-to-erasure and HIPAA consent revocation workflows.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Disposal Documentation; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; GDPR Article 17; ISO 15189

attributes.name: dna_integrity_number
attributes.description: DNA Integrity Number (DIN) score measured by TapeStation, ranging from 1 (fully degraded) to 10 (fully intact). Applicable to genomic DNA aliquots. Used to assess suitability for Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS) and Whole Exome Sequencing (WES) library preparation. Null for non-DNA aliquots.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS QC Metrics; ISO 15189; Agilent TapeStation DIN Standard

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the aliquot is considered expired and should not be used in clinical or research workflows. Calculated based on specimen type, storage conditions, and validated stability data per Standard Operating Procedure (SOP). Triggers automated alerts in LabVantage LIMS for disposal or review.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Stability Management; ISO 15189; GxP Good Laboratory Practice (GLP); FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: freeze_thaw_count
attributes.description: Number of freeze-thaw cycles the aliquot has undergone since creation. Excessive freeze-thaw cycles degrade nucleic acid integrity and protein activity. Used to enforce maximum freeze-thaw limits per Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and to flag aliquots that may be unsuitable for sensitive assays.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Sample Integrity Tracking; ISO 15189; GxP Good Laboratory Practice (GLP)

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of this aliquot within the parent-child hierarchy. Level 1 indicates a direct sub-division of the primary specimen; level 2 indicates an aliquot-of-aliquot; and so on. Enables efficient hierarchy traversal queries and enforces maximum sub-division depth policies.

attributes.name: initial_volume_ul
attributes.description: Original volume of biological material dispensed into the aliquot container at the time of aliquoting, expressed in microliters (µL). Provides the baseline for volume consumption tracking and yield calculations.

attributes.name: is_phi_deidentified
attributes.description: Indicates whether Protected Health Information (PHI) associated with this aliquot has been de-identified in accordance with HIPAA Safe Harbor or Expert Determination methods. True indicates de-identified; False indicates PHI is present and access controls apply. Governs data sharing eligibility for research and external collaborations.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514 De-identification Standard; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GDPR Article 89

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Human-readable label or name assigned to the aliquot for identification in laboratory workflows, reports, and LIMS displays. May include specimen accession number, aliquot sequence suffix, or study-specific naming conventions.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Sample Management; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current state of the aliquot in its operational lifecycle. 'available' indicates ready for use; 'consumed' indicates fully used in a workflow; 'depleted' indicates volume exhausted; 'reserved' indicates allocated to a pending workflow; 'quarantined' indicates held pending Quality Control (QC) review; 'disposed' indicates removed per retention policy; 'destroyed' indicates intentionally destroyed per protocol. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: available|consumed|depleted|reserved|quarantined|disposed|destroyed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Sample Lifecycle; ISO 15189; GxP Good Practice Regulations

attributes.name: lims_aliquot_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Aliquot ID
attributes.description: The native aliquot identifier assigned by LabVantage LIMS at the time of accessioning or aliquoting. Used as the operational cross-reference key between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the LIMS source system.

attributes.name: purity_ratio_260_230
attributes.description: Absorbance ratio at 260nm to 230nm measured by spectrophotometry. Indicates contamination by chaotropic salts, EDTA, or carbohydrates. Acceptable range is typically 2.0–2.2. Complements the A260/A280 ratio for comprehensive nucleic acid Quality Control (QC) assessment.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS QC Metrics; ISO 15189; GxP Good Laboratory Practice (GLP)

attributes.name: purity_ratio_260_280
attributes.description: Absorbance ratio at 260nm to 280nm measured by spectrophotometry (e.g., NanoDrop). Indicates nucleic acid purity; acceptable DNA purity is typically 1.8–2.0 and RNA purity 2.0–2.2. Values outside range may indicate protein or solvent contamination affecting downstream Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) performance.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS QC Metrics; ISO 15189; GxP Good Laboratory Practice (GLP)

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Intended downstream use of the aliquot. Drives workflow routing in LabVantage LIMS and determines which bioinformatics pipelines or Quality Control (QC) processes the aliquot will enter. Values include sequencing (Next-Generation Sequencing/NGS workflows), qc (Quality Control testing), archive (long-term storage), backup (redundancy), assay_validation (Clinical Assay Validation), and research (Research and Development).
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Workflow Assignment; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; GxP Good Laboratory Practice (GLP)

attributes.name: qc_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by laboratory personnel during Quality Control (QC) assessment. Documents observations, deviations, conditional pass justifications, or remediation actions taken. Supports audit trail requirements under Good Practice Regulations (GxP) and CLIA.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS QC Documentation; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; GxP Good Laboratory Practice (GLP)

attributes.name: qc_status
attributes.description: Result of the Quality Control (QC) assessment for this aliquot. 'pass' indicates aliquot meets all acceptance criteria for its intended purpose; 'fail' indicates one or more criteria not met; 'pending' indicates QC not yet completed; 'conditional_pass' indicates aliquot approved with documented exceptions; 'not_required' indicates QC waived per Standard Operating Procedure (SOP).
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS QC Workflow; ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; GxP Good Practice Regulations

attributes.name: rack_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the storage rack, plate, or box within the storage unit where this aliquot is positioned. Combined with well_position provides the precise physical location for robotic retrieval and manual locating in biobank operations.

attributes.name: rin_score
attributes.description: RNA Integrity Number (RIN) score measured by Bioanalyzer or TapeStation, ranging from 1 (fully degraded) to 10 (fully intact). Applicable to RNA aliquots only. Minimum RIN thresholds are defined per assay type (e.g., RIN ≥ 7 for RNA-seq library preparation). Null for non-RNA aliquots.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS QC Metrics; ISO 15189; Agilent Bioanalyzer RIN Standard

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Biological specimen type of the aliquot material (e.g., whole blood, plasma, serum, saliva, tissue, FFPE, cell line, DNA extract, RNA extract, cfDNA). Inherited from the parent specimen and critical for downstream workflow routing and assay compatibility checks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: whole_blood|plasma|serum|saliva|tissue|ffpe|cell_line|dna_extract|rna_extract|cfdna|urine|csf|buffy_coat — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Specimen Classification; SNOMED CT Specimen Ontology; ISO 15189

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: Required storage temperature for this aliquot in degrees Celsius (°C). Common values include -80°C (ultra-low for long-term nucleic acid storage), -20°C (standard freezer), 4°C (refrigerated), and ambient (15–25°C). Drives cold-chain compliance monitoring and storage assignment.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Storage Conditions; ISO 15189; GxP Good Practice Regulations; HIPAA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
