attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this aliquot record in the source LabVantage LIMS system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture, and audit trail completeness under GxP and ISO 15189.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Audit Trail; GxP Good Practice Regulations; ISO 15189; ISO 27001

attributes.name: use_restriction_code
attributes.description: Standardized data use restriction code governing permissible downstream uses of this aliquot and its derived data. Codes follow GA4GH/dbGaP conventions: GRU (General Research Use), HMB (Health/Medical/Biomedical), DS (Disease-Specific), POA (Population Origins/Ancestry), NPU (Non-Profit Use Only), RUO (Research Use Only). Enforced during data access governance reviews.
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GA4GH Data Use Ontology; dbGaP Data Use Limitations

attributes.name: volume_ul
attributes.description: Current measured volume of biological material in the aliquot container, expressed in microliters (µL). Decremented as material is consumed in workflows. Critical for determining aliquot sufficiency for downstream assays such as Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) library preparation.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Volume Tracking; ISO 15189 Quantity Management

attributes.name: volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for volume fields (volume_ul and initial_volume_ul). Standard unit is microliters (µL) for most genomics laboratory workflows; milliliters (mL) may be used for larger biobank specimens.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Unit Standards; ISO 15189; SI Units

attributes.name: well_position
attributes.description: Alphanumeric position identifier within the storage rack, plate, or box (e.g., A01, B12, H08 for a 96-well plate layout). Used for precise physical localization of the aliquot within its storage container for robotic liquid handling and manual retrieval.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Position Tracking; ISO 15189; SBS Microplate Standard

products.name: accession
products.description: Transactional record capturing the formal intake and registration of a specimen into the laboratory information management system (LabVantage). Records accession number (LIMS-generated), receipt date/time, receiving lab site, courier/shipment reference, condition on arrival (acceptable, compromised, rejected), accessioning technician, priority level (STAT, routine), and linkage to the originating clinical order (FK to order domain). Represents the chain-of-custody entry point — the moment a specimen transitions from external custody to laboratory custody.
products.reference: CLIA Accession Requirements / CAP Laboratory Standards

attributes.name: accession_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the accession record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity. TRANSACTION_HEADER role — represents the formal intake event of a specimen into laboratory custody.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Accessions represent received samples from customer accounts. Required for order fulfillment tracking, billing reconciliation, customer-specific SLA enforcement, and regulatory classification routing.

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_receivable. Business justification: Clinical accessioning creates billable events generating AR invoices. Essential for revenue cycle management, linking laboratory orders to billing, tracking days sales outstanding, and reconciling tes

attributes.name: authorized_orderer_id
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier (NPI) or internal identifier of the ordering physician or clinical provider who requisitioned the test. Used for result reporting, billing, and clinical communication. Classified as confidential.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Ordering Provider; HIPAA 45 CFR §162.402 (NPI); CLIA 42 CFR §493.1241

attributes.name: clinical_evidence_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_evidence. Business justification: Accessioned samples in clinical validation studies require linkage to evidence records for chain-of-custody documentation, protocol compliance verification, and audit trail completeness for regulatory

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory technician or scientist who performed the physical accessioning of the specimen. Required for chain-of-custody accountability and GxP audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — User/Personnel Object; GxP 21 CFR Part 11; CAP Checklist GEN.40490

attributes.name: genome_assembly_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.genome_assembly. Business justification: Accessioned samples are tagged with the intended reference genome at intake to ensure downstream pipeline compatibility and prevent misrouting. Required for sample routing decisions, assay selection,

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating clinical or research order that triggered specimen collection and submission. Links the accession to the order management domain, enabling traceability from test requisition through laboratory intake.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Order Linkage; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1241

attributes.name: lab_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory site that physically received and accessioned the specimen. Supports multi-site operations, routing logic, and site-level compliance reporting under CLIA and CAP.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Site Configuration; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1

attributes.name: lims_workflow_assignment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Workflow ID
attributes.description: Identifier of the LabVantage workflow instance assigned to this accession for processing routing. Links the accession to the specific laboratory workflow queue (e.g., DNA extraction, library preparation, sequencing run setup) activated upon acceptance.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Workflow Assignment; GxP 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 15189:2022 §5.5

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.opportunity. Business justification: Accessioned samples for commercial sequencing/diagnostic services (not research) must track to the sales opportunity for billable service tracking, revenue recognition, and customer invoicing. Core co

attributes.name: patient_id
attributes.description: Reference to the de-identified or pseudonymized patient/subject record associated with this specimen. Classified as restricted PHI under HIPAA. Used for clinical traceability while maintaining PHI separation per de-identification protocols.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; GDPR Article 9; IRB Protocol Requirements

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Accessioned samples are collected under R&D projects. Linking accessions to projects enables project-level cohort analysis, R&D spend allocation to sample processing, IRB compliance reporting by proje

attributes.name: sample_specimen_id
attributes.description: Reference to the biological sample master record in the Sample Management domain. Establishes the chain-of-custody link between the accession intake event and the canonical sample identity record.

attributes.name: accession_number
attributes.description: LIMS-generated, externally-visible unique identifier assigned to the specimen at the point of intake into LabVantage. Serves as the primary chain-of-custody reference number communicated to ordering clinicians, research teams, and downstream bioinformatics pipelines. Format: ACC-{YYYY}-{8-digit sequence}.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Accession Number; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1232; CAP Laboratory Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: accession_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the accession record within LabVantage. Drives downstream routing: 'received' = physically in lab but not yet reviewed; 'in_review' = condition assessment underway; 'accepted' = cleared for processing; 'rejected' = specimen rejected and not processed; 'on_hold' = pending additional information or consent; 'cancelled' = order cancelled prior to processing.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Accession Workflow States; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1232

attributes.name: accessioning_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the specimen was formally registered and accessioned into the LIMS by the receiving technician. May differ from receipt_timestamp if there is a delay between physical receipt and system registration. Used for TAT (Turnaround Time) calculations.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Accession Registration Time; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1232; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4

attributes.name: arrival_condition
attributes.description: Assessment of the physical condition of the specimen upon arrival at the laboratory. 'acceptable' = meets pre-analytical quality criteria; 'compromised' = degraded but may still be processable with notation; 'rejected' = fails minimum quality criteria and cannot be processed. Triggers rejection workflows and recollection requests when set to 'rejected'.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Condition on Arrival; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.6; CAP Checklist GEN.40490; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1232

attributes.name: assay_panel_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the genomic assay panel or test menu requested for this specimen (e.g., WGS, WES, NGS gene panel, SNP array, CRISPR screen). Drives workflow routing to the appropriate laboratory workstation and bioinformatics pipeline in LabVantage.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Test Request; Illumina BaseSpace — Run Configuration; Internal Assay Catalog

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the biological specimen was collected from the patient or subject. Critical for pre-analytical stability assessments, TAT calculations, and clinical result interpretation. Distinct from receipt_timestamp.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Collection Date; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1232; CAP Checklist GEN.40490; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4

attributes.name: collection_site
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the clinical facility, hospital, clinic, or research site where the specimen was collected from the patient. Supports multi-site clinical trial tracking, referring provider analytics, and logistics routing.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Collection Site; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1232; CAP Checklist GEN.40490

attributes.name: collection_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time the specimen was collected from the patient or subject, including timezone. Used for time-sensitive pre-analytical stability calculations (e.g., RNA degradation, cell viability) and clinical result contextualization.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Collection Time; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1232

attributes.name: collector_name
attributes.description: Name of the phlebotomist, nurse, or clinician who collected the specimen from the patient. Required for chain-of-custody documentation and pre-analytical error investigation. Classified as confidential business data.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Collector; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1232; CAP Checklist GEN.40490

attributes.name: condition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of observed pre-analytical issues or anomalies noted at specimen receipt (e.g., hemolysis, lipemia, insufficient volume, broken container, temperature excursion, clotted sample). Supports root cause analysis and pre-analytical QC reporting.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Condition Comments; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.6; CAP Checklist GEN.40490

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Status of the patient or subject's informed consent for specimen use in research or clinical testing. 'consented' = valid consent obtained; 'declined' = subject declined consent; 'pending' = consent process initiated but not completed; 'withdrawn' = previously consented subject has withdrawn consent; 'not_required' = clinical specimen exempt from research consent requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.508; GDPR Article 7 & 9; 45 CFR Part 46 (Common Rule); IRB Protocol Requirements

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Type of container or tube in which the specimen was collected and transported (e.g., EDTA tube, SST tube, PAXgene RNA tube, cryovial, FFPE block, dry swab). Determines extraction protocol eligibility and pre-analytical QC criteria. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: edta_tube|sst_tube|paxgene_rna|paxgene_dna|cryovial|ffpe_block|dry_swab|streck_tube|citrate_tube — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Container Type; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4; CLSI GP44-A4

attributes.name: courier_name
attributes.description: Name of the courier or logistics provider that transported the specimen to the laboratory (e.g., FedEx, World Courier, BioMatik, internal courier). Used for vendor performance tracking and temperature excursion investigations.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Courier; IATA DGR P650; CAP Checklist GEN.40490

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this accession record was first created in the source LIMS system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and GxP 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.
attributes.references: GxP 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 27001; LabVantage LIMS Audit Trail

attributes.name: external_requisition_number
attributes.description: Test requisition number assigned by the ordering facility's own system (e.g., hospital LIS, EHR order number). Enables bidirectional reconciliation between the external ordering system and the internal LIMS accession record.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — External Reference; HL7 FHIR ServiceRequest.requisition; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1241

attributes.name: gxp_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accession falls under GxP (Good Practice Regulations) requirements including GMP, GLP, or GCP. True = GxP controls apply, requiring full audit trail, electronic signature compliance per 21 CFR Part 11, and enhanced documentation in MasterControl.
attributes.references: GxP 21 CFR Part 11; GMP 21 CFR Part 211; GLP 21 CFR Part 58; GCP ICH E6(R2); ISO 13485:2016

attributes.name: irb_protocol_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the Institutional Review Board (IRB) protocol under which the specimen was collected and consented for research use. Required for research specimens to ensure ethical compliance. Null for purely clinical specimens not under a research protocol.
attributes.references: IRB Protocol Requirements; 45 CFR Part 46 (Common Rule); GDPR Article 9; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: phi_deidentified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Protected Health Information (PHI) associated with this accession has been de-identified per HIPAA Safe Harbor or Expert Determination methods. True = PHI has been de-identified and the record may be used in downstream analytics without PHI restrictions; False = PHI is present and full access controls apply.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; GDPR Article 89; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Processing priority assigned to the accession at intake. STAT (Short Turn-Around Time) specimens require immediate processing; routine specimens follow standard workflow queues; urgent specimens are expedited but below STAT; research specimens follow non-clinical timelines. Drives SLA (Service Level Agreement) enforcement and workflow queue prioritization in LabVantage.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Priority Flag; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1232; Internal SLA Policy

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the specimen was physically received at the laboratory, marking the transition from external courier custody to laboratory custody. This is the principal business event timestamp for the accession transaction. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Receipt Date/Time; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1232; CAP Checklist GEN.40490

attributes.name: recollection_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a recollection request has been issued to the ordering provider or collection site due to specimen rejection or insufficient quality. True = recollection has been requested; False = no recollection required.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Recollection Workflow; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.6; CAP Checklist GEN.40490

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accession is associated with a regulatory submission (e.g., FDA IND/NDA clinical trial specimen, CE-IVD validation study, EMA submission). True = specimen is part of a regulated submission context requiring enhanced documentation and audit trail.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312 (IND); FDA 21 CFR Part 820; IVDR EU 2017/746; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault — Regulatory Document Linkage

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason a specimen was rejected at accessioning. Populated only when arrival_condition = 'rejected'. Used for pre-analytical QC trending, rejection rate KPI reporting, and recollection request generation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: insufficient_volume|hemolysis|lipemia|clotted|wrong_tube|unlabeled|temperature_excursion|expired_container|broken_container|mislabeled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Rejection Reason; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.6; CAP Checklist GEN.40490; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1232

attributes.name: shipment_tracking_number
attributes.description: Courier or carrier tracking number associated with the shipment in which the specimen was transported to the laboratory. Enables shipment-level chain-of-custody traceability and temperature excursion investigation via carrier records.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Shipment Reference; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR) P650; CAP Checklist GEN.40490

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the LabVantage LIMS source system for this accession. Used for data lineage traceability between the Databricks Silver Layer and the operational system of record, supporting reconciliation and re-ingestion workflows.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Internal Record ID; ISO 27001; GxP 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the biological specimen material submitted for analysis (e.g., whole blood, FFPE tissue, saliva, buccal swab, plasma, serum, urine, bone marrow, CSF). Drives QC thresholds, extraction protocols, and assay eligibility rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: whole_blood|ffpe_tissue|saliva|buccal_swab|plasma|serum|urine|bone_marrow|csf|fresh_frozen_tissue — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Specimen Type Codelist; SNOMED CT Specimen Hierarchy; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Laboratory storage location code (freezer, rack, box, position) where the specimen was placed upon acceptance. Supports physical specimen retrieval, inventory management, and chain-of-custody continuity within the LIMS.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Storage Location; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.7; CAP Checklist GEN.40490

attributes.name: tat_target_hours
attributes.description: Target Turnaround Time (TAT) in hours from specimen receipt to result delivery, as defined by the SLA (Service Level Agreement) for the assigned priority level and assay type. Used for TAT compliance monitoring and SLA breach alerting.
attributes.references: Internal SLA Policy; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1291; CAP Checklist GEN.40490

attributes.name: temperature_at_receipt_c
attributes.description: Measured temperature of the specimen or shipping container at the time of receipt, expressed in degrees Celsius. Used to assess cold-chain compliance and flag potential temperature excursions that may affect specimen integrity and downstream assay validity.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Receipt Temperature; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.5; IATA DGR P650

attributes.name: transport_temperature_code
attributes.description: Required transport temperature condition under which the specimen was shipped to the laboratory. Used to verify compliance with specimen stability requirements and to flag potential temperature excursions during transit.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Transport Condition; IATA DGR P650; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.5

attributes.name: tube_label_code
attributes.description: Barcode or label identifier physically affixed to the specimen container at the time of collection or receipt. Used for physical specimen tracking, label verification at accessioning, and reconciliation against the LIMS accession number.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Container Barcode; CAP Checklist GEN.40490; ISBT 128 Standard

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this accession record was most recently modified in the source LIMS system. Supports change detection in the Silver Layer ETL pipeline and GxP audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: GxP 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 27001; LabVantage LIMS Audit Trail

attributes.name: use_classification
attributes.description: Intended use classification of the specimen at the time of accessioning. 'clinical' = IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic) or LDT (Laboratory Developed Test) clinical testing; 'research' = RUO (Research Use Only) investigation; 'QC' = Quality Control specimen for assay performance monitoring; 'validation' = analytical validation or clinical validation study specimen.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; FDA IVD Guidance; CLIA 42 CFR §493; CAP Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: volume_received_ml
attributes.description: Measured volume of the specimen received at the laboratory, expressed in millilitres. Used to assess adequacy for requested assays, trigger insufficient volume rejection flags, and support aliquoting planning. Represents the principal quantitative measurement of the accession transaction.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Volume Received; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.6; CLSI EP7-A2

attributes.name: volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the volume_received_ml field. Typically mL for liquid specimens; mg or g for solid tissue specimens. Allows the schema to accommodate non-liquid specimen types without type conversion.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Volume Unit; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4; CLSI EP7-A2

products.name: biobank_location
products.description: Master data entity representing a physical storage location within the biorepository hierarchy — freezer, shelf, rack, box, and well/position. Captures location code, storage unit type, temperature setpoint (e.g., -80°C, -196°C LN2, 4°C, RT), facility site, capacity (total positions, occupied positions), and current operational status. Enables precise chain-of-custody tracking and retrieval of specimens and aliquots.

attributes.name: biobank_location_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a physical storage location within the biorepository hierarchy. Primary key for this master resource entity.

attributes.name: change_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.change_control. Business justification: Change controls often affect storage locations (e.g., equipment upgrades, temperature setpoint changes). Labs link change controls to affected locations for regulatory compliance and audit trails.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Biobank storage equipment (ultra-low freezers, LN2 tanks, automated storage systems) are capitalized fixed assets requiring depreciation tracking. Essential for asset management, maintenance cost allo

attributes.name: parent_location_biobank_location_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediate parent location in the biorepository hierarchy (e.g., a box's parent is a rack, a rack's parent is a shelf). Enables recursive hierarchy traversal for chain-of-custody and retrieval workflows.

attributes.name: access_restriction_level
attributes.description: Physical and logical access control classification for this storage location. Governs who may retrieve specimens from this location. 'restricted' and above require role-based authorization in LabVantage LIMS and physical access badge control. Relevant for PHI-linked specimens and BSL-classified materials.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.310; ISO 27001 §A.11; NIH Biosafety Guidelines; GxP Access Control

attributes.name: backup_power_protected
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage unit is connected to an uninterruptible power supply (UPS) or emergency generator backup. Critical for specimen integrity risk assessment and business continuity planning for irreplaceable biobank specimens.
attributes.references: ISO 20387 §6.2; ISBER Best Practices; GxP Facility Requirements

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Machine-readable barcode or 2D matrix code (e.g., DataMatrix, QR) affixed to the physical storage unit or position label. Scanned during specimen accessioning, retrieval, and chain-of-custody verification in LabVantage LIMS.
attributes.references: ISO 20387; ISBER Best Practices; GS1 Barcode Standards

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which this storage location was formally commissioned and made available for specimen storage following successful IQ/OQ/PQ qualification. Marks the start of the location's operational lifecycle.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this biobank location record was first created in the system of record (LabVantage LIMS or enterprise data platform). Supports audit trail requirements under GxP, ISO 13485, and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 13485 §4.2.5; GxP Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which this storage location was permanently decommissioned and removed from active service. Null for locations still in service. Required for equipment lifecycle tracking and regulatory audit trails.

attributes.name: equipment_manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer of the physical storage equipment (e.g., 'Thermo Fisher Scientific', 'Panasonic', 'Chart Industries'). Required for vendor qualification records and regulatory equipment documentation.

attributes.name: equipment_model
attributes.description: Manufacturer model designation of the physical storage equipment at this location (e.g., 'Thermo Scientific TSX Series -80°C Freezer'). Used for equipment qualification documentation, spare parts management, and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: equipment_serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number of the physical storage equipment. Required for equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) documentation, warranty tracking, and regulatory audit trails per ISO 13485 and GxP requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 §7.6; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68; GxP Equipment Qualification

attributes.name: facility_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the physical facility or campus where this storage location resides (e.g., 'SDCA' for San Diego Campus A). Links to the enterprise site master for regulatory site registration and GxP compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 §7.5; GxP Site Registration; FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Level of this location within the biorepository physical hierarchy: facility → room → freezer → shelf → rack → box → position (well/slot). Enables hierarchical chain-of-custody traversal and capacity roll-up reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: facility|room|freezer|shelf|rack|box|position — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 20387; ISBER Best Practices for Repositories

attributes.name: is_cryogenic
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location uses cryogenic conditions (liquid nitrogen vapor or immersion, or mechanical ultra-low temperature ≤ -130°C). Drives safety protocol assignment, PPE requirements, and cryogenic handling SOP routing.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.101; ISO 20387; ISBER Cryogenic Safety Guidelines

attributes.name: is_gmp_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is subject to GMP regulations (e.g., for clinical trial specimens, IVD reagent intermediates, or GMP-grade biological materials). GMP-controlled locations require enhanced documentation, change control, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EU GMP Annex 15; ICH Q10; ISO 13485

attributes.name: is_phi_segregated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Protected Health Information (PHI) Segregated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specimens stored at this location are physically segregated due to PHI linkage, requiring enhanced access controls and HIPAA-compliant chain-of-custody documentation. Supports de-identification workflow management.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.514; GDPR Article 9; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent temperature calibration or verification performed on this storage unit. Required for GxP compliance and ISO 15189 accreditation. Tracked in MasterControl and SAP QM.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this biobank location record. Required for change control audit trails under FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 13485, and GxP data integrity requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 13485 §4.2.5; GxP Data Integrity (ALCOA+)

attributes.name: lims_location_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Location ID
attributes.description: Native location identifier assigned by LabVantage LIMS for this storage position. Used for system-of-record cross-referencing, data lineage tracing, and integration reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the operational LIMS.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique code assigned to this storage location within the biorepository management system (LabVantage LIMS). Used for labeling, chain-of-custody documentation, and specimen retrieval workflows. Example: FRZ-A01-SH3-RK2-BX05.

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Descriptive human-readable name for the storage location, used in operational reports and LIMS displays. Example: 'Freezer A1 – Shelf 3 – Rack 2 – Box 05'.

attributes.name: monitoring_sensor_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the continuous temperature/humidity monitoring sensor assigned to this storage location. Links to the environmental monitoring system (EMS) for real-time excursion alerting and 21 CFR Part 11-compliant audit trails.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68; ISO 20387 §6.3; GxP Environmental Monitoring

attributes.name: next_calibration_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next temperature calibration or verification of this storage unit. Drives preventive maintenance work orders in SAP S/4HANA PM and compliance alerts in MasterControl.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special handling instructions, or non-conformance observations associated with this storage location (e.g., 'Door seal replaced 2024-03-15', 'Reserved for clinical trial XYZ specimens only').

attributes.name: occupied_positions
attributes.description: Current number of specimen positions occupied at this storage location as tracked by LabVantage LIMS. Enables real-time utilization monitoring and triggers capacity alerts when approaching full occupancy.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of this biobank storage location. 'active' = available for specimen storage; 'maintenance' = temporarily unavailable due to servicing; 'quarantine' = specimens held pending investigation; 'decommissioned' = permanently retired from service.

attributes.name: position_column
attributes.description: Numeric column designator for a specific well or slot position within a box or rack (e.g., '1', '12'). Applicable at the position/well hierarchy level. Combined with position_row to form the full position address.

attributes.name: position_row
attributes.description: Alphanumeric row designator for a specific well or slot position within a box or rack (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'H'). Applicable at the position/well hierarchy level. Combined with position_column to form the full position address.

attributes.name: qualification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current GxP equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) expires and requalification is required. Drives preventive maintenance scheduling and regulatory compliance alerts in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 §7.6; GxP Equipment Qualification; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: GxP qualification status of the storage equipment: 'qualified' = Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ) completed and approved; 'requalification_required' = qualification expired or triggered by maintenance event. Mandatory for GMP/GLP-regulated specimen storage.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 §7.6; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68; GxP IQ/OQ/PQ Guidelines; ICH Q10

attributes.name: responsible_custodian
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the designated biorepository custodian or laboratory manager responsible for this storage location. Accountable for specimen integrity, access authorization, and regulatory compliance at this location.

attributes.name: rfid_tag
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier assigned to this storage unit for automated inventory scanning and real-time location tracking within the biorepository. Supports high-throughput specimen management workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 20387; ISBER Best Practices; GS1 RFID Standards

attributes.name: room_identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the laboratory or storage room within the facility where this location physically resides. Used for access control, environmental monitoring zone assignment, and GxP area classification.

attributes.name: specimen_type_compatibility
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of specimen types approved for storage at this location (e.g., 'whole_blood,plasma,FFPE,DNA,RNA,cell_line'). Enforced during specimen accessioning in LabVantage LIMS to prevent storage condition mismatches. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: whole_blood|plasma|serum|FFPE|DNA|RNA|cell_line|tissue|urine|saliva — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 20387 §6.3; ISBER Best Practices; LabVantage LIMS Specimen Type Configuration

attributes.name: storage_medium
attributes.description: Physical medium used for cryogenic or ambient storage at this location. Distinguishes mechanical freezer cooling from liquid nitrogen (LN2) vapor-phase or immersion-phase storage, which affects specimen viability protocols and safety requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 20387; ISBER Best Practices; OSHA Cryogenic Safety

attributes.name: storage_unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical storage unit at this location level (e.g., freezer, refrigerator, liquid nitrogen tank, ambient cabinet). Drives temperature monitoring SOP assignment and equipment maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: ISO 20387; ISBER Best Practices for Repositories

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Upper acceptable temperature limit in degrees Celsius for this storage location. Excursions above this threshold trigger alarms and non-conformance events per SOP.

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Lower acceptable temperature limit in degrees Celsius for this storage location. Excursions below this threshold trigger alarms and non-conformance events per SOP.

attributes.name: temperature_setpoint_c
attributes.description: Nominal target storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this location (e.g., -80.00 for ultra-low freezer, -196.00 for liquid nitrogen, 4.00 for refrigerator, 22.00 for room temperature). Critical for specimen integrity and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 20387 §6.3; ISBER Best Practices; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: total_capacity_positions
attributes.description: Maximum number of specimen positions (wells, slots, or tubes) this storage location can physically accommodate. Used for capacity planning, utilization reporting, and biorepository space management.

products.name: storage_event
products.description: Transactional record of every storage state change and custody transfer for a specimen or aliquot — initial placement, relocation, retrieval, return, and inter-section transfers. Captures event type, source location, destination location, event timestamp, operator ID, custodian identity, reason code (routine storage, retrieval for assay, transfer to external site, quarantine), temperature excursion flag, and electronic acknowledgment. Provides the full chain-of-custody audit trail required for GxP, CLIA, and forensic genomics compliance. Serves as the immutable custody log for all in-facility specimen movements.

attributes.name: storage_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each storage state change or custody transfer event record in the chain-of-custody audit trail. Primary key of the storage_event product.

attributes.name: aliquot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific aliquot (sub-divided portion of a specimen) involved in this storage event. Nullable when the event applies to the primary specimen rather than a derived aliquot. Populated from LabVantage LIMS aliquot tracking.

attributes.name: destination_location_biobank_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storage location (freezer, rack, shelf, box, or position) to which the specimen or aliquot was moved or placed. Null for disposal or external transfer events where no internal destination exists.

attributes.name: deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_deviation. Business justification: Storage events (temperature excursions, unauthorized access, location errors) trigger deviations. Labs document which storage event caused each deviation for regulatory compliance and audit trails.

attributes.name: irb_submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) protocol under which the specimen was collected and is being stored. Ensures that storage and custody actions are performed within the bounds of approved research protocols and informed consent agreements.
attributes.references: IRB, HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164, GDPR Article 9, NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: lims_workflow_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the LIMS-driven workflow task or work order that triggered or is associated with this storage event. Links the storage action to the broader laboratory workflow context (e.g., assay preparation, QC run, clinical testing batch).

attributes.name: primary_storage_biobank_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storage location (freezer, rack, shelf, box, or position) from which the specimen or aliquot was retrieved or transferred. Null for initial placement events where no prior location exists.

attributes.name: primary_storage_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory operator or technician who physically performed the storage event (placement, retrieval, relocation, or transfer). Sourced from Oracle Cloud HCM workforce records and LabVantage LIMS user registry.

attributes.name: sample_specimen_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary biological specimen (parent sample) involved in this storage event. Links to the specimen master record in LabVantage LIMS for full sample metadata and IRB consent context.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS, ISO 15189, CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: tertiary_storage_acknowledged_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who provided the electronic acknowledgment or e-signature for this storage event. May differ from the operator who performed the physical action, supporting dual-control and supervisory sign-off workflows required under GxP.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: acknowledged_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the electronic acknowledgment or e-signature was applied to this storage event record. Distinct from the event_timestamp (when the physical action occurred). Required for FDA 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail completeness.

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_sequence
attributes.description: Monotonically increasing integer representing the ordinal position of this storage event within the complete chain-of-custody history for the specimen or aliquot. Enables ordered reconstruction of the full custody timeline for forensic genomics, legal, and regulatory audit purposes.
attributes.references: GxP, CLIA 42 CFR Part 493, ISO 15189, CAP, forensic genomics standards

attributes.name: container_barcode
attributes.description: The barcode or 2D matrix code printed on the physical container (tube, vial, plate, cryovial) holding the specimen or aliquot at the time of this storage event. Scanned by the operator during the event to confirm physical identity and prevent sample mix-up errors.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS, ISO 15189, CLIA 42 CFR Part 493, GxP

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical container holding the specimen or aliquot during this storage event. Determines applicable storage conditions, handling protocols, and compatible storage unit configurations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this storage event record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Represents the record audit creation time, distinct from the event_timestamp which captures when the physical action occurred.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, ISO 15189, ISO 27001

attributes.name: deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage event involved a deviation from the applicable SOP or standard storage protocol. True triggers a deviation investigation workflow in the quality management system (Veeva Vault or MasterControl) and requires documented justification.
attributes.references: GxP, ISO 15189, FDA 21 CFR Part 211, ISO 13485, Veeva Vault

attributes.name: electronic_acknowledgment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the storage event has received a valid electronic acknowledgment (e-signature) from the responsible operator or custodian in compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements. True confirms the event is electronically signed and locked.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable identifier for this storage event, formatted as SE-{YYYY}-{YYYYMMDD}-{sequence}. Used in audit reports, chain-of-custody documentation, and regulatory submissions to uniquely reference a specific custody transfer or placement event.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the storage event record. Indicates whether the event has been completed, is pending electronic acknowledgment, was cancelled, encountered a failure condition, or is under supervisory review for compliance purposes.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise real-world date and time at which the storage state change or custody transfer physically occurred, recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. This is the principal business event time, distinct from the record audit timestamps. Critical for chain-of-custody sequencing and GxP compliance.
attributes.references: GxP, ISO 15189, CLIA 42 CFR Part 493, FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Categorical discriminator identifying the nature of the storage state change. Drives chain-of-custody logic and audit trail classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initial_placement|relocation|retrieval|return|inter_section_transfer|external_transfer|disposal|quarantine_placement — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GxP, CLIA 42 CFR Part 493, ISO 15189, CAP

attributes.name: external_site_name
attributes.description: Name of the external facility, partner laboratory, or clinical site to which the specimen or aliquot was transferred during an inter-site or external transfer event. Populated only for event_type = external_transfer. Supports chain-of-custody documentation for multi-site genomics studies.
attributes.references: GxP, ISO 15189, CLIA 42 CFR Part 493, HIPAA, GDPR

attributes.name: external_transfer_tracking_number
attributes.description: Shipping or courier tracking number associated with an external specimen transfer event. Enables end-to-end shipment traceability for specimens transferred to external sites, partner labs, or clinical collaborators. Populated only for event_type = external_transfer.
attributes.references: GxP, ISO 15189, IATA P650 (Biological Substances), CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: freeze_thaw_cycle_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of freeze-thaw cycles the specimen or aliquot has undergone up to and including this storage event. Excessive freeze-thaw cycles degrade nucleic acid and protein integrity; this count is critical for sample quality assessment in genomic and clinical workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 15189, CLIA 42 CFR Part 493, GxP, CAP

attributes.name: is_immutable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage event record has been locked and made immutable following electronic acknowledgment and audit finalization. Immutable records cannot be modified or deleted, satisfying FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and GxP requirements for tamper-evident audit trails.

attributes.name: lims_event_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Event Reference
attributes.description: The native event or transaction identifier assigned by LabVantage LIMS for this storage event. Enables bidirectional traceability between the Databricks Silver Layer data product and the operational LIMS system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: phi_deidentified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specimen or aliquot involved in this storage event has been de-identified in accordance with HIPAA Safe Harbor or Expert Determination methods. True means PHI has been removed or anonymized; False means the specimen retains linkage to identifiable patient data.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.514, GDPR Article 4, NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specimen or aliquot was placed into or removed from quarantine status as part of this storage event. Quarantined samples are restricted from use in assays or downstream workflows pending investigation or quality review.
attributes.references: GxP, ISO 15189, CLIA 42 CFR Part 493, FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: quarantine_reason
attributes.description: Standardized reason for placing the specimen or aliquot into quarantine. Populated only when quarantine_flag is True. Drives investigation workflows and determines the path to quarantine release or disposal.
attributes.references: GxP, ISO 15189, CLIA 42 CFR Part 493, FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining the business justification for the storage event. Used for operational reporting, compliance audits, and workflow analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: routine_storage|retrieval_for_assay|transfer_to_external_site|quarantine|inter_section_transfer|disposal_scheduled|emergency_retrieval — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GxP, ISO 15189, CLIA 42 CFR Part 493, CAP

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context or justification for the storage event beyond the standardized reason code. Captures operator notes, special circumstances, or deviations from standard operating procedures (SOPs) that require documentation.

attributes.name: required_temp_max_c
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the specimen or aliquot type involved in this event, as defined by the applicable SOP or specimen handling protocol. Used in conjunction with required_temp_min_c to define the acceptable temperature window.

attributes.name: required_temp_min_c
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the specimen or aliquot type involved in this event, as defined by the applicable SOP or specimen handling protocol. Used to evaluate whether a temperature excursion occurred.

attributes.name: sop_reference
attributes.description: Document identifier of the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) governing the storage event type performed. Links to the controlled document in MasterControl or Veeva Vault for audit trail completeness and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: GxP, ISO 15189, FDA 21 CFR Part 211, MasterControl, Veeva Vault

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this storage event was originated or ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between the lakehouse and upstream operational systems.
attributes.references: GxP, ISO 27001, Snowflake Data Cloud, LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: specimen_volume_ul
attributes.description: Volume of the specimen or aliquot in microliters (µL) at the time of this storage event. Captured to track volume consumption across retrieval events and to flag low-volume specimens that may be insufficient for planned assays.
attributes.references: ISO 15189, CLIA 42 CFR Part 493, LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: storage_condition_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the required storage condition category for the specimen or aliquot at the destination location. Drives storage unit assignment logic and temperature monitoring alert thresholds in the LIMS and facility management systems.
attributes.references: ISO 15189, CLIA 42 CFR Part 493, GxP, LabVantage LIMS

attributes.name: temperature_at_event_c
attributes.description: Recorded ambient or storage unit temperature in degrees Celsius at the time of the storage event. Captured from connected monitoring systems or manually entered by the operator. Used to assess sample integrity and document temperature excursion conditions.
attributes.references: GxP, ISO 15189, CLIA 42 CFR Part 493, FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temperature excursion (deviation from the required storage temperature range) was detected or reported in association with this storage event. True signals a potential sample integrity risk requiring investigation and documentation per GxP and CLIA requirements.
attributes.references: GxP, CLIA 42 CFR Part 493, ISO 15189, FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this storage event record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Tracks the last update for audit trail completeness and data lineage purposes. Immutable records will not have an updated_timestamp after locking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, ISO 15189, ISO 27001

products.name: sample_consent_record
products.description: Authoritative record of IRB-approved informed consent obtained from a research subject or patient for specimen collection and use. Captures consent form version, IRB protocol number, consent date, consent type (broad, specific, re-consent), scope of permitted use (research, clinical, commercial, data sharing), withdrawal date if applicable, and PHI handling authorization. Links specimen to the governing ethical and regulatory framework. Supports HIPAA, GDPR, and NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy compliance.
products.reference: IRB / HIPAA / NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy / GDPR

attributes.name: sample_consent_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the informed consent record within the Genomics Biotech data platform. Primary key for this entity. Role: MASTER_AGREEMENT — this entity represents a binding ethical and regulatory agreement governing specimen use.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: controlled_document_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the consent form document as managed in Veeva Vault regulatory document management system. Enables traceability to the exact document version presented to the subject.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the qualified staff member (e.g., clinical coordinator, genetic counselor, principal investigator) who administered and witnessed the informed consent process. Links to the workforce/personnel record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: nda_record_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Data Use Agreement (DUA) governing external sharing of genomic data derived from this specimen. Required when permitted_use_data_sharing is true. Managed in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.514(e); GDPR Article 28

attributes.name: research_protocol_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical or research study protocol under which the specimen was collected and consent was obtained. Links to the governing study protocol document in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: sample_specimen_id
attributes.description: Reference to the biological specimen governed by this consent record. Links the consent agreement to the physical sample in the LabVantage LIMS sample tracking system.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the de-identified research subject or patient from whom consent was obtained. Links to the subject/participant master record in the sample domain.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; GDPR Article 9; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: Informed consent documentation is required evidence in regulatory submissions for clinical validation studies, IRB compliance verification, and post-market surveillance plans. Essential for FDA/notifi

attributes.name: assent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether assent was obtained from a minor subject in addition to parental/guardian consent. Applicable for pediatric genomics studies. Required for IRB compliance in pediatric research protocols.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 50.55; ICH E6(R2) GCP; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: biobank_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has consented to long-term biobanking and storage of their specimen for future unspecified research use. Governs specimen retention policies in LabVantage LIMS.
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GDPR Article 9; ISO 20387 (Biobanking)

attributes.name: consent_collection_method
attributes.description: Method by which informed consent was obtained and documented. 'paper' — wet ink signature; 'electronic' — eConsent platform; 'verbal_with_waiver' — IRB-approved verbal consent with waiver of written documentation; 'remote_electronic' — remote eConsent; 'delegated' — consent delegated to authorized representative.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; FDA eConsent Guidance 2016; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: consent_collection_site
attributes.description: Name or code of the clinical or research site where informed consent was obtained (e.g., hospital, clinic, research center). Supports multi-site study management and site-level compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the research subject or patient provided signed informed consent. This is the principal business event date for the consent agreement and is required for regulatory compliance timelines.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 50; ICH E6(R2) GCP; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: consent_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent authorization expires and must be renewed or re-consented. Null for open-ended broad consents. Used to trigger re-consent workflows and enforce data use restrictions.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 7; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: consent_form_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the IRB-approved informed consent form presented to and signed by the subject (e.g., v1.0, v2.1). Critical for regulatory audit trails to confirm the subject received the current approved version.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 50; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: consent_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for documenting special circumstances, subject questions, deviations from standard consent process, or other relevant observations recorded during the consent encounter. Confidential — not for general access.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; GxP

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the consent record. 'active' — consent is valid and in force; 'withdrawn' — subject has revoked consent; 'expired' — consent period has lapsed without renewal; 'pending' — awaiting subject signature or IRB approval; 'superseded' — replaced by a newer consent version; 'revoked' — administratively invalidated.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; FDA 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Classification of the consent model applied. 'broad' permits use across multiple future research purposes; 'specific' restricts use to a defined study; 'tiered' allows subject to select permitted uses; 're_consent' indicates updated consent obtained for changed scope; 'emergency_waiver' denotes IRB-approved waiver; 'assent' applies to minors. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: broad|specific|tiered|re_consent|emergency_waiver|assent — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 7; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail requirements under FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and GxP.

attributes.name: deidentification_status
attributes.description: Current PHI de-identification status of the specimen and associated data. 'identified' — PHI present; 'de_identified' — HIPAA Safe Harbor or Expert Determination method applied; 'limited_dataset' — HIPAA limited dataset with DUA; 'pseudonymized' — GDPR pseudonymization applied; 'anonymized' — irreversibly anonymized.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.514; GDPR Article 4(5); ISO 27001

attributes.name: future_contact_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has consented to being contacted for future research studies or re-consent requests. Governs subject outreach activities in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: gdpr_lawful_basis
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Lawful Basis
attributes.description: The GDPR Article 6/9 lawful basis under which personal and special-category genomic data is processed for subjects in EU/EEA jurisdictions. 'not_applicable' for non-EU subjects. Required for GDPR compliance documentation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 9; GDPR Recital 33

attributes.name: incidental_findings_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has consented to disclosure of incidental or secondary genomic findings identified during sequencing or analysis (e.g., ACMG secondary findings). Distinct from primary study results.
attributes.references: ACMG Secondary Findings Guidelines; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; FDA 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: interpreter_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether a language interpreter was used during the consent process. When true, additional interpreter documentation is required per GCP guidelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 50.20

attributes.name: irb_protocol_number
attributes.description: The unique protocol number assigned by the Institutional Review Board (IRB) governing the study or research program under which this consent was obtained. Required for regulatory traceability and audit.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 56; ICH E6(R2) GCP; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code of the consent form presented to the subject (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'fr', 'zh-CN'). Ensures the subject received consent documentation in their primary language as required by FDA and ICH guidelines.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 50.20; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: legally_authorized_representative
attributes.description: Indicates whether consent was obtained from a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) rather than the subject directly (e.g., for incapacitated adults or minors). Triggers additional documentation requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 50.3(l); ICH E6(R2) GCP; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: lims_consent_record_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Consent Record ID
attributes.description: The native consent record identifier assigned by LabVantage LIMS. Enables bidirectional traceability between the Databricks Silver Layer data product and the operational LIMS system of record.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: permitted_use_clinical
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has authorized use of their specimen for clinical diagnostic purposes, including In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) assay validation and Laboratory Developed Test (LDT) workflows under CLIA/CAP.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Accreditation; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; IVDR 2017/746

attributes.name: permitted_use_commercial
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has authorized use of their specimen and genomic data for commercial product development, including reagent validation, instrument development, and product commercialization activities.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 9; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: permitted_use_data_sharing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has authorized sharing of their de-identified genomic data with external parties, including public genomic databases (e.g., dbGaP, GEO), research consortia, or partner institutions under the NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy.
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GDPR Article 9; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164 Safe Harbor

attributes.name: permitted_use_research
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has authorized use of their specimen and associated genomic data for internal Research and Development (R&D) purposes. Governs bioinformatics pipeline processing and variant analysis workflows.
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GDPR Article 9; FDA 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: phi_authorization
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has provided explicit HIPAA authorization for use and disclosure of their Protected Health Information (PHI) in conjunction with specimen and genomic data processing.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.508; FDA 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: re_consent_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which re-consent must be obtained from the subject. Null if re-consent is not required. Used to manage compliance timelines and subject outreach scheduling.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 50; ICH E6(R2) GCP; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: re_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a re-consent is required from the subject due to protocol amendments, expanded data use scope, or consent expiry. Triggers re-consent workflow in LabVantage LIMS and MasterControl.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 50; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Primary regulatory jurisdiction applicable to this consent record, using ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes. Determines which regulatory framework (FDA, EMA, IVDR, etc.) governs consent requirements and data handling obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|EU|GBR|CAN|AUS|JPN|CHN|IND|BRA|OTHER — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 50; IVDR 2017/746; GDPR; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: return_of_results_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has consented to receive individual genomic research results or incidental findings. Governs clinical reporting workflows and genetic counseling referral processes.
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; ACMG Guidelines; FDA 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: sponsor_name
attributes.description: Name of the sponsoring organization or institution for the study under which consent was obtained. May be Genomics Biotech itself or an external sponsor for collaborative studies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.3; GDPR Article 26

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Required for change tracking and audit trail compliance under FDA 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; GxP; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: veeva_document_code
attributes.description: The document identifier in Veeva Vault for the executed consent form document. Provides a direct link to the regulatory document management system for audit and inspection readiness.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; GxP

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the subject formally withdrew consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. When populated, triggers downstream data quarantine and use-restriction enforcement per GDPR right-to-erasure and HIPAA requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 & Article 17; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; FDA 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason for consent withdrawal. Required for regulatory reporting and adverse event tracking. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: subject_request|adverse_event|protocol_deviation|lost_to_followup|deceased|administrative|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 50; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 7

products.name: subject
products.description: De-identified or pseudonymized master record of the biological source individual (research participant, patient, donor, or animal model) from whom specimens are collected. Stores subject code, species, biological sex, year of birth (not full DOB for de-identification), ethnicity/ancestry group (for population genomics), disease indication, de-identification method applied (HIPAA Safe Harbor or Expert Determination), de-identification tier (fully de-identified, pseudonymized, limited dataset), and re-identification risk level. Does NOT store direct PHI — PHI linkage is managed via consent_record and access-controlled separately per HIPAA Safe Harbor. Supports cohort membership tracking via external study enrollment references.
products.reference: HIPAA Safe Harbor De-identification / GDPR Pseudonymization

attributes.name: subject_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the biological source individual (research participant, patient, donor, or animal model) within the Genomics Biotech data platform. Primary key for the subject master record. Role: MASTER_PARTY.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Research subjects enrolled through customer accounts (clinical sites, research institutions). Required for multi-site study management, institutional consent tracking, data access control, and site-sp

attributes.description: De-identified family or pedigree identifier linking related subjects (e.g., proband and family members in trio or family-based genomic studies). attributes.name: gene_annotation_track_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.gene_annotation_track. Business justification: Research subjects are analyzed with a consistent annotation track across longitudinal timepoints to ensure study reproducibility. Required for publication data freeze, cross-timepoint variant comparis

attributes.name: genome_assembly_id

attributes.name: irb_submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IRB or ethics committee protocol under which this subject was enrolled. Links the subject to the governing research protocol, consent framework, and permissible data use scope. Required for regulatory submissions, audit trails, and NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 45 CFR Part 46 (Common Rule); NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; FDA 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: pharmacogenomics_marker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.pharmacogenomics_marker. Business justification: Research subjects are genotyped for PGx markers in drug response studies and clinical trials. Required for clinical trial stratification, GWAS, and pharmacogenomics outcomes research. Marker-level sub

attributes.description: Age of the subject in whole years at the time of study enrollment, derived from year_of_birth and enrollment_date at data ingestion. Stored as a pre-computed integer to support cohort age-stratification queries without requiring DOB. Enables pediatric vs. adult cohort segmentation and age-related genomic analyses.

attributes.name: ancestry_group
attributes.description: Self-reported or genetically inferred ancestry/ethnicity group of the subject, used for population genomics stratification, Minor Allele Frequency (MAF) reference panel selection, and pharmacogenomics analyses. Stored as a controlled vocabulary term aligned with gnomAD and 1000 Genomes Project population labels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AFR|AMR|EAS|EUR|MID|SAS|ASH|LAT|OTH — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: gnomAD Population Labels; 1000 Genomes Project; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; GDPR Article 9 Special Category Data

attributes.name: biobank_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has consented to long-term biobanking of residual specimens for future research use beyond the primary study. Governs specimen retention policies, storage duration limits, and permissible secondary use of aliquots in LabVantage LIMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISBER Best Practices for Repositories; GDPR Article 89; HIPAA; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: biological_sex
attributes.description: Biological sex of the subject as recorded at enrollment, distinct from gender identity. Used for sex-stratified genomic analyses, reference genome selection (e.g., chrX/chrY copy number), population genomics cohort stratification, and clinical assay interpretation.

attributes.name: collection_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the subject's specimens were collected. Drives GDPR data residency requirements, export control compliance for genomic data, and population genomics geographic stratification.
