attributes.name: collection_site_code
attributes.description: Coded identifier for the clinical or research site where the subject's specimens are collected. Used for multi-site study analytics, site-level QC (Quality Control) performance tracking, and regulatory site accountability. De-identified at the site level to avoid geographic re-identification of rare-disease subjects.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CAP Accreditation; ISO 15189

attributes.name: consent_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IRB-approved informed consent record governing the permissible uses of this subject's biological specimens and genomic data. Managed in the access-controlled consent management system (separate from this de-identified record). Enables traceability of data use to specific consent scope without embedding PHI in this product.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; HIPAA Authorization 45 CFR §164.508; GDPR Article 7; IRB/IEC Requirements; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the subject record was first created in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements under GxP, HIPAA, and GDPR, and enables data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: GxP (21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records); HIPAA Security Rule; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability; ISO 27001

attributes.name: data_access_tier
attributes.description: Permissible data access level for genomic data derived from this subject, aligned with NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy tiers. Open access data is publicly available; registered access requires user registration; controlled access requires dbGaP or equivalent approval; restricted access is limited to named investigators under a data use agreement (DUA).
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy (NOT-OD-14-124); dbGaP Data Access Policy; GDPR Article 89; HIPAA

attributes.name: deidentification_method
attributes.description: The HIPAA-recognized or GDPR-compliant method applied to de-identify or pseudonymize the subject record. HIPAA Safe Harbor removes 18 specified identifiers; Expert Determination uses statistical analysis to certify re-identification risk is very small. Pseudonymization replaces direct identifiers with a code while retaining a linkage key in a separate access-controlled system. Drives data access tier assignment and downstream PHI handling rules.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514(b) Safe Harbor; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514(b)(1) Expert Determination; GDPR Article 4(5); GDPR Recital 26

attributes.name: deidentification_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the subject record's de-identification level per HIPAA and GDPR frameworks. Fully de-identified records have no re-identification pathway; pseudonymized records retain a coded linkage to PHI managed separately; limited dataset records retain certain geographic and date information under a data use agreement (DUA). Governs permissible downstream data uses and sharing.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HIPAA Limited Dataset 45 CFR §164.514(e); GDPR Article 89; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: disease_indication
attributes.description: Primary disease indication or phenotype associated with the subject, encoded using a standardized ontology term (e.g., ICD-10, OMIM, HPO). Drives cohort assembly for clinical genomics studies, variant interpretation in clinical assay workflows, and regulatory submission stratification. Free-text or ontology code depending on study protocol.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM; OMIM; Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO); IVDR 2017/746; FDA IVD Guidance

attributes.name: disease_indication_ontology
attributes.description: Ontology or coding system used to encode the disease_indication field (e.g., ICD-10, OMIM, HPO, SNOMED-CT). Enables interoperability across clinical, research, and regulatory systems and ensures consistent variant interpretation and cohort queries.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM; OMIM; HPO; SNOMED-CT; HL7 FHIR Condition.code

attributes.name: family_relationship
attributes.description: Role of this subject within the family pedigree identified by family_id. Used for trio-based variant calling, de novo mutation detection, and inheritance pattern analysis in WGS/WES (Whole Exome Sequencing) workflows. Null for unrelated subjects.
attributes.references: ACMG/AMP Variant Interpretation Guidelines; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; HL7 FHIR FamilyMemberHistory

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether GDPR applies to this subject's data, based on the subject's collection country and data processing location. When True, GDPR Article 9 special category data protections apply to genetic data, and data subject rights (access, erasure, portability) must be honored. Drives EU data residency and transfer compliance workflows.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; GDPR Article 4(13) Genetic Data; GDPR Article 44 Data Transfers; GDPR Recital 34

attributes.name: genomic_data_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has provided explicit consent for their genomic data to be shared with external repositories (e.g., dbGaP, EGA, UK Biobank). Required for NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy compliance and international data sharing agreements. When False, data must not be submitted to public or controlled-access repositories.
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy (NOT-OD-14-124); GDPR Article 7; HIPAA Authorization 45 CFR §164.508; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: hipaa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether HIPAA Privacy Rule applies to this subject's data, based on whether the subject is a US patient or the data is held by a HIPAA-covered entity or business associate. When True, PHI handling, minimum necessary standard, and de-identification requirements apply.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR Part 164; HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR Part 164; HHS Guidance on De-identification

attributes.name: incidental_findings_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has consented to receive incidental or secondary genomic findings (e.g., ACMG SF v3.2 actionable secondary findings) identified during WGS/WES analysis. Drives the return-of-results workflow and clinical reporting obligations for pathogenic variants in medically actionable genes.
attributes.references: ACMG Secondary Findings v3.2 (SF v3.2); ICH E6(R2) GCP; HIPAA; GDPR Article 9; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: lims_subject_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Subject ID
attributes.description: Native subject identifier assigned by LabVantage LIMS at the time of accessioning. Used for cross-system traceability between the Databricks Silver Layer data product and the operational LIMS workflow. Enables reconciliation and lineage tracking back to the system of record.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS Subject Master; ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for study coordinator or clinical staff annotations regarding the subject record, such as protocol deviations, special handling instructions, or enrollment exceptions. Must not contain direct PHI. Reviewed during data quality audits and IRB annual reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; LabVantage LIMS Subject Notes; ISO 15189

attributes.name: phi_linkage_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a PHI linkage record exists for this subject in the access-controlled consent and identity management system. When True, the subject_code can be re-linked to direct PHI by authorized personnel only. When False, the record is fully de-identified with no re-linkage pathway. Supports HIPAA Safe Harbor compliance auditing.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502(d); GDPR Article 4(5)

attributes.name: primary_assay_type
attributes.description: The primary genomic assay type intended or performed for this subject's specimens. Drives bioinformatics pipeline selection, QC (Quality Control) metric thresholds, and data product routing. WGS (Whole Genome Sequencing), WES (Whole Exome Sequencing), targeted panel, SNP (Single Nucleotide Polymorphism) array, RNA-seq, and methylation array are the principal assay categories. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WGS|WES|targeted_panel|SNP_array|RNA_seq|methylation_array|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub; LabVantage LIMS Assay Configuration; FDA IVD Guidance; IVDR 2017/746

attributes.name: recontact_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject has consented to being re-contacted for additional studies, incidental findings disclosure, or updated consent. Relevant for longitudinal genomics studies and return-of-results workflows. When False, no re-contact is permitted without a new consent process.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ACMG Incidental Findings Policy; GDPR Article 7; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: record_version
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number for the subject record, incremented on each update. Supports optimistic concurrency control, SCD Type 2 history tracking, and GxP audit trail requirements for regulated genomics data. Version 1 represents the initial record creation.
attributes.references: GxP 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ISO 13485 Section 4.2.5; Databricks Delta Lake Versioning

attributes.name: reference_genome_build
attributes.description: The reference genome assembly version used as the default for bioinformatics pipeline alignment and variant calling for this subject's specimens (e.g., GRCh38 for human, GRCm39 for mouse). Ensures consistency between sample metadata and downstream BAM/VCF (Variant Call Format) outputs. Critical for multi-cohort studies where genome build consistency is required.
attributes.references: NCBI Reference Sequence (RefSeq); Ensembl Genome Browser; ACMG Variant Classification; Illumina BaseSpace Sequence Hub

attributes.name: reidentification_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessed risk level that the subject record could be re-linked to a specific individual, based on the de-identification method applied and residual quasi-identifiers present (e.g., rare disease, small geographic area, unusual ancestry). Determined by the privacy officer or expert determination process. Drives data access controls, sharing restrictions, and consent re-contact requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Expert Determination 45 CFR §164.514(b)(1); GDPR Article 25 Data Protection by Design; ISO 27001; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this subject record was originated or last updated. Enables data lineage traceability and reconciliation between the Databricks Silver Layer and upstream operational systems (primarily LabVantage LIMS for sample domain records).
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS; Benchling R&D Notebook; ISO 27001; GxP 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: species
attributes.description: Biological species of the subject. Determines applicable reference genome, annotation pipeline, and regulatory classification (human vs. animal model). Critical for bioinformatics pipeline routing and IRB/IACUC compliance.
attributes.references: NCBI Taxonomy; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; ISO 15189

attributes.name: subject_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, de-identified alphanumeric code assigned to the subject at accessioning or enrollment. Used as the operational identifier across LIMS, bioinformatics pipelines, and clinical reports without exposing direct PHI. Equivalent to the participant ID or pseudonym in study documentation.
attributes.references: HIPAA Safe Harbor (45 CFR §164.514(b)); GDPR Article 4(5) Pseudonymisation; LabVantage LIMS Subject Code

attributes.name: subject_type
attributes.description: Classification of the biological source individual by their role in the study or clinical workflow. Drives consent requirements, regulatory handling, and data access controls. Research participants and patients require IRB/ethics board oversight; animal models require IACUC approval.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; HIPAA; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; IACUC

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the subject record in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental pipeline processing, and GxP audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: GxP (21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records); HIPAA Security Rule; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability; ISO 27001

attributes.name: use_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory use classification for data and specimens derived from this subject. RUO (Research Use Only) specimens are not intended for clinical diagnosis; IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic) specimens are used in validated clinical assays; LDT (Laboratory Developed Test) specimens are used in laboratory-developed clinical tests. Drives regulatory handling, labeling, and data access controls.
attributes.references: FDA IVD Guidance 21 CFR Part 809; IVDR 2017/746; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; ISO 13485

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject formally withdrew consent or was removed from the study. Triggers downstream data use restriction workflows per HIPAA and GDPR right-to-erasure requirements. Populated only when subject_status is 'withdrawn'.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.508; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Reason for subject withdrawal from the study or clinical program, recorded when subject_status transitions to 'withdrawn'. Supports regulatory audit trails, protocol deviation reporting, and IRB annual review documentation. Populated only when applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 45 CFR Part 46; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Veeva Vault Regulatory Document

attributes.name: year_of_birth
attributes.description: Four-digit birth year of the subject. Stored instead of full date of birth (DOB) to comply with HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification requirements (45 CFR §164.514(b)(2)(i)), which prohibit retention of specific birth dates. Enables age-range calculations and cohort age-stratification for population genomics without re-identification risk.
attributes.references: HIPAA Safe Harbor 45 CFR §164.514(b)(2)(i); GDPR Article 89 Research Exemption

products.name: collection_event
products.description: Transactional record of the physical specimen collection activity. Captures collection date/time, collection site (anatomical location or environmental site), collection method (venipuncture, biopsy, swab, saliva kit, liquid biopsy), collector ID, collection kit lot number, pre-analytical conditions (fasting status, time from collection to processing), and any collection deviations. Provides the pre-analytical metadata critical for NGS data quality interpretation.

attributes.name: collection_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the specimen collection event record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this transactional entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Collection events occur at customer sites. Essential for site-specific protocol compliance monitoring, collection kit logistics coordination, site performance metrics, and regulatory audit trails. Rea

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.campaign. Business justification: Collection events for biobank recruitment campaigns or population genomics studies must link to marketing campaign for effectiveness measurement (specimen collection volume vs. campaign spend), lead g

attributes.name: clinical_evidence_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_evidence. Business justification: Clinical specimen collection events in validation studies must be linked to evidence records for protocol compliance verification, data integrity audits, and regulatory inspection readiness.

attributes.name: collection_kit_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.reagent_catalog. Business justification: Collection events use specific collection kit products (PAXgene, Tempus, saliva kits). Critical for tracking kit performance across collection sites, supplier quality monitoring, and correlating pre-a

attributes.name: collection_kit_catalog_item_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Collection Kit Catalog Item Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.catalog_item. Business justification: Collection events use specific collection kit products. Currently denormalized as collection_kit_sku. Business need: kit lot traceability for regulatory compliance, collection protocol compliance veri

attributes.name: controlled_document_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) document in MasterControl that governed this collection event. Ensures traceability to the approved procedure version used, supporting GxP compliance and audit readiness.
attributes.references: MasterControl — Document Control; GxP (GLP/GCP); ISO 13485:2016 §4.2.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.40

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Collection events incur field operations costs (phlebotomy labor, collection kits, logistics) charged to cost centers. Necessary for clinical trial budgeting, site cost allocation, and per-patient cos

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trained personnel (phlebotomist, nurse, field technician, or research coordinator) who performed the physical specimen collection. Used for competency tracking, deviation investigation, and chain-of-custody documentation.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Personnel Module; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1489; CAP Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material. Business justification: Collection kits are materials with SKUs and lot numbers. Linking enables kit inventory management, automated consumption tracking, lot traceability for specimen provenance, and recall management. Remo

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the research study, clinical trial, or diagnostic project under which this collection event was performed. Enables cohort-level aggregation and study-specific pre-analytical QC reporting.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Study Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: research_protocol_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) approved protocol under which this collection event was conducted. Mandatory for research specimens; ensures regulatory traceability of consent and ethical approval.
attributes.references: IRB Protocol Requirements; 45 CFR Part 46 (Common Rule); FDA 21 CFR Part 50; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: sample_consent_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the informed consent record obtained from the subject prior to collection. Links to the IRB consent management entity. Mandatory for research and clinical genomics specimens; supports HIPAA, GDPR, and NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.508; GDPR Article 7; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; 45 CFR Part 46

attributes.name: sample_specimen_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary biological sample record created as a result of this collection event. Links to the sample master entity in the Sample Management domain for downstream LIMS workflow assignments, aliquoting, and storage tracking.

attributes.name: subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the human subject, patient, or research participant from whom the specimen was collected. Links to the subject/patient master record. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category. Classified restricted/pii_identifier as it directly identifies a research or clinical participant.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; GDPR Article 4; IRB Protocol Requirements; LabVantage LIMS — Subject Module

attributes.name: training_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.training_record. Business justification: Training records document that collectors are qualified to perform collections. Labs link training to collection events for regulatory compliance and audit trails.

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical or research study visit during which this collection event occurred. Supports longitudinal sample tracking and time-point-based genomic analysis (e.g., baseline vs. post-treatment comparisons).
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Visit Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: anatomical_site
attributes.description: Standardized anatomical location from which the specimen was collected (e.g., left antecubital vein, right breast core, nasopharynx). Encoded using SNOMED CT or ICD-10 topography codes where applicable. Critical for oncology and clinical genomics interpretation.
attributes.references: SNOMED CT Anatomy Hierarchy; ICD-10-CM Topography; HL7 FHIR Specimen.collection.bodySite; CAP Cancer Protocols

attributes.name: collection_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the country where the specimen was collected. Required for international regulatory compliance (GDPR, IVDR), cross-border data transfer governance, and geographic cohort stratification.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GDPR Article 44 (Cross-border transfers); IVDR 2017/746

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: Calendar date (yyyy-MM-dd) on which the specimen was collected. Stored separately from collection_timestamp to support date-level partitioning, reporting, and cases where only the date (not exact time) is known or required.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Collection Event; ISO 15189:2022; HIPAA Safe Harbor De-identification

attributes.name: collection_event_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known business identifier for the collection event, assigned by LabVantage LIMS at accessioning. Used for chain-of-custody documentation, deviation reports, and cross-system traceability. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.

attributes.name: collection_kit_lot_number
attributes.description: Lot number of the collection kit (e.g., blood draw tube, biopsy kit, saliva collection kit, liquid biopsy tube) used during the collection event. Critical for pre-analytical QC, reagent traceability, and recall management. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM lot tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Batch/Lot Management; ISO 13485:2016 §7.5.9; FDA 21 CFR Part 820

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: Standardized method used to obtain the biological specimen. Drives pre-analytical QC interpretation and NGS library preparation protocol selection. Values: venipuncture (blood draw), biopsy (tissue), swab (mucosal/surface), saliva_kit (self-collected saliva), liquid_biopsy (cell-free DNA from blood), fine_needle_aspiration (FNA cytology).
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Collection Method Reference; CLSI GP33; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.3

attributes.name: collection_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional collector observations, special circumstances, or contextual notes recorded at the time of collection that do not fit into structured fields. Supports clinical interpretation and deviation investigation.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Collection Event Notes; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4

attributes.name: collection_order_number
attributes.description: External order or requisition number from the ordering system (e.g., SAP SD sales order, clinical order management system) that triggered this collection event. Enables end-to-end traceability from customer order to specimen collection.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Sales Order; LabVantage LIMS — Order Integration; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.1

attributes.name: collection_site_code
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical, research, or environmental site where the specimen was collected (e.g., hospital phlebotomy unit, field sampling location, clinical trial site). Links to the site/location master record.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Site Master; CLIA 42 CFR §493; CAP Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: collection_sop_version
attributes.description: Version number of the SOP document used at the time of collection (e.g., v1.2, v3.0). Stored alongside the SOP ID to capture the exact approved version in effect, as SOP versions change over time.

attributes.name: collection_temperature_c
attributes.description: Ambient or transport temperature in degrees Celsius at the time of or immediately following specimen collection. Used to assess cold-chain compliance and pre-analytical stability. Critical for cfDNA liquid biopsy and RNA specimens.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Pre-Analytical Conditions; CLSI; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.5

attributes.name: collection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) at which the physical specimen was collected from the subject or environment. This is the principal real-world event time and is critical for pre-analytical time calculations (e.g., time-to-processing, cold-chain compliance). Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Collection Event; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1241; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.4

attributes.name: collection_tube_count
attributes.description: Number of collection tubes or containers used during the collection event. Relevant for blood draw events with multiple tube types (EDTA, SST, Streck cfDNA). Supports aliquot planning and chain-of-custody reconciliation.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Collection Event; CLSI H3-A6

attributes.name: collection_urgency
attributes.description: Priority classification of the collection event that governs Turnaround Time (TAT) expectations and workflow prioritization in LabVantage LIMS. 'stat' = immediate priority; 'urgent' = same-day; 'routine' = standard TAT.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Workflow Priority; SLA Management; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4

attributes.name: collection_volume_ml
attributes.description: Volume of specimen collected, expressed in millilitres (mL). Used for pre-analytical QC assessment (e.g., short draw detection), yield estimation, and aliquot planning. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER QUANTITATIVE_RESULT category (non-monetary transaction).
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Collection Metrics; CLSI H3-A6 (Venipuncture); ISO 15189:2022 §5.4

attributes.name: collection_volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the collection volume field. Typically mL for liquid specimens; mg or g for solid tissue specimens; uL for micro-volume collections.

attributes.name: collector_certification_number
attributes.description: Professional certification or license number of the individual who performed the collection (e.g., phlebotomy certification, nursing license). Required for CLIA and CAP compliance documentation and chain-of-custody integrity.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR §493.1489; CAP Accreditation Standards; ISO 15189:2022 §5.1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the collection event record was first created in LabVantage LIMS. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA tracking. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Audit Trail; ISO 27001; GxP 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: deviation_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the pre-analytical deviation observed during the collection event (e.g., 'Specimen hemolyzed due to difficult venipuncture', 'Collection tube inverted fewer than required times'). Populated only when deviation_flag is True.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Deviation Notes; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.6; GxP

attributes.name: deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pre-analytical deviation occurred during this collection event (e.g., hemolysis, incorrect tube, delayed processing, temperature excursion). True = deviation recorded; False = no deviation. Triggers downstream QC review and may affect NGS data quality interpretation.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Deviation Management; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.6; GxP; CLIA 42 CFR §493

attributes.name: deviation_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the pre-analytical deviation type. Used for trending, root cause analysis, and QC reporting. Populated only when deviation_flag is True.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Deviation Classification; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.6; CLIA 42 CFR §493

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the collection event workflow. 'scheduled' = collection planned but not yet performed; 'in_progress' = collector has initiated; 'completed' = specimen successfully collected and handed off; 'cancelled' = event voided before collection; 'deviated' = completed with documented pre-analytical deviation. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Workflow State Machine; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4

attributes.name: fasting_status
attributes.description: Pre-analytical fasting status of the subject at the time of collection. Relevant for metabolomics, lipid panels, and certain genomic assays where fasting state affects analyte stability and downstream data quality interpretation.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Pre-Analytical Conditions; CLSI EP7; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.2

attributes.name: hemolysis_index
attributes.description: Semi-quantitative assessment of hemolysis in the collected blood specimen, graded on a standardized scale (none, 1+ to 4+). Hemolysis is a key pre-analytical variable that degrades DNA/RNA quality and affects NGS library preparation success rates.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Specimen QC; CLSI EP7; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.6

attributes.name: lims_accession_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Accession Number
attributes.description: Accession number assigned by LabVantage LIMS at the time of specimen receipt and registration. Serves as the primary LIMS-side identifier for chain-of-custody tracking and workflow assignment.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Accessioning Module; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1241; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.4

attributes.name: phi_deidentified
attributes.description: Indicates whether Protected Health Information (PHI) associated with this collection event has been de-identified per HIPAA Safe Harbor or Expert Determination method. True = de-identified; False = identifiable PHI present. Governs data access controls and downstream sharing permissions.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; GDPR Article 89; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the specimen was received at the processing laboratory. Used to calculate time-in-transit and total pre-analytical time (collection to receipt). Critical for TAT reporting and cold-chain compliance verification.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Specimen Receipt; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.4; CLIA 42 CFR §493.1241

attributes.name: scheduled_collection_date
attributes.description: Planned calendar date for the collection event as defined in the study protocol or clinical order. Compared against collection_date to calculate collection compliance and protocol adherence metrics.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Study Schedule; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Clinical Trial Protocol

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Biological specimen type collected. Determines downstream processing protocols, storage conditions, and applicable NGS assay types (e.g., WGS, WES, liquid biopsy ctDNA). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: whole_blood|plasma|serum|buffy_coat|saliva|tissue_ffpe|tissue_fresh_frozen|buccal_swab|urine|csf|stool|bone_marrow|amniotic_fluid — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Specimen Type Reference; SNOMED CT; HL7 FHIR Specimen Resource; ISO 15189:2022

attributes.name: time_to_processing_minutes
attributes.description: Elapsed time in minutes between specimen collection timestamp and the start of primary processing (e.g., centrifugation, nucleic acid extraction). A critical pre-analytical variable for NGS data quality; exceeding thresholds may trigger QC flags or deviation records.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Pre-Analytical Metrics; CLSI H18-A4; ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.5

attributes.name: transport_condition
attributes.description: Required transport temperature condition for the collected specimen from collection site to processing laboratory. Drives cold-chain logistics and is compared against actual temperature readings for pre-analytical QC.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Transport Conditions; IATA P650 (Biological Substances); ISO 15189:2022 §5.4.5

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the collection event record in LabVantage LIMS. Supports audit trail requirements and Silver Layer incremental load detection. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.
attributes.references: LabVantage LIMS — Audit Trail; GxP 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 27001

attributes.name: use_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory use classification of the specimen collected. RUO = Research Use Only; IVD = In Vitro Diagnostic; LDT = Laboratory Developed Test; clinical_trial = collected under an approved clinical trial protocol; quality_control = internal QC specimen. Determines applicable regulatory framework (FDA, CLIA, CAP) and data handling requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 809 (IVD); CLIA 42 CFR §493; CAP Accreditation; ISO 13485:2016

products.name: lims_workflow_assignment
products.description: Tracks the assignment of a specimen or aliquot to a specific laboratory workflow or assay queue within LabVantage LIMS. Records workflow type (library prep, DNA extraction, QC, clinical assay, research assay), assigned lab section, priority, scheduled start date, SLA due date, assigned technician, and current workflow status (queued, in-progress, completed, on-hold, failed). Enables turnaround-time monitoring, workload balancing, and bottleneck identification across the sample processing pipeline. Supports multi-step workflow chains where one assignment completion triggers the next.
products.reference: LabVantage LIMS Workflow Module / CLIA TAT Requirements

attributes.name: lims_workflow_assignment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Workflow Assignment Identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the workflow assignment record in LabVantage LIMS. Primary key for tracking specimen or aliquot assignment to laboratory workflows.

attributes.name: approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.regulatory_approval. Business justification: LIMS workflows for IVD assays must operate under approved regulatory scope (CLIA, CE-IVD, FDA clearance). Required for compliance verification, audit trails, and ensuring workflows match approved inte

attributes.name: assay_kit_catalog_item_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Assay Kit Catalog Item Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.catalog_item. Business justification: Workflows consume specific assay kits (sequencing reagents, array chips, library prep kits). Business need: protocol compliance verification, cost allocation per sample, inventory consumption tracking

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory instrument or equipment assigned for this workflow execution. Links to instrument master record for utilization tracking and maintenance correlation.

attributes.name: batch_id
