products.name: performance_telemetry
products.description: Stores time-series performance telemetry streamed from connected instrument assets — including sequencing run metrics (cluster density, Q30 score, Phred score, coverage depth, error rate), PCR amplification curves, array scan intensities, system health indicators (temperature, pressure, flow rate, laser power), and operational counters (run count, cycle count, reagent consumption). Granularity ranges from per-cycle to per-run depending on metric type. Enables predictive maintenance modeling, remote diagnostics, instrument performance trending, anomaly detection, and proactive field service dispatch. Landed in Databricks Lakehouse with configurable retention policies per metric class.
products.reference: Illumina BaseSpace Instrument Telemetry / IoT Sensor Stream

attributes.name: performance_telemetry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the performance telemetry record. Primary key for time-series instrument performance data.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Remote monitoring telemetry requires customer account link for proactive service programs, usage analytics, customer success dashboards, and predictive maintenance. Enables account-level performance r

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the instrument asset that generated this telemetry event. Links to the instrument master data for sequencing platforms, array scanners, PCR/qPCR systems, liquid handlers, and gene-editing equipment.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the laboratory technician or operator who initiated the run or maintenance activity. Supports operator-specific performance analysis and training needs assessment. Anonymized for privacy.

attributes.name: experiment_id

attributes.name: flow_cell_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the flow cell consumable used in the sequencing run. Tracks flow cell-specific performance and enables warranty claims for defective consumables. Nullable for non-sequencing instruments.

attributes.name: gene_model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.gene_model. Business justification: Telemetry systems track per-gene coverage metrics, uniformity, and quality scores for targeted panels and exome sequencing. Enables gene-level performance monitoring and detection of coverage dropouts

attributes.name: genome_assembly_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.genome_assembly. Business justification: Telemetry metrics like alignment rates, coverage uniformity, and error rates are genome-build-dependent. Quality monitoring systems compare telemetry against reference-specific benchmarks. Essential f

attributes.name: genomic_region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.genomic_region. Business justification: Telemetry captures region-specific metrics like on-target rate, uniformity across capture regions, and per-region coverage depth. Essential for monitoring targeted panel performance, detecting capture

attributes.name: instrument_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sequencing run, PCR run, or array scan session associated with this telemetry event. Nullable for system health metrics not tied to a specific analytical run.

attributes.name: production_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_batch. Business justification: Instrument performance metrics collected during manufacturing QC operations must link to production batches for data integrity audits. FDA 21 CFR Part 11 requires complete audit trail of analytical in

attributes.name: quality_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.quality_assessment. Business justification: Telemetry metrics (Q30, signal intensity, error rates) are assessed against quality thresholds in real-time. Links telemetry data points to formal quality assessment records. Enables automated QC work

attributes.name: reagent_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.lot. Business justification: Quality investigations routinely correlate instrument performance degradation (Q30 scores, error rates, cluster density) with specific reagent lots. Enables root cause analysis for run failures, suppo

attributes.name: service_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the field service event or maintenance activity associated with this telemetry record. Links to ServiceNow service tickets for post-service performance validation. Nullable for routine operational telemetry.

attributes.name: anomaly_detection_score
attributes.description: Machine learning-derived anomaly score indicating deviation from expected instrument behavior. Range 0.0000 to 1.0000, where higher values indicate greater anomaly likelihood. Enables predictive maintenance.

attributes.name: calibration_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent instrument calibration affecting this metric. Enables correlation of performance drift with calibration intervals. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Nullable if calibration not applicable.

attributes.name: cluster_density
attributes.description: Number of DNA clusters per square millimeter on the flow cell surface. Critical sequencing quality metric; optimal range varies by platform. Measured in clusters/mm². Nullable for non-sequencing instruments.

attributes.name: coverage_depth
attributes.description: Average number of reads covering each genomic position. Measured as X coverage (e.g., 30X). Critical for variant calling confidence. Nullable for non-sequencing instruments.

attributes.name: cycle_count_cumulative
attributes.description: Total number of sequencing cycles, PCR cycles, or operational cycles completed by the instrument. High-precision counter for component wear prediction and preventive maintenance.

attributes.name: cycle_number
attributes.description: Sequencing cycle, PCR cycle, or scan pass number when the metric was captured. Enables per-cycle performance trending and quality degradation analysis. Nullable for run-level or system-level metrics.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Assessment of telemetry data quality and reliability. Flags sensor malfunctions, calibration drift, or communication errors that may compromise data integrity.

attributes.name: error_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of incorrect base calls or measurement errors. Calculated from PhiX control spike-in or known reference. Lower values indicate better performance. Nullable for non-sequencing instruments.

attributes.name: facility_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the laboratory, manufacturing site, or customer facility where the instrument is installed. Enables multi-site performance comparison and regional trend analysis.

attributes.name: firmware_version
attributes.description: Instrument firmware or software version active when the telemetry was captured. Critical for correlating performance changes with software updates and supporting root cause analysis.

attributes.name: flow_rate_ml_per_min
attributes.description: Reagent or buffer flow rate in milliliters per minute. Ensures proper reagent delivery timing and volume. Deviations indicate pump wear or fluidics issues. Nullable for instruments without fluidics.

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the telemetry record was ingested into the Databricks Lakehouse. Distinct from telemetry_timestamp; used for data pipeline monitoring and latency analysis. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: lane_number
attributes.description: Flow cell lane number for sequencing instruments or array section identifier. Enables lane-specific performance comparison and troubleshooting. Nullable for non-lane-based instruments.

attributes.name: laser_power_watts
attributes.description: Optical laser power output in watts. Critical for imaging-based sequencers and array scanners. Degradation over time indicates laser aging and need for replacement. Nullable for non-optical instruments.

attributes.name: metric_name
attributes.description: Specific name of the performance metric being measured. Examples include cluster_density, q30_score, phred_score, coverage_depth, error_rate, temperature, pressure, flow_rate, laser_power, run_count, cycle_count, reagent_consumption.

attributes.name: metric_type
attributes.description: Classification of the telemetry metric being captured. Discriminates between sequencing performance data, PCR curves, array intensities, system health parameters, and operational usage counters.

attributes.name: metric_value
attributes.description: Numeric value of the telemetry measurement. Precision supports high-resolution sensor data and calculated performance indicators. Interpretation depends on metric_name and unit_of_measure.

attributes.name: phred_score_mean
attributes.description: Average Phred quality score across all base calls in the measurement window. Logarithmic scale representing base call accuracy. Nullable for non-sequencing instruments.

attributes.name: pressure_psi
attributes.description: Fluidics system pressure in pounds per square inch. Monitors pump performance and detects blockages or leaks in liquid handling systems. Nullable for instruments without fluidics.

attributes.name: q30_score_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of bases with Phred quality score of 30 or higher (99.9% base call accuracy). Industry-standard sequencing quality metric. Nullable for non-sequencing instruments.

attributes.name: read_number
attributes.description: Read identifier for paired-end or multi-read sequencing protocols (e.g., Read 1, Read 2, Index Read). Nullable for single-read runs or non-sequencing instruments.

attributes.name: reagent_volume_consumed_ml
attributes.description: Volume of reagent consumed during the measurement period in milliliters. Tracks reagent usage for inventory management and cost accounting. Cumulative or per-run depending on metric granularity.

attributes.name: retention_policy_class
attributes.description: Data retention classification determining how long this telemetry record is stored in the lakehouse. Varies by metric type: operational counters may be archived longer than per-cycle metrics.

attributes.name: run_count_cumulative
attributes.description: Total number of analytical runs completed by the instrument since installation or last counter reset. Operational counter for predictive maintenance scheduling and warranty tracking.

attributes.name: signal_intensity_mean
attributes.description: Average fluorescence or optical signal intensity. Used for array scanners and imaging-based sequencers. Higher values indicate better signal-to-noise ratio. Arbitrary units specific to instrument platform.

attributes.name: signal_to_noise_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of signal intensity to background noise. Higher values indicate cleaner data and better instrument performance. Dimensionless ratio. Nullable for non-imaging instruments.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or instrument control software that generated the telemetry stream. Examples: Illumina BaseSpace, instrument embedded controller, ServiceNow IoT connector. Supports multi-source data lineage.

attributes.name: telemetry_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the telemetry data point was captured by the instrument. Represents the real-world event time of the measurement or observation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Instrument operating temperature in degrees Celsius. Critical system health indicator for thermal cyclers, flow cells, and reagent storage compartments. Out-of-range values trigger maintenance alerts.

attributes.name: threshold_lower_limit
attributes.description: Lower acceptable boundary for the metric value. Values below this threshold trigger quality alerts or instrument service notifications. Defined per metric type and instrument model.

attributes.name: threshold_upper_limit
attributes.description: Upper acceptable boundary for the metric value. Values above this threshold trigger quality alerts or instrument service notifications. Defined per metric type and instrument model.

attributes.name: threshold_violation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the metric value falls outside acceptable thresholds. True when metric_value is below threshold_lower_limit or above threshold_upper_limit. Drives automated alerting and service dispatch.

attributes.name: tile_number
attributes.description: Imaging tile or spatial region identifier within a lane or array. Supports spatial performance analysis and detection of localized instrument issues. Nullable for non-imaging instruments.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the metric value. Examples: percent, clusters_per_mm2, phred_score, x_coverage, celsius, psi, ml_per_min, watts, count, cycles. Essential for correct interpretation and trending.

Supports GxP firmware baseline management, change control under ISO 13485 and 21 CFR Part 11, and field service firmware upgrade planning.

products.name: instrument_run
products.description: Records each instrument run executed on a sequencing platform, array scanner, or PCR/qPCR system — capturing run ID, run type (WGS/WES/targeted/array/qPCR), start and end datetime, operator, flow cell or array cartridge used, reagent lot numbers, run parameters (read length, cycle count, multiplexing index), run status (in-progress/completed/failed/aborted), and output data location (FASTQ/BAM path in BaseSpace or cloud storage). Central transactional record linking instrument operations to sequencing and bioinformatics domains.

Affects HGVS nomenclature, coverage calculations for target regions, and clinical report

attributes.name: genomic_region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.genomic_region. Business justification: Each targeted sequencing run specifies which genomic regions were captured/sequenced (e.g., Agilent SureSelect v7 exome). Determines coverage analysis boundaries, off-target rate calculations, and whi

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material. Business justification: Sequencing runs consume specific reagent kits, flow cell prep materials, and library prep consumables. Linking run to material enables lot-level traceability for quality investigations, regulatory com

attributes.name: reagent_kit_lot_id

attributes.name: research_protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.protocol. Business justification: Runs execute validated protocols for regulatory compliance and reproducibility. Essential for GxP audit trails, protocol deviation tracking, and method validation. Removes denormalized protocol name/v

attributes.name: sequencing_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sequencing.sequencing_run. Business justification: Links instrument execution record to sequencing run for run reconciliation, QC correlation, and instrument utilization reporting. Genomics operations require bidirectional navigation between instrumen

attributes.name: variant_database_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.variant_database. Business justification: Clinical sequencing runs specify which variant databases (ClinVar, COSMIC, gnomAD) to use for annotation during analysis. This determines pathogenicity classification and clinical reporting content. R

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.work_order. Business justification: Sequencing runs support work order QC checkpoints (library quality validation, intermediate product testing). Manufacturing execution systems require linking analytical runs to work orders for real-ti

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the instrument run completed or terminated, as recorded by the instrument control software.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the instrument run commenced, as recorded by the instrument control software or BaseSpace Sequence Hub.

attributes.name: cluster_density
attributes.description: Average cluster density on the flow cell surface, measured in thousands of clusters per square millimeter (K/mm²). Key quality metric for NGS runs.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this instrument run record was first created in the system, typically at run initiation or scheduling.

attributes.name: cycle_count
attributes.description: Total number of sequencing cycles executed in the run, determining read length and paired-end configuration. Applicable to NGS platforms.

attributes.name: error_rate
attributes.description: Estimated sequencing error rate as a percentage, typically calculated from PhiX control spike-in. Lower values indicate higher accuracy.

attributes.name: failure_reason
attributes.description: Detailed description of the reason for run failure or abortion, including error codes, instrument alerts, or operator notes. Null for successful runs.

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier or run name assigned by the operator or Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS). Often includes date, instrument serial, and sequence number.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 - Medical Laboratories Quality and Competence

attributes.name: instrument_software_version
attributes.description: Version number of the instrument control software or firmware used to execute the run, critical for reproducibility and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: is_clinical_run
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this run was performed under Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) or In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) regulatory requirements (True) or for Research Use Only (RUO) purposes (False).

attributes.name: is_paired_end
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the run used paired-end sequencing (True) or single-end sequencing (False). Applicable to NGS runs only.
attributes.references: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) Metadata Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this instrument run record was last updated, capturing status changes, QC updates, or data corrections.

attributes.name: mean_quality_score
attributes.description: Average Phred quality score across all bases in the run, indicating base-calling accuracy. Phred score of 30 corresponds to 99.9% accuracy.
attributes.references: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) Quality Standards

attributes.name: multiplexing_index_strategy
attributes.description: Indexing strategy used for sample multiplexing: single index (one barcode), dual index (two barcodes), unique dual index (UDI for collision avoidance), or none (single sample run).

attributes.name: number_of_samples
attributes.description: Total count of biological samples multiplexed and processed in this instrument run. For single-sample runs, value is 1.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 - Medical Laboratories Quality and Competence

attributes.name: output_data_location
attributes.description: File system path or cloud storage URI (e.g., Amazon Web Services (AWS) S3 bucket, BaseSpace project path) where raw output data (FASTQ, BAM, or array intensity files) is stored.
attributes.references: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) Submission Guidelines

attributes.name: output_file_format
attributes.description: Primary file format of the run output data: FASTQ (raw sequencing reads), Binary Alignment Map (BAM) (aligned reads), IDAT (Illumina array intensity), CEL (Affymetrix array), Variant Call Format (VCF) (variant calls), or other.
attributes.references: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) Data Format Standards

attributes.name: percent_aligned_to_phix
attributes.description: Percentage of reads that aligned to the PhiX control genome, confirming the expected spike-in concentration (typically 1%).

attributes.name: percent_pf_clusters
attributes.description: Percentage of clusters passing Illumina chastity filter, indicating the proportion of high-quality clusters. Typical target is >80%.

attributes.name: percent_q30_bases
attributes.description: Percentage of bases with Phred quality score of 30 or higher (≥99.9% accuracy). Industry standard quality threshold for clinical and research sequencing.
attributes.references: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) Quality Standards

attributes.name: phix_error_rate
attributes.description: Error rate measured specifically from PhiX control library spike-in, used as internal quality control for sequencing accuracy.

attributes.name: qc_performed_by
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory personnel or bioinformatician who performed the quality control review and approved or rejected the run.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 - Medical Laboratories Quality and Competence

attributes.name: qc_review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the quality control review was completed and the run QC status was finalized.

attributes.name: qc_status
attributes.description: Overall quality control assessment of the run: passed (meets all quality thresholds), failed (does not meet minimum quality), warning (marginal quality requiring review), or not-evaluated (QC pending).
attributes.references: ISO 15189 - Medical Laboratories Quality and Competence

attributes.name: read_length
attributes.description: Length of sequencing reads in base pairs (bp) for NGS runs, e.g., 150 bp paired-end. Null for non-sequencing assays.
attributes.references: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) Metadata Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the run: In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) (FDA-cleared assay), Laboratory Developed Test (LDT) (CLIA-validated), Research Use Only (RUO) (non-clinical), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) (manufacturing QC), or not-applicable.

attributes.name: run_mode
attributes.description: Operational mode or workflow configuration selected for the run: standard (default protocol), rapid (accelerated turnaround), high-throughput (maximum sample capacity), low-throughput (small batch), or custom (user-defined parameters).

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the instrument run: queued (scheduled but not started), in-progress (actively running), completed (finished successfully), failed (terminated due to error), aborted (manually stopped by operator), or under-review (completed but awaiting quality control approval).

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Type of genomic assay or experiment performed: Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS), Whole Exome Sequencing (WES), targeted sequencing panel, RNA sequencing, ChIP sequencing, array-based genotyping, gene expression array, quantitative Polymerase Chain Reaction (qPCR), droplet digital PCR (ddPCR), CRISPR screening, or library quality control. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WGS|WES|targeted_sequencing|RNA_seq|ChIP_seq|array_genotyping|array_expression|qPCR|ddPCR|CRISPR_screen|library_QC — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) Metadata Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the run was scheduled to begin, as recorded in the instrument scheduling system or LIMS.

attributes.name: target_coverage_depth
attributes.description: Planned average sequencing coverage depth (e.g., 30X for WGS, 100X for WES) as specified in the run protocol. Null for non-sequencing assays.
attributes.references: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) Metadata Standards

attributes.name: total_reads_generated
attributes.description: Total number of sequencing reads (or read pairs for paired-end) generated by the run. Null for non-sequencing assays.
attributes.references: NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) Metadata Standards

attributes.name: total_yield_gb
attributes.description: Total sequencing yield in gigabases (Gb) produced by the run, calculated as total reads multiplied by read length. Null for non-sequencing assays.

products.name: service_contract
products.description: Manages all instrument coverage entitlements — including manufacturer standard warranties (included with purchase), extended warranties, and separately purchased service contracts (comprehensive, parts-only, time-and-materials). Captures entitlement type, acquisition method (bundled-with-purchase vs separately-sold), coverage scope, SLA tier (response time, uptime guarantee), start and end dates, annual value, renewal terms, included PM visits, provider (manufacturer/third-party), and claim eligibility rules. Sourced from SAP SD service contracts and Salesforce CRM. SSOT for answering 'what coverage does this instrument have?' for field service entitlement checking, warranty claims, and SLA compliance.
products.reference: SAP SD Service Contract / Salesforce Service Agreement

attributes.name: service_contract_id

attributes.name: account_id

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing instrument, array scanner, PCR/qPCR platform, liquid handler, or gene-editing equipment covered by this service contract.

attributes.name: catalog_item_id

Links contract performance obligations to revenue recognition schedules for financial re

attributes.name: annual_contract_value

attributes.name: consumables_discount_percent

attributes.name: contract_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this contract (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: contract_number

attributes.name: contract_signed_date

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the service entitlement: manufacturer standard warranty (included with purchase), extended warranty, comprehensive service contract (parts, labor, PM), parts-only coverage, time-and-materials agreement, or preventive maintenance only.

attributes.name: coverage_scope
attributes.description: Defines which subsystems and components of the instrument are covered: full system, optics module only, fluidics subsystem, electronics, software updates, or exclusions such as consumables.

attributes.name: coverage_territory
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where this service contract is valid. Instruments moved outside this territory may void coverage. Critical for field service dispatch and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service contract record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Fixed amount the customer must pay per service incident before contract coverage applies. Common in lower-tier contracts. Null if no deductible.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the service contract coverage expires. Nullable for perpetual or lifetime warranties. Triggers renewal workflow 90 days prior.

attributes.name: included_pm_visits
attributes.description: Number of on-site preventive maintenance visits included in the contract term at no additional charge. Typically 1-4 per year depending on instrument type and SLA tier.

attributes.name: labor_coverage_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether field service engineer labor (on-site and remote) is included at no additional charge. True for comprehensive and labor-only contracts, false for parts-only.
attributes.references: SAP SD Service Contract Item Categories

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this service contract record. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: loaner_instrument_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temporary replacement instrument is provided during extended repairs (typically >5 business days downtime). Available only in platinum and gold tiers.

attributes.name: max_claims_per_year
attributes.description: Maximum number of service incidents that can be claimed under this contract within a 12-month period. Null for unlimited. Exceeding this cap triggers time-and-materials billing.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional contract details, special terms, customer-specific accommodations, or operational notes for field service engineers. Not visible to customer.
attributes.references: SAP SD Service Contract Header Text

attributes.name: parts_coverage_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether replacement parts (optics, sensors, pumps, valves, circuit boards) are included at no additional charge. True for comprehensive and parts-only contracts, false for labor-only or time-and-materials.
attributes.references: SAP SD Service Contract Item Categories

attributes.name: pm_visit_frequency_months
attributes.business_glossary_term: Preventive Maintenance (PM) Visit Frequency in Months
attributes.description: Scheduled interval in months between preventive maintenance visits (e.g., 3 for quarterly, 6 for semi-annual, 12 for annual). Drives field service scheduling.

attributes.name: priority_parts_shipping
attributes.description: Indicates whether replacement parts are shipped via expedited carrier (overnight or same-day) at no additional charge. Standard for platinum/gold, optional upgrade for silver/bronze.

attributes.name: remote_support_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether 24/7 remote diagnostics, troubleshooting, and software support via secure VPN connection are included. Standard for all tiers except bronze.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days before contract end date when renewal notification is sent to the customer. Typically 90, 60, or 30 days depending on contract value and complexity.

attributes.name: renewal_terms
attributes.description: Defines how the contract renews at expiration: automatic renewal unless cancelled, manual renewal requiring customer action, non-renewable (one-time coverage), opt-in (customer must confirm), opt-out (customer must cancel).

attributes.name: response_time_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours from service request submission to field service engineer dispatch or remote support initiation, as committed in the SLA tier.

attributes.name: service_provider
attributes.description: Entity responsible for delivering service under this contract: manufacturer (Genomics Biotech), authorized service partner, third-party maintenance organization, or customer self-service with remote support.

attributes.name: service_provider_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the organization providing service under this contract. For manufacturer service, this is Genomics Biotech. For partners, the authorized partner company name.

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: Service level tier defining response time commitments, uptime guarantees, and priority: platinum (4-hour response, 99.5% uptime), gold (8-hour, 98%), silver (next business day, 95%), bronze (48-hour), standard (best effort).

attributes.name: software_updates_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether instrument control software, firmware, and bioinformatics pipeline updates are included. Critical for maintaining regulatory compliance (FDA 21 CFR Part 11, IVDR) and performance optimization.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the service contract coverage becomes effective. For manufacturer warranties, typically the instrument installation qualification (IQ) completion date.
attributes.references: SAP SD Service Contract Validity Period

attributes.name: travel_expenses_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether field service engineer travel costs (airfare, mileage, lodging, meals) are included in the contract or billed separately. Typically true for platinum/gold tiers, false for bronze/standard.

attributes.name: uptime_guarantee_percent
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed instrument availability percentage over the measurement period (typically monthly or quarterly). Failure to meet this may trigger service credits.

products.name: blanket_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between instrument_model and blanket_order. It captures model-specific pricing, volume commitments, and consumption tracking when a blanket order covers multiple instrument models with differentiated terms. Each record links one instrument_model to one blanket_order with pricing and consumption attributes that exist only in the context of this specific model-agreement combination.. Existence Justification: In genomics biotech operations, large genome centers and biopharma customers establish multi-year reagent supply agreements (blanket orders) that cover multiple instrument models simultaneously (e.g., NovaSeq 6000, NextSeq 2000, and MiSeq systems). Each instrument model within the blanket order has model-specific pricing tiers, volume commitments, discount structures, and consumption tracking because reagent costs, chemistries, and throughput requirements vary significantly by platform. The business actively manages these model-specific terms as part of commercial contract administration.

Existence Justification: In genomics biotech service organizations, blanket orders for spare parts supply are structured as multi-line agreements where each blanket order covers multiple spare part SKUs (pumps, lasers, flow cells, optical components) with part-specific pricing, committed quantities, and consumption tracking. A single spare part can be included in multiple blanket orders serving different customers or regions, each with distinct negotiated terms. products.name: test_qualification
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory qualification and validation relationship between physical instrument assets and clinical IVD test catalog entries. It captures the formal validation process required for CLIA compliance, CAP accreditation, and FDA regulatory submissions. Each record links one instrument asset to one validated clinical test with qualification protocol references, validation dates, regulatory submission tracking, and expiration dates for re-qualification. This is the operational SSOT for the IVD Validation Matrix that determines which instruments are authorized to run which clinical tests.. Existence Justification: In genomics biotech clinical operations, each IVD test must be formally validated on specific instrument assets before clinical use, creating a true many-to-many operational relationship. One instrument can be qualified to run multiple different clinical tests (e.g., a NovaSeq 6000 validated for WGS, WES, and multiple targeted panels), and one clinical test must be validated on multiple instruments for capacity, redundancy, and business continuity. The qualification relationship itself is a regulated business entity with validation dates, protocol references, regulatory submission tracking, and expiration dates that trigger re-validation workflows.

products.name: batch_test
products.description: This association product represents the testing event between instrument_asset and production_batch. It captures the quality control testing performed on a specific production batch using a specific instrument asset. Each record links one instrument_asset to one production_batch with attributes that exist only in the context of this testing relationship: test type, timing, sample count, and QC results. Essential for batch release documentation, Certificate of Analysis (CoA) generation, and regulatory compliance (GMP/GxP traceability).. Existence Justification: In genomics biotech manufacturing, production batches undergo multiple quality control tests (identity, purity, potency, sterility) before release, and each test type requires a different instrument platform (sequencers for identity, HPLC for purity, qPCR for potency). A single batch is tested on multiple instruments, and each instrument tests multiple batches over time. The business actively manages these testing events as part of the Electronic Batch Record (EBR) lifecycle and Certificate of Analysis (CoA) generation, tracking test type, timing, sample count, and results for each instrument-batch combination.

It captures the detailed part usage for each maintenance activity, including quantity consumed, serial/lot traceability, installation timestamps, and removed part tracking. Each record links one maintenance event to one spare part with attributes that exist only in the context of this consumption transaction. Supports parts inventory management, cost allocation, warranty claims, regulatory compliance, and maintenance analytics.. Existence Justification: In real-world instrument maintenance operations, a single maintenance event routinely consumes multiple spare parts (e.g., replacing flow cell, optical sensor, and tubing in one service visit), and each spare part is consumed across many different maintenance events over time. The business actively manages these part consumption transactions as operational records with specific quantities, serial numbers, lot traceability, installation timestamps, and cost data that belong to neither the maintenance event nor the spare part alone.

products.name: lot
products.description: GMP-compliant lot (batch) master record for every manufactured or received reagent lot. Captures lot number, manufacturing date, expiry date, quantity produced, GMP release status, quarantine flags, retest date, originating work order or supplier shipment, supplier lot number, supplier COA reference, country of origin, and supplier quality grade. Includes immutable status audit trail recording all lifecycle transitions (quarantine → QC testing → released → restricted → disposed) with triggering event, operator ID, timestamp, and supporting document reference. SSOT for lot traceability across the reagent lifecycle. Supports FDA 21 CFR Part 211, ISO 13485, and GxP requirements.

attributes.description: Externally-known unique document number for the COA, used for regulatory submission, customer delivery, and audit trail. Typically follows a controlled numbering scheme.

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the PDF or electronic document version of the COA. Supports document management and customer self-service access.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the lot as determined by stability studies and documented in the COA. After this date, the lot should not be used.

attributes.name: gmp_release_authorized
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Release Authorization Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the lot has been authorized for GMP release based on COA results. True indicates the lot meets all acceptance criteria and is approved for distribution.

attributes.name: intended_use
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the intended use for this lot: Research Use Only (RUO), In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD), GMP-grade for manufacturing, or other classifications. Determines regulatory requirements and customer eligibility.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the COA was officially issued and released for use. This is the authoritative date for regulatory and customer-facing purposes.

attributes.name: issuing_laboratory
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the laboratory or facility that performed the QC testing and issued the COA. May be an internal GMP facility or a contracted testing laboratory.

attributes.name: issuing_laboratory_location
attributes.description: Geographic location or site identifier of the issuing laboratory. Required for regulatory traceability and multi-site operations.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the COA record was last modified. Tracks changes for audit trail and version control purposes.

attributes.name: overall_result
attributes.description: Overall pass/fail determination for the lot based on all QC tests performed. A pass result authorizes lot release; fail or conditional results trigger investigation and disposition.

attributes.name: regulatory_status
attributes.description: Regulatory compliance status of the lot based on COA results and applicable regulations (FDA, EMA, IVDR, etc.). Indicates whether the lot meets all regulatory requirements for its intended use.

attributes.name: release_authorization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lot was authorized for release following COA approval. Critical for regulatory compliance and lot traceability.

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date by which the lot should be retested to confirm continued conformance to specifications. Applicable for reagents with limited stability or time-sensitive performance characteristics.

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the COA was reviewed by QC personnel prior to QA approval. Part of the multi-stage approval workflow.

attributes.name: reviewed_by_name
attributes.description: Full name of the quality control analyst or reviewer who performed the initial review of test results before QA approval.

attributes.name: specification_document_number
attributes.description: Controlled document number of the product specification used for testing. Links to the master specification repository.

attributes.name: specification_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the product specification document against which the lot was tested. Ensures traceability to the correct acceptance criteria and test methods.

attributes.name: storage_conditions
attributes.description: Required storage conditions for the lot as documented in the COA (e.g., -20°C, 2-8°C, room temperature, protect from light). Critical for maintaining product integrity.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: Date on which the quality control testing was performed for this lot. May differ from issue date due to review and approval cycles.

attributes.name: test_summary
attributes.description: High-level summary of tests performed, including test names and categories (e.g., identity, purity, potency, sterility). Provides quick overview of COA scope.

products.name: sds
products.description: Safety Data Sheet (SDS) master record for each reagent or chemical substance, capturing GHS hazard classification, signal words, hazard and precautionary statements, first-aid measures, handling and storage requirements, disposal instructions, regulatory identifiers (CAS number, UN number), and SDS version history. Supports OSHA HazCom, REACH, and GHS compliance. Linked to reagent catalog entries and storage location requirements.
products.reference: Safety Data Sheet (SDS); GHS; OSHA HazCom 2012; REACH

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Safety Data Sheet record. Primary key.
attributes.references: ISO 11014 - Safety Data Sheet Content and Order of Sections

attributes.name: approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.regulatory_approval. Business justification: Safety Data Sheets must reference regulatory approval status (RUO vs IVD) as labeling requirements, hazard communication, and distribution restrictions differ by regulatory designation. Essential for

attributes.name: catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the reagent or chemical substance that this SDS document describes. Links to the reagent catalog entry.

attributes.name: controlled_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.controlled_document. Business justification: SDSs are controlled documents requiring version control, approval workflows, training tracking, and regulatory submission. Standard document control practice in GMP/GLP genomics operations for safety

attributes.name: research_protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.protocol. Business justification: SDS documents reference safe handling protocols for laboratory use. Links safety documentation to operational procedures. Required for EHS compliance, laboratory safety audits, and ensuring proper han

attributes.name: retention_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.retention_policy. Business justification: SDS documents have regulatory retention requirements (OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200, REACH). Real business need: EHS compliance and audit trail for hazardous material documentation.

attributes.name: accidental_release_measures
attributes.description: Emergency procedures, protective equipment, and proper methods for containment and cleanup of spills or leaks. Section 6 of SDS.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by the Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance. Format: XXXXXX-XX-X.

attributes.name: composition_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the chemical composition, including hazardous ingredients, concentration ranges, and CAS numbers for components. Section 3 of SDS.

attributes.name: country_of_issue
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country for which this SDS was prepared (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SDS record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: disposal_considerations
attributes.description: Guidance on proper disposal methods, waste treatment, and applicable regulations for the substance and contaminated packaging. Section 13 of SDS.

attributes.name: document_language
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code indicating the language in which this SDS is written (e.g., ENG for English, DEU for German).

attributes.name: ec_number
attributes.description: Seven-digit identifier assigned to chemical substances registered in the European Union. Format: XXX-XXX-X.

attributes.name: ecological_information
attributes.description: Environmental effects including ecotoxicity, persistence and degradability, bioaccumulative potential, and mobility in soil. Section 12 of SDS.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this SDS version becomes the official document for use. May differ from revision date to allow distribution time.

attributes.name: emergency_phone
attributes.description: 24-hour emergency telephone number for chemical emergencies (e.g., CHEMTREC, manufacturer emergency line). Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: exposure_controls
attributes.business_glossary_term: Exposure Controls and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
attributes.description: Occupational exposure limits, engineering controls, and personal protective equipment recommendations (respiratory, hand, eye, skin protection). Section 8 of SDS.

attributes.name: firefighting_measures
attributes.description: Suitable extinguishing media, specific hazards arising from the chemical, and special protective equipment for firefighters. Section 5 of SDS.

attributes.name: first_aid_measures
attributes.description: Instructions for first aid treatment following exposure by different routes (inhalation, skin contact, eye contact, ingestion). Section 4 of SDS.

attributes.name: ghs_classification
attributes.description: GHS hazard class and category codes for the substance (e.g., Flam. Liq. 2, Acute Tox. 3, Skin Corr. 1A). Multiple classifications separated by semicolons.
attributes.references: GHS Rev. 9, OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: handling_precautions
attributes.description: Precautions for safe handling including advice on protective measures, hygiene practices, and conditions to avoid. Section 7 of SDS.
attributes.references: ISO 11014 Section 7, OSHA HazCom Standard, GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: hazard_statements
attributes.description: Standardized GHS hazard statement codes and text describing the nature of the hazards (e.g., H225: Highly flammable liquid and vapor). Multiple statements separated by semicolons.

attributes.name: intended_use
attributes.description: Recommended use and restrictions on use of the chemical product (e.g., laboratory reagent, research use only, in vitro diagnostic).

attributes.name: manufacturer_address
attributes.description: Complete mailing address of the manufacturer or supplier. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactures or supplies the chemical product. Section 1 of SDS.

attributes.name: manufacturer_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the manufacturer or supplier. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SDS record was last modified in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: physical_properties
attributes.description: Physical and chemical characteristics including appearance, odor, pH, melting point, boiling point, flash point, vapor pressure, density, solubility. Section 9 of SDS.

attributes.name: pictogram_codes
attributes.description: GHS pictogram codes indicating hazard symbols (e.g., GHS02 for flame, GHS06 for skull and crossbones). Multiple codes separated by semicolons.

attributes.name: precautionary_statements
attributes.description: Standardized GHS precautionary statement codes and text describing recommended measures to minimize or prevent adverse effects (e.g., P210: Keep away from heat/sparks/open flames). Multiple statements separated by semicolons.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Manufacturer's catalog number or Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) for the reagent or chemical product.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Commercial or trade name of the chemical product or reagent as it appears on the label and in the catalog.
attributes.references: GHS Rev. 9 Section 1.1, OSHA HazCom Standard

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Number
attributes.description: Registration number issued under the EU REACH regulation for substances manufactured or imported in quantities of one tonne or more per year.

attributes.name: regulatory_information
attributes.description: Safety, health, and environmental regulations specific to the product including TSCA, REACH, OSHA, EPA listings and restrictions. Section 15 of SDS.
attributes.references: ISO 11014 Section 15, TSCA, REACH, OSHA Regulations

attributes.name: revision_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of the SDS was last revised or updated. Critical for ensuring users have current safety information.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200, GHS Rev. 9

attributes.name: sds_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the SDS document, typically assigned by the manufacturer or regulatory system. Externally-known unique code.

attributes.name: sds_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SDS document. Active indicates the document is currently in use; superseded indicates it has been replaced by a newer version.

attributes.name: signal_word
attributes.description: GHS signal word indicating the relative level of severity of hazard: Danger (more severe) or Warning (less severe).

attributes.name: stability_reactivity
attributes.description: Chemical stability, possibility of hazardous reactions, conditions to avoid, incompatible materials, and hazardous decomposition products. Section 10 of SDS.

attributes.name: storage_requirements
attributes.description: Conditions for safe storage including temperature range, humidity control, incompatible materials, and special storage requirements. Section 7 of SDS.
attributes.references: ISO 11014 Section 7, OSHA HazCom Standard, GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum recommended storage temperature in degrees Celsius to maintain product stability and safety.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum recommended storage temperature in degrees Celsius to maintain product stability and safety.

attributes.name: supersedes_date
attributes.description: Date of the previous SDS version that this document replaces. Nullable for initial SDS versions.

attributes.name: toxicological_information
attributes.description: Information on toxicological effects including routes of exposure, symptoms, acute and chronic effects, and numerical measures of toxicity (LD50, LC50). Section 11 of SDS.

attributes.name: transport_information
attributes.description: Transportation classification including UN number, proper shipping name, transport hazard class, packing group, and environmental hazards. Section 14 of SDS.
attributes.references: ISO 11014 Section 14, UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit identification number assigned by the United Nations for hazardous materials transport. Format: UNXXXX.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this SDS revision, following semantic versioning (e.g., 1.0, 2.1). Incremented when content is updated.

products.name: storage_location
products.description: Physical or logical storage location master for reagent inventory — capturing facility, building, room, freezer/refrigerator unit, shelf, and rack/position identifiers. Records monitored temperature zone, humidity range, capacity limits, current occupancy, environmental monitoring device linkage, access control level, and GMP qualification status. Supports LIMS-driven storage assignment, FIFO/FEFO management, cold-chain compliance tracking, and capacity planning.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Storage Location (MM-IM); LabVantage LIMS Storage Management

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical or logical storage location. Primary key for the storage location master data.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Storage location setup in GxP-controlled environments requires qualified personnel. Tracks accountability for cold storage, hazardous material areas, and cleanroom qualification. Supports audit trail

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent facility or site where this storage location physically resides. Links to facility master data for geographic and organizational context.

attributes.name: parent_location_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent storage location in a hierarchical storage structure. Enables nested location modeling such as freezer containing shelves containing racks.

attributes.name: access_control_level
attributes.description: Security classification determining who can physically access this storage location. Aligns with facility security protocols and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Machine-readable barcode identifier affixed to the physical storage location. Used for automated inventory scanning and LIMS integration.

attributes.name: building_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific building within the facility where the storage location is situated. Supports multi-building campus environments.

attributes.name: capacity_occupied_units
attributes.description: Current number of storage units occupied in this location. Updated by LIMS during inventory transactions to track utilization.

attributes.name: capacity_total_units
attributes.description: Maximum number of storage units (e.g., boxes, vials, plates) that can be accommodated in this location. Used for capacity planning and space optimization.

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for capacity tracking. Defines what constitutes one storage unit for capacity calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: box|vial|plate|tube|bottle|bag|container — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cold_chain_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location meets cold chain compliance requirements for temperature-sensitive reagents. Requires continuous environmental monitoring and validated temperature control.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage location record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when the storage location was deactivated or decommissioned. Used for historical tracking and to prevent new inventory assignments to retired locations.

attributes.name: deactivation_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or reason code for deactivating the storage location. Supports root cause analysis and facility planning decisions.

attributes.name: environmental_monitor_device_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the temperature/humidity monitoring device or sensor linked to this storage location. Enables traceability to environmental monitoring records.

attributes.name: fefo_enforcement_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: First Expired First Out (FEFO) Enforcement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether FEFO inventory management rules are enforced for this storage location. When true, LIMS will prioritize inventory with nearest expiry dates for picking.

attributes.name: fifo_enforcement_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: First In First Out (FIFO) Enforcement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether FIFO inventory management rules are enforced for this storage location. When true, LIMS will prioritize oldest inventory for picking.

attributes.name: gmp_qualification_status
attributes.description: GMP qualification state of the storage location. Indicates whether the location has passed Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ) protocols.

attributes.name: hazardous_material_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is approved for storing hazardous or flammable reagents. Requires special safety equipment and ventilation per Safety Data Sheet (SDS) requirements.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the storage location, used for operational reference and LIMS integration. Typically follows facility-room-unit-position hierarchy encoding.

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the storage location, used for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storage location based on environmental control and physical characteristics. Determines applicable storage protocols and monitoring requirements.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this storage location record. Supports audit trail and accountability requirements.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage location record was last updated. Tracks data currency and supports change management processes.

attributes.name: next_requalification_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic requalification of the storage location. Supports proactive compliance management and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special handling instructions, or location-specific information not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the storage location was last qualified or requalified per GMP requirements. Used to track qualification currency and schedule requalification activities.

attributes.name: room_number
attributes.description: Room or area identifier within the building where the storage location is positioned. Used for physical navigation and access control.

attributes.name: shelf_position
attributes.description: Granular position identifier within the storage unit, such as shelf level, rack number, or drawer position. Enables precise inventory localization.

attributes.name: storage_location_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the storage location. Controls whether the location can accept new inventory assignments and reflects qualification state.

attributes.name: target_humidity_max_pct
attributes.description: Upper bound of the acceptable relative humidity range for this storage location as a percentage. Applicable for humidity-sensitive reagent storage.

attributes.name: target_humidity_min_pct
attributes.description: Lower bound of the acceptable relative humidity range for this storage location as a percentage. Applicable for humidity-sensitive reagent storage.

attributes.name: target_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Upper bound of the acceptable temperature range for this storage location in degrees Celsius. Used for environmental monitoring and alarm thresholds.

attributes.name: target_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Lower bound of the acceptable temperature range for this storage location in degrees Celsius. Used for environmental monitoring and alarm thresholds.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Designated temperature control zone for the storage location. Determines which reagent types can be stored and monitoring requirements per GMP guidelines.

attributes.name: unit_identifier
attributes.description: Specific equipment unit identifier such as freezer serial number, refrigerator asset tag, or shelf unit code. Links to equipment master for maintenance tracking.

products.name: inventory_balance
products.description: Real-time reagent inventory balance record tracking on-hand quantity, reserved quantity, available-to-use quantity, and unit of measure for each reagent lot at each storage location. Captures reorder point, minimum stock level, maximum stock level, and last physical count date. Supports FEFO (First Expired First Out) dispensing logic, low-stock alerts, and GMP inventory reconciliation. Updated by goods receipts, dispensing events, and inventory adjustments.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Inventory Management (MM-IM); Stock Overview

attributes.name: inventory_balance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory balance record. Primary key for the inventory balance entity.

attributes.name: catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific reagent product (library prep kit, flow cell, CRISPR reagent, PCR master mix, enzyme, buffer, array chip) for which this inventory balance is maintained.

attributes.name: coa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Certificate of Analysis (COA) document for this reagent lot. COA contains quality test results, specifications, and release approval required for Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) compliance.

attributes.name: consignment_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Consignment inventory at customer sites or customer-reserved stock requires tracking ownership/allocation. Supports revenue recognition timing, inventory valuation, and service agreement compliance fo

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for this inventory location or reagent usage. Supports departmental cost allocation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system account that performed the last update to this inventory balance record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.lot. Business justification: Inventory balances are inherently lot-specific in GMP environments - each balance record represents quantity of a specific lot at a specific location. Currently inventory_balance has lot_number as STR

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) document for this reagent. SDS contains hazard information, handling instructions, and emergency procedures required for workplace safety compliance.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Inventory balances are tracked by SKU for financial valuation, MRP planning, and order fulfillment. Required for perpetual inventory, available-to-promise calculations, and inventory aging reports in

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical storage location (warehouse, cold room, freezer, shelf) where this reagent lot is stored. Supports multi-site inventory management.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor from whom this reagent lot was procured. Supports vendor performance analysis and supply chain traceability.

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity available for immediate use or reservation, calculated as on-hand quantity minus reserved quantity minus any quality hold quantity. Drives dispensing and allocation logic.

attributes.name: batch_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inventory balance record. Active indicates normal operations; depleted indicates zero on-hand; expired indicates past expiry date; recalled indicates manufacturer recall.

attributes.name: consignment_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that this inventory is held on consignment from the vendor and is not owned by the company until consumed. Affects inventory valuation and accounts payable processing. True indicates consignment stock.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory balance record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: days_to_expiry
attributes.description: Number of days remaining until the reagent lot reaches its expiry date. Used for expiry alerts, FEFO prioritization, and inventory aging reports.

attributes.name: expiry_alert_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that the reagent lot is approaching expiry (typically within 30-90 days based on business rules). True indicates alert condition requiring expedited usage or disposal planning.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Manufacturer-specified expiration date for the reagent lot. Critical for First Expired First Out (FEFO) dispensing logic, shelf-life management, and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) compliance.

attributes.name: fefo_priority_rank
attributes.business_glossary_term: First Expired First Out (FEFO) Priority Rank
attributes.description: Calculated ranking for First Expired First Out (FEFO) dispensing logic. Lower rank indicates earlier expiry and higher dispensing priority. Prevents expiry waste and ensures Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) compliance.

attributes.name: gmp_release_status
attributes.description: Quality Control (QC) release status indicating whether the reagent lot is approved for use in Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) operations. Blocked or quarantine status prevents dispensing.

attributes.name: last_adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the most recent inventory adjustment transaction. Supports audit trail, root cause analysis, and inventory accuracy improvement initiatives. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: physical_count|damage|expiry|transfer|correction|theft|spillage|quality_issue — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP MM Inventory Adjustment, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: last_movement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent inventory transaction (goods receipt, dispensing, transfer, adjustment) affecting this balance record. Used for inventory aging and slow-moving stock analysis.

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count or cycle count for this reagent lot at this storage location. Supports Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) inventory reconciliation and audit requirements.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this inventory balance record. Reflects the last goods receipt, dispensing, adjustment, or status change event.

attributes.name: low_stock_alert_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that the available quantity has fallen below the reorder point, triggering a low-stock alert for procurement action. True indicates alert condition.

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date when the reagent lot was manufactured. Used for shelf-life calculation, traceability, and quality control purposes.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: Maximum inventory level allowed at the storage location to prevent overstocking, manage storage capacity, and minimize expiry risk. Used for replenishment order quantity calculation.

attributes.name: minimum_stock_level
attributes.description: Safety stock or minimum inventory level that must be maintained to prevent stockouts and ensure continuous operations. Used for inventory policy enforcement.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special handling instructions, or contextual information about this inventory balance record. Supports operational communication and exception documentation.

attributes.name: on_hand_quantity
attributes.description: Total physical quantity of the reagent lot currently present at the storage location. Represents the actual inventory count before any reservations or allocations.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number under which this reagent lot was procured. Links inventory to procurement transaction for audit trail and cost reconciliation.

attributes.name: quarantine_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the reagent lot placed under quality hold or quarantine pending Quality Control (QC) inspection, Certificate of Analysis (COA) review, or investigation. Not available for use.

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date when the reagent lot was received into inventory at the storage location. Marks the start of internal shelf-life tracking and inventory aging analysis.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Minimum inventory level that triggers a replenishment order or low-stock alert. Calculated based on lead time, consumption rate, and safety stock requirements.

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the reagent lot that has been reserved or allocated for specific orders, experiments, or production runs but not yet physically dispensed. Reduces available-to-use quantity.

attributes.name: restricted_use_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that this reagent lot has usage restrictions (e.g., Research Use Only (RUO), specific project allocation, regulatory hold). True indicates restricted access requiring authorization.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that created or last updated this inventory balance record (SAP_MM=SAP Materials Management, LIMS=Laboratory Information Management System, WMS=Warehouse Management System, MES=Manufacturing Execution System, MANUAL=manual entry).

attributes.name: storage_condition_code
attributes.description: Required storage condition for the reagent lot (RT=room temperature, 2-8C=refrigerated, -20C=frozen, -80C=ultra-low freezer, LN2=liquid nitrogen, DRY=desiccated, DARK=light-protected). Ensures proper handling and stability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RT|2-8C|-20C|-80C|LN2|DRY|DARK — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: total_valuation_amount
attributes.description: Total inventory value for this balance record, calculated as on-hand quantity multiplied by valuation price. Used for balance sheet reporting and inventory turnover analysis.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the reagent quantity (e.g., EA for each, ML for milliliters, UL for microliters, KIT for kits, RXNS for reactions). Aligns with SAP Material Master UOM.
attributes.references: ISO 80000 - Quantities and Units, SAP MM UOM

attributes.name: valuation_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the valuation price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency inventory valuation.

attributes.name: valuation_price
attributes.description: Standard or moving average price per unit of measure used for inventory valuation and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation. Supports financial reporting and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Valuation, GAAP, IFRS

products.name: dispensing_event
products.description: Transactional record of each reagent material movement — including dispensing to experiments/assays, consumption by instruments, internal transfers between storage locations or facilities, and returns to stock. Captures event timestamp, movement type (dispense, transfer, return, inter-site shipment), operator ID, lot number, quantity moved, unit of measure, source location, destination (experiment, assay run, production work order, instrument, or storage location), transfer reason (lab request, cold-chain relocation, quarantine move), remaining lot quantity post-event, cold-chain compliance flag, and chain-of-custody confirmation. Supports full LOT traceability from receipt through consumption or relocation, GMP usage logs, inter-site transfer documentation, and LIMS-driven reagent tracking.
products.reference: LabVantage LIMS Reagent Dispensing; GMP Usage Log; 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: dispensing_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the reagent dispensing event record. Primary key for tracking individual material movement transactions.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing or laboratory instrument that consumed the reagent, if applicable (e.g., flow cell loaded into sequencer).

attributes.name: catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master reagent product being dispensed (e.g., library prep kit, flow cell, CRISPR reagent, PCR master mix).

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Reagents dispensed for customer service work, evaluation programs, or contract research require tracking destination account for cost recovery, service agreement compliance, and usage analytics. Suppo

attributes.name: experiment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the research or production experiment that consumed the reagent, if applicable.

attributes.name: gmp_batch_record_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Batch Record Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: Reference to the GMP batch production record that documents the use of this reagent in manufacturing. Required for FDA-regulated production.

attributes.name: internal_order_id

products.name: tag_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the classification assignment between reagent_catalog and catalog_tag. It captures the application of controlled vocabulary tags to reagent products for data catalog discovery, FAIR compliance, and faceted search. Each record links one reagent catalog entry to one catalog tag with metadata about the assignment confidence, algorithm used, and temporal validity of the classification.. Existence Justification: In genomics biotech data governance operations, reagent catalog entries are tagged with multiple controlled vocabulary tags for FAIR-compliant discovery, faceted search, and regulatory classification (e.g., GMP-Critical, Cold-Chain, Hazardous, RUO, IVD). Each tag can be applied to many reagents across different product families. The business actively manages these tag assignments through data stewardship workflows, tracking assignment confidence, classification algorithms, temporal validity, and approval status.

attributes.description: Free-text notes explaining the rationale for this tag assignment, special considerations, or review comments. Used for documentation and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this tag assignment. Active assignments are used for search. Pending_review assignments require steward approval. Deprecated assignments are historical.

attributes.description: The algorithm or method used to assign this tag. Examples: manual_curation, ml_classifier_v2, rule_based_engine, ontology_mapping. Enables traceability and quality control.

attributes.description: Numeric confidence score (0.0 to 1.0) indicating the certainty or relevance of this tag assignment. Used for machine-learning-based tagging and quality assessment.

attributes.description: Date when this tag assignment was reviewed and approved by a data steward. Null for unreviewed assignments.

attributes.description: Name of the alignment software tool used to produce this result (e.g., BWA-MEM, BWA-MEM2, DRAGEN, STAR, Bowtie2, minimap2). The choice of aligner affects sensitivity, specificity, and computational cost. Required for reproducibility and regulatory method validation documentation.

attributes.description: Semantic version string of the aligner tool used (e.g., 0.7.17, 2.2.1).
