attributes.description: Target average selling price per transaction for accounts in this segment, used for pricing strategy and revenue forecasting. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: technical_support_model
attributes.description: Technical support delivery model for this segment: DEDICATED_FAE (dedicated Field Application Engineer), SHARED_FAE (shared FAE resources), SELF_SERVICE (online resources only), PARTNER_SUPPORT (through distributors), PREMIUM_SUPPORT (24/7 premium service).

attributes.name: typical_order_size_category
attributes.description: Typical order size category for accounts in this segment (e.g., SMALL for individual reagent orders, LARGE for instrument purchases, ENTERPRISE for multi-year contracts).

products.name: address
products.description: Physical and mailing addresses associated with customer accounts and contacts — shipping destinations for instruments and reagent kits, billing addresses, laboratory site addresses, and registered legal addresses. Captures address type (shipping, billing, legal, lab site), street lines, city, state/province, postal code, country (ISO 3166), geocoordinates, validated flag, validation source, biosafety level of the receiving lab (BSL-1 through BSL-4), cold-chain eligibility flag, and hazmat receiving authorization.
products.reference: Salesforce CRM Address / SAP SD Ship-To

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the address record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account or contact associated with this address.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address is currently active and available for use in transactions. True if active, False if inactive or deprecated.

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the address purpose: shipping destination for instruments and reagent kits, billing address for invoicing, legal registered address, laboratory site address, general mailing address, or headquarters location.

attributes.name: biosafety_level
attributes.description: Biosafety containment level of the receiving laboratory site (BSL-1 through BSL-4) as defined by CDC/NIH guidelines. Determines permissible shipment of biological materials, reagents, and samples. BSL-1: minimal hazard; BSL-2: moderate hazard; BSL-3: serious/potentially lethal; BSL-4: dangerous/exotic. Not applicable for non-laboratory addresses.
attributes.references: CDC/NIH Biosafety in Microbiological and Biomedical Laboratories (BMBL)

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality name where the address is located.

attributes.name: cold_chain_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address is equipped and authorized to receive temperature-sensitive shipments requiring cold-chain logistics (e.g., reagents, enzymes, library prep kits stored at -20°C or -80°C). True if eligible, False if not.
attributes.references: Good Distribution Practice (GDP) for Temperature-Controlled Products

attributes.name: cold_chain_temperature_range
attributes.description: Acceptable temperature range for cold-chain shipments to this address (e.g., 2-8°C, -20°C, -80°C, ambient). Null if cold_chain_eligible_flag is False.
attributes.references: Good Distribution Practice (GDP) for Temperature-Controlled Products

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the country of the address (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR, DEU, CHN, JPN).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the address record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: delivery_instructions
attributes.description: Special instructions for delivery to this address, including access codes, gate instructions, receiving hours, contact person for delivery, loading dock location, or other site-specific logistics guidance.
attributes.references: Logistics and Supply Chain Management Standards

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the address ceased to be valid or was deprecated. Null if the address is still active. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the address became valid and available for use. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: hazmat_receiving_authorized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address is authorized and equipped to receive hazardous materials shipments (e.g., flammable reagents, corrosive chemicals, biological agents) in compliance with DOT, IATA, and IMDG regulations. True if authorized, False if not.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations, IMDG Code

attributes.name: hazmat_un_classes_accepted
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazardous Materials United Nations (UN) Classes Accepted
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of UN hazard classes that the receiving site is authorized to accept (e.g., Class 3: Flammable Liquids, Class 6.2: Infectious Substances, Class 8: Corrosives, Class 9: Miscellaneous). Null if hazmat_receiving_authorized_flag is False.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the address record was last updated or modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees for precise geolocation of the address. Range: -90.0000000 to +90.0000000. Used for logistics routing and cold-chain planning.

attributes.name: line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including street number, street name, and building identifier. First line of the physical or mailing address.

attributes.name: line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, floor, apartment, unit, building name, or other location details within the primary address.

attributes.name: line_3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line for additional location details, department name, or care-of information.

attributes.name: loading_dock_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has a loading dock or freight receiving area for large shipments (e.g., sequencing instruments, bulk reagent orders). True if available, False if not.
attributes.references: Logistics and Supply Chain Management Standards

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees for precise geolocation of the address. Range: -180.0000000 to +180.0000000. Used for logistics routing and cold-chain planning.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the address, including historical context, special handling requirements, known delivery issues, or other relevant information for operations and customer service teams.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code, ZIP code, or postcode for mail delivery routing. Format varies by country (e.g., 12345, 12345-6789, A1A 1A1, SW1A 1AA).

attributes.name: primary_address_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary or default address for the associated customer account. True if primary, False if secondary or alternate address.

attributes.name: receiving_hours
attributes.description: Standard receiving hours for deliveries at this address (e.g., Monday-Friday 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, 24/7, By Appointment Only). Used for logistics planning and carrier scheduling.
attributes.references: Logistics and Supply Chain Management Standards

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, region, or administrative division within the country. Uses standard postal abbreviations where applicable (e.g., CA for California, ON for Ontario).

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo). Used for scheduling deliveries, service appointments, and coordinating with customer sites.

attributes.name: validated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been validated against an authoritative postal or geocoding service. True if validated, False if not validated or validation failed.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification, Canada Post SERP

attributes.name: validation_source
attributes.description: Name of the address validation service or system used to verify the address (e.g., USPS CASS, Google Maps Geocoding API, Loqate, Melissa Data, Canada Post SERP). Null if address has not been validated.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the address was last validated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Null if address has never been validated.

products.name: customer_consent_record
products.description: Tracks explicit consent and data privacy agreements obtained from customer contacts and accounts — GDPR data processing consent, HIPAA Business Associate Agreement acknowledgment, PHI handling authorization, marketing opt-in/opt-out, genomic data sharing consent (NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy), and IRB-related data use agreements. Captures consent type, consent version, consent status (granted, withdrawn, expired), consent date, expiry date, collection channel (web, paper, CRM), consent text version reference, and the identity of the consenting individual.
products.reference: GDPR Article 7 / HIPAA BAA / NIH GDS Policy

attributes.name: customer_consent_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer consent record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account or organization that provided this consent. Links to the customer master record managed in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific individual contact person who provided or signed this consent. Links to the contact master record.

attributes.name: dpia_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.dpia. Business justification: Processing genomic data with PHI requires Data Protection Impact Assessment under GDPR Article 35. Consent records must reference the DPIA that authorized the processing activity. Mandatory for lawful

attributes.name: parent_consent_record_customer_consent_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to a parent or predecessor consent record that this record supersedes or amends. Used to track consent version history and re-consent workflows. Nullable if this is an original consent.

attributes.name: retention_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.retention_policy. Business justification: Consent records have legal retention requirements under GDPR, HIPAA, and IRB protocols. Retention policies define minimum/maximum retention periods and disposal methods for consent documentation. Dire

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the detailed audit trail or log entry that captures the full consent workflow, including all system interactions, user actions, and timestamps. Links to audit logging system.

attributes.name: collection_channel
attributes.description: The channel or method through which this consent was collected from the customer. Indicates whether consent was obtained via web portal, mobile application, paper form, email, CRM system entry, phone conversation, in-person interaction, or API integration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web_portal|mobile_app|paper_form|email|crm_system|phone|in_person|api — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Salesforce CRM Data Capture Standards

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer or contact provided this consent. Represents the business event date when consent was granted, distinct from system audit timestamps.

attributes.name: consent_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this consent becomes legally effective and enforceable. May differ from consent_date if there is a future start date specified in the agreement.

attributes.name: consent_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this consent expires and is no longer valid. Nullable for consents that do not have a predetermined expiration. Used to trigger re-consent workflows and ensure compliance with time-limited authorizations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; HIPAA Privacy Rule; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: consent_language
attributes.description: The language in which the consent form was presented to and understood by the data subject. ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (e.g., EN for English, ES for Spanish, FR for French).
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; GDPR Article 12; ICH GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: consent_method
attributes.description: The method by which consent was formally captured and recorded. Includes electronic signature, wet (physical) signature, verbal consent (documented), checkbox selection, click-through acceptance, or implied consent.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; ESIGN Act; HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: consent_purpose
attributes.description: The specific business or legal purpose for which this consent was obtained. Examples include research data sharing, marketing communications, clinical trial participation, genomic data analysis, or third-party data transfer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; HIPAA Privacy Rule; ICH GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: consent_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of the scope and boundaries of what this consent covers. Specifies the data types, processing activities, third parties, geographic regions, or specific use cases that are authorized under this consent.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; HIPAA Privacy Rule; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consent record. Indicates whether consent is actively granted, has been withdrawn by the customer, has expired based on time limits, is pending approval or signature, has been revoked by the organization, or has been superseded by a newer consent version.

attributes.name: consent_text_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document control number pointing to the full legal text of the consent agreement. Links to the controlled document repository (e.g., Veeva Vault) where the complete consent language is stored.

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: The category or type of consent being recorded. Includes GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) data processing consent, HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) Business Associate Agreement acknowledgment, PHI (Protected Health Information) handling authorization, marketing opt-in/opt-out, genomic data sharing consent per NIH (National Institutes of Health) Genomic Data Sharing Policy, and IRB (Institutional Review Board) related data use agreements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.508; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent form or agreement template used when this consent was obtained. Tracks which version of the legal text or policy the customer agreed to, enabling audit trails when consent language changes.

attributes.name: consenting_party_role
attributes.description: The role or capacity in which the individual provided consent. Indicates whether they are the primary contact, an authorized representative, legal guardian, principal investigator, IRB (Institutional Review Board) coordinator, or data protection officer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; HIPAA Privacy Rule; ICH GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user or process that created this consent record. Part of the audit trail for accountability and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this consent record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: data_subject_email
attributes.description: The email address of the individual who provided consent. Used for consent verification, withdrawal notifications, and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: data_subject_name
attributes.description: The full name of the individual data subject (person) who provided this consent. May differ from the customer account name if the consent is provided by an authorized representative or specific contact within an organization.

attributes.name: geolocation
attributes.description: Geographic location information (e.g., country, region, or coordinates) from which the consent was provided. Used to determine applicable data protection regulations and jurisdictional compliance requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Territorial Scope; HIPAA; Data Residency Standards

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address from which the consent was submitted, if collected via electronic channel. Used for audit trail and fraud prevention purposes. May be considered PII under GDPR in certain jurisdictions.

attributes.name: irb_protocol_number
attributes.description: The IRB (Institutional Review Board) protocol number associated with this consent, if applicable. Links consent to a specific approved research study or clinical trial.
attributes.references: ICH GCP Guidelines; 21 CFR Part 56; 45 CFR Part 46

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction or geographic region whose data protection laws govern this consent. Examples include EU, USA, California, Brazil, Canada. Determines applicable compliance requirements and data subject rights.
attributes.references: GDPR Territorial Scope; HIPAA; CCPA; LGPD

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user or process that last modified this consent record. Part of the audit trail for accountability and compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this consent record was last updated or modified. Part of the audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the customer has opted in to receive marketing communications. True if opted in, False if opted out.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or context related to this consent record. Used to capture special circumstances, clarifications, or operational details not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: The primary regulatory or legal framework under which this consent was obtained. Includes GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act), CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act), LGPD (Brazilian General Data Protection Law), PIPEDA (Canadian Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act), or NIH (National Institutes of Health) Genomic Data Sharing Policy.
attributes.references: GDPR; HIPAA; CCPA; LGPD; PIPEDA; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: renewal_frequency_months
attributes.description: The frequency in months at which this consent must be renewed. Nullable if renewal is not required or if renewal is event-driven rather than time-based.

attributes.name: renewal_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this consent requires periodic renewal or re-confirmation. True if renewal is required, False if consent is perpetual or does not require renewal.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; HIPAA Privacy Rule; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: research_participation_consent
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the customer or data subject has consented to participation in research studies or use of their data for research purposes. True if consent is granted, False otherwise.
attributes.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy; ICH GCP Guidelines; IRB Standards

attributes.name: signature_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the consent was signed or formally accepted by the data subject. Provides audit trail for electronic consent workflows.
attributes.references: ESIGN Act; GDPR Article 7; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: third_party_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated or structured list of specific third parties (organizations or categories) with whom data sharing is authorized under this consent. Nullable if no third-party sharing is allowed or if sharing is unrestricted.

attributes.name: third_party_sharing_allowed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the data subject has consented to sharing their data with third parties. True if third-party sharing is authorized, False otherwise.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; HIPAA Privacy Rule; NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer or data subject withdrew this consent. Nullable if consent has not been withdrawn. Triggers data processing cessation and right-to-be-forgotten workflows.

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the data subject for withdrawing consent. Used for compliance documentation and to improve consent processes.

products.name: technical_requirement
products.description: Documents customer-specific technical and application requirements captured during pre-sales, onboarding, or support engagements. Covers sequencing application type (WGS, WES, targeted panel, single-cell), required read length, coverage depth targets, preferred library preparation method, multiplexing requirements, bioinformatics pipeline preferences (FASTQ delivery, BAM/VCF output), instrument platform preference, throughput requirements, turnaround time (TAT) expectations, and regulatory use classification (RUO vs. IVD/LDT). Enables field application scientists and commercial teams to configure appropriate product and service offerings.

attributes.name: gxp_compliance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether GxP (GMP, GLP, GCP) compliance is required for this application, typically for clinical or diagnostic use cases.

attributes.name: index_strategy
attributes.description: Indexing strategy for sample multiplexing: single index (i7 only), dual index (i7 + i5), unique dual index (UDI), or combinatorial dual index.

attributes.name: instrument_platform_preference
attributes.description: Customer's preferred or required sequencing instrument platform (e.g., NovaSeq 6000, NextSeq 2000, MiSeq, iSeq 100). Free-text field to accommodate evolving product portfolio.

attributes.description: Preferred or required library preparation method or kit (e.g., TruSeq DNA PCR-Free, Nextera DNA Flex, Stranded mRNA, KAPA HyperPrep). Free-text field capturing customer-specific protocol preferences.

attributes.name: minimum_coverage_depth
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable sequencing coverage depth threshold below which data quality is considered insufficient for the intended application.

attributes.name: multiplexing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether multiplexing (pooling multiple samples with unique index barcodes in a single sequencing run) is required or preferred.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, clarifications, or customer-specific nuances not covered by structured fields.

attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR Part 160 and Part 164

attributes.name: phred_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable Phred quality score threshold for base calling (commonly Q20 or Q30, representing 99% or 99.9% base call accuracy).

attributes.name: qc_metric_requirements
attributes.description: Specific quality control (QC) metrics and thresholds required by the customer (e.g., Q30 score >80%, cluster density, duplication rate <20%). Free-text field capturing detailed QC specifications.

attributes.name: read_configuration
attributes.description: Sequencing read configuration: single-end (one read per fragment) or paired-end (two reads per fragment).

attributes.name: read_length_bp
attributes.description: Required sequencing read length in base pairs (bp). Common values include 50, 75, 100, 150, 250, 300 bp depending on application.

attributes.name: regulatory_use_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the intended use: RUO (Research Use Only), IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic), LDT (Laboratory Developed Test), clinical research, or diagnostic. Determines compliance and validation requirements.

attributes.name: requirement_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this technical requirement record, formatted as TR-NNNNNNNN.

attributes.name: requirement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the technical requirement record in the customer engagement workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|active|superseded|archived — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: Type of biological sample to be sequenced (e.g., whole blood, saliva, FFPE tissue, fresh frozen tissue, cell line, plasma, DNA, RNA). Free-text to accommodate diverse sample matrices.

attributes.name: samples_per_run
attributes.description: Expected or maximum number of samples to be multiplexed per sequencing run, if multiplexing is required.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Any special sample handling, processing, or data analysis instructions provided by the customer (e.g., low-input protocols, degraded sample protocols, custom bioinformatics workflows).

attributes.name: species
attributes.description: Biological species of the sample (e.g., Homo sapiens, Mus musculus, Arabidopsis thaliana, microbial species). Free-text to accommodate diverse research organisms.

attributes.name: target_coverage_depth
attributes.description: Required average sequencing coverage depth (e.g., 30x for WGS, 100x for WES, 500x for targeted panels). Represents the average number of reads covering each base position.

attributes.name: throughput_requirement_gb
attributes.description: Required sequencing throughput in gigabases (Gb) per run or per sample, depending on application and multiplexing strategy.

attributes.name: turnaround_time_days
attributes.description: Expected turnaround time (TAT) in calendar days from sample receipt to data delivery, as required by the customer's operational or clinical workflow.

attributes.name: variant_calling_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether variant calling (SNP, indel, CNV detection) is required as part of the bioinformatics pipeline deliverable.

products.name: service_agreement
products.description: Records service-level agreements, support contracts, and product evaluation/beta-testing engagements established with customer accounts — instrument service contracts, reagent supply agreements, bioinformatics support SLAs, field application scientist engagement terms, instrument beta placements, early-access reagent kit evaluations, clinical assay validation pilots, CRISPR tool assessments, and demo placements. Captures agreement type (instrument warranty, preventive maintenance, reagent supply SLA, FAS support, beta evaluation, early access, clinical evaluation, demo placement), program name, start date, end date, SLA tier (standard, premium, enterprise), response time commitments, uptime guarantees, covered instruments/products, annual contract value (ACV), renewal terms, agreement status, evaluation status, products under evaluation, success criteria, customer feedback summary, commercial conversion outcome, and internal scientific lead. Serves as the unified contractual and evaluation engagement record — no separate evaluation program entity exists.

products.name: interaction
products.description: Captures all recorded touchpoints and engagement activities between Genomics Biotech personnel and customer accounts or contacts — sales calls, field application scientist (FAS) site visits, technical support calls, webinar attendance, trade show meetings, product demonstrations, training sessions, and scientific advisory board meetings. Stores interaction type, interaction date, channel (in-person, phone, email, video, portal), subject, outcome/notes, next action, associated opportunity or case reference, duration, and the internal employee who conducted the interaction. Provides the relationship history timeline for each account and supports customer engagement scoring.

products.name: contracted_material
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between service_agreement and material. It captures the specific pricing, volume commitments, and commercial terms negotiated for each material included in a customer service agreement. Each record links one service_agreement to one material with contracted pricing, volume commitments, discount tiers, and validity periods that exist only in the context of this contractual relationship.. Existence Justification: In genomics biotech operations, service agreements (reagent rental programs, consumables supply contracts, instrument service contracts with bundled reagents) routinely cover multiple materials with individually negotiated pricing, volume commitments, and discount tiers. Each material (reagents, flow cells, array substrates, consumables) can be included in multiple customer service agreements with different contracted terms. The business actively manages contracted material pricing as line items within service agreements, tracking pricing validity periods, volume commitments, and discount tiers per agreement-material combination.

Captures delivery line number, product SKU, product description, delivery quantity, unit of measure, lot number (LOT), batch number, serial number (for instruments), storage location, pick status, pack status, goods issue quantity, COA reference number, expiry date for reagents/consumables, cold-chain handling instruction, and hazardous material classification.

attributes.name: delivery_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the delivery line item within the outbound delivery document. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.batch. Business justification: Critical for GMP compliance and 21 CFR Part 11 traceability. Each delivered reagent/kit must trace to a qualified batch with QC release status, COA number, expiry date, and cold-chain compliance flag.

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master product being shipped on this delivery line. Links to the product catalog for instruments, reagents, consumables, or sequencing kits.

attributes.name: coa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.coa. Business justification: Certificates of Analysis must accompany reagent shipments in genomics biotech. FK enables automated CoA document retrieval for customer portals, regulatory audit trails, and quality documentation requ

attributes.name: delivery_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent outbound delivery document header. Links this line item to its containing shipment.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order that triggered this delivery line. Enables traceability from shipment back to customer order.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.lot. Business justification: Delivery documentation must capture exact lot shipped for cold chain validation, customer acceptance, and regulatory compliance. FK provides manufacturing date, expiry, QC status, and CoA reference re

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material. Business justification: Delivery lines ship specific materials from supply master. Link enables batch traceability, expiry date validation, hazmat classification enforcement, and COA reference number attachment for GMP-compl

attributes.name: production_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_batch. Business justification: Delivery documentation for genomics products requires batch/lot traceability for regulatory compliance, CoA attachment, and field complaint investigation. Delivery lines must reference production batc

attributes.name: sales_order_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific sales order line item being fulfilled by this delivery line. Establishes one-to-one or many-to-one fulfillment relationship.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Delivery lines must reference SKUs for lot/batch traceability, Certificate of Analysis generation, regulatory compliance documentation, and inventory depletion. Critical for GMP/GDP compliance and shi

attributes.name: cold_chain_handling_instruction
attributes.description: Temperature control requirements for shipping and storage of this product. Critical for reagent stability and assay performance. Specifies required temperature range during transit.
attributes.references: WHO Cold Chain Guidelines, IATA Temperature Control Regulations

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where this product was manufactured. Required for customs documentation and trade compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery line record was first created in the system. Marks the beginning of the delivery line lifecycle.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the line value amount. Typically matches the sales order currency.

attributes.name: delivery_line_status
attributes.description: Overall lifecycle status of this delivery line. Tracks progression from order release through goods issue and shipment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|in_picking|picked|packed|goods_issued|cancelled|on_hold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: delivery_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of product being shipped on this delivery line. Represents the actual amount picked, packed, and dispatched to the customer.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date for reagents, consumables, and sequencing kits. Critical for quality assurance and regulatory compliance. Products must be used before this date to ensure performance specifications.

attributes.name: goods_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which goods issue was posted for this delivery line. Marks the official transfer of ownership and inventory reduction in the ERP system.

attributes.name: goods_issue_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity for which goods issue has been posted in the ERP system. Represents the inventory reduction and financial posting amount. May differ from delivery quantity in case of partial shipments.

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Gross weight of the product on this delivery line in kilograms, including all packaging materials. Used for carrier billing and freight planning.

attributes.name: harmonized_tariff_code
attributes.description: International harmonized system code for customs classification. Determines duty rates, import restrictions, and trade statistics reporting.

attributes.name: hazmat_classification
attributes.description: Hazardous material classification for shipping compliance. Determines packaging, labeling, and carrier requirements. Common for reagents containing flammable solvents, corrosive buffers, or biological materials. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_hazardous|flammable_liquid|corrosive|oxidizer|toxic|biological_substance|dry_ice|lithium_battery — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations, DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this delivery line record. Tracks changes to quantities, status, or other attributes throughout the fulfillment process.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the delivery document. Determines the ordering and position of this line in the shipment manifest.
attributes.references: SAP SD Delivery Line Item Numbering

attributes.name: line_value_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of this delivery line based on the delivered quantity and unit price. Used for shipment insurance valuation and customs declaration.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this product lot or batch was manufactured. Used for shelf-life calculation, quality tracking, and regulatory traceability.

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Net weight of the product on this delivery line in kilograms, excluding packaging. Used for shipping cost calculation and customs documentation.

attributes.name: pack_status
attributes.description: Current status of the packing process for this delivery line. Indicates whether the item has been placed in shipping containers with appropriate cold-chain or hazmat packaging.

attributes.name: pick_status
attributes.description: Current status of the warehouse picking process for this delivery line. Tracks progression from pick list generation through physical item retrieval.

attributes.name: product_regulatory_status
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the product being shipped. RUO (Research Use Only) for research products, IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic) for clinical products, CE-IVD for European market, FDA-cleared/approved for US clinical use.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating why this delivery line was rejected, cancelled, or placed on hold. Examples include insufficient inventory, quality hold, customer request, or regulatory block.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized products such as sequencing instruments, flow cell scanners, and high-value equipment. Enables unit-level tracking, warranty management, and service history.
attributes.references: SAP MM Serial Number Management, ISO 13485

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special handling requirements for this delivery line. May include fragile handling, orientation requirements, light sensitivity, or customer-specific instructions.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: The warehouse storage location code from which this product was picked. Identifies the specific bin, shelf, or cold storage zone within the distribution center.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for hazardous materials. Required for international shipping compliance and carrier acceptance. Examples: UN1170 (ethanol), UN3373 (biological substance).
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the delivery quantity. Common values include EA (each) for instruments, KIT for reagent kits, VIAL for liquid reagents, PLATE for array plates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KIT|BOX|VIAL|PLATE|SET|UNIT|L|ML|G|KG — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: volume_cubic_meters
attributes.description: Total volume occupied by this delivery line item in cubic meters. Used for warehouse space planning and freight optimization.

products.name: shipment
products.description: Physical shipment record tracking the movement of one or more deliveries from Genomics Biotech warehouse to the customer site. Captures shipment number, carrier name, carrier tracking number, shipment status (booked, in-transit, out-for-delivery, delivered, exception), ship date, estimated delivery date, actual delivery date, origin facility, destination address, shipment method, cold-chain monitoring flag, temperature excursion flag, temperature log reference, proof-of-delivery reference, carrier SLA breach flag, and TAT compliance status.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shipment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: delivery_id
attributes.description: Reference to the delivery document that this shipment executes. Multiple deliveries may be consolidated into one shipment.

attributes.name: deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_deviation. Business justification: Temperature excursions or shipping violations during cold chain transport are quality deviations requiring investigation. Real-time monitoring systems flag deviations, QA investigates impact on produc

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent sales order that this shipment fulfills. Links to the order management system.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date the shipment was physically received and signed for by the customer or designated recipient. Null until delivery is confirmed.
attributes.references: SAP SD Proof of Delivery Date

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the logistics carrier responsible for transporting the shipment (e.g., FedEx, UPS, DHL, specialized cold-chain provider).

attributes.name: carrier_sla_breach_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Carrier Service Level Agreement (SLA) Breach Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier failed to meet the committed delivery Service Level Agreement (SLA). True if actual delivery date exceeds estimated delivery date by the SLA tolerance threshold.

attributes.name: carrier_tracking_number
attributes.description: Unique tracking identifier assigned by the carrier for real-time shipment visibility and proof of delivery.

attributes.name: cold_chain_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment contains temperature-sensitive reagents, consumables, or biological samples requiring continuous cold-chain monitoring. True if cold-chain logistics are mandatory.
attributes.references: Good Distribution Practice (GDP) for Medicinal Products

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: customer_reference_number
attributes.description: Customer-provided purchase order number, project code, or internal reference for shipment tracking and invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: destination_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the customer delivery location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: destination_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, building, or department information at the delivery location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: destination_city
attributes.description: City name of the customer delivery location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the customer delivery location (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, CHN).

attributes.name: destination_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the customer delivery location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: destination_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the customer delivery location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: estimated_delivery_date
attributes.description: Carrier-provided or system-calculated expected delivery date based on service level and transit time.

attributes.name: export_declaration_number
attributes.description: Customs export declaration or Electronic Export Information (EEI) filing number for international shipments. Required for cross-border regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau Automated Export System (AES)

attributes.name: freight_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total freight and logistics cost charged by the carrier for this shipment, in the company's reporting currency. Used for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: freight_cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the freight cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: hazmat_class
attributes.description: United Nations (UN) hazard classification code for hazardous materials in the shipment (e.g., Class 6.2 for infectious substances, Class 9 for miscellaneous). Null if hazmat_flag is false.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, labeling, and regulatory documentation per Department of Transportation (DOT) or International Air Transport Association (IATA) regulations. True if hazmat present.

attributes.name: incoterm_code
attributes.description: Three-letter Incoterms code defining the division of costs, risks, and responsibilities between seller and buyer for international shipments (e.g., DDP = Delivered Duty Paid, FOB = Free On Board). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: insurance_value_amount
attributes.description: Declared value of the shipment contents for insurance purposes. Used to determine coverage limits and premium calculation.

attributes.name: insurance_value_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the insurance value amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: origin_facility_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the warehouse, distribution center, or manufacturing plant from which the shipment originated. Format: XXX-XXXX.

attributes.name: package_count
attributes.description: Number of individual packages, boxes, or containers included in this shipment. Used for receiving verification and inventory reconciliation.

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to the signed proof of delivery document (e.g., signature image, electronic confirmation). Used for dispute resolution and audit trail.

attributes.name: ship_date
attributes.description: Date the shipment departed from the origin facility. Used for Turnaround Time (TAT) calculation and Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking.

attributes.name: shipment_method
attributes.description: Shipping service level selected for this shipment. Determines transit time and cost. Values: ground, air, express, overnight, international, cold_chain (temperature-controlled).

attributes.name: shipment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique shipment identifier used for tracking and customer communication. Format: SHP-xxxxxxxxxx.

attributes.name: shipment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shipment. Values: booked (carrier confirmed), in_transit (en route), out_for_delivery (final mile), delivered (received by customer), exception (delay or issue), cancelled (shipment voided).

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special handling requirements for the shipment (e.g., 'Fragile - Handle with Care', 'This Side Up', 'Keep Frozen', 'Deliver to Loading Dock Only').

attributes.name: tat_compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment met the customer-committed Turnaround Time (TAT) from order placement to delivery. Values: compliant (delivered within TAT), at_risk (approaching deadline), breached (missed TAT), not_applicable (no TAT commitment).

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment experienced a temperature excursion outside the acceptable range during transit. True if excursion detected. Triggers quality review and potential product rejection.
attributes.references: Good Distribution Practice (GDP) for Medicinal Products

attributes.name: temperature_log_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to the detailed temperature monitoring log file (e.g., data logger serial number, cloud storage path). Used for compliance audit and quality investigation.
attributes.references: Good Distribution Practice (GDP) for Medicinal Products

attributes.name: temperature_range_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold-chain shipments. Null for non-temperature-controlled shipments.
attributes.references: Good Distribution Practice (GDP) for Medicinal Products

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold-chain shipments. Null for non-temperature-controlled shipments.
attributes.references: Good Distribution Practice (GDP) for Medicinal Products

attributes.name: total_volume_cubic_meters
attributes.description: Total volumetric size of the shipment in cubic meters. Used for dimensional weight pricing and warehouse space planning.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 Quantities and Units - Space and Time

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the shipment in kilograms, including packaging materials. Used for freight cost calculation and carrier capacity planning.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 Quantities and Units - Space and Time

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit United Nations identification number for hazardous materials (e.g., UN3373 for biological substances). Null if hazmat_flag is false. Format: UNxxxx.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

products.name: return_authorization
products.description: Customer return authorization and processing record for instruments, reagent kits, consumables, or flow cells that are defective, expired, or incorrectly shipped. Sourced from ERP returns processing. Captures return order number, original sales order reference, return reason code (defective, wrong-item, expired, over-shipment, customer-cancellation), return authorization number (RMA), return status (requested, authorized, in-transit, received, inspected, credited), customer account ID, return quantity, return value, credit memo reference, QC inspection result upon receipt, disposition code (restock, quarantine, destroy), and GMP deviation flag.

attributes.name: return_authorization_id
attributes.description: Primary key for return_authorization

attributes.name: approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.regulatory_approval. Business justification: Returns of regulated genomics products (sequencing kits, arrays, instruments) trigger post-market surveillance obligations, adverse event assessment per ISO 13485, and field safety action evaluation.

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.batch. Business justification: GMP deviation investigations require batch-level traceability for returned goods. Links return to batch QC status, COA, manufacturing date, and supplier batch number for root cause analysis and suppli

attributes.name: complaint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.complaint. Business justification: Returns are often initiated by quality complaints. RMA systems link to complaint records for disposition decisions (credit, replacement, investigation), CAPA initiation, and customer satisfaction trac

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Return processing costs, restocking fees, and quality investigation expenses charged to quality assurance or customer service cost centers. Supports GxP-compliant cost tracking for product complaints

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account requesting the return.

attributes.name: deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_deviation. Business justification: Product returns may trigger quality deviations when defects are confirmed during QC inspection. QA reviews returned goods, documents deviations (GxP classification, severity), and initiates investigat

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.lot. Business justification: Product returns require lot-level traceability for quality investigations, stability studies, and CAPA. FK enables root cause analysis linking returned material to manufacturing batch, QC results, sto

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material. Business justification: Returns reference specific materials for disposition decisions (restock, scrap, quarantine), quality investigations, and CAPA initiation. Enables material-level return rate analysis and supplier quali

attributes.name: nonconformance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.nonconformance. Business justification: Returned products failing inspection generate nonconformance records (NCRs). Warehouse QC inspection creates NCRs for supplier notification, disposition decisions (scrap, rework, use-as-is), and inter

attributes.name: primary_return_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality control inspector who performed the return inspection.

attributes.name: primary_return_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original sales order from which this return originated.

attributes.name: production_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_batch. Business justification: Product return investigations in regulated genomics require root cause analysis tied to manufacturing batch records. Quality teams analyze returns by batch to identify process deviations, environmenta

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: RMA records reference specific SKUs for credit calculation, quality investigation, CAPA initiation, and regulatory deviation reporting. Essential for post-market surveillance and complaint handling in

attributes.name: test_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.test_order. Business justification: When clinical test kits, reagents, or sample collection supplies are returned, linking to the originating test order enables root cause analysis, quality event tracking, and CAPA. Critical for GxP com

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or facility where the returned goods were received.

attributes.name: capa_number
attributes.description: Reference to the CAPA investigation record if corrective action was initiated.

attributes.name: capa_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this return requires a formal CAPA investigation and corrective action plan.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the shipping carrier used for the return shipment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this return authorization record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_memo_number
attributes.description: Reference to the financial credit memo document issued to the customer upon return approval.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the return value amount.

attributes.name: disposition_code
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the returned goods based on inspection results (restock, quarantine, destroy, rework, scrap, return-to-vendor).
attributes.references: SAP QM Usage Decision, GMP Quality Management

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the returned product, particularly relevant for reagents and consumables with limited shelf life.
attributes.references: SAP QM Shelf Life Expiration, GMP Stability

attributes.name: gmp_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this return triggered a GMP deviation investigation due to quality or compliance concerns.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this return authorization record was last updated.

attributes.name: qc_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date when the quality control inspection of the returned goods was completed.

attributes.name: qc_inspection_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes and observations recorded by the QC inspector during the return inspection.

attributes.name: qc_inspection_result
attributes.description: Quality control inspection outcome upon receipt of the returned goods.

attributes.name: restocking_fee_amount
attributes.description: Restocking fee charged to the customer for processing the return, if applicable per return policy.

attributes.name: return_authorized_date
attributes.description: Date when the return authorization was approved and RMA number was issued.

attributes.name: return_credited_date
attributes.description: Date when the credit memo was issued and the customer account was credited.

attributes.name: return_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of units being returned by the customer.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the return request.

attributes.name: return_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text explanation of the return reason provided by the customer or customer service representative.

attributes.name: return_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the returned goods were physically received at the warehouse or facility.

attributes.name: return_requested_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer initially requested the return authorization.

attributes.name: return_shipping_cost
attributes.description: Cost of shipping the returned goods, which may be borne by the customer or the company depending on return reason.

attributes.name: return_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the return authorization workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: requested|authorized|in-transit|received|inspected|credited|rejected|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: return_value_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the returned goods in the transaction currency.

attributes.name: rma_number
attributes.description: Externally-known return authorization number issued to the customer for tracking and processing the return.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the root cause identified during return investigation.
attributes.references: SAP QM Quality Notification, CAPA Process

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number of the returned instrument or equipment unit, if applicable.

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the returned product experienced temperature excursion during storage or transit, affecting product integrity.
attributes.references: GMP Cold Chain Management, 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Shipment tracking number provided by the carrier for the return shipment.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the return quantity (each, kit, box, vial, plate, cartridge). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KIT|BOX|VIAL|PLATE|CARTRIDGE|UNIT — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: status_event
products.description: Immutable event log capturing every status transition in the lifecycle of a sales order — from order creation through fulfillment, shipment, delivery, and closure. Enables SLA-driven TAT tracking and order lifecycle audit. Captures event timestamp, order ID, previous status, new status, status change reason, triggered-by system (SAP SD, Salesforce, manual), triggered-by user ID, SLA milestone flag (e.g., order-confirmed, shipped-on-time, delivered-on-time), TAT elapsed hours at transition, and SLA breach indicator.
products.reference: Order Lifecycle Event / SAP SD Change Log

attributes.name: status_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each order status transition event. Primary key for the order status event log.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who placed the order. Denormalized from the order record to enable direct customer-level TAT and SLA reporting from the event log.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or service account that triggered the status change. Null for fully automated system transitions.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sales order that experienced this status transition. Links this event to the parent order entity.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or fulfillment center processing this order at the time of the status transition. Enables location-specific TAT analysis.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The actual date the order was delivered to the customer. Populated only when the status transitions to delivered or completed.

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the shipping carrier (e.g., FedEx, UPS, DHL) when the order is shipped. Null for pre-shipment transitions.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes entered by the user or system at the time of the status transition. Provides additional context for audit and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Name of the upstream data source or integration pipeline that delivered this event record (e.g., SAP_SD_CDC, Salesforce_API, Manual_Entry).

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: SAP distribution channel through which the order was placed (e.g., direct_sales, distributor, e-commerce). Supports channel-specific SLA tracking.

attributes.name: event_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating the order of this event within the lifecycle of the parent order (1 for first transition, 2 for second, etc.). Enables chronological reconstruction of order history.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the order status transition occurred in the source system. Represents the real-world business event time, distinct from audit timestamps.

attributes.name: expected_delivery_date
attributes.description: The expected delivery date communicated to the customer at the time of this status transition. Updated as the order progresses through fulfillment.

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this event record was ingested into the Databricks lakehouse. Distinct from event_timestamp, which represents the business event time.

attributes.name: is_reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition represents a reversal or rollback of a previous status (e.g., moving from shipped back to in_fulfillment due to a return). True for backward transitions.

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The order status after this transition event. Captures the to-state in the order lifecycle state machine. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|confirmed|in_fulfillment|shipped|delivered|completed|cancelled|on_hold — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel used to notify the customer of this status change (e.g., email, SMS, customer portal). Null if no notification was sent.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an automated customer notification (email, SMS) was sent for this status transition. Supports customer communication audit.

attributes.name: order_priority
attributes.description: Priority level of the order at the time of this status transition. Affects SLA targets and fulfillment sequencing.

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Type of sales order experiencing this status transition (e.g., instrument_sale, reagent_order, sequencing_service, consumable_order, software_license). Enables segmented TAT analysis by product category.

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: The order status immediately before this transition event. Captures the from-state in the order lifecycle state machine. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|confirmed|in_fulfillment|shipped|delivered|completed|cancelled|on_hold — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the order status was reversed or rolled back. Null for forward-progressing transitions.

attributes.name: sales_organization
attributes.description: SAP sales organization responsible for this order at the time of the status transition. Enables regional TAT performance analysis.

attributes.name: shipment_tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier tracking number assigned when the order status transitions to shipped. Null for pre-shipment status transitions.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition occurred after the committed SLA deadline, representing a breach of customer service commitments. True if TAT exceeded target.

attributes.name: sla_breach_severity
attributes.description: Classification of the severity of the SLA breach based on how much the TAT exceeded the target (e.g., minor for <4 hours late, major for >24 hours late).

attributes.name: sla_milestone_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition represents a contractual SLA milestone (e.g., order-confirmed, shipped-on-time, delivered-on-time). True if this event is an SLA checkpoint.

attributes.name: sla_milestone_name
attributes.description: Name of the SLA milestone associated with this status transition (e.g., Order Confirmation, Shipment Dispatch, Delivery Completion). Null if not an SLA milestone.

attributes.name: source_system_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction or event identifier from the source system (SAP SD document number, Salesforce event ID) that triggered this status change. Enables traceability back to the originating system.

attributes.name: status_change_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the status transition (e.g., customer_request, inventory_available, quality_hold, shipment_dispatched).

attributes.name: status_change_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation or additional context describing why the order status changed. Provides human-readable detail beyond the reason code.

attributes.name: tat_elapsed_hours
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in hours from order creation to this status transition. Enables TAT tracking and performance analysis against committed delivery timelines.

attributes.name: tat_target_hours
