attributes.name: triggered_by_system
attributes.description: The source system or application that initiated this status transition (e.g., SAP SD for fulfillment updates, Salesforce CRM for order entry, manual override by user).

attributes.name: triggered_by_user_name
attributes.description: Full name of the user who triggered the status change. Supports audit trail and accountability for manual interventions.

products.name: fulfillment_instruction
products.description: Operational directive translating a confirmed sales order into specific warehouse, logistics, or field service execution tasks. Covers standard pick-pack-ship, cold-chain logistics coordination (dry ice, controlled-rate shipping for enzymes/reagents), instrument installation scheduling with field service engineers, sequencing service sample-kit dispatch, and software license activation. Captures instruction type (ship, install, service-dispatch, activate), execution status, assigned facility or field team, priority level, special handling codes, scheduled execution date, TAT deadline, and completion confirmation. Serves as the orchestration layer between commercial order management and physical/digital fulfillment.
products.reference: SAP SD / Warehouse Management Fulfillment Order

attributes.name: fulfillment_instruction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fulfillment instruction record. Primary key for the fulfillment instruction entity.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to instrument.instrument_asset. Business justification: Installation fulfillment instructions must reference the specific serialized instrument asset being deployed for installation qualification execution, site preparation validation, and asset tracking.

attributes.name: assigned_team_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the field service team, logistics crew, or installation squad assigned to execute this instruction. Used for install, service_dispatch, and field-based fulfillment types.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the field service engineer assigned to perform installation or service dispatch. Used for resource scheduling and performance tracking.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the confirmed sales order that this fulfillment instruction executes. Links to the parent order in SAP SD.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Installation and qualification services for sequencing instruments execute against internal orders (capex projects). Links service fulfillment activities to project cost tracking and asset capitalizat

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse, distribution center, or service depot responsible for executing this instruction. Null if assigned to field service team rather than facility.

attributes.name: sequencing_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sequencing.sequencing_run. Business justification: Fulfillment instructions for sequencing service orders must specify which sequencing run executes the order. Critical for operations tracking, linking commercial orders to lab execution, TAT monitorin

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.warehouse_location. Business justification: Picking instructions specify exact bin locations for temperature-controlled reagents, hazmat materials, and serialized instruments. Enables FEFO enforcement, cold-chain zone validation, and GMP-compli

attributes.name: actual_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when fulfillment was successfully completed (shipment dispatched, installation signed off, or license activated). Used for TAT compliance reporting and customer notification.

attributes.name: actual_execution_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when fulfillment execution actually began (warehouse pick started, field engineer arrived on site, or activation process initiated). Used for TAT performance measurement.

attributes.name: completion_confirmation_signature
attributes.description: Digital signature or confirmation code from customer or field engineer acknowledging successful fulfillment completion. Used for proof of delivery, installation acceptance, or service completion.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Email address for shipment notifications, installation appointment confirmations, and service dispatch updates. Used for automated customer communication.

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual at the delivery location authorized to receive shipment or coordinate installation. Used for carrier delivery confirmation and field service appointment scheduling.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number for delivery coordination, installation scheduling, or service dispatch communication. Used by carriers and field service engineers.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment instruction record was created in the system. Typically occurs immediately after sales order confirmation. Used for audit trail and TAT calculation baseline.

attributes.name: customs_declaration_number
attributes.description: Customs authority reference number for international shipments. Required for cross-border fulfillment to comply with import/export regulations and tariff classification.

attributes.name: execution_status
attributes.description: Current state of the fulfillment instruction in its execution lifecycle. Pending = awaiting assignment; Assigned = allocated to facility or team; In_Progress = actively being executed; Completed = successfully fulfilled; Cancelled = instruction voided; On_Hold = temporarily suspended; Failed = execution unsuccessful. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|assigned|in_progress|completed|cancelled|on_hold|failed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: U.S. Commerce Department Export Control Classification Number for dual-use technology and controlled items. Required for sequencing instruments and bioinformatics software with encryption. Ensures compliance with Export Administration Regulations (EAR).
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR) 15 CFR Part 774

attributes.name: failure_notes
attributes.description: Free-text explanation providing additional context for fulfillment failure or cancellation. Captured by warehouse staff, field engineer, or logistics coordinator.

attributes.name: failure_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code explaining why fulfillment execution failed or was cancelled. None = no failure. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: address_invalid|recipient_unavailable|customs_hold|damaged_in_transit|installation_site_not_ready|technical_issue|cancelled_by_customer|none — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: installation_appointment_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time for instrument installation or field service visit. Applicable for install and service_dispatch instruction types. Coordinated with customer and field service engineer availability.

attributes.name: instruction_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the fulfillment instruction, formatted as FI- followed by 10 digits. Used for tracking and communication with warehouse, logistics, and field service teams.

attributes.name: instruction_type
attributes.description: Category of fulfillment action required. Ship = standard pick-pack-ship; Install = instrument installation with field service engineer; Service_Dispatch = field service task; Activate = software license or cloud service activation; Sample_Kit_Dispatch = sequencing service sample collection kit; Cold_Chain_Ship = temperature-controlled logistics for reagents/enzymes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this fulfillment instruction record. Tracks status changes, assignment updates, and completion events. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: license_activation_key
attributes.description: Unique activation key for software license or cloud service entitlement. Applicable for activate instruction type. Generated by license management system and delivered to customer via secure channel.

attributes.name: packing_list_number
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse packing list document detailing items included in shipment. Used for shipment verification and customs documentation.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this fulfillment instruction. Critical = immediate action required (e.g., clinical diagnostic emergency); High = expedited processing; Normal = standard processing; Low = non-urgent.

attributes.name: scheduled_execution_date
attributes.description: Planned date for fulfillment execution (ship date, installation date, or service dispatch date). Used for capacity planning and customer communication.

attributes.name: ship_to_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for delivery destination. Copied from sales order ship-to party at instruction creation. May differ from customer billing address.

attributes.name: ship_to_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for delivery destination (suite, building, department). Optional field for additional address detail.

attributes.name: ship_to_city
attributes.description: City name for delivery destination. Used for logistics routing and customs documentation.

attributes.name: ship_to_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for delivery destination (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Used for customs, export control, and regulatory compliance (FDA, EMA, IVDR jurisdictional rules).

attributes.name: ship_to_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for delivery destination. Used for carrier routing and delivery time estimation.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) Postal Code Standards

attributes.name: ship_to_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region for delivery destination. Used for tax calculation and regulatory compliance (e.g., state-specific IVD regulations).

attributes.name: shipping_carrier_code
attributes.description: Standard carrier identifier for logistics provider (e.g., FEDEX, UPS, DHL, WORLDCOURIER). Applicable for ship and cold_chain_ship instruction types. Null for non-shipping fulfillment.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 6346 Carrier Codes

attributes.name: shipping_service_level
attributes.description: Carrier service tier selected for shipment. Overnight = next-day delivery; Two_Day = 2-business-day; Ground = standard surface; International_Express = expedited cross-border; International_Standard = economy cross-border; White_Glove = premium instrument delivery with setup.

attributes.name: special_handling_code
attributes.description: Logistics and handling requirements for this fulfillment. Dry_Ice = dry ice packaging for frozen reagents; Controlled_Rate_Freezer = CRF shipping for enzyme stability; Ambient = room temperature; Refrigerated = 2-8°C cold chain; Hazmat = hazardous materials compliance; Fragile = delicate instruments; High_Value = security escort; Biohazard = biosafety protocols; None = standard handling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dry_ice|controlled_rate_freezer|ambient|refrigerated|hazmat|fragile|high_value|biohazard|none — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Dangerous Goods Regulations; Good Distribution Practice (GDP)

attributes.name: tat_deadline_timestamp
attributes.description: Service Level Agreement (SLA) deadline by which this fulfillment instruction must be completed. Derived from order TAT commitment and used for SLA compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: temperature_monitoring_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether cold-chain temperature monitoring is required during transit. True for reagents, enzymes, and temperature-sensitive consumables requiring Good Distribution Practice (GDP) compliance. Triggers data logger inclusion in shipment.
attributes.references: Good Distribution Practice (GDP) for Medicinal Products; ISO 23640 Cold Chain Logistics

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-provided tracking identifier for shipment visibility. Populated after shipment dispatch. Used for customer self-service tracking and delivery confirmation.

products.name: customer_acceptance
products.description: Formal record of customer sign-off confirming receipt and acceptance of delivered goods or completed services — critical for revenue recognition milestones and IVD/GxP compliance. Covers goods-receipt confirmation, instrument installation sign-off (post-IQ/OQ/PQ), sequencing data delivery acceptance, and software go-live acknowledgment. Captures acceptance type, status, signatory, rejection reasons, and revenue recognition trigger.

attributes.name: customer_acceptance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer acceptance record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who is providing acceptance confirmation. The party receiving and accepting the goods or services.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to instrument.instrument_asset. Business justification: Customer acceptance of installed sequencing instruments triggers revenue recognition, warranty activation, and service contract initiation. Links acceptance testing (IQ/OQ/PQ completion) to specific s

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.batch. Business justification: Revenue recognition for reagent kits and consumables tied to specific batch acceptance. Links acceptance to batch COA, QC release status, and expiry date for regulatory submission documentation and cu

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CAPA record initiated from this acceptance event. Links to quality management system for tracking corrective actions. Null if no CAPA was initiated.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 CAPA Process, MasterControl CAPA Management

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Acceptance record creation attribution supports quality system compliance, CLIA/CAP audit requirements, and revenue recognition process validation. New FK replaces denormalized created_by text field w

attributes.name: experiment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.experiment. Business justification: Customer acceptance of sequencing data deliverables is tied to specific experiments in customer research workflows. Provides research context beyond sequencing_run_id, enabling experiment-level qualit

attributes.name: fair_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.fair_assessment. Business justification: NIH-funded genomics projects require FAIR-compliant data delivery. Customer acceptance for research-grade sequencing data includes FAIR assessment verification (persistent identifiers, metadata comple

attributes.name: genome_assembly_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.genome_assembly. Business justification: Clinical sequencing data acceptance requires documenting the reference genome build used for alignment and variant calling to meet CAP/CLIA reproducibility requirements and enable customer validation

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales order for which acceptance is being recorded. Links to the originating commercial transaction in SAP SD.

attributes.name: production_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_batch. Business justification: Instrument installation qualification and sequencing service acceptance criteria include batch-specific performance data. Customer acceptance records must link to production batches for revenue recogn

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.revenue_recognition. Business justification: Direct link from customer acceptance event to revenue recognition record enables ASC 606 compliance. Acceptance of sequencing data delivery or instrument installation qualification satisfies performan

attributes.name: sequencing_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sequencing run for which data delivery acceptance is being recorded. Applicable only for sequencing service acceptance types. Links to NGS data generation event.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment delivery associated with this acceptance event. Tracks physical delivery of goods.

attributes.name: variant_database_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.variant_database_version. Business justification: Clinical variant interpretation service acceptance requires documenting the specific variant database versions (ClinVar, gnomAD, COSMIC releases) used for annotation to meet regulatory traceability re

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the customer formally accepted the delivered goods or completed services. Key milestone for revenue recognition under ASC 606 and contract fulfillment.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Revenue Recognition, SAP SD Billing

attributes.name: acceptance_document_url
attributes.description: Storage location or reference path to the signed acceptance document or certificate. Points to document management system (Veeva Vault) for audit and compliance retrieval.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Document Management, 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: acceptance_method
attributes.description: Mechanism through which the customer provided acceptance confirmation. Distinguishes between electronic signature, paper-based signature, email confirmation, customer portal acknowledgment, or automated system integration.

attributes.name: acceptance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or special conditions related to the acceptance event. Captures context not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: acceptance_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the acceptance record. Human-readable reference number used in customer communications and audit trails.

attributes.name: acceptance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the acceptance record. Tracks progression from pending customer review through final accepted or rejected state. Critical for revenue recognition trigger and order closure workflow.
attributes.references: SAP SD Order Status, ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: acceptance_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the customer acceptance was recorded in the system. Provides audit trail for compliance and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard, GxP Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: acceptance_type
attributes.description: Category of acceptance event. Distinguishes between physical goods receipt confirmation, instrument installation qualification sign-off (IQ/OQ/PQ), sequencing data delivery acceptance, software implementation go-live acknowledgment, or service completion confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP SD Delivery Types, GxP Qualification Standards

attributes.name: actual_acceptance_days
attributes.description: Actual number of days elapsed from delivery to customer acceptance. Calculated as the difference between delivery date and acceptance date. Used for SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SD Service Level Agreement Management

attributes.name: capa_initiated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Initiated Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a Corrective and Preventive Action was initiated as a result of this acceptance event. True when rejection or conditional acceptance triggers quality investigation.
attributes.references: ISO 13485 CAPA Process, FDA 21 CFR Part 820

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this acceptance record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for compliance and data lineage.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Audit Trail, ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the revenue amount. Indicates the currency in which the transaction value is denominated.

attributes.name: data_delivery_format
attributes.description: File format in which sequencing or bioinformatics data was delivered to the customer. Applicable for sequencing data delivery acceptance types. Tracks compliance with customer specifications.
attributes.references: FASTQ Format Specification, SAM/BAM Format Specification, VCF Format Specification

attributes.name: data_quality_metric_passed
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether delivered sequencing data met agreed-upon quality thresholds (Phred score, coverage depth, read length). True indicates data passed QC specifications. Applicable for sequencing data delivery acceptance.
attributes.references: Illumina Quality Metrics, ISO 15189 Laboratory Quality Standards

attributes.name: installation_qualification_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Installation Qualification (IQ) / Operational Qualification (OQ) / Performance Qualification (PQ) Status
attributes.description: Status of instrument qualification protocol execution for IVD and GxP installations. Tracks completion of Installation Qualification, Operational Qualification, and Performance Qualification phases. Applicable only for instrument acceptance types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_applicable|iq_passed|oq_passed|pq_passed|iq_failed|oq_failed|pq_failed|in_progress — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820, GxP Qualification Standards, ISO 13485

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the system user who last modified this acceptance record. Provides audit trail for record changes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Audit Trail, GxP Documentation Standards

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this acceptance record was last modified in the system. Audit trail field for compliance and change tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Audit Trail, ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: qualification_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which all required qualification protocols (IQ/OQ/PQ) were successfully completed for instrument installations. Null for non-instrument acceptance types.
attributes.references: GxP Qualification Standards, FDA 21 CFR Part 820

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which acceptance documentation was submitted to regulatory authorities. Null if no regulatory submission is required or submission has not yet occurred.

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_required
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this acceptance event requires submission to regulatory authorities (FDA, EMA) as part of post-market surveillance or clinical trial reporting. True for IVD and clinical genomics acceptances.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code

attributes.references: SAP QM Defect Codes, ISO 13485 Nonconformance Management

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text detailed explanation of the rejection or conditional acceptance. Captures customer-provided specifics for quality investigation and corrective action. Null when acceptance status is accepted.

attributes.name: revenue_amount

attributes.references: ASC 606 Revenue Recognition, SAP FI Revenue Accounting

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date on which revenue was recognized in the financial system based on this acceptance event. Aligns with ASC 606 performance obligation satisfaction. Null if revenue recognition has not yet occurred.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Revenue Recognition, SAP FI Revenue Accounting

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_triggered
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this acceptance event triggered revenue recognition in the financial system. True when acceptance satisfies ASC 606 performance obligation criteria and revenue can be recognized.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Revenue Recognition, SAP FI Revenue Accounting

attributes.name: signatory_email
attributes.description: Email address of the signatory for acceptance confirmation and audit trail purposes. Used for electronic signature verification and communication.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Signatures, GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who signed off on the acceptance on behalf of the customer. Required for IVD and GxP compliance documentation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Signatures, GxP Documentation Standards

attributes.name: signatory_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the individual who provided acceptance sign-off. Validates authority to accept on behalf of the customer organization.

attributes.name: sla_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the acceptance was received within the SLA target timeframe. True indicates on-time acceptance per contractual commitment.
attributes.references: SAP SD Service Level Agreement Management

attributes.name: sla_target_acceptance_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Acceptance Days
attributes.description: Number of days from delivery within which customer acceptance is expected per contractual SLA. Used to track on-time acceptance performance and customer responsiveness.
attributes.references: SAP SD Service Level Agreement Management

products.name: credit_memo

Triggers revenue reversal for milestone-based recognition on sequencing service orders.
products.reference: SAP SD Credit Memo (VA01 G2 / VF01)

attributes.name: credit_memo_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the credit memo record. Primary key.

attributes.name: complaint_id

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account receiving the credit. Used for accounts receivable reconciliation and customer balance updates.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager who approved the credit memo. Used for audit trail and accountability in credit authorization process.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original sales order against which this credit memo was issued. Links to the order that generated the original revenue.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Credit memos generate GL journal entries for revenue reversal and AR adjustment. Direct link supports SOX audit trail, reconciliation between order management and financial accounting systems, and mon

attributes.name: return_authorization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the return order that triggered this credit memo, if applicable. Null for non-return credit scenarios such as pricing corrections or goodwill credits.

attributes.name: test_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.test_order. Business justification: When clinical test services are credited due to cancellation, quality issues, or billing errors, linking credit memos to originating test orders enables financial reconciliation, revenue adjustment tr

attributes.name: accounting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger accounting document created for this credit memo. Links credit memo to financial postings in the ERP system.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the credit memo was approved by the authorized approver. Used for tracking approval cycle time and compliance with credit policies.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the credit memo in the workflow. Determines whether the credit has been authorized for issuance and posting to customer account.

attributes.name: billing_document_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Billing Document Number
attributes.description: The ERP system billing document number associated with this credit memo. Used for financial reconciliation and audit trail in SAP FI/CO modules.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity issuing the credit memo. Used for legal entity reporting and statutory compliance.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center to which the credit memo impact is allocated for internal cost accounting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the credit memo record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and process cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: The gross credit amount issued to the customer before tax adjustments. Represents the base value of goods or services being credited.

attributes.name: credit_memo_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the credit memo, typically generated by the ERP billing system. Used for customer communication and accounting reconciliation.

attributes.name: credit_memo_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credit memo based on the business reason for issuance. Determines accounting treatment and approval workflow.

attributes.name: credit_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the specific reason for credit issuance. Used for root cause analysis, quality tracking, and process improvement. Examples: defective product, shipping damage, pricing error, SLA breach, customer satisfaction.

attributes.name: credit_reason_description

attributes.name: customer_reference_number

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: SAP distribution channel through which the original sale and subsequent credit occurred. Examples: direct sales, distributor, e-commerce.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: SAP division code representing the product line or business unit. Examples: sequencing instruments, reagents and consumables, bioinformatics software.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the credit memo was posted. Used for monthly financial reporting and period reconciliation.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the credit memo was posted. Used for financial reporting, period closing, and year-over-year analysis.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the credit memo was officially issued to the customer. Represents the business event date for revenue reversal and accounts receivable adjustment.
attributes.references: SAP FI Posting Date and Revenue Recognition Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified the credit memo record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the credit memo record was last modified. Used for audit trail and data currency tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments regarding the credit memo. Captures special circumstances, customer agreements, or internal coordination details.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the credit will be returned to the customer. Determines cash flow impact and accounts receivable treatment.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the credit memo was posted to the general ledger and customer account. May differ from issue_date due to batch processing or period-end adjustments.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Profit center for internal management reporting and segment profitability analysis. Tracks credit impact by business segment.

attributes.name: refund_date
attributes.description: Date when the refund payment was processed and sent to the customer. Null if payment method is account credit or offset.

attributes.name: refund_status

attributes.name: sales_organization

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: created_by

attributes.name: trade_compliance_check_id

attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the compliance check record. Format: TCC-YYYYMMDD followed by sequence number.

attributes.description: Date until which this compliance check remains valid. After this date, a new compliance check must be performed before shipment can proceed. Typically 30-90 days from screening date depending on risk profile.

attributes.name: check_validity_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this compliance check is valid. Compliance checks have limited validity periods and must be refreshed if the order is delayed or circumstances change.

attributes.name: compliance_officer_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance check requires or has received manual review by a trade compliance officer. True if manual review is required or completed; False if automated screening is sufficient.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the trade compliance check. Cleared indicates approval for export; blocked indicates denial; pending-review requires manual review; conditional-approval requires additional documentation; escalated requires senior compliance officer review; expired indicates check validity has lapsed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this trade compliance check record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and compliance record retention.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the shipment value amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used for financial reporting and customs valuation.

attributes.name: customer_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the customer destination. Used to determine export control jurisdiction and licensing requirements.

attributes.name: denied_party_list_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific denied party list where a match was found (e.g., BIS Denied Persons List, BIS Entity List, OFAC SDN List). Populated only when denied_party_screening_result is fail or manual-review-required.
attributes.references: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Part 744 and OFAC Sanctions Lists

attributes.name: denied_party_screening_result
attributes.description: Result of screening the customer and end-user against U.S. government denied parties lists including the Denied Persons List, Entity List, Unverified List, and Specially Designated Nationals. Pass indicates no match; fail indicates a match requiring transaction block; manual-review-required indicates potential match requiring compliance officer investigation.
attributes.references: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Part 744 and OFAC Sanctions Lists

attributes.name: dual_use_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product being exported is classified as dual-use technology (items that have both commercial and military or proliferation applications). True for dual-use items requiring enhanced export control scrutiny.

attributes.name: eccn
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number assigned to the product being exported. Alphanumeric code (e.g., 3A001.b) that identifies items subject to U.S. Department of Commerce export controls under the Commerce Control List.
attributes.references: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Part 774 Commerce Control List

attributes.name: end_use_declaration
attributes.description: Customer-provided statement describing the intended use of the genomic instruments, reagents, or data products. Required for dual-use technology assessment and export control classification.

attributes.name: harmonized_tariff_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System tariff classification code for customs and duty assessment. Six to ten digit code used for international trade documentation and customs clearance.

attributes.name: itar_controlled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is subject to ITAR controls administered by the U.S. Department of State Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. True if ITAR-controlled; False if subject only to EAR or no export controls.
attributes.references: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) 22 CFR 120-130

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this trade compliance check record was last updated. Tracks changes to compliance status, review notes, or other fields for audit purposes.

attributes.name: license_exception_code
attributes.description: Three-letter code identifying the applicable license exception (e.g., ENC for encryption, TSU for technology and software unrestricted, RPL for servicing and replacement parts). Populated when no full export license is required but an exception applies.

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: Government-issued export license number authorizing the shipment. Populated when license_requirement_flag is True and a valid license has been obtained from the Bureau of Industry and Security or other regulatory authority.

attributes.name: license_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an export license is required for this transaction based on the product ECCN, destination country, and end-use. True if license required; False if license exception or no license required applies.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level category of the product being exported. Used to determine applicable export control regulations and compliance workflows specific to genomics and biotechnology products.

attributes.name: product_sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit identifier for the specific product being exported. Links to the product master data for detailed specifications and export control classification.

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for any regulatory hold, investigation, or enforcement action related to this compliance check. Populated when the transaction is subject to ongoing regulatory scrutiny or voluntary self-disclosure.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance officer completed manual review of the trade compliance check. Populated when compliance_officer_review_flag is True.

attributes.name: review_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the compliance officer documenting the rationale for the compliance decision, additional due diligence performed, or conditions attached to approval. Used for audit trail and regulatory defense.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Categorical risk classification derived from the risk score. Low risk transactions may proceed with automated approval; high and critical risk require compliance officer review and enhanced documentation.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Numerical risk score (0.00 to 100.00) assigned by the screening system based on destination country, product sensitivity, customer profile, and end-use. Higher scores indicate elevated export control risk requiring enhanced due diligence.

attributes.name: routed_export_transaction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a routed export transaction where a foreign principal party in interest (FPPI) authorizes a U.S. agent to facilitate export. True for routed exports requiring special documentation and compliance procedures.

attributes.name: screening_date
attributes.description: Date when the trade compliance screening was performed. Represents the business event date for the compliance check execution.

attributes.name: screening_system_name
attributes.description: Name and version of the automated trade compliance screening system used to perform the check (e.g., SAP Global Trade Services, Descartes Visual Compliance, Amber Road). Used for audit trail and system validation.

attributes.name: screening_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the automated screening system executed the compliance check. Used for audit trail and time-sensitive compliance validation.

attributes.name: shipment_value_amount
attributes.description: Total commercial value of the goods being exported in the transaction currency. Used for export documentation, customs declaration, and license threshold determination.

attributes.name: ultimate_consignee_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the ultimate consignee location. May differ from customer_country_code if goods are transshipped or re-exported.

attributes.name: ultimate_consignee_name
attributes.description: Name of the ultimate end-user or consignee who will receive and use the exported goods. May differ from the bill-to customer. Required for denied party screening and end-use verification.

attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special terms, conditions, or instructions noted on the customer purchase order that require attention during order fulfillment. May include delivery instructions, quality requirements, or contractual clauses.

products.name: product_bom
products.description: Bill of Materials header record linking a finished-goods catalog item, SKU, or commercial bundle to its component materials, sub-assemblies, reagents, packaging, or bundled SKUs. Stores BOM number, BOM type (production/engineering/costing/commercial-bundle), component item reference, component quantity, unit of measure, lead time offset, scrap factor, effective date range, discount percentage (for commercial bundles), eligibility rules, and BOM status (active/superseded/draft). Critical for manufacturing cost rollup, supply planning, regulatory traceability of component lots, and commercial bundle definition with solution-selling go-to-market strategies.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA PP-BD Bill of Materials

attributes.name: product_bom_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bill of materials record. Primary key for the BOM entity.

attributes.name: change_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.change_control. Business justification: BOM changes (component substitutions, formulation modifications, supplier changes) require change control in GMP/QMS environments. Links BOM revision to change control for impact assessment, validatio

attributes.name: primary_component_product_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the component material, sub-assembly, reagent, consumable, or bundled SKU that is part of this BOM. Links to the product master record.

attributes.name: tertiary_product_substitute_component_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to an alternative component that can be used in place of the primary component. Supports supply chain flexibility and risk mitigation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP BOM Alternative Items

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who approved this BOM for production use. Required for design control and quality management compliance.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM was approved for production use. Critical for regulatory traceability and design control.

attributes.name: assembly_instruction
attributes.description: Textual description of how this component should be assembled, installed, or integrated into the parent product. May reference work instructions, SOPs, or engineering drawings.

attributes.name: backflush_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this component is backflushed (automatically consumed upon production confirmation) rather than manually issued. True if backflushed, false if manual issue.

attributes.name: bom_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the BOM. Human-readable unique code used in manufacturing, engineering, and supply chain systems.

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the BOM: draft (under development), active (approved for use), superseded (replaced by newer version), obsolete (no longer valid), frozen (locked for regulatory compliance).

attributes.name: bom_type
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM purpose: production (manufacturing execution), engineering (design specification), costing (cost rollup), commercial-bundle (solution-selling package), service (field service parts), or planning (supply chain planning).

attributes.name: change_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the engineering change order (ECO) or change request that authorized this BOM version or component change. Critical for design control and audit trails.

attributes.name: co_product_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this item is a co-product (additional output) rather than a component input. True if co-product, false if component.

attributes.name: component_position
attributes.description: Sequential position or item number of this component within the BOM structure. Used for ordering and assembly instructions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP BOM Item Number

attributes.name: component_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the component material required to produce one unit of the parent product. Supports fractional quantities for reagents and consumables.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP BOM Item Quantity

attributes.name: cost_rollup_method
attributes.description: Costing methodology used to calculate the component cost contribution to the parent product: standard (predetermined cost), average (moving average), FIFO (first-in-first-out), LIFO (last-in-first-out), or actual (transaction-based).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: discount_percent
attributes.description: Discount percentage applied when this component is part of a commercial bundle. Used for solution-selling pricing strategies and promotional offers.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this BOM or component relationship is no longer valid. Null indicates open-ended validity.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this BOM or component relationship becomes valid and can be used in production or commercial transactions.

attributes.name: eligibility_rules
attributes.description: Business rules or conditions that determine when this component is included in the BOM. May reference customer segments, geographic regions, regulatory classifications, or product configurations.

attributes.name: is_critical_component
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this component is critical for product functionality, regulatory compliance, or supply chain risk. True if critical, false otherwise.

attributes.name: is_phantom_assembly
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this component is a phantom (transient sub-assembly that is not stocked). True if phantom, false if physical inventory item.

attributes.name: lead_time_offset_days
attributes.description: Number of days before the parent product start date that this component must be available. Used for backward scheduling in production planning.

attributes.name: lot_traceability_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether lot-level traceability is required for this component per regulatory or quality requirements. True if lot tracking is mandatory, false otherwise.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this BOM record. Part of audit trail for regulatory compliance and change control.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM record was last modified. Part of audit trail for regulatory compliance and change control.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this BOM or component relationship. May include special handling instructions, quality requirements, or supply chain considerations.

attributes.name: operation_sequence
attributes.description: Routing operation number at which this component is consumed. Links BOM items to production routing steps.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility where this BOM is used. Supports multi-site manufacturing and plant-specific BOMs.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory status of the BOM or component: RUO (Research Use Only), IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic), CE-IVD (European IVD), LDT (Laboratory Developed Test), GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), or non-regulated.

attributes.name: scrap_factor_percent
attributes.description: Expected waste or loss percentage for this component during manufacturing. Used for material requirements planning (MRP) and cost rollup calculations.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the component quantity is expressed (e.g., EA for each, L for liters, ML for milliliters, G for grams, KG for kilograms). Aligns with ISO 80000 standards.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the BOM. Tracks engineering changes and revisions over time. Critical for regulatory traceability and change control.

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: Production work center or assembly station where this component is consumed or installed. Links BOM to routing operations.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created this BOM record. Part of audit trail for regulatory compliance and change control.

products.name: bom_line
products.description: Individual component line within a Bill of Materials, representing one raw material, sub-assembly, packaging item, or commercial bundle component required to produce or compose the parent finished good or bundle. Captures component SKU reference, required quantity, unit of measure, item category (raw material/semi-finished/packaging/phantom/bundle-component), component role (primary instrument/reagent/software/service for bundles), alternative item group, substitution eligibility flag, mandatory/optional flag, supply type (in-house/external), and validity dates. Enables granular cost analysis, component substitution management, lot traceability from raw material to finished product, and commercial bundle composition with revenue allocation.

attributes.name: bom_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the BOM line item. Primary key for the BOM line entity.

attributes.name: bom_sku_id
attributes.description: FK to product.sku

attributes.name: change_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.change_control. Business justification: Individual BOM line changes (component specification updates, alternative suppliers, quantity adjustments) require change control for traceability. Links component-level changes to formal change manag

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user (engineer, quality manager, or authorized approver) who approved this BOM line for production use. Required for GMP and ISO 13485 compliance.

attributes.name: genome_assembly_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.genome_assembly. Business justification: Software/data components in BOMs (reference genome indices, annotation files) must track specific assembly versions for lot traceability and change control. Required for ISO 13485 design control, 21 C

attributes.name: primary_bom_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product master record for the component material, sub-assembly, reagent, consumable, or service item required in this BOM line.

attributes.name: product_bom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent BOM header that this line belongs to. Links the component line to the finished good or assembly BOM.

attributes.name: alternative_item_group
attributes.description: Identifier for a group of interchangeable components that can substitute for one another in the BOM. Enables flexible sourcing and component substitution management during production or supply shortages.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM line was approved for production use. Part of the design control and change management audit trail.

attributes.name: assembly_instruction
attributes.description: Free-text field containing specific assembly, handling, or usage instructions for this component. Used by manufacturing operators and documented in work instructions and SOPs.

attributes.name: bom_line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the BOM line: active (in production use), inactive (temporarily disabled), pending_approval (awaiting engineering or quality approval), obsolete (phased out, retained for historical reference).

attributes.name: component_cost
attributes.description: Standard unit cost of the component material. Used for BOM cost rollup, COGS calculation, and product profitability analysis. Confidential business data.

attributes.name: component_role
attributes.description: Functional role of the component within a commercial bundle or product offering. Used for revenue allocation, customer communication, and bundle composition analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: primary_instrument|reagent|consumable|software|accessory|service|documentation — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the component cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency BOM costing for global manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: critical_component_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is critical to product performance, safety, or regulatory compliance. Critical components require enhanced quality control, supplier qualification, and change control procedures.

attributes.name: engineering_change_number
attributes.description: Reference to the engineering change order or document control number that authorized the addition, modification, or removal of this component in the BOM. Critical for traceability and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: expiry_control_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether expiration date tracking is required for this component. Essential for reagents, biological materials, and consumables with limited shelf life.

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, and documentation (SDS, shipping labels, disposal procedures).

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: Classification of the component type within the BOM structure: raw_material (base chemicals, reagents), semi_finished (sub-assemblies, intermediate products), packaging (boxes, labels, inserts), phantom (logical grouping without inventory), bundle_component (commercial bundle item), service (installation, training, support).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM line record was last updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and synchronization with downstream systems.

attributes.name: lead_time_offset_days
attributes.description: Number of days before the production start date that this component must be available. Used for material requirements planning (MRP) and procurement scheduling.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the parent BOM, used for ordering and referencing specific component positions in the assembly structure.

attributes.name: lot_control_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether lot number tracking is required for this component. Critical for reagents, consumables, and materials subject to GMP, traceability, and recall management.

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is mandatory for the finished product or optional. Optional components may be included based on customer configuration or production variant.

attributes.name: reference_designator
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the physical location or position of the component in the assembly (e.g., R1, C5, U3 for electronics; position codes for mechanical assemblies). Used in assembly drawings and work instructions.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory status of the component: RUO (Research Use Only), IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic), CE_IVD (CE marked IVD), GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice controlled), non_regulated. Determines handling, documentation, and quality requirements.

attributes.name: required_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the component required to produce one unit of the parent finished good or assembly. Supports fractional quantities for reagents and consumables.

attributes.name: revenue_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the total bundle or product revenue allocated to this component. Used for revenue recognition, performance obligations under ASC 606, and component-level profitability analysis in commercial bundles.

attributes.name: scrap_percentage
attributes.description: Expected scrap or waste percentage for this component during production. Used to calculate net material requirements and cost of goods sold (COGS) accurately.

attributes.name: serial_number_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether serial number tracking is required for this component. Typically applies to high-value instruments, critical sub-assemblies, and items requiring individual traceability.

attributes.name: substitution_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component can be substituted with an alternative item from the same alternative item group during production or order fulfillment.

attributes.name: supply_type
attributes.description: Source of the component: in_house (manufactured internally), external (purchased from vendor), subcontract (manufactured by third party to our spec), customer_supplied (provided by customer for custom orders).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the required quantity is expressed (e.g., EA for each, L for liters, KG for kilograms, ML for milliliters). Aligns with ISO and industry standards for laboratory and manufacturing materials.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this BOM line is effective. Supports BOM versioning, engineering changes, and time-phased component transitions.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this BOM line is effective. Null indicates the component is currently active with no planned end date. Used for component phase-out and obsolescence management.

products.name: pricing
products.description: Commercial pricing record defining the list price, ASP (Average Selling Price), transfer price, and tiered volume pricing for each SKU by currency, region, and sales channel. Stores price type (list/contract/distributor/OEM/government), currency code, unit price, minimum order quantity, volume break thresholds, effective start and end dates, approval status, and the pricing owner (commercial ops team). Supports revenue recognition, deal desk quoting, and margin analysis. Distinct from customer-specific contract pricing which lives in the order/agreement domain.

attributes.name: pricing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pricing record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Pricing approvals are a critical business control in genomics biotech, especially for regulated diagnostic products with transfer pricing and ASP reporting requirements. Approved_by is currently bare

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product SKU for which this pricing applies. Links to the product catalog.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the pricing record: draft (being prepared), pending_approval (submitted for review), approved (active and usable), rejected (not approved), expired (validity period ended), superseded (replaced by newer pricing).

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pricing record was approved. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: asp
attributes.description: Average Selling Price realized across all transactions for this SKU in the specified period and region. Used for revenue forecasting, margin analysis, and competitive benchmarking. Confidential business metric.

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the customer contract or master agreement that governs this pricing. Null for standard list pricing. Used to link pricing to contractual commitments.

attributes.name: cost_price
attributes.description: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) per unit. Used for margin calculation and profitability analysis. Confidential financial data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pricing record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the price is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY).

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Target customer segment for this pricing tier: enterprise (large commercial accounts), mid_market, small_business, academic (universities and research institutes), government (public sector), clinical (diagnostic labs and hospitals), pharma (pharmaceutical companies), biotech (biotechnology firms). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: enterprise|mid_market|small_business|academic|government|clinical|pharma|biotech — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Standard discount percentage applied to the list price to derive the unit price. Used for transparency in pricing calculations and margin analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Condition Types

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this pricing is no longer valid. Null for open-ended pricing. Used to manage price changes, promotions, and contract expirations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Validity Period

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this pricing becomes active and can be used in quotations and orders. Part of the pricing validity period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Validity Period

attributes.name: list_price
attributes.description: Standard catalog list price per unit before any discounts or adjustments. Used as the baseline for discount calculations and margin analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Condition Records

attributes.name: margin_percentage
attributes.description: Gross margin percentage calculated as (unit_price - cost_price) / unit_price. Used for profitability analysis and pricing strategy optimization. Confidential financial metric.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of units that must be purchased for this price to apply. Used to enforce volume thresholds and manage production efficiency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Order Processing

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pricing record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context about this pricing record, such as special terms, conditions, or rationale for pricing decisions. Used for internal documentation and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the commercial operations team member responsible for maintaining this pricing record. Primary contact for pricing inquiries and updates.

attributes.name: price_list_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the price list or pricing schedule that contains this record. Used to manage pricing history and track price list updates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Master Data

attributes.name: price_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing record: list (standard catalog price), contract (customer-specific negotiated), distributor (channel partner pricing), OEM (original equipment manufacturer pricing), government (public sector pricing), transfer (intercompany pricing), promotional (temporary campaign pricing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: list|contract|distributor|oem|government|transfer|promotional — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Unique code identifying the promotional campaign associated with this pricing. Null for non-promotional pricing. Used for campaign tracking and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: promotional_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing is part of a temporary promotional campaign (True) or standard pricing (False). Used to track promotional effectiveness and revenue impact.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country or region code where this pricing applies (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, CHN, JPN). Supports regional pricing strategies.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the product being priced: RUO (Research Use Only), IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic), CE-IVD (Conformité Européenne In Vitro Diagnostic), LDT (Laboratory Developed Test), GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice compliant), research_grade. Affects pricing strategy and market access.

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: Sales channel through which this pricing is offered: direct (direct sales force), distributor (channel partners), OEM (original equipment manufacturer partnerships), online (e-commerce), government (public sector contracts), academic (research institutions).

attributes.name: transfer_price
attributes.description: Intercompany transfer price used for transactions between legal entities or business units. Used for internal cost allocation and tax compliance. Confidential.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Intercompany Pricing, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the pricing (e.g., each for instruments, kit for reagent kits, run for sequencing services, license for software subscriptions, sample for assay services). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|kit|box|case|liter|milliliter|gram|pack|license|run|sample — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Effective selling price per unit after applying standard discounts, volume breaks, or channel adjustments. This is the operational price used in quoting and order entry.

attributes.name: volume_tier_1_price
attributes.description: Unit price applicable when order quantity meets or exceeds volume_tier_1_quantity. Null if no volume pricing applies.

attributes.name: volume_tier_1_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity threshold for the first volume discount tier. Null if no volume pricing applies.

attributes.name: volume_tier_2_price
attributes.description: Unit price applicable when order quantity meets or exceeds volume_tier_2_quantity. Null if tier does not exist.

attributes.name: volume_tier_2_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity threshold for the second volume discount tier. Null if tier does not exist.

attributes.name: volume_tier_3_price
attributes.description: Unit price applicable when order quantity meets or exceeds volume_tier_3_quantity. Null if tier does not exist.

attributes.name: volume_tier_3_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity threshold for the third volume discount tier. Null if tier does not exist.

products.name: regulatory_classification
products.description: Regulatory use and market authorization classification for each catalog item by jurisdiction. Captures intended use classification (RUO/IVD/CE-IVD/LDT/ASR), device class (Class I/II/III per FDA 21 CFR), IVDR risk class (A/B/C/D per EU 2017/746), GMDN code, product code (FDA), CE-IVD certificate number, authorization status (authorized/pending/withdrawn), jurisdiction (US/EU/APAC/ROW), authorization date, expiry date, and labeling language requirements. Serves as the SSOT for regulatory status consumed by regulatory submissions, quality, and commercial teams.
products.reference: FDA 21 CFR Part 820 / EU IVDR 2017/746 / ISO 13485

attributes.name: regulatory_classification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory classification record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the catalog product (sequencing platform, array, CRISPR tool, reagent kit, consumable, software license, or service) that this regulatory classification applies to.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Regulatory classifications (FDA device class, IVDR risk class, CE marking) require full audit trails for 21 CFR Part 11 and ISO 13485 compliance. Created_by is currently bare text; linking to employee

attributes.name: genome_assembly_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.genome_assembly. Business justification: IVD regulatory submissions must specify validated reference genome(s) in technical documentation. Required for FDA 510k submissions (Section 6: Performance Characteristics), EU IVDR technical files (A

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_id
attributes.description: Internal tracking identifier for the regulatory submission dossier or application associated with this classification record.

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory authorization was granted by the governing authority in the specified jurisdiction. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: authorization_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory authorization expires and requires renewal. Null for authorizations without expiration. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: authorization_number
attributes.description: Unique authorization or clearance number assigned by the regulatory authority (e.g., FDA 510(k) number, premarket approval number, or equivalent jurisdiction-specific identifier).

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory authorization status in the specified jurisdiction. Authorized (approved for market), Pending (under review), Withdrawn (voluntarily removed), Suspended (temporarily halted), Expired (authorization lapsed).

attributes.name: biocompatibility_testing_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether biocompatibility testing per ISO 10993 series is required for regulatory approval in the jurisdiction.

attributes.name: ce_certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate number issued by the EU Notified Body for CE-IVD marked products, demonstrating conformity with EU IVDR requirements.

attributes.name: clinical_evidence_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether clinical evidence (clinical trials, performance studies, or clinical evaluation reports) is required for regulatory authorization in this jurisdiction.
attributes.references: EU IVDR 2017/746 Article 56, FDA 21 CFR Part 812

attributes.name: controlled_substance_schedule
attributes.description: DEA controlled substance schedule if the product contains or is used with controlled substances. Applicable to certain reagents or diagnostic kits.
attributes.value_regex: Schedule I|Schedule II|Schedule III|Schedule IV|Schedule V|Not Controlled

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory classification record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: cybersecurity_requirements_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether cybersecurity controls and documentation are required for regulatory submission, applicable to connected devices, software, and bioinformatics platforms.
attributes.references: FDA Cybersecurity Guidance, EU IVDR 2017/746 Annex I

attributes.name: data_privacy_compliance_required
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of data privacy regulations that must be complied with for this product in the jurisdiction (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA). Applicable to products handling patient or customer data.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this regulatory classification record becomes effective and applicable for commercial operations. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_required
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of environmental regulations applicable to the product (e.g., RoHS, REACH, WEEE) for manufacturing, distribution, and disposal in the jurisdiction.
attributes.references: EU RoHS Directive, EU REACH Regulation, EU WEEE Directive

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control classification number (ECCN) or equivalent for products subject to export restrictions (e.g., gene-editing tools, high-throughput sequencers with dual-use potential).

attributes.name: fda_device_class
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Device Class
attributes.description: FDA device classification under 21 CFR for US market. Class I (low risk, general controls), Class II (moderate risk, special controls), Class III (high risk, premarket approval required), or Not Applicable for non-device products or non-US jurisdictions.

attributes.name: fda_product_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Product Code
attributes.description: Three-letter FDA product code assigned to the device type for classification and regulatory tracking purposes in the US market.

attributes.name: gmdn_code
attributes.description: Five-digit GMDN code providing internationally recognized nomenclature for medical devices. Used for regulatory submissions and device identification across jurisdictions.

attributes.name: gmdn_term_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Medical Device Nomenclature (GMDN) Term Name
attributes.description: Human-readable GMDN term name corresponding to the GMDN code, describing the device type in standardized nomenclature.

attributes.name: intended_use_classification
attributes.description: Primary regulatory classification defining the intended use of the product. RUO (Research Use Only) for research applications, IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic) for FDA-regulated diagnostic devices, CE-IVD (Conformité Européenne In Vitro Diagnostic) for EU-regulated diagnostics, LDT (Laboratory Developed Test) for lab-developed tests, ASR (Analyte Specific Reagent) for FDA ASR classification, GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) for manufacturing-grade products.

attributes.name: ivdr_risk_class
attributes.business_glossary_term: In Vitro Diagnostic Regulation (IVDR) Risk Class
attributes.description: EU IVDR 2017/746 risk classification for in vitro diagnostic medical devices. Class A (lowest risk), Class B (low risk), Class C (moderate risk), Class D (highest risk), or Not Applicable for non-IVD products or non-EU jurisdictions.
attributes.value_regex: Class A|Class B|Class C|Class D|Not Applicable

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the regulatory jurisdiction where this classification applies (e.g., USA for United States, DEU for Germany, CHN for China). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|CAN|MEX|GBR|DEU|FRA|ITA|ESP|CHE|NLD|BEL|AUT|SWE|DNK|NOR|FIN|IRL|POL|CZE|HUN|ROU|BGR|HRV|SVN|SVK|EST|LVA|LTU|GRC|PRT|CYP|MLT|LUX|CHN|JPN|KOR|IND|AUS|NZL|SGP|HKG|TWN|THA|MYS|IDN|PHL|VNM|BRA|ARG|CHL|COL|PER|ZAF|ISR|TUR|SAU|ARE|EGY|RUS|UKR — 60 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: labeling_language_required
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes required for product labeling and instructions for use in the specified jurisdiction (e.g., en, de, fr, es, zh, ja).

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this regulatory classification record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory classification record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional regulatory notes, special conditions, or jurisdiction-specific requirements not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: notified_body_number
