attributes.name: validity_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract expires. After this date, no further releases or purchase orders can be created against this contract unless renewed.

attributes.name: validity_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the contract terms become effective and binding. Contract cannot be used for procurement before this date.

products.name: demand_plan
products.description: Forward-looking demand forecast for materials and finished goods required to support genomics production schedules, reagent kit assembly, and customer order fulfillment. Captures planning period, material, plant, forecasted quantity, forecast method (statistical, consensus, MRP-driven), confidence interval, demand signal source (sales forecast, production plan, safety stock replenishment), revision history, and planner notes. Drives procurement triggers, supplier capacity reservations, and MRP net requirements calculation. Supports uninterrupted supply of critical NGS, microarray, and CRISPR inputs.

attributes.name: demand_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the demand plan record. Primary key for the demand plan entity.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Demand planning approval workflow requires personnel accountability for forecast commitments and budget implications. Enables approval delegation analysis, planner performance tracking, and audit trai

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_budget. Business justification: Demand plans drive procurement budgets; finance validates forecast-driven budget requests for reagents, consumables, and materials. Enables budget planning, forecast accuracy tracking, and spend autho

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or finished good for which demand is being planned. Links to reagent kits, sequencing consumables, instruments, or other genomics products.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.opportunity. Business justification: Demand planning incorporates weighted pipeline opportunities, especially for capital equipment with long lead times. Business process: sales & operations planning (S&OP), forecast-to-plan reconciliati

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or distribution center where the material is produced or stocked.

attributes.name: previous_plan_demand_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prior version of this demand plan, enabling revision history tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval state of the demand plan. Indicates whether the plan is pending review, approved by demand planning manager, or rejected for revision.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the demand plan was approved for execution.

attributes.name: confidence_interval_lower
attributes.description: Lower bound of the confidence interval for the forecasted quantity. Represents the minimum expected demand under normal variability.

attributes.name: confidence_interval_upper
attributes.description: Upper bound of the confidence interval for the forecasted quantity. Represents the maximum expected demand under normal variability.

attributes.name: confidence_level_percentage
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level associated with the forecast interval, typically 90%, 95%, or 99%. Indicates the probability that actual demand will fall within the confidence interval.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the demand plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_order_backlog_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of confirmed customer orders not yet fulfilled. Represents committed demand that must be satisfied in the planning period.

attributes.name: demand_category
attributes.description: Classification of demand type. Independent demand is driven by customer orders (finished goods), dependent demand is driven by production schedules (components), and service parts demand is driven by maintenance and support needs.

attributes.name: demand_signal_source
attributes.description: Origin of the demand signal driving the forecast. Indicates whether demand is driven by sales forecasts, production schedules, safety stock replenishment needs, confirmed customer orders, promotional campaigns, or new product launches.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_percentage
attributes.description: Historical accuracy of the forecast method for this material and plant combination, expressed as a percentage. Used to assess forecast reliability and adjust safety stock levels.

attributes.name: forecast_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to generate the demand forecast. Indicates whether the forecast was derived from statistical models, consensus planning sessions, MRP net requirements, manual planner input, machine learning algorithms, or historical averages.

attributes.name: forecasted_quantity
attributes.description: Predicted demand quantity for the material during the planning period. Represents units of reagent kits, flow cells, instruments, or other genomics products required to meet anticipated customer orders and production schedules.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required to procure or produce the material. Critical for calculating reorder points and ensuring uninterrupted supply of genomics consumables.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the demand plan record was last updated.

attributes.name: mrp_element_type
attributes.description: Type of MRP element generated or influenced by this demand plan. Indicates whether the plan drives planned orders, purchase requisitions, production orders, or stock transfers.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the demand plan. Tracks whether the plan is in draft, approved for execution, actively driving procurement, superseded by a newer version, or archived.

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the demand plan, enabling tracking of plan revisions and iterations over time.

attributes.name: planner_name
attributes.description: Name of the demand planner or supply chain analyst responsible for creating and maintaining this demand plan.

attributes.name: planner_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments from the demand planner. May include assumptions, market intelligence, customer feedback, or adjustments made to statistical forecasts.

attributes.name: planning_horizon
attributes.description: Time granularity of the demand plan. Indicates whether the plan is weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annual.

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the planning period for which demand is forecasted.

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the planning period for which demand is forecasted. Typically aligned with monthly, quarterly, or weekly planning cycles.

attributes.name: procurement_trigger_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the demand plan has triggered a procurement action. True when forecasted demand exceeds available inventory and requires purchase order creation.

attributes.name: product_lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the material in its product lifecycle. Influences demand planning strategies, with introduction and growth stages requiring aggressive forecasting and end-of-life stages requiring phase-out planning.

attributes.name: production_plan_quantity
attributes.description: Demand quantity derived from production schedules and manufacturing plans. Represents materials required to support planned production runs of reagent kits, library prep kits, or instrument assembly.

attributes.name: promotional_impact_quantity
attributes.description: Additional demand quantity expected due to promotional campaigns, product launches, or marketing initiatives.

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: Inventory level at which procurement or production should be triggered to replenish stock. Calculated based on lead time demand and safety stock requirements.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision number tracking changes to the demand plan over time. Incremented each time the plan is updated.

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the demand plan was revised. Examples include market changes, customer order updates, supply disruptions, or forecast accuracy adjustments.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Buffer inventory quantity maintained to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions. Critical for high-value genomics consumables with long lead times.

attributes.name: sales_forecast_quantity
attributes.description: Demand quantity derived from sales team forecasts and customer pipeline analysis. Represents anticipated customer orders for NGS kits, microarray products, or CRISPR tools.

attributes.name: seasonality_factor
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to baseline forecast to account for seasonal demand patterns. Values greater than 1.0 indicate peak seasons, values less than 1.0 indicate off-peak periods.

attributes.name: supplier_capacity_reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of supplier production capacity reserved based on this demand plan. Ensures critical raw materials and components for genomics products are available when needed.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the forecasted quantity is expressed. Examples include EA (each), KIT, BOX, L (liters), or other units relevant to genomics consumables and instruments.

products.name: replenishment_order
products.description: Internal procurement or transfer order generated by MRP or demand planning to replenish stock of a material at a plant or storage location. Captures planned order number, order type (purchase requisition, stock transfer order, production order trigger), material, required quantity, required date, source plant/supplier, and conversion status (open, converted to PO, confirmed). Bridges demand planning and execution in the SAP MM/PP integration. Sourced from SAP MM (EBAN/EBKN for purchase requisitions).

attributes.name: replenishment_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the replenishment order record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: capex_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.capex_request. Business justification: Equipment/instrument replenishment orders originate from approved capex requests. Links procurement execution to capital budget authorization, enabling capex spend tracking and project completion veri

attributes.name: catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.reagent_catalog. Business justification: MRP-generated replenishment orders specify which reagent catalog item needs restocking. Enables demand planning by product, safety stock calculations by reagent type, conversion to purchase requisitio

attributes.name: converted_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: Replenishment orders (planned orders from MRP) are converted to purchase orders when released. The replenishment_order table has converted_document_number (STRING) and converted_document_type (STRING)

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center that will be charged for this replenishment order. Links to the financial organizational unit responsible for the procurement cost.

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record being replenished. Links to the genomics product, reagent, consumable, or component requiring stock replenishment.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the destination plant or manufacturing facility where the material is required. Links to the organizational unit receiving the replenishment.

attributes.name: reagent_subscription_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.reagent_subscription. Business justification: Replenishment orders may be triggered by subscription consumption forecasts or committed volumes. Business process: subscription-driven MRP, automated replenishment for subscription customers, subscri

attributes.name: requisitioner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: MRP-generated replenishment order requisitioner tracking enables cost center accountability, planner workload analysis, and audit trail for automated procurement. Replaces denormalized 'requisitioner_

attributes.name: source_plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the source plant from which material will be transferred. Applicable when source type is internal plant or distribution center. Links to the supplying organizational unit.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific storage location within the plant where the material will be received. Links to warehouse, cold storage, or controlled environment area.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external supplier or vendor from whom the material will be procured. Applicable when source type is external supplier. Links to supplier master data.

attributes.name: batch_managed
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the material is batch-managed requiring lot number tracking and Certificate of Analysis (COA) documentation. True for reagents, consumables, and controlled materials.

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the material requires cold chain handling and temperature-controlled logistics. True for temperature-sensitive reagents, enzymes, and biological materials.

attributes.name: conversion_date
attributes.description: Date when the replenishment order was converted into an execution document such as a purchase order, stock transfer order, or production order. Null if not yet converted.

attributes.name: converted_document_number
attributes.description: Business identifier of the execution document created from this replenishment order. Purchase order number, stock transfer order number, or production order number. Null if not yet converted.

attributes.name: converted_document_type
attributes.description: Type of execution document created from this replenishment order. Indicates the downstream procurement or manufacturing process triggered.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the replenishment order record was first created in the system. Audit trail for order lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated cost. Standard currency for procurement transactions.

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Estimated total cost for fulfilling this replenishment order. Calculated based on material standard cost, last purchase price, or contract price. Used for budget planning and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) forecasting.

attributes.name: gmp_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this replenishment order is for Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) controlled materials requiring enhanced quality and compliance tracking. Critical for regulated genomics products.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the replenishment order record was last updated. Tracks changes to order status, quantities, or dates throughout the procurement lifecycle.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Planned procurement or transfer lead time in days from order creation to material availability. Used for scheduling and delivery date calculation.

attributes.name: mrp_controller
attributes.description: Code identifying the MRP controller or planner responsible for this material and replenishment order. Links to the person or team managing material availability.

attributes.name: mrp_run_date
attributes.description: Date when the MRP calculation was executed that generated this replenishment order. Provides traceability to the planning cycle.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments related to the replenishment order. Captures special instructions, handling requirements, or planning considerations.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the replenishment order indicating its position in the procurement or transfer workflow. Tracks conversion from planned order to execution document. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|converted_to_po|confirmed|partially_fulfilled|fulfilled|cancelled|on_hold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the replenishment order indicating the procurement or transfer mechanism. Determines the execution workflow and system integration path.

attributes.name: planned_order_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the planned order generated by Material Requirements Planning (MRP) or demand planning system. Externally visible order number used for tracking and reference.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level for the replenishment order. Indicates urgency based on stock-out risk, production schedule impact, or customer commitment criticality.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Code identifying the purchasing group responsible for converting this replenishment order into a purchase order. Links to the procurement team handling supplier negotiations.

attributes.name: reorder_point_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this replenishment order was triggered by reaching the reorder point threshold. True if reorder point logic initiated the order.

attributes.name: required_date
attributes.description: Date by which the material must be available at the destination plant or storage location to meet production or customer demand. Drives procurement lead time calculations.

attributes.name: required_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material required to fulfill the replenishment need. Calculated by Material Requirements Planning (MRP) based on demand, safety stock, and reorder point logic.

attributes.name: safety_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this replenishment order was triggered to maintain safety stock levels. True if the order is for safety stock replenishment, false if for normal demand.

attributes.name: shelf_life_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expected expiration date for the material based on shelf life and required date. Used for First Expired First Out (FEFO) inventory management and quality control.
attributes.references: SAP MM Shelf Life Management Standards

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the source from which the material will be procured or transferred. Determines whether the order triggers external procurement or internal stock transfer.

attributes.name: special_procurement_type
attributes.description: Classification of special procurement logic applied to this replenishment order. Indicates non-standard procurement scenarios such as consignment, subcontracting, or pipeline materials.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the required quantity. Standard units include EA (each), KG (kilogram), L (liter), BOX, VIAL, KIT, etc.

products.name: warehouse_location
products.description: Master record for physical storage locations within Genomics Biotech warehouses and distribution centers — including ambient, refrigerated (2–8°C), frozen (−20°C, −80°C), and ultra-cold (liquid nitrogen) zones required for biological reagents, flow cells, and CRISPR components. Captures warehouse number, storage type, storage section, bin location, temperature zone, capacity (weight/volume), hazardous material classification (UN number, hazard class, storage incompatibilities), GMP zone classification, and current utilization. Supports cold-chain zone management and regulatory compliance for transport/storage of hazardous genomics inputs. Sourced from SAP WM/EWM.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical storage location within the warehouse or distribution center. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Storage locations (labs, cold storage, warehouses) are cost centers for overhead allocation. Enables facility cost accounting, space utilization analysis, and overhead rate calculation for costing mod

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Warehouse location setup accountability required for GMP facility qualification and audit trails. Enables personnel accountability for warehouse configuration and training verification for warehouse m

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent warehouse or distribution center facility where this storage location resides.

attributes.name: aisle_number
attributes.description: Aisle identifier within the warehouse where this storage location resides. Used for warehouse navigation and picking route optimization.

attributes.name: batch_managed_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether inventory stored in this location requires batch or lot number tracking. True if batch management is enforced for traceability and quality control. Critical for reagents, flow cells, and consumables subject to Certificate of Analysis (COA) requirements.

attributes.name: bin_location
attributes.description: Specific bin, shelf, or pallet position within the storage section. Represents the most granular physical address for inventory placement (e.g., A12-R03-B05).

attributes.name: blocked_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the storage location is currently blocked for use due to maintenance, damage, temperature excursion, or other operational issues. True if location is unavailable for inventory placement or retrieval.

attributes.name: blocked_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the storage location is blocked (e.g., 'Temperature excursion detected', 'Structural damage', 'Scheduled maintenance'). Populated only when blocked_indicator is True.

attributes.name: capacity_volume_m3
attributes.description: Maximum volumetric capacity of the storage location in cubic meters. Used for space utilization planning and warehouse optimization.

attributes.name: capacity_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight capacity of the storage location in kilograms. Used for load planning and safety compliance to prevent structural overload.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage location record was first created in the warehouse management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: current_utilization_percent
attributes.description: Current utilization of the storage location as a percentage of total capacity (weight or volume). Calculated based on inventory currently stored. Used for warehouse efficiency KPIs and replenishment planning.

attributes.name: cycle_count_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this storage location is included in regular cycle counting programs for inventory accuracy verification. True if location is subject to periodic physical counts.

attributes.name: fefo_enforcement
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether First Expired First Out (FEFO) inventory rotation is enforced for this storage location. True if the WMS must prioritize inventory with the earliest expiration date for picking. Used for biological reagents, enzymes, and flow cells with strict shelf-life requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.142, SAP EWM FEFO Strategy

attributes.name: fifo_enforcement
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether First In First Out (FIFO) inventory rotation is enforced for this storage location. True if the warehouse management system (WMS) must prioritize oldest inventory for picking. Critical for reagents and consumables with limited shelf life.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.142, SAP EWM FIFO Strategy

attributes.name: gmp_zone_classification
attributes.description: GMP cleanliness classification for the storage location. Grade A (highest sterility) for aseptic operations, Grade B for background environment for Grade A, Grade C and D for less critical manufacturing steps, non_gmp for non-regulated storage. Required for IVD and RUO product manufacturing compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211, EU GMP Annex 1, ISO 14644

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: UN hazard classification for materials stored in this location (e.g., 3 for flammable liquids, 6.2 for infectious substances, 8 for corrosives). Used for segregation and emergency response planning.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods, 49 CFR Part 173

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this storage location is designated for hazardous materials. True if the location is certified for hazmat storage per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200, UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent cycle count performed for this storage location. Used to schedule next cycle count and monitor inventory accuracy compliance.

attributes.name: level_number
attributes.description: Vertical level or shelf position within the rack (e.g., 1 for ground level, 2 for first shelf above ground). Used for ergonomic picking optimization and safety compliance.

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the storage location. Active for normal use, inactive for temporarily unused, blocked for operational issues, quarantine for QC hold, maintenance for scheduled work, decommissioned for permanently retired locations.

attributes.name: mixed_storage_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this storage location allows multiple Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) to be stored simultaneously. True if mixed SKU storage is permitted, False if location is dedicated to a single SKU.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this storage location record. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Audit Trail, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage location record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: picking_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this storage location is designated for active picking operations (order fulfillment). True if location is in the pick zone, False if it is a reserve or bulk storage location.

attributes.name: picking_strategy
attributes.description: WMS strategy for selecting inventory from this storage location during order fulfillment. FIFO for oldest first, FEFO for earliest expiration first, LIFO for last in first out, nearest_location for travel optimization, highest_stock for inventory balancing.

attributes.name: putaway_strategy
attributes.description: Warehouse management system (WMS) strategy for directing incoming inventory to this storage location. Fixed_bin for dedicated SKU locations, next_empty_bin for dynamic allocation, bulk_storage for pallet-level storage, high_rack for vertical storage systems, floor_storage for oversized items.

attributes.name: quarantine_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this storage location is designated for quarantined inventory pending quality control (QC) release or investigation. True if location is restricted for quarantine use only.

attributes.name: rack_number
attributes.description: Rack or shelving unit identifier within the aisle. Used for precise physical location addressing.

attributes.name: replenishment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this storage location requires automatic replenishment from reserve storage when inventory falls below a threshold. True if location is part of an automated replenishment strategy.

attributes.name: serial_number_managed_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether inventory stored in this location requires serial number tracking at the individual unit level. True if serial number management is enforced. Used for high-value instruments, flow cells, and components requiring unit-level traceability.

attributes.name: storage_incompatibilities
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of hazard classes or material types that must NOT be stored in proximity to this location due to chemical incompatibility (e.g., 'acids,oxidizers'). Used to enforce segregation rules and prevent dangerous reactions.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the storage location, typically a combination of warehouse number, aisle, rack, and bin identifiers (e.g., WH01-A12-R03-B05). Used for operational picking and putaway instructions.
attributes.references: SAP MM Storage Location, SAP EWM Storage Bin

attributes.name: storage_section
attributes.description: Logical subdivision within the warehouse (e.g., aisle, zone, or area designation) used to organize storage locations by product category, temperature zone, or operational workflow.

attributes.name: storage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storage environment based on temperature control and regulatory requirements. Ambient for room temperature, refrigerated for 2–8°C, frozen for −20°C or −80°C, ultra_cold for liquid nitrogen storage, hazmat for hazardous materials, gmp_controlled for Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) zones.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211, ISO 13485, GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: temperature_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for this storage location. Excursions beyond this threshold trigger quality alerts and potential quarantine of affected inventory.

attributes.name: temperature_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for this storage location. Used for cold-chain monitoring and compliance validation.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Controlled temperature range for the storage location. Critical for cold-chain management of biological reagents, flow cells, enzymes, and CRISPR components. Values: ambient (15–25°C), 2_to_8_celsius (refrigerated), minus_20_celsius (frozen), minus_80_celsius (ultra-frozen), liquid_nitrogen (−196°C).

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for hazardous materials stored in this location (e.g., UN1170 for ethanol). Required for transport and storage compliance of dangerous goods.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods, 49 CFR Part 172

attributes.name: x_coordinate
attributes.description: X-axis coordinate of the storage location within the warehouse floor plan (in meters). Used for automated guided vehicle (AGV) navigation and warehouse mapping.

attributes.name: y_coordinate
attributes.description: Y-axis coordinate of the storage location within the warehouse floor plan (in meters). Used for AGV navigation and warehouse mapping.

attributes.name: z_coordinate
attributes.description: Z-axis (height) coordinate of the storage location within the warehouse (in meters). Used for vertical storage systems and automated retrieval systems.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Supplier qualification ownership tracking required for quality system compliance, audit trails, and personnel workload analysis. Enables qualification review assignment and personnel accountability fo

attributes.name: sox_control_id

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier being qualified. Links to the supplier master record.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the supplier qualification was formally approved.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorized person (typically Quality Assurance manager or Director) who approved the supplier qualification.

attributes.name: approved_material_scope
attributes.description: Description of the material categories, product families, or specific Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) for which the supplier is qualified. May reference material groups, reagent types, consumable categories, or instrument components.

attributes.name: audit_date

attributes.name: audit_findings_summary

attributes.name: audit_type

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date

attributes.name: corrective_action_required

attributes.name: corrective_action_status

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_required|open|in_progress|submitted|verified|closed|overdue — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: critical_findings_count

attributes.name: fda_registered

attributes.name: gmp_scope

attributes.name: iso_13485_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier holds ISO 13485 certification for medical devices quality management system.

attributes.name: iso_9001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier holds ISO 9001 certification for general quality management system.

attributes.name: major_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of major non-conformances identified during the audit. Major findings require corrective action within a defined timeframe.

attributes.name: material_group_code

attributes.name: minor_findings_count

attributes.name: modified_by_user

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this supplier qualification record was last modified.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review or re-qualification of the supplier. Ensures ongoing compliance and performance monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the supplier qualification. May include restrictions, special handling requirements, or historical context.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supplier was formally qualified or the qualification decision was made.

attributes.name: qualification_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the supplier qualification record, typically generated by Veeva Vault or SAP QM (Quality Management) module. Format: SQ-NNNNNNNN.

attributes.name: qualification_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the Quality Assurance (QA) or procurement professional responsible for managing this supplier qualification record.

attributes.name: qualification_score

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the supplier qualification: approved (fully qualified), conditional (qualified with restrictions or corrective actions required), suspended (temporarily not approved), disqualified (failed qualification), pending (awaiting decision), or under_review (evaluation in progress).

attributes.name: qualification_type
attributes.description: Type of supplier qualification process conducted: initial (first-time qualification), re-qualification (periodic renewal), audit-based (triggered by on-site audit), risk-based (triggered by risk assessment), expedited (fast-track for low-risk suppliers), or conditional (qualified with restrictions).

attributes.name: regulatory_body_alignment

attributes.name: reinstatement_date

attributes.name: review_frequency_months

attributes.name: risk_tier

attributes.name: suspension_reason

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id

attributes.name: critical_deviation_count

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: deviation_count

attributes.name: documentation_completeness_rate_pct

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date

attributes.name: evaluator_email

attributes.name: improvement_action_description

attributes.name: in_full_delivery_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase orders delivered with complete quantities as ordered during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: incoming_quality_acceptance_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of received lots that passed incoming quality inspection on first attempt without rejection or rework.

attributes.name: innovation_contribution_score

products.name: sourcing_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the sourcing agreement or approved supplier list (ASL) entry between a supplier and a material. It captures negotiated commercial terms, lead times, qualification status, and pricing that exist only in the context of a specific supplier-material combination. Each record links one supplier to one material with procurement terms that cannot be stored on supplier alone (varies by material) or material alone (varies by supplier). This is the operational SSOT for multi-sourcing decisions and procurement execution.. Existence Justification: In genomics biotech procurement operations, materials are routinely multi-sourced from multiple qualified suppliers, each with negotiated pricing, lead times, and minimum order quantities specific to that supplier-material combination. Conversely, each supplier provides multiple materials to the organization. Procurement teams actively manage these sourcing agreements as operational entities - they negotiate terms per supplier-material pair, maintain approved supplier lists (ASLs) per material, track qualification status, and execute sourcing decisions based on price, lead time, and supplier performance for each specific material.

attributes.name: agreement_effective_date

attributes.name: agreement_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this sourcing agreement expires. After expiration, the supplier-material combination must be re-qualified or the agreement renewed.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this sourcing agreement. ACTIVE=Available for procurement, INACTIVE=Not currently used, SUSPENDED=Temporarily blocked, EXPIRED=Past expiration date.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sourcing agreement record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier is the preferred source for this material based on quality, price, reliability, or strategic relationship. Used by MRP and procurement to prioritize sourcing decisions.

attributes.name: price_validity_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the current negotiated price validity period. After this date, the price must be renegotiated or the agreement becomes inactive.

attributes.name: price_validity_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the current negotiated price validity period for this supplier-material agreement. Prices are time-bound and require renegotiation after expiry.

attributes.name: qualification_status

QUALIFIED=Approved for production use, CONDITIONAL=Approved with restrictions, UNDER_EVALUATION=In qualification process, DISQUALIFIED=Not approved. Material-specific qualification is separate from general supplier certification.

products.name: contract_line
products.description: This association product represents the line-item-level contract terms between a supplier contract and a specific reagent catalog item. It captures the contracted pricing, quantities, lead times, and validity periods that are negotiated per supplier-reagent combination. Each record links one supplier contract to one reagent catalog item with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific contractual relationship. This is the operational record used for contract compliance validation, price verification during procurement, and supplier performance tracking.. Existence Justification: In genomics biotech procurement operations, supplier contracts are structured with multiple line items, each covering a specific reagent catalog item with its own negotiated pricing, quantities, lead times, and validity periods. A single blanket contract (e.g., annual agreement with a reagent supplier) covers multiple reagent SKUs (flow cells, library prep kits, enzymes), and conversely, a single reagent can be sourced under multiple contracts from different suppliers or under overlapping contract periods for supply security. The business actively manages these contract lines for price validation, release order creation, and supplier performance tracking.

attributes.name: contracted_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of this specific reagent committed under this contract line. For quantity contracts, this represents the target quantity to be released over the contract validity period.

attributes.name: price_condition_type

attributes.name: quantity_released_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity released against this contract line via purchase orders. Used to track contract utilization and remaining quantity available.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

attributes.name: validity_end_date

attributes.name: validity_start_date

attributes.name: value_released_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative monetary value released against this contract line. Calculated as sum of (quantity × unit_price) across all purchase order releases.

products.name: supplier_reagent_qualification
products.description: This association product represents the formal qualification and approval of a specific supplier to provide a specific reagent catalog item. It captures the qualification scope, effective dates, GMP classification, risk tier, and approval status that exist only in the context of this supplier-reagent pairing. Each record links one supplier qualification to one reagent catalog item, enabling Approved Vendor List (AVL) management and procurement compliance tracking.. Existence Justification: In genomics biotech operations, suppliers undergo qualification processes that are scoped to specific reagent categories or individual reagent catalog items. A single supplier qualification record can cover multiple reagents (e.g., a supplier qualified for all PCR enzymes), and a single reagent can be sourced from multiple qualified suppliers with different pricing, lead times, and risk profiles. The business actively manages Approved Vendor Lists (AVLs) that track which suppliers are qualified to provide which reagents, with qualification dates, expiry dates, GMP scope, and approval status specific to each supplier-reagent pairing.

products.name: batch_quality_test
products.description: This association product represents the Quality Test Event between batch and quality_rule. It captures the execution and results of a specific quality rule test performed on a specific batch. Each record links one batch to one quality_rule with test execution details, results, pass/fail determination, and deviation tracking that exist only in the context of this specific test execution.. Existence Justification: In genomics biotech manufacturing, each batch must be tested against multiple quality specifications (completeness checks, purity thresholds, potency assays, sterility tests, etc.) before release, and each quality rule is applied to many batches over time. The business actively manages test execution records with specific results, pass/fail determinations, analyst assignments, and deviation tracking for each batch-rule combination. This is an operational quality control process, not an analytical correlation.

attributes.name: batch_quality_test_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this specific test execution. Primary key for the batch quality test association.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the laboratory instrument or equipment used to perform this test. Required for equipment qualification traceability.

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the batch being tested

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this test result was officially approved by QA. Batch cannot be released until all critical tests are approved.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the QA supervisor or manager who reviewed and approved this test result. Required for batch release authorization.

attributes.name: deviation_number
attributes.description: Reference to the formal deviation record if this test failed or produced out-of-specification results. Links to deviation management system for investigation and CAPA.

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Determination of whether the batch met the quality rule specification. PASS indicates compliance, FAIL indicates non-compliance, CONDITIONAL_PASS indicates acceptable with deviation, PENDING indicates test not yet complete.

attributes.name: retest_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test must be repeated due to inconclusive results, equipment failure, or approaching retest date. Triggers retest workflow.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this quality rule test was executed against the batch. Critical for traceability and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: test_method_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific test method, SOP, or analytical procedure used to execute this test. May vary by laboratory or equipment.

attributes.name: test_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from the analyst regarding test execution, observations, or contextual information relevant to interpreting the result.

attributes.name: test_result_value
attributes.description: The actual measured or observed value from executing this quality rule test on the batch. May be numeric, categorical, or descriptive depending on the rule type.

attributes.name: tested_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the QA analyst, laboratory technician, or automated system that performed this test. Required for GxP compliance and audit trail.

products.name: material_qualification
products.description: This association product represents the qualification relationship between materials and employees in genomics biotech operations. It captures personnel qualification and competency tracking for handling specific materials (reagents, controlled substances, hazardous materials) in compliance with GMP, CLIA, and safety regulations. Each record links one material to one employee with qualification status, dates, competency level, and training details that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In genomics biotech operations, material handling qualifications represent a true many-to-many operational relationship. Each employee can be qualified to handle multiple materials (reagents, controlled substances, hazardous chemicals), and each material requires multiple qualified personnel for operational continuity, shift coverage, and regulatory compliance. The qualification itself is a managed business entity with lifecycle attributes (qualification date, expiry, status, competency level, assessor) that belong to neither the material nor the employee alone.

attributes.name: material_qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material qualification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: assessor_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the qualified assessor who conducted the competency evaluation and granted the qualification. Required for GMP audit trail.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the employee who holds the qualification

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the material master record that requires qualified handling

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Unique certification or qualification reference number issued by training system or regulatory body. Required for audit documentation.

attributes.name: competency_level
attributes.description: Level of competency achieved for handling this material. Basic=supervised use only, Intermediate=independent use, Advanced=complex procedures, Expert=troubleshooting, Trainer=can qualify others.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this qualification record was created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualification expires and requires renewal. Critical for compliance scheduling and personnel availability planning.

attributes.name: last_assessment_date

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: next_assessment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next competency reassessment must be completed to maintain qualification status. Used for scheduling and compliance alerts.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special conditions, restrictions, or additional context for this qualification (e.g., 'Qualified for use in cleanroom only', 'Requires buddy system').

attributes.name: qualification_date

attributes.name: qualification_status

products.name: nonconformance
products.description: Nonconforming material or product record (NCR) capturing instances where a product, reagent, instrument component, or raw material fails to meet defined specifications or acceptance criteria. Tracks nonconformance source (incoming inspection, in-process QC, final release, customer complaint), affected material/lot/batch, failure mode, quantity affected, disposition decision (use-as-is, rework, reject/scrap, return to supplier), and regulatory reportability assessment. Distinct from deviation (process departure) — NCR is material/product-focused. Supports SAP QM module integration and ISO 13485 Clause 8.3 nonconforming product control.
products.reference: Nonconforming Product Record / NCR (ISO 13485 Clause 8.3, SAP QM)

attributes.description: Format specification for expiry date labeling on product packaging. Day-level precision for short shelf-life products; month-level precision for products with shelf life greater than 12 months per regulatory guidance.

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stability study was conducted under GMP conditions per 21 CFR Part 211. True for studies supporting regulatory submissions and commercial products; false for research-use-only (RUO) product development studies.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 Current Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: ich_climatic_zone
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) Climatic Zone
attributes.description: ICH climatic zone classification for the intended market. Zone I: temperate climate; Zone II: subtropical/Mediterranean; Zone III: hot/dry; Zone IV: hot/humid; Zone IVa: hot/humid with high temperature; Zone IVb: hot/very humid. Determines storage condition requirements.
attributes.references: ICH Q1F Stability Data Package for Registration in Climatic Zones III and IV

attributes.name: lims_study_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Study Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: External identifier for the stability study in LabVantage LIMS. Used for integration with laboratory workflow, sample scheduling, and test result capture.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified the stability study record. Maintains complete audit trail for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the stability study record. Tracks data currency and change history.

attributes.name: principal_investigator
attributes.description: Name of the scientist or quality professional responsible for stability study design, execution, and data interpretation. Accountable for study integrity and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: regulatory_purpose
attributes.description: Regulatory driver for conducting the stability study. Initial registration supports new product approval; post-approval commitment fulfills regulatory agency requirements; annual stability ensures ongoing compliance; change control evaluates impact of manufacturing changes; shelf-life extension supports expiry date extension; market surveillance monitors commercial product stability.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry: Stability Testing of Drug Substances and Drug Products

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of product units enrolled in the stability study. Must be sufficient to support all planned time points and replicate testing per ICH guidelines.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2) Section 3.2 Selection of Batches

attributes.name: sap_qm_inspection_lot
attributes.description: SAP QM inspection lot number linked to the stability study. Connects stability data to lot release decisions and quality notifications in SAP S/4HANA QM module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Inspection Lot Processing

attributes.name: stability_indicating_assays
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of analytical test methods used to assess product stability. Examples: HPLC for purity, qPCR for enzyme activity, spectrophotometry for concentration, visual inspection for appearance, pH measurement. These assays must be validated to detect degradation.
attributes.references: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Environmental storage condition specification for the stability study including temperature, relative humidity, and light exposure. Examples: 25°C ± 2°C / 60% RH ± 5%, 40°C ± 2°C / 75% RH ± 5%, -20°C ± 5°C, 2-8°C. Follows ICH climatic zone definitions.

attributes.name: storage_humidity_percent
attributes.description: Target relative humidity percentage for the stability study storage condition. Null for frozen storage conditions where humidity control is not applicable.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: Target storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the stability study. Numeric representation extracted from storage condition for analytical purposes.

attributes.name: study_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the final time point testing was completed and study data analysis finalized. Null for ongoing studies.

attributes.name: study_duration_months
attributes.description: Total planned duration of the stability study in months. Typical durations: 12-36 months for real-time studies, 6 months for accelerated studies, 12 months for intermediate studies per ICH guidelines.

attributes.name: study_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional study information, observations, and context. Includes notes on study design rationale, deviations, special handling requirements, and lessons learned.

attributes.name: study_protocol_number
attributes.description: Unique protocol identifier assigned to the stability study following ICH Q1A/Q1B guidelines. Used for regulatory submission and traceability.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products

attributes.name: study_sponsor
attributes.description: Business unit or department sponsoring the stability study. Typically Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, or Product Development. Responsible for study oversight and funding.

attributes.name: study_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the stability study was initiated and samples were placed on stability storage. Marks time zero for all time point calculations.

attributes.name: study_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stability study. Planned indicates study design approved but not initiated; active indicates ongoing testing; on-hold indicates temporary suspension; completed indicates all time points tested and data analyzed; cancelled indicates study terminated; under-review indicates final data review and shelf-life determination in progress.

attributes.name: study_type
attributes.description: Classification of the stability study program. Real-time studies establish shelf life under recommended storage conditions; accelerated studies predict shelf life under elevated stress; intermediate studies bridge real-time and accelerated; stress studies determine degradation pathways; in-use studies assess stability after package opening; photostability studies evaluate light exposure effects.

attributes.name: time_point_schedule
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of planned time points in months for sample testing. Example: 0,3,6,9,12,18,24,36 for long-term real-time study. Defines the pull schedule for stability sample testing.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2) Section 3.1 Frequency of Testing

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Document identifier in Veeva Vault for the stability study protocol and final report. Ensures controlled document management and regulatory audit trail.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created the stability study record. Supports audit trail and accountability requirements.

products.name: change_control
products.description: Unified quality change control record governing all GxP-impactful changes — including manufacturing processes, equipment, materials, software, facilities, analytical methods, and controlled document revisions. Manages the complete change lifecycle: initiation, impact assessment (regulatory, validation, training, document), cross-functional approval routing, implementation authorization, and post-change effectiveness verification. Encompasses both document-level changes (SOP revisions, specification updates) and broader operational changes requiring regulatory submission (PAS, CBE-30, CBE-0). Integrates with Veeva Vault for change control workflow, MasterControl for document revision routing, and SAP for ERP-side change implementation. Supports FDA 21 CFR Part 820.40, ICH Q10, and ISO 13485 Clause 7.3.9.
products.reference: Change Control (FDA 21 CFR Part 820.40, ICH Q10, ISO 13485 Clause 7.3.9)

Critical for maintaining assay performance and regulatory

attributes.name: genome_assembly_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.genome_assembly. Business justification: Changes to reference genome versions in production pipelines require formal change control with validation, impact assessment, and regulatory notification. Critical for maintaining GxP compliance and

Required for CAP/CLIA

attributes.name: actual_implementation_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the change was fully implemented. Null if implementation is not yet complete.

attributes.name: affected_equipment_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated or structured list of equipment asset IDs or instrument serial numbers impacted by the change. Used for equipment qualification and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: affected_facility_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated or structured list of facility locations, cleanrooms, or manufacturing sites impacted by the change. Used for facility qualification and environmental monitoring.

attributes.name: affected_product_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated or structured list of product SKUs, catalog numbers, or product families impacted by the change. Used for traceability and scope definition.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal cross-functional approval is required for this change control. True for GxP-impactful changes requiring Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and functional area approval; False for administrative changes with simplified routing.

attributes.name: approval_routing_path
attributes.description: Structured representation of the approval workflow path, listing required approvers by role or department (e.g., Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, Engineering, R&D). May be comma-separated or JSON-encoded.

attributes.name: change_category
attributes.description: Functional category of the change control request. Defines the operational domain affected by the change: manufacturing process modifications, equipment qualification changes, raw material or reagent changes, software system updates, facility modifications, analytical method validation changes, or controlled document revisions (SOP, specification, protocol). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: manufacturing_process|equipment|material|software|facility|analytical_method|document_revision — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: change_control_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the proposed change, including current state, proposed future state, rationale, and business justification. Provides comprehensive context for impact assessment and approval decision-making.

attributes.name: change_control_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the change control request, typically formatted as CC-NNNNNN. Used for cross-functional communication and regulatory traceability.

attributes.name: change_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the change control request. Tracks progression from initiation through approval, implementation, and closure. Draft: initial creation. Submitted: routed for review. Under Review: impact assessment and approval routing in progress. Approved: authorized for implementation. Rejected: not approved. Implementation: change being executed. Completed: implementation finished, awaiting effectiveness check. Closed: effectiveness verified and change control archived. Cancelled: withdrawn before completion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|implementation|completed|closed|cancelled — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: Classification of the change based on regulatory and business impact. Major: significant process/product changes requiring regulatory submission. Minor: low-impact changes with limited scope. Critical: urgent changes affecting patient safety or product quality. Administrative: documentation-only changes with no GxP impact.
attributes.references: ICH Q10, FDA Guidance on Process Validation

attributes.name: closure_comments
attributes.description: Final comments or notes recorded at the time of change control closure, summarizing outcomes, lessons learned, or follow-up actions.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the change control was formally closed after successful implementation and effectiveness verification. Null if the change control is not yet closed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the change control record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: document_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the change requires updates to controlled documents (SOPs, specifications, protocols, work instructions, batch records, device master records). True if document updates are required; False otherwise.

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which the post-implementation effectiveness check was completed. Null if effectiveness check is not yet performed or not required.

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a post-implementation effectiveness check is required to verify that the change achieved its intended objectives and did not introduce unintended consequences. True if effectiveness check is required; False otherwise.

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the post-implementation effectiveness check. Effective: change achieved intended objectives. Partially Effective: some objectives met, additional action required. Ineffective: objectives not met, corrective action required. Not Applicable: effectiveness check not required or not yet performed.

attributes.name: impact_assessment_summary
attributes.description: Consolidated summary of cross-functional impact assessment results, covering regulatory, validation, training, documentation, supply chain, and operational impacts. Informs approval decision and implementation planning.
attributes.references: ICH Q10, FDA Guidance on Process Validation

attributes.name: implementation_plan
attributes.description: Detailed plan describing how the approved change will be executed, including tasks, responsibilities, timelines, resource requirements, and success criteria. May reference linked project plans or work orders.

attributes.name: initiator_department
attributes.description: Organizational department or functional area of the change initiator (e.g., Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Engineering). Used for cross-functional impact analysis and routing.

attributes.name: justification
attributes.description: Business and technical rationale for the proposed change. May include quality improvement objectives, cost reduction, regulatory compliance requirements, risk mitigation, process optimization, or corrective action linkage.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the change control record was last modified. Updated on any field change. Used for audit trail and version control.

attributes.name: planned_implementation_date
attributes.description: Target date for completing the implementation of the approved change. Used for scheduling, resource planning, and tracking.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the change control request. Critical: immediate action required (safety, regulatory, or business continuity). High: significant impact, expedited review. Medium: standard processing. Low: minimal impact, routine processing.

attributes.name: qa_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which Quality Assurance approved the change control. Null if QA approval is not yet obtained or not required.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which Regulatory Affairs approved the change control. Null if Regulatory approval is not yet obtained or not required.

attributes.name: regulatory_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the change requires regulatory notification or submission (PAS, CBE-30, CBE-0, annual report). True if regulatory submission is required; False otherwise.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.70, FDA 21 CFR Part 601.12, EMA Variation Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_type
attributes.description: Type of regulatory submission required for the change. PAS (Prior Approval Supplement): major changes requiring pre-approval. CBE-30 (Changes Being Effected in 30 Days): moderate changes with 30-day notification. CBE-0 (Changes Being Effected): minor changes with immediate notification. Annual Report: reportable in annual submission. None: no regulatory submission required.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.70, FDA 21 CFR Part 601.12

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Risk assessment classification based on potential impact to product quality, patient safety, regulatory compliance, and business operations. Determines the rigor of impact assessment and approval routing requirements.
attributes.references: ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management, ISO 14971

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Concise, descriptive title summarizing the nature and scope of the proposed change. Used for quick identification in dashboards, reports, and approval workflows.

attributes.name: training_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the change requires training or retraining of personnel (SOP training, equipment training, software training). True if training is required; False otherwise.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820.25, ISO 13485 Clause 6.2, GMP Annex 11

attributes.name: validation_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the change requires revalidation, requalification, or verification activities (process validation, equipment qualification, software validation, analytical method validation). True if validation activities are required; False otherwise.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Process Validation, ICH Q2(R1), GAMP 5
