domains.name: regulatory
domains.description: Manages regulatory submissions, approvals, and post-market surveillance across global jurisdictions — including FDA 510(k)/PMA filings, CE-IVD/IVDR technical files, EMA submissions, ICH dossiers, adverse event reporting, regulatory intelligence, and labeling compliance. Tracks submission status, agency correspondence, and IVD registration lifecycles. Integrates Veeva Vault for controlled regulatory document management.
domains.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820, IVDR 2017/746, ISO 13485, ICH

products.name: submission
products.description: Master record for every regulatory submission made to a health authority — FDA 510(k), PMA, De Novo, CE-IVD technical file, EMA dossier, ICH CTD, IVDR registration, and country-specific IVD filings. Captures submission type, target agency, target jurisdiction (country/region/trading bloc), submission date, dossier reference, regulatory pathway classification, product scope, predicate device (for 510(k)), lead regulatory affairs owner, and current lifecycle status. Includes jurisdiction-level metadata: applicable regulatory framework, competent authority, IVD classification system, language requirements, and local representative requirement. SSOT for all regulatory filing identities across global jurisdictions.
products.reference: FDA eCTD / ICH M4 Dossier / IVDR Technical File

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory submission record. Primary key for the submission entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Each regulatory submission incurs significant costs (fees, consultant time, document preparation) allocated to specific regulatory affairs cost centers. Required for submission cost tracking, budget v

attributes.name: lead_regulatory_affairs_owner_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lead Regulatory Affairs Owner Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Every regulatory submission requires an accountable regulatory affairs professional as lead. Critical for submission strategy execution, agency interactions, workload planning, and regulatory affairs

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.opportunity. Business justification: Major regulatory submissions (510k, PMA, CE Mark) are commercial milestones tracked in sales forecasts. Sales teams monitor submission status and target decision dates to forecast product launch timin

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory authority formally accepted the submission for substantive review. Marks the start of the official review clock for submissions with defined review timelines.

attributes.name: adverse_event_reporting_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether post-market adverse event reporting obligations apply to this submission. True if MDR, vigilance, or adverse event reporting is required, False otherwise.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 803, IVDR 2017/746 Chapter VII

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory authority granted approval, clearance, or market authorization for the submission. Null if the submission is not yet approved or was denied.

attributes.name: clinical_data_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether clinical performance data or clinical evidence is required as part of the submission. True if clinical studies or clinical performance evaluation is mandatory, False otherwise.

attributes.name: clinical_study_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier(s) for the clinical studies or clinical performance evaluations included in the submission. May include ClinicalTrials.gov NCT numbers, internal study codes, or published literature references.

attributes.name: competent_authority
attributes.description: The specific competent authority or notified body responsible for reviewing and approving the submission within the target jurisdiction. For EU IVDR submissions, identifies the notified body number and name.

attributes.name: correspondence_log_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or link to the log of all correspondence exchanged with the regulatory authority regarding this submission (e.g., information requests, deficiency letters, responses, meeting minutes). Typically managed in Veeva Vault or document control system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this submission record was first created in the regulatory data system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: device_classification
attributes.description: The regulatory risk classification assigned to the device or IVD under the target jurisdiction's classification system (e.g., FDA Class I/II/III, IVDR Class A/B/C/D, GHTF/IMDRF risk class). Determines the level of regulatory control and submission pathway.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 862, IVDR 2017/746 Annex VIII, IMDRF GHTF/SG1/N77

attributes.name: dossier_reference
attributes.description: The internal or external reference number for the regulatory dossier or technical file associated with this submission. Links to the controlled document set in Veeva Vault or other document management system.

attributes.name: expedited_review_granted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the regulatory authority granted expedited, priority, or breakthrough designation review status. True if granted, False if denied or not applicable.
attributes.references: FDA Breakthrough Devices Program, EMA PRIME

attributes.name: expedited_review_requested
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether expedited, priority, or breakthrough designation review was requested from the regulatory authority. True if expedited review was requested, False otherwise.
attributes.references: FDA Breakthrough Devices Program, EMA PRIME

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: The regulatory submission fee amount paid or payable to the regulatory authority for processing the submission. Expressed in the currency of the target jurisdiction.

attributes.name: fee_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the submission fee amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: gmp_certification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Certification Required Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether GMP or ISO 13485 certification is required as part of the submission. True if quality system certification must be demonstrated, False otherwise.

attributes.name: intended_use
attributes.description: The intended use or indications for use statement for the product as declared in the regulatory submission. Defines the clinical or research purpose, target population, and claims for the IVD or genomic product.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 809, IVDR 2017/746 Annex XIII

attributes.name: iso_13485_certificate_number
attributes.description: The certificate number for the organization's ISO 13485 quality management system certification, if applicable and required for the submission. Null if not required or not yet obtained.

attributes.name: labeling_compliance_verified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether product labeling (IFU, package insert, device labels) has been verified for compliance with target jurisdiction requirements. True if labeling review is complete and compliant, False otherwise.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 809, IVDR 2017/746 Annex I

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The primary language in which the regulatory submission dossier is prepared and submitted to the authority. Reflects jurisdiction-specific language requirements (e.g., English for FDA, local language for EU member states).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this submission record was last updated or modified. Audit trail field for tracking changes and data lineage.

attributes.name: local_representative_name
attributes.description: The name of the authorized representative or legal manufacturer representative appointed in the target jurisdiction, if required. Null if no representative is required or not yet appointed.

attributes.name: local_representative_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the target jurisdiction requires the appointment of a local authorized representative or legal manufacturer representative for the submission. True if required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last modified this submission record. Audit trail field for accountability and compliance.

attributes.name: notified_body_number
attributes.description: For EU CE-IVD and IVDR submissions, the four-digit identification number assigned to the notified body conducting conformity assessment. Null for non-EU submissions or self-declared conformity.

attributes.name: post_market_surveillance_plan
attributes.description: Reference to the post-market surveillance plan or post-market clinical follow-up plan submitted as part of the regulatory dossier. Required for IVDR and certain FDA submissions.

attributes.name: predicate_device
attributes.description: For FDA 510(k) submissions, the legally marketed device to which substantial equivalence is claimed. Includes the predicate device name and 510(k) number. Null for non-510(k) submissions.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: The business priority level assigned to this regulatory submission. Reflects strategic importance, revenue impact, or time-to-market urgency (critical, high, medium, low).

attributes.name: product_scope
attributes.description: A description of the product(s) or device(s) covered by this regulatory submission. Identifies the IVD assay, sequencing platform, reagent kit, instrument, or gene-editing tool that is the subject of the filing.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: The device registration or listing number assigned by the regulatory authority upon approval or clearance (e.g., FDA establishment registration number, EUDAMED UDI-DI, Health Canada device license number). Null if not yet assigned.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 807, IVDR 2017/746 Article 29, EUDAMED

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: The primary regulatory framework or legislation under which the submission is made (e.g., FDA 21 CFR Part 807, IVDR 2017/746, IVDD 98/79/EC, Medical Device Regulation 2017/745, Health Canada MDEL). Defines the legal basis for the submission.

attributes.name: regulatory_pathway
attributes.description: The specific regulatory pathway or route to market classification under which the submission is filed. Provides additional granularity beyond submission type (e.g., 510(k) Traditional, 510(k) Special, 510(k) Abbreviated, Class I exempt, Class II, Class III PMA, IVDR Class A/B/C/D).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 807, IVDR 2017/746 Annex VIII

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory submission was officially filed with the target regulatory authority. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the submission lifecycle.

attributes.name: submission_number
attributes.description: The externally-known regulatory submission number or dossier reference assigned by the submitting organization or regulatory authority (e.g., FDA 510(k) number K123456, PMA number P210001, CE-IVD technical file reference).

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the regulatory submission in the approval workflow. Tracks progression from initial draft through regulatory authority review to final decision (draft, submitted, under review, additional information requested, approved, cleared, denied, withdrawn). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|additional_info_requested|approved|cleared|denied|withdrawn — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.description: The regulatory pathway classification for the submission. Indicates the type of regulatory filing made to the health authority (e.g., FDA 510(k) premarket notification, PMA premarket approval, De Novo classification request, CE-IVD technical file, IVDR registration, EMA dossier, ICH CTD).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 807, IVDR 2017/746, ICH M4

attributes.name: target_agency
attributes.description: The primary health authority or regulatory agency to which the submission is directed (e.g., FDA, EMA, Health Canada, TGA, PMDA, ANVISA, NMPA). Identifies the competent authority responsible for reviewing and approving the submission.

attributes.name: target_decision_date
attributes.description: The planned or regulatory-mandated target date by which the authority is expected to issue a decision on the submission. Used for tracking review timelines and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: target_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The country, region, or trading bloc for which regulatory approval is sought (e.g., USA, European Union, Canada, Australia, Japan, Brazil, China). Defines the geographic scope of the regulatory submission.

attributes.name: udi_di
attributes.description: The Unique Device Identification Device Identifier (UDI-DI) assigned to the product covered by this submission. Required for FDA and EU IVDR submissions. Null if not yet assigned.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 801, IVDR 2017/746 Article 27, EUDAMED

products.name: submission_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing each discrete regulatory submission action — initial filing, amendment, supplement, response to deficiency letter, withdrawal, or resubmission. Tracks submission date, submission method (eCTD gateway, paper, eSTAR), agency receipt confirmation, submission version, and associated dossier package reference. Enables full audit trail of all submission activities per dossier.

attributes.name: submission_contact_employee_id

attributes.name: actual_decision_date

attributes.name: deficiency_letter_date

attributes.name: deficiency_letter_received_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a deficiency letter or additional information request was received from the agency in response to this submission.

attributes.name: deficiency_response_due_date

attributes.name: ectd_sequence_number

attributes.description: Sequential number assigned to each eCTD submission within a regulatory application. Used to maintain chronological order of submissions per ICH eCTD specification.

attributes.name: fee_payment_date

attributes.name: modified_by_user

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this submission event record was last modified in the system. Audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: regulatory_correspondent_name

attributes.name: review_clock_days

attributes.name: submission_date

attributes.name: submission_fee_amount

attributes.name: submission_fee_currency_code

attributes.name: submission_format

attributes.name: submission_method

attributes.name: submission_notes

attributes.name: submission_package_reference

attributes.name: submission_volume_count
attributes.description: Number of physical or logical volumes comprising the submission package. Used for large submissions split across multiple files or binders.

attributes.name: target_decision_date
attributes.description: Expected date by which the regulatory agency should issue a decision on this submission, based on statutory or performance goal timelines.

attributes.name: total_document_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual documents included in this submission event. Provides a measure of submission complexity and completeness.

attributes.name: total_page_count
attributes.description: Total number of pages across all documents in the submission package. Used for resource planning and review estimation.

products.name: notified_body
products.description: Master record for EU notified bodies and third-party conformity assessment organizations engaged for CE-IVD/IVDR certification, including the full lifecycle of their assessment activities. Captures notified body name, NB identification number, accreditation scope (IVD device classes), designated countries, primary contact, contract status, and audit schedule. Records each conformity assessment activity — IVDR Annex IX/X/XI assessments, ISO 13485 surveillance audits, CE-IVD technical file reviews, and QMS audits — including assessment type, audit dates, scope, findings, non-conformities raised, corrective action responses, certificate outcomes, and certificate expiry. attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit fiscal year in which the transaction was posted. May differ from calendar year depending on company fiscal calendar configuration.
attributes.references: SAP FI Fiscal Year Variant; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Classification of costs and revenues by business function (e.g., R&D, manufacturing, sales, administration) for cost-of-sales accounting and functional P&L reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Functional Area; GAAP Cost Classification

attributes.name: gl_account_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the GL account providing business context for the account classification (e.g., Sequencing Reagent Revenue, R&D Salaries, Instrument COGS).

attributes.name: gl_account_number
attributes.description: Unique account number from the chart of accounts identifying the GL account. Defines the classification of the transaction (revenue, COGS, R&D expense, SG&A, asset, liability, equity).
attributes.references: SAP FI Chart of Accounts; GAAP Account Classification; IFRS

attributes.name: group_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the corporate group's reporting currency used in consolidated financial statements (typically USD for US-based multinationals).

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: Identifier for parallel accounting ledgers (e.g., 0L=leading ledger, 2L=IFRS ledger, 3L=tax ledger). Enables simultaneous accounting under multiple GAAPs.
attributes.references: SAP FI New GL Parallel Accounting; IFRS; US GAAP

attributes.name: local_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the company code's local currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). All local amounts are denominated in this currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit code controlling the posting characteristics (debit/credit, account type, field status). Determines which fields are required or optional during posting.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Management-oriented organizational unit for internal profit and loss reporting. Enables P&L analysis by product line, business unit, or geographic region.

attributes.name: reference_key
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking the GL posting to the originating business transaction (e.g., sales order number, purchase order number, invoice number). Enables drill-back to source documents.
attributes.references: SAP FI Document Reference Logic; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this posting is a reversal of a previous entry. True if this is a reversal document, False otherwise. Used for audit trail and error correction tracking.
attributes.references: SAP FI Reversal Logic; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the original posting that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Maintains audit trail for corrections.
attributes.references: SAP FI Reversal Documentation; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: segment
attributes.description: Organizational unit for segment reporting under IFRS 8 and GAAP ASC 280. Represents reportable business segments for external financial reporting.

attributes.name: special_gl_indicator
attributes.description: Single-character code identifying special GL transactions such as down payments, bills of exchange, or guarantees. Blank for standard postings.

attributes.name: tax_amount_local
attributes.description: Tax amount calculated and posted in local currency. Separated from base amount for tax reporting and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Reporting; VAT Reporting; GAAP ASC 740

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction and tax rate applied to the transaction. Used for automatic tax calculation and tax reporting compliance.
attributes.references: SAP FI Tax Configuration; IRS Tax Regulations; VAT Directives

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Descriptive text providing business context for the posting. May include vendor name, customer name, or transaction description for audit and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: trading_partner
attributes.description: Company code of the intercompany trading partner for intercompany transactions. Used for intercompany reconciliation and elimination entries in consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP FI Intercompany Accounting; IFRS 10 Consolidation

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the original business transaction was denominated. May differ from local_currency for foreign currency transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI Currency Types

attributes.name: user_name
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who posted the document. Used for audit trail and SOX compliance to track who made financial postings.
attributes.references: SAP Security; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Individual accounting journal entry document in SAP FI — records the business transaction that drives a general ledger posting. Captures document type, posting date, reference document, reversal status, and the originating business process (e.g., revenue recognition, COGS allocation, R&D capitalization). Each journal entry contains one or more line items and is the atomic unit of financial recording.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry document in SAP FI. Primary key for the journal entry record.

attributes.name: posted_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: SOX compliance and segregation of duties validation require tracking which employee posted each journal entry. Critical for audit trail, maker-checker controls, and access certification reviews in GxP

attributes.name: quality_issue_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.quality_issue. Business justification: Quality issues detected in financial data must link to affected journal entries for investigation and correction. Enables remediation workflow and audit trail for data quality incidents in financial r

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: Baseline date for payment terms calculation. Used to determine due date and cash discount periods for payables and receivables.

attributes.name: batch_input_session
attributes.description: Batch input session name if this journal entry was created through batch processing. Used for mass data upload tracking and error resolution.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Business area code representing a segment or division for internal management reporting. Used for segment reporting and P&L analysis.

attributes.name: changed_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this journal entry record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date when this journal entry was cleared. Null if the document remains open. Used for accounts payable and receivable aging analysis.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the clearing document if this journal entry has been cleared (e.g., payment clearing an invoice). Used for open item management.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character company code representing the legal entity in SAP FI. Used for financial consolidation and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center code for cost allocation and overhead tracking. Used for departmental expense management and budget control.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this journal entry record was created in the SAP FI system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the document currency. Represents the currency in which the journal entry amounts are denominated.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: Date on the source document that originated this journal entry. Represents the business transaction date.

attributes.name: document_header_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the document header level providing context about the journal entry purpose or business transaction.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI document number assigned to this journal entry. Unique business identifier for the accounting document within the fiscal year and company code.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Two-character SAP document type code that classifies the journal entry by business transaction category (e.g., SA=GL account document, DR=customer invoice, KR=vendor invoice, DZ=customer payment, KZ=vendor payment).

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: Date when the journal entry document was created in the system. Used for audit trail and document tracking.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate used to convert foreign currency amounts to local currency. Applied at the time of posting for multi-currency transactions.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the journal entry was posted. Used for period-based financial reporting and year-end closing.

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: Ledger group identifier for parallel accounting scenarios (e.g., IFRS, US GAAP, local GAAP). Used for multi-standard financial reporting.

attributes.name: line_item_count
attributes.description: Number of line items contained in this journal entry document. Used for document completeness validation and processing efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: Total document amount in local currency (company code currency). Used for statutory reporting and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: originating_process
attributes.description: Business process that originated this journal entry. Identifies the source transaction type for traceability and process-specific reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: revenue_recognition|cogs_allocation|rd_capitalization|payroll|procurement|asset_depreciation|intercompany|manual_adjustment|accrual|tax_provision|other — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: parked_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is in parked status (saved but not yet posted). Parked documents do not update the general ledger until posted.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms code defining due date calculation and cash discount conditions. Used for accounts payable and receivable management.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the journal entry was posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period assignment and affects financial statement reporting.

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit posting key that controls the type of posting (debit/credit) and account type. Standard SAP FI posting keys include 40 (debit GL), 50 (credit GL), 01 (debit customer), 11 (credit customer), 31 (debit vendor), 21 (credit vendor).

attributes.name: posting_period
attributes.description: Posting period within the fiscal year (1-12 for regular periods, 13-16 for special periods). Used for monthly financial close and reporting.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Profit center code for internal profitability analysis. Used for management accounting and EBITDA tracking by business unit.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number linking this journal entry to source documents such as invoices, purchase orders, or contracts. Used for cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date when this journal entry was reversed. Null if the document has not been reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the reversing journal entry. Null if this document has not been reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry has been reversed. True if the document has been reversed, false otherwise.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the original journal entry that this document reverses. Populated only if this is a reversal document.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the system that originated this journal entry (e.g., SAP FI, SAP CO, external interface, manual entry). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is subject to SOX internal controls and requires additional approval or documentation. Used for financial reporting compliance.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax code applied to this journal entry for automatic tax calculation. Determines tax rate, tax type, and GL account assignment for tax postings.

attributes.name: trading_partner
attributes.description: Trading partner company code for intercompany transactions. Used for intercompany reconciliation and elimination in consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_amount
attributes.description: Total document amount in transaction currency. Sum of all line item amounts in the original transaction currency.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_code
attributes.description: Withholding tax code for vendor payments or customer receipts subject to tax withholding. Used for statutory withholding tax reporting.

attributes.name: workflow_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the journal entry document. Used for approval workflows and SOX controls on manual journal entries.

products.name: cost_center
products.description: SAP CO organizational master data representing cost and profit objects within Genomics Biotech — encompasses cost centers (NGS Operations, Bioinformatics Engineering, Clinical Assay Validation, R&D Gene Editing, Manufacturing GMP), profit centers (Sequencing Instruments, Reagent Kits, Clinical Genomics Services, Agricultural Genomics), and business segments. Tracks hierarchy, responsible manager, valid-from/to dates, currency, company code assignment, and parent node. Enables multi-dimensional P&L reporting, internal cost allocation, ROI analysis by business unit, segment-level EBITDA tracking, and transfer pricing documentation by profit center.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost center within the SAP CO (Controlling) module. Primary key for cost center master data.

attributes.name: market_segment_target_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.market_segment_target. Business justification: Market segments often have dedicated cost centers for segment P&L reporting. Enables segment profitability analysis, resource allocation decisions, and strategic investment tracking. Common in genomic

attributes.name: mdm_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.mdm_policy. Business justification: Cost centers are master data entities subject to MDM policies governing naming conventions, hierarchies, ownership, and lifecycle. Required for master data governance and organizational structure mana

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent cost center in the organizational hierarchy. Enables roll-up reporting and hierarchical cost allocation.

attributes.name: primary_cost_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who is the responsible manager or cost center owner. Accountable for budget and cost performance.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.territory. Business justification: Sales territories commonly map to cost centers for expense allocation and P&L reporting. Enables territory profitability analysis, sales expense management, and headcount planning. Standard practice i

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: Primary activity type or service provided by this cost center for activity-based costing (e.g., sequencing runs, bioinformatics compute hours, QC testing hours). Used for internal cost allocation.

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total annual budget allocated to this cost center in the local currency. Used for budget vs. actual variance analysis and cost control.

attributes.name: budget_allocation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center has a formal budget allocation. True if budget is assigned and tracked, false otherwise.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Business area assignment for segment reporting (e.g., Sequencing Instruments, Reagent Kits, Clinical Genomics Services, Agricultural Genomics). Enables cross-company-code P&L analysis.

attributes.name: capitalization_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Research and Development (R&D) Capitalization Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs from this cost center are eligible for R&D capitalization under accounting standards. True for development-stage R&D activities meeting capitalization criteria.

attributes.name: cogs_allocation_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Allocation Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs from this cost center are allocated to COGS. True for manufacturing, production, and direct service delivery cost centers.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP FI company code to which this cost center is assigned. Represents the legal entity for financial consolidation and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP CO controlling area that governs this cost center. Defines the organizational unit for cost accounting and internal reporting.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used for allocating costs from this cost center to other cost objects: direct (direct assignment), activity-based (ABC costing), step-down (sequential allocation), reciprocal (mutual services), or none (no allocation).

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: Functional category of the cost center: production (manufacturing and operations), research and development (R&D activities), sales and marketing, administration (corporate overhead), quality assurance (QA/QC), or regulatory affairs.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the cost center (e.g., NGS-OPS-001, BIO-ENG-002, R&D-CRISPR-003). Externally-known unique code used in financial reporting and cost allocation.

attributes.name: cost_center_group
attributes.description: Grouping classification for aggregated reporting (e.g., All R&D Centers, All Manufacturing Centers, All Clinical Centers). Enables multi-dimensional analysis.

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the cost center (e.g., NGS Operations, Bioinformatics Engineering, Clinical Assay Validation, R&D Gene Editing, Manufacturing GMP).

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center: active (operational and accepting postings), inactive (closed, no postings allowed), blocked (temporarily suspended), or planned (future activation).

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the organizational unit: cost center (cost tracking only), profit center (revenue and cost), investment center (ROI tracking), revenue center (revenue focus), or service center (internal services).

attributes.name: cost_element_group
attributes.description: Primary cost element group associated with this cost center (e.g., labor, materials, overhead, depreciation). Used for cost structure analysis.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this cost center record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for cost center transactions and budgets (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Defines the local currency for cost accounting.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Department code to which this cost center belongs. Links cost center to organizational structure for workforce and operational reporting.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Functional area classification for cost-of-sales accounting (e.g., COGS, R&D, SG&A). Used for P&L reporting by function.

attributes.name: gmp_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center operates under GMP regulations. True for manufacturing and quality centers subject to FDA/EMA GMP requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211, EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the cost center hierarchy (1 = top level, increasing for deeper levels). Used for hierarchical reporting and aggregation.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this cost center record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Physical location or site code where the cost center operates (e.g., facility, campus, building). Used for geographic cost analysis.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about the cost center, including special instructions, organizational changes, or audit remarks.

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Business segment code for segment reporting (e.g., Sequencing Instruments, Reagent Kits, Clinical Services, Agricultural Genomics). Enables segment-level P&L and EBITDA tracking.

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Abbreviated description of the cost center for display in reports and dashboards.

attributes.name: sox_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is subject to SOX internal controls and audit requirements. True for cost centers involved in financial reporting processes.

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center participates in intercompany transfer pricing. True for profit centers involved in cross-entity transactions requiring transfer pricing documentation.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Effective start date for this cost center. Defines when the cost center becomes active and can accept cost postings.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Effective end date for this cost center. Defines when the cost center is closed and no longer accepts cost postings. Null for open-ended cost centers.

products.name: accounts_payable
products.description: SAP FI-AP vendor invoice and payable transaction record — captures supplier invoices received for raw materials, reagent components, CRO/CMO services, instrument parts, and third-party bioinformatics tools. Tracks invoice amount, due date, payment terms, withholding tax, GR/IR clearing status, and payment block. Supports three-way match (PO–GR–Invoice) and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: accounts_payable_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accounts payable transaction record. Primary key for the accounts payable entity.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.campaign. Business justification: Marketing campaigns generate vendor invoices (agencies, event vendors, media buys) that flow through AP. Essential for campaign expense accrual, budget reconciliation, and marketing ROI calculation. G

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Replace string cost_center with FK for proper cost allocation reporting.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Replace string profit_center with FK to enable profit‑center level analysis of payables.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier or vendor from whom goods or services were procured. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: The reference date from which payment terms are calculated. Typically the invoice date or goods receipt date depending on payment term configuration.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: The business area or division to which this payable is assigned. Enables cross-company code financial reporting by business segment.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric code representing the legal entity within the enterprise for which this payable is recorded. Used for financial consolidation and reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the invoice record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and process performance analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the invoice is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The cash discount amount available if payment is made within the discount period as defined in payment terms.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the accounting document in the system. May differ from invoice date and posting date depending on document workflow.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment must be made to the vendor according to the agreed payment terms. Critical for cash flow forecasting and avoiding late payment penalties.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert foreign currency invoice amounts to the company code local currency. Null for local currency invoices.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year in which the invoice was posted. Used for period-based financial reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the invoice was posted. Derived from the posting date and company code fiscal year variant.

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: The general ledger account number to which the expense portion of this invoice is posted. Determines the expense classification in financial statements.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: The goods receipt document number confirming physical receipt of materials or services. Critical for GR/IR (Goods Receipt/Invoice Receipt) clearing and three-way match.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor issued the invoice. Used for aging analysis and payment term calculation.

attributes.name: invoice_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the invoice contents. May include details about the goods or services procured, project references, or special instructions.

attributes.name: invoice_gross_amount
attributes.description: The total invoice amount including all taxes, fees, and charges before any discounts or adjustments.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The unique invoice number assigned by the vendor. This is the externally-known identifier for the invoice document.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice. Draft invoices are being prepared; posted invoices are in the ledger; blocked invoices require approval; approved invoices are ready for payment; paid invoices are settled; cancelled invoices are voided.

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type. Standard invoices are for goods/services received; credit memos reduce payables; debit memos increase payables; down payments and prepayments are advance payments.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: The invoice amount converted to the company code local currency using the exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who last modified the invoice record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the invoice record was last modified. Used for audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: net_payable_amount
attributes.description: The net amount payable to the vendor after applying all taxes, discounts, and adjustments. This is the amount that will be paid.

attributes.name: payment_block_code
attributes.description: Code indicating why payment is blocked. Common reasons include pending approval, price variance, quantity variance, or quality issues. Null if no block is active.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which payment was made to the vendor. Null if invoice is unpaid. Used for cash flow analysis and vendor payment performance tracking.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which payment will be or was made to the vendor. Determines payment processing workflow and bank account selection.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the payment run or payment document that settled this invoice. Null if invoice is unpaid.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Code representing the agreed payment terms with the vendor (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30). Defines discount periods and due date calculation logic.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the invoice was posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period for financial reporting.

attributes.name: price_variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between the invoice price and the purchase order price. Positive values indicate the invoice price exceeds PO price; negative values indicate invoice price is lower.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The purchase order number against which this invoice is being verified. Used for three-way match (PO-GR-Invoice) validation.

attributes.name: quantity_variance
attributes.description: The difference between the invoiced quantity and the goods receipt quantity. Used to identify over-billing or under-billing situations.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount included in the invoice. May include VAT, sales tax, withholding tax, or other applicable taxes.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way match validation comparing purchase order, goods receipt, and invoice. Matched indicates all three documents agree within tolerance; variances indicate discrepancies requiring resolution.

attributes.name: vendor_reference
attributes.description: Additional reference information provided by the vendor, such as their internal order number, delivery note number, or contract reference.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of withholding tax deducted from the vendor payment. This amount is remitted to tax authorities on behalf of the vendor.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_code
attributes.description: Code representing the withholding tax type and rate applied to this invoice. Required for tax compliance in jurisdictions with withholding tax requirements.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who created or entered the invoice record in the system. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accounts receivable transaction record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: account_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: header_id

attributes.name: opportunity_id

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Link receivable to profit center for profitability reporting.

attributes.name: reagent_subscription_id

Essential for subscription revenue recognition, collections management, and churn analysis. Critical in genomics for reagent rental and consumables

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Classification of receivable age for aging analysis (current, 1-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, over 90 days past due).

attributes.name: ar_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the receivable indicating whether it is open, partially paid, fully cleared, overdue, written off, or under dispute.

attributes.name: billing_block_code
attributes.description: Code indicating if billing is blocked for this receivable pending resolution of credit hold, compliance check, or other business rule.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date the receivable was fully cleared through payment or other settlement mechanism. Null if still open.

attributes.name: collection_agency
attributes.description: Name of the third-party collection agency to which this overdue receivable has been assigned for recovery, if applicable.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity that owns this receivable for financial consolidation and reporting.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or username of the person who created this receivable record in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accounts receivable record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_memo_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of any credit memo issued against this invoice for returns, adjustments, or billing corrections.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, etc.).

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Business segment classification of the customer for this receivable (research institution, clinical lab, biopharma partner, agricultural genomics, government, academic).

attributes.name: days_sales_outstanding
attributes.description: Number of days this receivable has been outstanding since invoice date. Key metric for cash flow and working capital management.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Cash discount or early payment discount amount offered to the customer if payment is received within discount terms.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this receivable is currently under dispute by the customer (True=disputed, False=not disputed).

attributes.name: dispute_reason

attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax posting record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customer_tax_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number of the customer for output tax postings. Used for reverse charge VAT and cross-border transaction reporting.

attributes.name: deferred_tax_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax posting represents a deferred tax asset or liability. True for deferred tax entries, false for current tax postings.
attributes.references: IAS 12 Income Taxes, ASC 740 Income Taxes

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate used to convert transaction currency amounts to local currency. Rate applied at posting date.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the tax posting was recorded. Used for period-based tax reporting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction (country, state, province) where the tax obligation arises. Examples: US-CA (California), GB (United Kingdom), DE (Germany), SG (Singapore).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes, ISO 3166-2 Subdivision Codes

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the local reporting currency of the company code. Used for statutory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, SAP FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: local_tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount converted to local reporting currency using the exchange rate at posting date. Used for statutory financial reporting.

attributes.name: local_tax_base_amount
attributes.description: Tax base amount converted to local reporting currency using the exchange rate at posting date. Used for statutory financial reporting.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax posting record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the payment transaction used to settle this tax liability with the tax authority. Links to payment document for reconciliation.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current status of the tax posting in the financial system. Posted (finalized), parked (draft), cleared (settled with tax authority), reversed (corrected), cancelled (voided).

attributes.name: rd_project_code
attributes.description: Project code for R&D activities eligible for tax credits. Links tax postings to qualifying R&D expenditure for credit claim substantiation.

attributes.name: rd_tax_credit_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Research and Development (R&D) Tax Credit Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this posting relates to R&D tax credit claims (Section 41 US, HMRC UK R&D relief). True for R&D tax credit transactions.
attributes.references: IRC Section 41, HMRC R&D Tax Relief Guidelines

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the reversal entry if this posting has been reversed. Used to track corrections and adjustments for tax reconciliation.

attributes.name: reverse_charge_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reverse charge mechanism applies (customer self-assesses VAT/GST instead of supplier charging it). True for reverse charge transactions.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive Article 196, OECD International VAT/GST Guidelines

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax posting is subject to SOX internal control testing and audit procedures. True for material tax transactions requiring enhanced controls.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount for this posting. Positive for tax payable/output tax, negative for tax receivable/input tax. Denominated in transaction currency.

attributes.name: tax_authority
attributes.description: Name of the tax authority or revenue agency to which the tax is owed or from which a credit is claimed. Examples: IRS, HMRC, Finanzamt, IRAS.

attributes.name: tax_base_amount
attributes.description: The taxable base amount (net amount before tax) on which the tax calculation is performed. Denominated in transaction currency.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: SAP tax code that defines the tax type, rate, and calculation method. Examples: V0 (VAT 0%), V1 (VAT standard rate), I1 (input VAT), U1 (US sales tax).

attributes.name: tax_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tax is input (paid to suppliers), output (collected from customers), payable (owed to tax authority), or receivable (refund/credit from tax authority).

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the tax exemption certificate or ruling that supports the exemption claim. Used for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for tax exemption or reduced rate. Examples: export (zero-rated export), RUO (research use only exempt), IVD_exempt. Blank if no exemption applies.

attributes.name: tax_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The tax rate percentage applied to the tax base amount. Examples: 20.00 (UK VAT), 7.00 (California sales tax), 19.00 (German VAT).
attributes.references: SAP FI Tax Rate Master Data

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: Tax registration or identification number of the company code in the jurisdiction. Examples: VAT number (EU), GST registration (Singapore), EIN (US). Used for tax return filing.

attributes.name: tax_return_period
attributes.description: Tax reporting period to which this posting belongs. Format: YYYY-QN for quarterly (e.g., 2024-Q1) or YYYY-MNN for monthly (e.g., 2024-M03). Determines which tax return filing includes this transaction.

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tax transaction type. Includes VAT (Value Added Tax), GST (Goods and Services Tax), sales tax, withholding tax, use tax, excise tax, customs duty, and R&D tax credit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VAT|GST|sales_tax|withholding_tax|use_tax|excise_tax|customs_duty|rd_tax_credit — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, SGD.

attributes.name: vendor_tax_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number of the vendor or supplier for input tax postings. Used for VAT/GST reclaim validation and withholding tax reporting.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this posting represents withholding tax deducted at source from payments to vendors or employees. True for withholding tax entries.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 515, OECD Model Tax Convention

products.name: capex_request
products.description: Capital expenditure (CAPEX) request and approval record — manages the lifecycle of investment proposals for Genomics Biotech capital projects including new sequencing instrument lines, GMP facility expansions, HPC infrastructure upgrades, and laboratory automation investments. Tracks requested amount, business justification, NPV/IRB/payback period, approval workflow status, approved amount, asset class, and WBS element linkage. Supports CAPEX governance and SOX investment controls.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the capital expenditure request. Primary key for the CAPEX request record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Link CAPEX request to cost center for budgeting and approval workflow.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
