attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Link CAPEX request to profit center for investment performance measurement.

attributes.name: requester_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Capital expenditure requests must track the requesting employee for approval workflow routing (based on org hierarchy), budget accountability, post-implementation review assignment, and audit trail. E

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Replace WBS element code with FK to wbs_element for project accounting linkage.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the capital expenditure request was formally approved by the authorized governance body. Null if not yet approved. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of the CAPEX request in the approval workflow: draft (not yet submitted), submitted (awaiting review), under_review (in governance committee), approved (authorized for execution), rejected (denied), on_hold (pending additional information), or cancelled (withdrawn by requester). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|on_hold|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approved_amount
attributes.description: Capital expenditure amount approved by the governance committee or authorized approver. May differ from requested amount due to budget constraints or scope adjustments. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Full name of the executive or committee chair who authorized the capital expenditure. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Category of asset being acquired or developed through this capital expenditure: sequencing instrument, manufacturing equipment (GMP production lines), facility (building/cleanroom expansion), IT infrastructure (HPC/cloud), laboratory automation, or other.

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Budget version identifier (e.g., PLAN, FORECAST, REVISED) indicating which budget cycle this CAPEX request is associated with.

attributes.name: budget_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year for which the capital expenditure is budgeted and planned. Format: YYYY (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Name of the business unit or division submitting the capital expenditure request (e.g., Sequencing, Clinical Genomics, Manufacturing).

attributes.name: capitalization_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether the expenditure qualifies for capitalization under GAAP/IFRS accounting standards (True) or must be expensed immediately (False).

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity submitting the capital expenditure request. Used for financial consolidation and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the CAPEX request record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the requested and approved amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method to be used for depreciating the capital asset: straight_line (equal annual expense), declining_balance (accelerated depreciation), units_of_production (usage-based), or not_applicable (non-depreciable asset).

attributes.name: environmental_impact_assessment
attributes.description: Summary of the capital project's environmental impact, including energy consumption, waste generation, and sustainability considerations. Required for facility and manufacturing equipment investments.

attributes.name: investment_program
attributes.description: Name of the strategic investment program or portfolio to which this CAPEX request belongs (e.g., NGS Platform Expansion 2024, GMP Facility Modernization).

attributes.name: irr_percentage
attributes.description: Internal rate of return for the capital investment, expressed as a percentage. Represents the discount rate at which NPV equals zero. Used to assess investment attractiveness.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the CAPEX request record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: npv_amount
attributes.description: Calculated net present value of the capital investment, representing the present value of expected future cash flows minus the initial investment. Used for investment prioritization.

attributes.name: payback_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months required to recover the initial capital investment through generated cash flows or cost savings. Used for liquidity and risk assessment.

attributes.name: project_category
attributes.description: Strategic classification of the capital project: strategic (long-term competitive advantage), operational (business-as-usual improvement), or mandatory (regulatory/compliance-driven).

attributes.name: regulatory_driver
attributes.description: Specific regulatory requirement or compliance mandate driving the capital expenditure (e.g., FDA 21 CFR Part 11, IVDR 2017/746, ISO 13485). Null if not compliance-driven.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by the approver or governance committee for rejecting the capital expenditure request. Null if not rejected.

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date when the capital expenditure request was formally submitted for approval. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: request_description
attributes.description: Detailed business justification and description of the capital expenditure request, including strategic rationale, expected benefits, and project scope.

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the capital expenditure request, used for tracking and reference in approval workflows and financial reporting.

attributes.name: request_title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title of the capital expenditure request, summarizing the investment purpose.

attributes.name: request_type
attributes.description: Classification of the capital expenditure request by investment purpose: expansion (capacity growth), replacement (asset renewal), new product (R&D commercialization), efficiency (cost reduction), compliance (regulatory requirement), or infrastructure (IT/facility upgrade).

attributes.name: requested_amount
attributes.description: Total capital expenditure amount requested by the business unit, in the company's reporting currency. Includes all project costs: equipment, installation, training, and contingency.

attributes.name: required_by_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the capital asset or project must be operational to meet business objectives. Used for prioritization and resource planning. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk assessment for the capital investment project: low (proven technology, low execution risk), medium (moderate complexity), high (significant technical or market uncertainty), or critical (high probability of failure or cost overrun).

attributes.name: roi_percentage
attributes.description: Expected return on investment expressed as a percentage of the capital expenditure. Calculated as (expected benefit - investment cost) / investment cost * 100.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this CAPEX request is subject to SOX internal control requirements due to materiality thresholds or financial statement impact.

attributes.name: sponsor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the executive sponsor or business owner accountable for the capital investment. Typically a VP or C-level executive.

attributes.name: strategic_alignment_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score (typically 1-10) assessing how well the capital investment aligns with corporate strategic priorities. Used in governance committee prioritization.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the capital asset in years, used for depreciation calculation and asset accounting. Null if not applicable or not yet determined.

products.name: sox_control
products.description: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) internal control master for Genomics Biotech financial processes — documents each key control including journal entry approval thresholds, segregation of duties matrices, period-end close checklists, revenue recognition reviews, fixed asset physical verification, and IT general controls over financial systems. Tracks control ID, owner, type (preventive/detective/corrective), frequency (continuous/daily/monthly/quarterly), testing status, test evidence, deficiency classification (control deficiency/significant deficiency/material weakness), and remediation plan with target date. Supports external audit reliance, management certification (Section 302/404), and SEC reporting.

attributes.name: sox_control_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SOX control. Primary key for the sox_control data product.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: control_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: SOX control ownership must link to employee master for responsibility tracking, organizational change impact analysis, access reviews, and control testing assignments. Essential for SOX 404 compliance

attributes.name: mdm_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.mdm_policy. Business justification: SOX controls enforce MDM policies on financial master data (chart of accounts, cost centers, legal entities). Required for demonstrating control over master data governance in financial reporting.

attributes.name: quality_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.quality_assessment. Business justification: SOX controls require documented quality assessments as evidence of control execution. Links control testing to data quality validation results for audit trail and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: quality_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.quality_rule. Business justification: SOX controls enforce specific data quality rules on financial reporting data (completeness checks, reconciliation rules). Required for demonstrating control effectiveness and audit evidence in regulat

attributes.name: compensating_control_description
attributes.description: Description of any compensating or mitigating controls in place while a deficiency is being remediated. Compensating controls provide interim assurance that risks are managed during the remediation period.

attributes.name: control_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the control objective, procedures performed, evidence retained, and how the control mitigates the identified risk. Includes who performs the control, what is reviewed, and acceptance criteria.

attributes.name: control_documentation_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the formal control documentation (e.g., process narrative, flowchart, risk-control matrix document ID) that provides detailed control design specifications.

attributes.name: control_frequency
attributes.description: How often the control is performed or operates. Continuous controls operate in real-time (e.g., system access restrictions), while periodic controls operate at defined intervals (e.g., monthly reconciliations). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: continuous|daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|annually|event_driven — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: control_nature
attributes.description: Describes the execution mechanism of the control: manual (performed entirely by people), automated (system-enforced), IT-dependent manual (manual control relying on system reports), or IT general control (infrastructure/access control).

attributes.name: control_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the control, typically formatted as domain prefix followed by sequential number (e.g., FIN-001, IT-GC-045). Used in audit documentation and management reporting.

attributes.name: control_performer_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or role that executes the control activity. May differ from control owner. For automated controls, this may reference the system or application name.

attributes.name: control_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the control. Active controls are in operation and subject to testing. Inactive or retired controls are no longer in effect.

attributes.name: control_title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title of the control activity (e.g., 'Journal Entry Approval Over $50K', 'Segregation of Duties - AP Processing').

attributes.name: control_type
attributes.description: Classification of the control based on its timing and purpose: preventive (stops errors before they occur), detective (identifies errors after occurrence), or corrective (remediates identified issues).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this control record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for control lifecycle management.

attributes.name: deficiency_classification
attributes.description: Severity classification of any identified control deficiency. Control deficiency: minor issue. Significant deficiency: important enough to merit attention by those charged with governance. Material weakness: reasonable possibility of material misstatement not being prevented or detected.

attributes.name: deficiency_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the control deficiency identified during testing, including root cause analysis, impact assessment, and specific instances where the control failed to operate as designed.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the control became operational and subject to SOX compliance testing requirements. Used to determine testing scope for annual audits.

attributes.name: external_auditor_reliance
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether external auditors plan to rely on this control for their financial statement audit. Controls with auditor reliance require more rigorous testing and documentation.

attributes.name: financial_statement_assertion
attributes.description: The financial statement assertion(s) addressed by this control: existence/occurrence, completeness, valuation/allocation, rights/obligations, presentation/disclosure. Multiple assertions may be listed if applicable.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year for which this control record and testing results apply. Supports year-over-year trending and historical audit trail.

attributes.name: key_control_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a key control upon which external auditors may place reliance for financial statement audit purposes. Key controls are subject to more rigorous testing requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the person who last modified this control record. Supports accountability and change tracking for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this control record was most recently updated. Used to track changes to control design, ownership, or testing results.

attributes.name: last_test_date
attributes.description: Date when the control was most recently tested for design and operating effectiveness. Used to track testing currency and plan future testing cycles.

attributes.name: management_review_conclusion
attributes.description: Management's assessment of control effectiveness based on testing results and operational performance. Used for Section 302/404 certifications and disclosure decisions.

attributes.name: management_review_date
attributes.description: Date when management last reviewed the control design and operating effectiveness as part of their Section 302/404 certification process.

attributes.name: next_test_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next control testing activity. Calculated based on control frequency, risk rating, and prior test results. Used for test planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: process_area
attributes.description: The business process or financial cycle to which this control belongs (e.g., 'Revenue Recognition', 'Accounts Payable', 'Inventory Valuation', 'Payroll Processing', 'Fixed Assets', 'Period-End Close').

attributes.name: remediation_owner
attributes.description: Name of the individual accountable for executing the remediation plan and achieving control effectiveness. May differ from the control owner if organizational changes are required.

attributes.name: remediation_plan
attributes.description: Documented action plan to address identified control deficiencies. Includes specific corrective actions, responsible parties, resources required, and interim compensating controls if applicable.

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current progress status of remediation activities. Completed indicates actions are finished; validated indicates retesting confirmed effectiveness.

attributes.name: remediation_target_date
attributes.description: Committed date by which the control deficiency will be fully remediated and the control will operate effectively. Used for management tracking and external auditor follow-up.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who reviews and approves the control execution evidence. Required for controls with a review component to demonstrate segregation of duties.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework - Control Activities Principle

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Description of the financial reporting risk that this control is designed to mitigate. Articulates what could go wrong in the absence of the control (e.g., 'Unauthorized journal entries could result in material misstatement').

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the inherent risk level associated with the process area before considering control effectiveness. Used to prioritize testing and monitoring activities.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of control instances or transactions selected for testing. Determined based on control frequency, population size, and desired confidence level.

attributes.name: segregation_of_duties_matrix_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the documented segregation of duties matrix that defines incompatible functions and role assignments. Links this control to the broader SOD framework.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework - Control Activities Principle

attributes.name: system_application
attributes.description: Name of the primary system or application in which the control operates or from which control evidence is generated (e.g., 'SAP FI', 'Oracle Cloud HCM', 'Veeva Vault'). Critical for IT general control mapping.

attributes.name: test_approach
attributes.description: Primary testing methodology used to evaluate control effectiveness: inquiry (asking questions), observation (watching execution), inspection (reviewing evidence), reperformance (executing control independently), or data analytics (statistical sampling).

attributes.name: test_evidence_location
attributes.description: File path, document management system reference, or repository location where control testing evidence is stored. Required for audit trail and external auditor review.

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: Current status of control testing for the active testing period. Passed indicates effective operation; failed indicates a deficiency requiring remediation.

attributes.description: Indicates whether this absence is related to a workers compensation claim due to work-related injury or illness.

products.name: headcount_plan
products.description: FTE planning and headcount budget records by org unit, job family, and fiscal period — capturing planned headcount, approved headcount, actual filled headcount, open requisition count, contractor FTE equivalents, and variance to plan. Supports annual workforce planning cycles, R&D headcount capitalization decisions, and GMP staffing compliance. Enables CFO/CHRO reporting on FTE spend vs. budget.

attributes.name: headcount_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the headcount plan record. Primary key for the headcount planning entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center that will bear the financial burden of this headcount plan. Links to the finance cost_center master data for General Ledger (GL) integration.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary work location (site, office, or facility) for this headcount plan entry. Supports geographic workforce distribution analysis.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational unit for which this headcount plan applies. Links to the org_unit master data.

attributes.name: primary_headcount_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who approved this headcount plan record. Supports audit trail and governance requirements.

attributes.name: tertiary_headcount_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: The user identifier of the person who last modified this headcount plan record. Supports audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: actual_filled_headcount
attributes.description: The actual number of Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) positions filled as of the reporting date. Sourced from Oracle Cloud HCM active assignments.

attributes.name: approved_headcount
attributes.description: The approved number of Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) positions after budget review and executive approval. May differ from planned_headcount due to budget constraints or strategic adjustments.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this headcount plan record was approved. Supports audit trail and Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) compliance.

attributes.name: budget_allocation_amount
attributes.description: The total budget amount allocated for this headcount plan entry, including salary, benefits, and overhead. Used for Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) spend vs. budget variance reporting.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 4217 currency code for the budget allocation amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: The business unit code for this headcount plan entry. Aligns with corporate organizational structure and Profit and Loss (P&L) reporting.

attributes.name: clia_certified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) Certified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the headcount in this plan entry requires Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) certification or qualification. Relevant for clinical genomics and In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) laboratory personnel.

attributes.name: contractor_fte_equivalent
attributes.description: The Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) count of contractors and contingent workers supporting this org unit and job family. Enables total workforce capacity analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this headcount plan record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: The employment type classification for this headcount plan entry. Distinguishes between permanent employees, contractors, and temporary staff.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year (1-12). Provides monthly granularity for headcount planning and Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) tracking.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter within the fiscal year for this headcount plan (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4). Enables quarterly workforce planning and variance analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this headcount plan applies (e.g., 2024, 2025). Supports annual workforce planning cycles.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: The functional area classification for this headcount plan entry (e.g., Research and Development (R&D), Manufacturing, Quality, Sales, General and Administrative (G&A)). Used for functional cost allocation and Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) reporting.

attributes.name: gxp_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the headcount in this plan entry is subject to Good Practice Regulations (GxP) (Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), Good Clinical Practice (GCP)) compliance requirements. Drives training and qualification planning.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 / EU GMP Annex 11

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: The job family classification for this headcount plan entry (e.g., Research and Development (R&D), Manufacturing, Quality Assurance (QA), Field Application Scientist, Bioinformatics, Clinical Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Human Resources (HR)). Aligns with workforce planning categories.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud HCM Job Family Taxonomy

attributes.name: job_level
attributes.description: The job level or grade for this headcount plan entry (e.g., Individual Contributor, Senior, Lead, Manager, Director, Vice President (VP), Executive). Used for workforce stratification and compensation planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud HCM Job Level Framework

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this headcount plan record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: open_requisition_count
attributes.description: The number of open job requisitions for this org unit, job family, and fiscal period. Indicates active recruiting efforts to close the headcount gap.

attributes.name: plan_effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this headcount plan record ceases to be effective. Null indicates an open-ended plan. Supports temporal workforce planning and historical analysis.

attributes.name: plan_effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this headcount plan record becomes effective. Supports temporal workforce planning and historical analysis.

attributes.name: plan_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this headcount plan entry. Captures business context, assumptions, or special considerations.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the headcount plan record. Tracks the approval workflow and activation state of the plan.

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: The version identifier for this headcount plan (e.g., Original Budget, Revised Q2, Board Approved). Supports multiple planning scenarios and revisions throughout the fiscal year.

attributes.name: planned_headcount
attributes.description: The planned number of Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) positions for this org unit, job family, and fiscal period. Represents the initial workforce plan target.

attributes.name: rd_capitalization_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Research and Development (R&D) Capitalization Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the headcount in this plan entry is eligible for Research and Development (R&D) capitalization under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) or International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). Supports financial reporting and Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) compliance.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which this headcount plan record originated (e.g., Oracle Cloud HCM, SAP S/4HANA, Workday, custom workforce planning tool). Supports data lineage and integration traceability.

attributes.name: variance_to_plan
attributes.description: The variance between approved_headcount and actual_filled_headcount (calculated as actual_filled_headcount minus approved_headcount). Negative values indicate understaffing; positive values indicate overstaffing.

products.name: lifecycle_event
products.description: Captures discrete HR lifecycle events providing a complete audit trail for each employee — new hire onboarding, internal transfer, promotion, demotion, role change, location change, leave of absence initiation, return from leave, and termination/offboarding. Each event captures event type, effective date, prior state, new state, initiating manager, HR business partner, approval chain, and event reason code. Critical for SOX compliance (personnel change controls), GxP personnel qualification continuity (21 CFR Part 211.25), and CLIA personnel change documentation. Sourced from Oracle Cloud HCM.
products.reference: Oracle Cloud HCM HR Action / Person History

attributes.name: lifecycle_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the HR lifecycle event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: alt5_lifecycle_final_approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who provided final approval for this lifecycle event.

attributes.name: new_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work location after this lifecycle event. Null for termination events.

attributes.name: primary_lifecycle_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who is the subject of this lifecycle event.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud HCM - Worker Data Model

attributes.name: primary_lifecycle_prior_job_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job profile assigned to the employee before this event. Null for new hire events.

attributes.name: primary_lifecycle_prior_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational unit the employee belonged to before this event. Null for new hire events.

attributes.name: primary_lifecycle_prior_position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee's position before this lifecycle event. Null for new hire events.

attributes.name: prior_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work location before this lifecycle event. Null for new hire events.

attributes.name: quaternary_lifecycle_initiating_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager who initiated this lifecycle event. Critical for SOX compliance audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls, Oracle Cloud HCM - Action Initiator

attributes.name: quinary_lifecycle_hr_business_partner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the HR business partner responsible for processing this lifecycle event.

attributes.name: tertiary_lifecycle_new_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee's direct manager after this lifecycle event. Null for termination events.

attributes.name: approval_chain
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of employee IDs representing the approval workflow sequence for this event. Provides complete audit trail for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls, Oracle Cloud HCM - Approval Hierarchy

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when final approval was granted for this lifecycle event. Critical for SOX audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this lifecycle event record was first created in the system. Distinct from event_effective_date which represents the business event date.

attributes.name: event_comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, context, or special instructions related to this lifecycle event.

attributes.name: event_effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this lifecycle event becomes effective for the employee. This is the business event date, distinct from system processing timestamps. Critical for SOX compliance and GxP personnel qualification continuity per 21 CFR Part 211.25.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.25 - Personnel Qualifications, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the lifecycle event, typically system-generated sequence number from Oracle Cloud HCM.

attributes.name: event_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the lifecycle event. Maps to Oracle Cloud HCM action reason lookup values.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud HCM - Action Reason Codes

attributes.name: event_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual explanation of the reason for the lifecycle event. Provides context beyond the standardized reason code.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the lifecycle event. Tracks progression through approval and execution stages. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|in_progress|completed|cancelled|rejected — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the HR lifecycle event. Defines the nature of the personnel action being recorded. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_hire|internal_transfer|promotion|demotion|role_change|location_change|leave_of_absence_start|return_from_leave|termination|offboarding — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this lifecycle event record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: new_clia_qualified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) Qualified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee requires CLIA personnel qualification in their new role. Null for termination events.

attributes.name: new_employment_type
attributes.description: Employment classification after this lifecycle event. Null for termination events.

attributes.name: new_fte_percentage
attributes.description: Full-time equivalent allocation percentage after this event. 100.00 represents full-time. Null for termination events.

attributes.name: new_gxp_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee's new role is designated as GxP-critical requiring regulatory qualification per 21 CFR Part 211.25. Null for termination events.

attributes.name: prior_clia_qualified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) Qualified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee held CLIA personnel qualification in their prior role. Null for new hire events.

attributes.name: prior_employment_type
attributes.description: Employment classification before this lifecycle event. Null for new hire events.

attributes.name: prior_fte_percentage
attributes.description: Full-time equivalent allocation percentage before this event. 100.00 represents full-time. Null for new hire events.

attributes.name: prior_gxp_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee's prior role was designated as GxP-critical requiring regulatory qualification per 21 CFR Part 211.25. Null for new hire events.

attributes.name: requalification_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which training requalification must be completed following this lifecycle event. Null if requalification is not required.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which this lifecycle event record originated, typically Oracle Cloud HCM instance identifier.

attributes.name: source_system_event_code
attributes.description: Native event identifier from the source system (Oracle Cloud HCM action ID) for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: sox_control_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lifecycle event is subject to SOX personnel change control requirements due to financial system access or authority changes.

attributes.name: system_access_change_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lifecycle event requires changes to system access permissions and roles. Critical for SOX IT general controls.

attributes.name: training_requalification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lifecycle event triggers mandatory GxP training requalification per 21 CFR Part 211.25.

products.name: lab_qualification
products.description: Tracks individual laboratory and instrument-specific qualifications for scientists, engineers, and technicians — e.g., NGS instrument operator qualification (Illumina NovaSeq, NextSeq), qPCR operator qualification, CRISPR editing lab qualification, biosafety level (BSL-1/BSL-2) authorization, and cleanroom gowning qualification. Captures qualification type, instrument/lab scope, qualification date, qualified-by assessor, expiry date, and requalification status. Distinct from GxP training records — this is competency-based lab authorization.

attributes.name: lab_qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the laboratory qualification record. Primary key for the lab_qualification product.

attributes.name: controlled_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the qualification documentation stored in the document management system (e.g., Veeva Vault, MasterControl). Links to assessment forms, certificates, and training records.

attributes.name: genome_assembly_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.genome_assembly. Business justification: Lab qualifications for variant calling, NGS pipeline operation, and clinical bioinformatics must specify the genome build the employee is qualified to use. CLIA personnel qualification records require

attributes.name: genomic_access_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.genomic_access_control. Business justification: Lab qualifications determine technical access rights to specific genomic analysis platforms (e.g., Illumina BaseSpace, bioinformatics pipelines) and associated datasets. Operational necessity: only qu

attributes.name: primary_lab_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who holds this laboratory qualification. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: quality_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.quality_rule. Business justification: Lab qualifications (instrument-specific, assay-specific) authorize personnel to perform quality-controlled genomic workflows. Quality rules enforce that only qualified personnel execute critical data

attributes.name: assay_type
attributes.description: Specific assay or test method for which the qualification applies. Examples: WGS (Whole Genome Sequencing), WES (Whole Exome Sequencing), SNP Array, CNV Detection, CRISPR Editing Protocol. Null for non-assay-specific qualifications.

attributes.name: assessment_score
attributes.description: Numerical score achieved during the qualification assessment, expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Null if the assessment was pass/fail without numerical scoring.

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who conducted the qualification assessment. Denormalized for audit trail and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: CAP College of American Pathologists Accreditation

attributes.name: assessor_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the assessor at the time of qualification. Examples: Senior Scientist, Lab Manager, Technical Director, Quality Assurance Manager.

attributes.name: biosafety_level
attributes.description: Biosafety containment level for which the individual is authorized. BSL-1 for minimal hazard, BSL-2 for moderate risk, BSL-3 for serious or potentially lethal agents. Not applicable for non-biosafety qualifications.

attributes.name: cap_accreditation_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: College of American Pathologists (CAP) Accreditation Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification is required for CAP laboratory accreditation. True for qualifications mandated by CAP inspection checklists; false otherwise.
attributes.references: CAP College of American Pathologists Accreditation

attributes.name: cleanroom_class
attributes.description: ISO cleanroom classification for which the individual is qualified. ISO 5 (Class 100) through ISO 8 (Class 100,000) per ISO 14644-1. Not applicable for non-cleanroom qualifications.

attributes.name: clia_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification is required for CLIA-regulated clinical laboratory operations. True for qualifications mandated by CLIA personnel standards; false otherwise.

attributes.name: competency_assessment_method
attributes.description: Method used to assess competency for this qualification. Practical demonstration for hands-on skills; written exam for knowledge; observation for supervised performance; simulation for controlled scenarios; combination for multi-method assessment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this qualification record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualification expires and requalification is required. Null for qualifications with no expiration (permanent authorization).

attributes.name: gxp_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification is critical for GxP compliance (Good Manufacturing Practice, Good Laboratory Practice, Good Clinical Practice). True for qualifications required for regulated activities; false otherwise.

attributes.name: independent_runs_required
attributes.description: Number of successful independent runs required to demonstrate competency. Null for non-operational qualifications.

attributes.name: instrument_model
attributes.description: Specific instrument model or platform for which the qualification applies. Examples: Illumina NovaSeq 6000, Illumina NextSeq 2000, Applied Biosystems QuantStudio 7, CRISPR Cas9 System. Null for non-instrument qualifications.

attributes.name: iso_13485_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 13485 Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification is required for ISO 13485 medical device quality management system compliance. True for qualifications mandated by ISO 13485 personnel competency requirements; false otherwise.

attributes.name: lab_scope
attributes.description: Laboratory area, facility, or functional scope to which this qualification applies. Examples: NGS Production Lab, qPCR Lab, Gene Editing Suite, BSL-2 Containment Area, Cleanroom Zone A.
attributes.references: ISO 15189 Medical Laboratories Quality and Competence

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this qualification record was last updated. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: last_requalification_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent requalification assessment. Null if the individual has not yet been requalified since initial qualification.

attributes.name: next_requalification_due_date
attributes.description: Calculated date by which the next requalification must be completed. Derived from last qualification date plus requalification frequency. Null for qualifications not requiring requalification.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, special conditions, limitations, or observations related to the qualification. Examples: Qualified with restrictions, requires co-signer for first 10 runs, authorized for research use only.

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum score required to pass the qualification assessment, expressed as a percentage. Typically 80.00 or higher for GxP-regulated qualifications.

attributes.name: qualification_certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or credential number issued upon successful qualification. Used for audit trail and verification purposes.

attributes.name: qualification_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific qualification. Examples: NGS-NOVASEQ-OPR, QPCR-OPR, CRISPR-EDIT-L2, BSL2-AUTH, CR-GOWN-A.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the individual successfully completed the qualification and was authorized. Represents the effective start of competency.

attributes.name: qualification_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the laboratory qualification. Examples: NovaSeq 6000 Instrument Operator, qPCR Operator Qualification, CRISPR Gene Editing Lab Level 2, Biosafety Level 2 Authorization, Cleanroom Gowning Class A.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the qualification. Active indicates the individual is currently authorized; expired indicates the qualification has lapsed; suspended indicates temporary hold; pending_requalification indicates renewal in process; revoked indicates permanent removal; in_progress indicates initial qualification underway.

attributes.name: qualification_type
attributes.description: Category of laboratory qualification. Distinguishes between instrument operation, lab technique competency, biosafety clearance, cleanroom access, assay-specific authorization, and equipment maintenance qualification.

attributes.name: requalification_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between required requalification assessments. Common values: 12, 24, 36. Null for qualifications that do not require periodic requalification.

attributes.name: requalification_status
attributes.description: Current status of requalification requirement. Not required for permanent qualifications; upcoming when approaching expiry; overdue when past expiry; in progress during reassessment; completed when renewed.

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualification was revoked due to performance issues, safety violations, or other disqualifying events. Null for qualifications that have not been revoked.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the qualification was revoked. Examples: Failed requalification assessment, safety violation, quality incident, extended absence, role change. Null for qualifications that have not been revoked.

attributes.name: sop_version
attributes.description: Version of the Standard Operating Procedure under which the qualification was conducted. Ensures traceability to the specific procedure version used for assessment.

attributes.name: supervised_runs_completed
attributes.description: Number of supervised instrument runs, assays, or procedures completed during the qualification process. Null for non-operational qualifications.

attributes.name: suspension_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualification suspension was lifted and authorization was reinstated. Null for qualifications that are currently suspended or have not been suspended.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the qualification was temporarily suspended. Examples: Pending investigation, refresher training required, equipment change, procedure update. Null for qualifications that have not been suspended.

attributes.name: suspension_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualification was temporarily suspended. Null for qualifications that have not been suspended.

attributes.name: training_hours_completed
attributes.description: Total number of training hours completed as part of the qualification process. Includes classroom instruction, hands-on practice, and supervised operation.

products.name: payroll_result
products.description: Stores processed payroll run results per employee per pay period — capturing gross pay, net pay, tax withholdings (federal, state, local), benefit deductions, voluntary deductions (401k, FSA), overtime pay, shift differential pay for GMP manufacturing staff, and payroll run status. Sourced from Oracle Cloud HCM Payroll. Restricted classification. Supports SOX financial controls and labor cost allocation to cost centers and R&D capitalization.
products.reference: Oracle Cloud HCM Payroll Run Result

attributes.name: payroll_result_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payroll result record. Primary key for this entity representing a single employee's processed payroll for a specific pay period.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Cost center to which this payroll expense is allocated. Critical for labor cost allocation and R&D capitalization analysis per SOX requirements.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee for whom this payroll result was processed. Links to the employee master record in Oracle Cloud HCM.

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll run batch that generated this result. Links to the payroll run header record.

attributes.name: workforce_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee assignment record active during this pay period. Captures the position, organization, and cost center context for this payroll result.

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: Discretionary or performance-based bonus payments included in this pay period. May include annual bonuses, spot awards, or incentive compensation.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Sales commission earnings for field application specialists and commercial staff. Calculated based on revenue attainment and commission plans.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll result record was first created in the system. Part of standard audit trail.

attributes.name: dental_insurance_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Employee portion of dental insurance premiums deducted from pay. Typically pre-tax under cafeteria plan.

attributes.name: federal_tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Federal income tax withheld from gross pay per IRS regulations and employee W-4 elections. Required for SOX financial controls and tax reporting.

attributes.name: fsa_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Employee pre-tax contributions to healthcare or dependent care FSA. Subject to IRS annual limits and use-it-or-lose-it rules.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for posting this payroll expense. Maps to chart of accounts for financial reporting and SOX controls.

attributes.name: gross_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total earnings before any deductions or withholdings. Includes regular pay, overtime, shift differentials, bonuses, and other earnings components.

attributes.name: health_insurance_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Employee portion of health insurance premiums deducted from pay. May be pre-tax under Section 125 cafeteria plan.

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Total hours worked during the pay period including regular and overtime hours. Used for labor productivity analysis and FTE calculations.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud HCM Time and Labor

attributes.name: hsa_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Employee pre-tax contributions to HSA for high-deductible health plan participants. Subject to IRS annual limits.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll result record was last updated. Tracks changes for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: local_tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Local or municipal income tax withheld where applicable. Includes city, county, or district taxes based on work or residence location.

attributes.name: medicare_tax_amount
attributes.description: Employee portion of FICA Medicare tax withheld. Includes additional Medicare tax for high earners per ACA regulations.

attributes.name: net_pay_amount
attributes.description: Take-home pay after all deductions and withholdings. The amount disbursed to the employee via direct deposit or check.

attributes.name: other_deductions_amount
attributes.description: Sum of miscellaneous deductions not captured in standard categories. May include garnishments, union dues, charitable contributions, or loan repayments.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Hours worked beyond standard schedule at premium pay rates. Subject to FLSA regulations and company overtime policy.

attributes.name: overtime_pay_amount
attributes.description: Additional earnings for hours worked beyond standard schedule. Calculated at premium rates per labor regulations and company policy.

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the pay period covered by this payroll result. Defines the earnings and deductions calculation window.

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the pay period covered by this payroll result. Used for period-based reporting and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: payment_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this payroll result. Typically USD for US operations.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the net pay was disbursed to the employee. Used for cash flow forecasting and SOX financial controls.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which net pay was disbursed to the employee. Direct deposit is standard for most employees.

attributes.name: payroll_frequency
attributes.description: Pay cycle frequency for this employee. Determines pay period duration and payment schedule.

attributes.name: payroll_run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this payroll result. Tracks progression from calculation through payment and supports audit trail for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll result was calculated and finalized. Critical for audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: pto_hours_used
attributes.description: Paid time off hours taken during this pay period. Reduces available PTO balance and is included in gross pay calculation.

attributes.name: rd_capitalization_amount
attributes.description: Portion of labor cost eligible for R&D capitalization per accounting standards. Used for financial statement preparation and tax credits.

attributes.name: rd_capitalization_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of gross pay allocated to R&D capitalization. Determined by employee role, project assignment, and accounting policy.

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Standard hours worked at base pay rate. Excludes overtime and premium hours.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud HCM Time and Labor

attributes.name: regular_pay_amount
attributes.description: Base earnings for standard hours worked during the pay period. Excludes overtime, bonuses, and other supplemental pay.

attributes.name: retirement_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Employee pre-tax or Roth contributions to 401(k) retirement plan. Voluntary deduction subject to IRS annual limits.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payroll result has been reversed or voided. True if reversed, false if active. Used for audit trail and correction tracking.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for reversing this payroll result. Required for SOX audit trail when corrections are made.

attributes.name: shift_differential_amount
attributes.description: Premium pay for GMP manufacturing staff working non-standard shifts (evening, night, weekend). Critical for labor cost analysis in regulated manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: social_security_tax_amount
attributes.description: Employee portion of FICA Social Security tax withheld. Calculated at statutory rate up to annual wage base limit.

attributes.name: state_tax_withheld_amount

products.name: genomic_access_grant
products.description: This association product represents the authorization event granting an employee access to a specific genomic dataset governed by an access control policy. It captures time-bound access permissions, approval workflows, data use limitations, and audit requirements. Each record links one employee to one genomic access control policy with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific access grant, including grant dates, expiration, approval references, and compliance tracking.. Existence Justification: In genomics research and clinical operations, employees require access to multiple genomic datasets (dbGaP studies, internal cohorts, clinical variant databases), and each dataset has multiple authorized users across different roles (researchers, bioinformaticians, clinicians, data stewards). Access grants are actively managed as time-bound authorizations with approval workflows, expiration tracking, audit logging, and compliance requirements tied to IRB protocols and data use agreements. This is an operational M:N relationship where the business manages individual access grants as distinct entities.

products.name: genome_qualification
products.description: This association product represents the qualification relationship between employees and genome assemblies. It captures CLIA-compliant personnel qualification records for bioinformatics staff authorized to work with specific reference genome builds. Each record links one employee to one genome assembly with qualification status, proficiency level, certification dates, and last usage tracking required for regulatory compliance and project staffing decisions.. Existence Justification: In genomics biotechnology operations, bioinformatics employees must be qualified to work with specific genome assemblies for CLIA compliance and quality assurance. A single employee (bioinformatician, scientist) can be qualified on multiple genome builds (GRCh37, GRCh38, T2T-CHM13, GRCm39), and each genome assembly requires multiple qualified personnel for operational continuity, cross-coverage, and 24/7 pipeline support. The qualification relationship itself carries regulatory-critical data including qualification dates, proficiency levels, certification expiry, and last usage tracking.

domains.name: reference
domains.description: Curates and governs reference genomic data assets — reference genome assemblies (GRCh38/hg38, T2T), variant databases (dbSNP, ClinVar, gnomAD), gene annotation tracks, pathway databases, and population allele frequency references (MAF). Ensures versioned, auditable reference data integrity for reproducible genomic analysis, annotation pipelines, and regulatory-grade variant interpretation.
domains.references: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy, ISO 15189, GA4GH

products.name: genome_assembly
products.description: Master catalog of reference genome assemblies used across all Genomics Biotech pipelines and assays. Each record represents a distinct assembly build (e.g., GRCh38, T2T-CHM13, GRCm39) with its organism taxonomy, chromosome count, total base pairs, source authority (GRC/NCBI/UCSC/Ensembl), assembly level, primary FASTA artifact path, MD5 checksum, and active/deprecated lifecycle status. Serves as the authoritative SSOT for genome build identity — every variant coordinate, gene annotation, and region definition in the enterprise references exactly one assembly record.
products.reference: NCBI Assembly / GRC Reference Genome Build

attributes.name: genome_assembly_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the reference genome assembly record. Primary key.

attributes.name: superseded_by_assembly_genome_assembly_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the genome_assembly_id of the newer assembly that supersedes this one. Null if this assembly is current or has not been superseded.

attributes.name: annotation_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the gene annotation track associated with this assembly (e.g., GENCODE v42, Ensembl 109). Gene annotations are versioned independently of the assembly.

attributes.name: assembly_accession
attributes.description: Official accession identifier assigned by the source authority (NCBI/INSDC format: GCA_ for GenBank, GCF_ for RefSeq). Serves as the globally unique external identifier for this assembly build.
attributes.references: NCBI Assembly Database; INSDC (International Nucleotide Sequence Database Collaboration)

attributes.name: assembly_alias
attributes.description: Alternative or legacy name for the assembly (e.g., hg38 for GRCh38, mm10 for GRCm38). Used for cross-referencing with external tools and historical datasets.
attributes.references: UCSC Genome Browser; Ensembl Genome Browser

attributes.name: assembly_level
attributes.description: Degree of completeness and contiguity of the assembly. Chromosome = fully assembled chromosomes; Scaffold = ordered contigs with gaps; Contig = unordered contiguous sequences; Complete Genome = fully closed, telomere-to-telomere.
attributes.references: NCBI Assembly Database; Genome Reference Consortium (GRC)

attributes.name: assembly_method
attributes.description: Bioinformatics software and algorithm used to assemble the genome (e.g., FALCON, Canu, DISCOVAR, SPAdes). Important for reproducibility and quality assessment.

attributes.name: assembly_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the genome assembly (e.g., GRCh38, T2T-CHM13v2.0, GRCm39). This is the canonical label used across all bioinformatics pipelines and publications.

attributes.name: assembly_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the assembly. Active = currently used in production pipelines; deprecated = no longer recommended but still accessible; superseded = replaced by a newer version; archived = retained for historical reproducibility only.

attributes.name: assembly_type
attributes.description: Ploidy and structural representation of the assembly. Haploid = single consensus sequence; diploid = phased maternal/paternal; haploid-with-alt-loci = primary assembly plus alternate haplotype scaffolds.

attributes.name: bowtie2_index_path
attributes.description: Path to the Bowtie2 index files for this assembly. Alternative aligner index used in some RNA-seq and ChIP-seq pipelines.

attributes.name: bwa_index_path
attributes.description: Path to the BWA (Burrows-Wheeler Aligner) index files for this assembly. Required for read alignment in NGS pipelines.

attributes.name: chromosome_count
attributes.description: Total number of chromosomes represented in the assembly, including autosomes, sex chromosomes, and mitochondrial DNA where applicable.
attributes.references: Genome Reference Consortium (GRC); NCBI Assembly Database

attributes.name: contig_count
attributes.description: Total number of contiguous sequences (contigs) in the assembly. Lower contig count indicates higher assembly contiguity and quality.
attributes.references: NCBI Assembly Database; Genome Reference Consortium (GRC)

attributes.name: contig_n50_bp
attributes.description: N50 statistic for contigs: the length at which 50% of the total assembly length is contained in contigs of this size or larger. Key quality metric for assembly contiguity.
attributes.references: Genome Assembly Quality Metrics; NCBI Assembly Database

attributes.name: coverage_depth
attributes.description: Average sequencing coverage depth (fold coverage) used to generate the assembly. Higher coverage generally indicates higher assembly accuracy.
attributes.references: NGS Quality Metrics; Genome Assembly Best Practices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this genome assembly record was first created in the Genomics Biotech reference data catalog. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format; ISO 27001 Information Security

attributes.name: cytoband_file_path
attributes.description: Path to the cytoband file defining chromosome banding patterns (Giemsa staining regions). Used for cytogenetic coordinate mapping and visualization.

attributes.name: deprecated_date
attributes.description: Date on which this assembly was officially deprecated by the source authority or by Genomics Biotech internal policy. Null if the assembly is still active.
attributes.references: Genome Reference Consortium (GRC) Lifecycle Policy; ISO 8601 Date Format

attributes.name: fasta_file_path
attributes.description: Cloud storage or file system path to the primary FASTA file containing the assembly sequences. This is the authoritative artifact used by all downstream pipelines.
attributes.references: FASTA Format Specification; AWS S3; Azure Blob Storage; Google Cloud Storage

attributes.name: fasta_md5_checksum
attributes.description: MD5 hash of the FASTA file for integrity verification. Ensures the file has not been corrupted or tampered with during transfer or storage.
attributes.references: MD5 Message-Digest Algorithm (RFC 1321); ISO 27001 Information Security

attributes.name: gc_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of guanine (G) and cytosine (C) bases in the total assembly sequence. Species-specific characteristic used for quality control and comparative genomics.

attributes.name: gff_file_path
attributes.description: Path to the GFF3 file containing genomic features and annotations. Alternative to GTF, used by some annotation pipelines and genome browsers.

attributes.name: gtf_file_path
attributes.description: Path to the GTF file containing gene annotations (exons, transcripts, genes) for this assembly. Used by RNA-seq and variant annotation pipelines.

attributes.name: index_file_path
attributes.description: Path to the FASTA index file (.fai) used by bioinformatics tools (e.g., samtools, GATK) for rapid random access to sequences.
attributes.references: SAMtools FASTA Index Format; GATK Best Practices

attributes.name: is_primary_assembly
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the primary/default assembly for the organism. True = primary assembly used by default in all pipelines; False = alternate or legacy assembly.
attributes.references: Genome Reference Consortium (GRC); NCBI Assembly Database

attributes.name: is_reference_standard
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this assembly is recognized as a community reference standard (e.g., GRCh38 for human). True = reference standard; False = non-standard or custom assembly.
attributes.references: Genome Reference Consortium (GRC); FDA Guidance on NGS-Based Oncology Panels

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional metadata, known issues, usage recommendations, or special handling instructions for this assembly (e.g., 'Contains unresolved centromeric gaps', 'Recommended for clinical variant calling').

attributes.name: organism_common_name
attributes.description: Common or vernacular name of the organism (e.g., human, mouse, thale cress). Used for user-facing displays and non-technical reporting.

attributes.name: organism_name
attributes.description: Scientific name of the organism for which this genome assembly was built (e.g., Homo sapiens, Mus musculus, Arabidopsis thaliana).

attributes.name: patch_version
attributes.description: Incremental patch or update number applied to the base assembly (e.g., p13 for GRCh38.p13). Patches correct errors or add alternate loci without changing the primary coordinate system.
attributes.references: Genome Reference Consortium (GRC) Patch Release Policy

attributes.name: ploidy
attributes.description: Number of complete sets of chromosomes in the organism. Haploid = one set (e.g., bacteria, haploid yeast); diploid = two sets (e.g., human, mouse); polyploid = more than two sets (e.g., wheat, some plants).

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date on which this assembly version was officially released by the source authority. Critical for reproducibility and version control in genomic analyses.

attributes.name: scaffold_count
attributes.description: Total number of scaffolds in the assembly. Scaffolds are ordered and oriented contigs connected by gaps of estimated size.
attributes.references: NCBI Assembly Database; Genome Reference Consortium (GRC)

attributes.name: scaffold_n50_bp
attributes.description: N50 statistic for scaffolds: the length at which 50% of the total assembly length is contained in scaffolds of this size or larger. Higher values indicate better long-range contiguity.
