attributes.description: Indicates whether the annotation track includes strand information (forward, reverse, both, or unstranded).

attributes.name: track_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the gene annotation track (e.g., GENCODE v38, RefSeq GRCh38.p13, Ensembl 104).

attributes.name: transcript_count
attributes.description: Total number of transcript isoforms annotated in this track.

attributes.name: usage_scope
attributes.description: Intended usage scope of the annotation track: RUO (Research Use Only), IVD (In Vitro Diagnostic), LDT (Laboratory Developed Test), or Internal (internal research and development).
attributes.references: FDA IVD Guidance; CLIA LDT Regulations; ISO 13485

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date when the annotation track was validated for production use.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date Format; Internal QA/QC Procedures

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annotation track has undergone internal validation for use in clinical or regulatory-grade pipelines.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the data steward or system that created this annotation track record.

products.name: gene_model
products.description: Authoritative master record for each gene in the reference catalog — capturing HGNC gene symbol, Ensembl gene ID, Entrez gene ID, gene name, gene biotype, chromosomal locus (chromosome, start, end, strand), genome build, OMIM ID, gene family, associated disease phenotypes, essential gene flag, cancer gene census flag, pharmacogenomics relevance flag, and curation status. Serves as the enterprise SSOT for gene identity, enabling consistent gene-level reporting across variant interpretation, clinical assay design, and research workflows.
products.reference: HGNC Gene Nomenclature / Ensembl Gene Model

attributes.name: gene_model_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the gene model record. Primary key for the gene model entity.

attributes.name: gene_annotation_track_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.gene_annotation_track. Business justification: Gene models are sourced from specific gene annotation tracks (GENCODE, RefSeq, etc.). Each gene model should reference its source annotation track. The source_database string attribute should be repla

attributes.name: acmg_secondary_findings_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG) Secondary Findings Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gene is on the ACMG list of genes recommended for reporting of secondary findings in clinical sequencing. Critical for clinical laboratory compliance and incidental findings workflows.

attributes.name: associated_disease_phenotypes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of disease phenotypes or clinical conditions associated with variants in this gene. Supports clinical assay design and variant prioritization workflows.

attributes.name: cancer_gene_census_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gene is catalogued in the Cancer Gene Census as a known cancer driver gene. Critical for oncology assay design and somatic variant interpretation.

attributes.name: chromosome
attributes.description: Chromosome on which the gene is located (1-22, X, Y, or MT for mitochondrial). Critical for cytogenetic reporting and structural variant analysis.
attributes.references: ISCN (International System for Human Cytogenomic Nomenclature)

attributes.name: constraint_metric_loeuf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Loss-of-Function Observed/Expected Upper Bound Fraction (LOEUF) Constraint Metric
attributes.description: Loss-of-Function Observed/Expected Upper Bound Fraction from gnomAD, a continuous measure of gene constraint. Lower LOEUF scores indicate greater intolerance to loss-of-function variants.

attributes.name: constraint_metric_pli
attributes.business_glossary_term: Probability of Loss-of-Function Intolerance (pLI) Constraint Metric
attributes.description: Probability of Loss-of-Function Intolerance score from gnomAD, indicating the gene's tolerance to inactivating variants. High pLI (>0.9) suggests the gene is intolerant to loss-of-function variants.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gene model record was first created in the reference data catalog. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: curator_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from the data curation team documenting special considerations, known issues, or manual overrides applied to this gene model. Supports knowledge transfer and audit trails.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this gene model version was superseded or retired. Null for currently active versions. Supports temporal queries and regulatory audit trails.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this gene model version became effective and available for use in production annotation pipelines and clinical assays.

attributes.name: end_position
attributes.description: Genomic coordinate of the gene end position (3' end) in base pairs, relative to the reference genome build. Defines the gene boundary for annotation pipelines.

attributes.name: ensembl_gene_accession
attributes.description: Stable Ensembl gene identifier used for cross-referencing with Ensembl genome browser and annotation databases.

attributes.name: entrez_gene_number
attributes.description: NCBI Entrez Gene ID, the primary identifier used in NCBI databases including Gene, PubMed, and ClinVar for gene-level cross-referencing.

attributes.name: essential_gene_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gene is essential for cell viability or organism survival based on functional genomics studies. Used in CRISPR screen analysis and drug target prioritization.
attributes.references: DepMap (Cancer Dependency Map), OGEE (Online Gene Essentiality Database)

attributes.name: gene_biotype
attributes.description: Functional classification of the gene based on its molecular product type. Determines the gene's role in cellular processes and influences analysis pipelines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: protein_coding|lncRNA|miRNA|snRNA|snoRNA|rRNA|pseudogene — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gene_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the gene's known or predicted function, biological role, and clinical significance. Supports manual curation and knowledge base enrichment.

attributes.name: gene_family
attributes.description: Gene family or superfamily to which this gene belongs (e.g., 'kinase', 'G-protein coupled receptor', 'immunoglobulin'). Supports functional enrichment analysis and pathway mapping.

attributes.name: gene_length_bp
attributes.description: Total length of the gene in base pairs from start to end position. Used for coverage depth normalization and sequencing quality metrics.

attributes.name: gene_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the gene, providing human-readable context for the gene symbol (e.g., 'tumor protein p53' for TP53).

attributes.name: gene_status
attributes.description: Current curation status of the gene record in the reference catalog. Active genes are approved for use in production pipelines; retired or withdrawn genes require remapping.

attributes.name: gene_synonym_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of alternative names and synonyms for the gene. Enhances search and cross-referencing capabilities across literature and databases.

attributes.name: gene_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this gene model record, tracking updates to gene coordinates, annotations, or metadata over time. Ensures reproducibility and audit trail for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: genome_build
attributes.description: Reference genome assembly version used for gene coordinates (e.g., GRCh38/hg38, GRCh37/hg19, T2T-CHM13). Essential for coordinate liftover and reproducible variant interpretation.

attributes.name: haploinsufficiency_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score indicating the likelihood that loss of one gene copy (haploinsufficiency) causes disease. Used for copy number variant interpretation and dosage sensitivity analysis.

attributes.name: hgnc_gene_symbol
attributes.business_glossary_term: HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee (HGNC) Gene Symbol
attributes.description: Official gene symbol assigned by HGNC, the authoritative naming body for human genes. This is the primary human-readable identifier for the gene.

attributes.name: last_curated_date
attributes.description: Date when this gene model record was last reviewed and curated by the bioinformatics or clinical genomics team. Supports data quality monitoring and refresh scheduling.

attributes.name: locus_group
attributes.description: High-level classification of the locus type as defined by HGNC. Groups genes by their primary molecular function category.

attributes.name: locus_type
attributes.description: Detailed locus type classification providing finer granularity than locus group (e.g., 'gene with protein product', 'RNA, long non-coding').

attributes.name: mane_select_transcript_transcript_model_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Matched Annotation from NCBI and EMBL-EBI (MANE) Select Transcript Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: MANE Select transcript identifier representing the gold-standard transcript for clinical reporting, jointly curated by NCBI and Ensembl.
attributes.references: MANE (Matched Annotation from NCBI and EMBL-EBI)

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gene model record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trails, and downstream data refresh orchestration.

attributes.name: omim_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man (OMIM) Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: OMIM identifier linking the gene to known genetic disorders and phenotypes. Used for clinical variant interpretation and disease association reporting.

attributes.name: pharmacogenomics_relevance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gene has known pharmacogenomic associations affecting drug metabolism, efficacy, or toxicity. Used for precision medicine and clinical decision support.
attributes.references: PharmGKB (Pharmacogenomics Knowledge Base), CPIC (Clinical Pharmacogenetics Implementation Consortium)

attributes.name: previous_gene_symbols
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of previous or alias gene symbols for this gene. Supports legacy data migration and cross-reference mapping.

attributes.name: start_position
attributes.description: Genomic coordinate of the gene start position (5' end) in base pairs, relative to the reference genome build. Used for variant mapping and gene overlap analysis.

attributes.name: strand
attributes.description: DNA strand on which the gene is encoded: '+' for forward/sense strand, '-' for reverse/antisense strand. Critical for transcript orientation and variant effect prediction.

attributes.name: transcript_count
attributes.description: Number of known transcript isoforms for this gene. Indicates alternative splicing complexity and impacts variant annotation strategies.

attributes.name: transcript_model_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the canonical or representative transcript for this gene, used as the default for variant annotation and clinical reporting.
attributes.references: Ensembl, MANE (Matched Annotation from NCBI and EMBL-EBI)

attributes.name: triplosensitivity_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score indicating the likelihood that gain of one gene copy (triplosensitivity) causes disease. Used for copy number variant interpretation and dosage sensitivity analysis.

products.name: transcript_model
products.description: Reference catalog of gene transcripts associated with each gene model — capturing Ensembl transcript ID, RefSeq accession (NM_/NR_/XM_), transcript name, biotype (protein-coding, lncRNA, retained intron), canonical transcript flag, MANE Select flag, MANE Plus Clinical flag, exon count, CDS start/end, UTR coordinates, protein ID, transcript length (bp), genome build, and curation status. Critical for exon-level variant annotation, splice site analysis, and clinical reporting of coding variants in IVD/LDT assays.

attributes.name: transcript_model_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transcript model record. Primary key.

attributes.name: gene_annotation_track_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.gene_annotation_track. Business justification: Transcript models are sourced from specific gene annotation tracks. Each transcript should reference its source annotation track for full provenance. Removes redundant annotation_source and annotation

attributes.name: gene_model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent gene model that this transcript belongs to.

attributes.name: appris_annotation
attributes.description: APPRIS annotation classifying the transcript as principal (most functionally important isoform) or alternative, with confidence levels 1-5 for principal isoforms. Principal1 is the highest confidence. Used to prioritize functionally relevant isoforms in variant interpretation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: principal1|principal2|principal3|principal4|principal5|alternative1|alternative2 — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: biotype
attributes.description: Functional classification of the transcript indicating its biological role: protein_coding (translates to protein), lncRNA (long non-coding RNA), miRNA (microRNA), snRNA (small nuclear RNA), snoRNA (small nucleolar RNA), rRNA (ribosomal RNA), pseudogene (non-functional gene copy), processed_transcript (non-coding transcript without clear classification), retained_intron (transcript with retained intron), nonsense_mediated_decay (transcript subject to NMD pathway). Critical for filtering coding vs non-coding variants in clinical pipelines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: protein_coding|lncRNA|miRNA|snRNA|snoRNA|rRNA|pseudogene|processed_transcript|retained_intron|nonsense_mediated_decay — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ccds_accession
attributes.description: Consensus CDS identifier for transcripts that are identically annotated across multiple annotation sources (Ensembl, RefSeq, UCSC). Null if not part of CCDS. High-confidence coding transcripts used in clinical reporting.

attributes.name: cds_end_position
attributes.description: Genomic coordinate (1-based) of the coding sequence end position (translation termination site, typically stop codon). Null for non-coding transcripts. Essential for determining whether a variant falls in the coding region or 3' UTR.

attributes.name: cds_start_position
attributes.description: Genomic coordinate (1-based) of the coding sequence start position (translation initiation site, typically ATG start codon). Null for non-coding transcripts. Essential for determining whether a variant falls in the 5' UTR, coding region, or 3' UTR.

attributes.name: checksum
attributes.description: MD5 or SHA-256 hash of the transcript sequence and structural coordinates, used to detect data corruption and ensure integrity of reference data in regulatory-grade pipelines per 21 CFR Part 11.

attributes.name: chromosome
attributes.description: Chromosome on which this transcript is located (1-22, X, Y, M/MT for mitochondrial). May include 'chr' prefix depending on genome build convention. Essential for genomic coordinate mapping and variant liftover.

attributes.name: coding_length_bp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Coding Sequence Length in Base Pairs (bp)
attributes.description: Length of the coding sequence (CDS) in base pairs, from start codon to stop codon. Null for non-coding transcripts. Used for protein length calculation (coding_length_bp / 3) and frameshift variant impact assessment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transcript model record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking per GxP requirements.

attributes.name: curation_status
attributes.description: Quality and review status of the transcript annotation: reviewed (manually curated and validated), validated (experimentally confirmed), predicted (computational prediction), provisional (preliminary annotation pending review), withdrawn (deprecated or superseded). Critical for filtering high-confidence transcripts in clinical assays.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or pipeline that loaded this transcript model record (e.g., Ensembl ETL Pipeline, RefSeq Import Job). Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this transcript model version was superseded or deprecated. Null for currently active versions. Used for temporal queries and audit trails in regulatory-grade systems.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this transcript model version became effective and available for use in annotation pipelines. Used for temporal queries and version control in regulatory-grade systems.

attributes.name: ensembl_transcript_accession
attributes.description: Ensembl stable transcript identifier with optional version suffix (e.g., ENST00000456328.2). Primary external reference for Ensembl-based annotation pipelines.

attributes.name: exon_count
attributes.description: Total number of exons in this transcript model. Used for splice site analysis, exon-level variant annotation, and transcript structure validation.

attributes.name: gencode_tag
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of GENCODE tags providing additional transcript metadata (e.g., basic, CCDS, appris_principal, MANE_Select, exp_conf). Used for advanced filtering and quality assessment in annotation pipelines.

attributes.name: genome_build
attributes.description: Reference genome assembly version used for this transcript annotation: GRCh38/hg38 (current standard), GRCh37/hg19 (legacy), T2T-CHM13 (telomere-to-telomere complete assembly). Critical for coordinate liftover and ensuring annotation consistency across pipelines.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this transcript model is currently active and should be used in annotation pipelines. Inactive transcripts are retained for historical reference and audit purposes but excluded from production workflows.

attributes.name: is_canonical
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this transcript is designated as the canonical (representative) transcript for the gene. Canonical transcripts are typically the longest coding transcript or the most biologically relevant isoform, used as the default for variant annotation when multiple isoforms exist.

attributes.name: is_mane_plus_clinical
attributes.business_glossary_term: Matched Annotation from NCBI and EMBL-EBI (MANE) Plus Clinical Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this transcript is designated as a MANE Plus Clinical transcript. MANE Plus Clinical includes additional clinically relevant transcripts beyond MANE Select that are important for clinical variant interpretation, particularly for genes with multiple clinically significant isoforms.

attributes.name: is_mane_select
attributes.business_glossary_term: Matched Annotation from NCBI and EMBL-EBI (MANE) Select Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this transcript is designated as the MANE Select transcript. MANE Select represents the single agreed-upon transcript per gene between RefSeq and Ensembl/GENCODE, providing a gold-standard reference for clinical reporting and variant interpretation. Critical for regulatory-grade IVD/LDT assays.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transcript model record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trails per GxP requirements.

attributes.name: protein_accession
attributes.description: Ensembl protein identifier (ENSP) or RefSeq protein accession (NP_ for reviewed, XP_ for predicted) associated with this transcript. Null for non-coding transcripts. Used for protein-level variant annotation and functional impact prediction.

attributes.name: refseq_accession
attributes.description: NCBI RefSeq transcript accession (NM_ for protein-coding mRNA, NR_ for non-coding RNA, XM_/XR_ for predicted models) with optional version. Used for clinical variant reporting and cross-reference to NCBI databases.

attributes.name: strand
attributes.description: DNA strand orientation of the transcript: + (forward/sense strand) or - (reverse/antisense strand). Critical for correct variant annotation and HGVS nomenclature generation.

attributes.name: transcript_end_position
attributes.description: Genomic coordinate (1-based) of the transcript end position (transcription termination site). Used for genomic range queries and variant overlap detection.

attributes.name: transcript_length_bp
attributes.description: Total length of the transcript in base pairs, including all exons from transcription start to transcription end. Used for transcript size filtering and coverage depth calculations in sequencing QC.

attributes.name: transcript_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or symbol for the transcript, often derived from the gene symbol with a transcript-specific suffix (e.g., BRCA1-201, TP53-001).

attributes.name: transcript_start_position
attributes.description: Genomic coordinate (1-based) of the transcript start position (transcription start site). Used for genomic range queries and variant overlap detection.

attributes.name: transcript_support_level
attributes.description: Ensembl Transcript Support Level (1-5) indicating the quality of experimental evidence supporting the transcript structure: 1 (all splice junctions supported by at least one non-suspect mRNA), 2 (best supporting mRNA is flagged as suspect or support from multiple ESTs), 3 (only support is from single EST), 4 (best supporting EST is flagged as suspect), 5 (no single transcript supports the model structure). Lower values indicate higher confidence. Used for transcript filtering in clinical pipelines.

attributes.name: utr_3_prime_end
attributes.description: Genomic coordinate (1-based) of the 3' UTR end position (transcript end). Null for non-coding transcripts or transcripts without annotated 3' UTR. Used for regulatory variant analysis and polyadenylation signal assessment.

attributes.name: utr_3_prime_start
attributes.description: Genomic coordinate (1-based) of the 3' UTR start position (immediately after CDS end). Null for non-coding transcripts or transcripts without annotated 3' UTR. Used for regulatory variant analysis and polyadenylation signal assessment.

attributes.name: utr_5_prime_end
attributes.description: Genomic coordinate (1-based) of the 5' UTR end position (immediately before CDS start). Null for non-coding transcripts or transcripts without annotated 5' UTR. Used for regulatory variant analysis.

attributes.name: utr_5_prime_start
attributes.description: Genomic coordinate (1-based) of the 5' UTR start position (transcript start before the CDS). Null for non-coding transcripts or transcripts without annotated 5' UTR. Used for regulatory variant analysis.

products.name: population_allele_frequency
products.description: Reference table of population-level allele frequency data for known variants, sourced from gnomAD, 1000 Genomes, TOPMed, and internal cohort databases. Captures variant identifier (rsID/HGVS), chromosome, position, reference allele, alternate allele, genome build, population group (global, AFR, AMR, ASJ, EAS, FIN, NFE, SAS, OTH), allele count, allele number, allele frequency (AF), homozygote count, hemizygote count, source database version, and QC filter status. Foundational reference for MAF-based variant filtering, population stratification, and clinical variant classification (ACMG BA1/BS1 criteria).

attributes.name: population_allele_frequency_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the population allele frequency record. Primary key for this reference data product.

attributes.name: gene_model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.gene_model. Business justification: Population allele frequency records reference genes. The gene_symbol string attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to gene_model for referential integrity. Removes redundant gene_symbol which c

attributes.name: transcript_model_id
attributes.description: RefSeq or Ensembl transcript identifier (e.g., NM_000277.1, ENST00000357654) for the canonical transcript affected by this variant.

attributes.name: variant_database_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.variant_database_version. Business justification: Population allele frequency data is sourced from specific versions of variant databases (gnomAD v3.1.2, 1000 Genomes Phase 3, etc.). Each frequency record should reference the exact database version f

attributes.name: allele_count
attributes.description: Total number of times the alternate allele was observed in the population cohort. Used to calculate allele frequency.

attributes.name: allele_frequency
attributes.description: Population-level allele frequency calculated as allele_count divided by allele_number. Core metric for MAF-based variant filtering and ACMG BA1/BS1 criteria application.

attributes.name: allele_number
attributes.description: Total number of alleles successfully genotyped in the population cohort at this position. Denominator for allele frequency calculation.

attributes.name: alternate_allele
attributes.description: The alternate (variant) allele sequence observed in the population at this genomic position.

attributes.name: chromosome
attributes.description: Chromosome on which the variant is located. Standard nomenclature: 1-22 for autosomes, X, Y for sex chromosomes, MT for mitochondrial DNA.

attributes.name: clinical_significance
attributes.description: Clinical interpretation of the variant if available from ClinVar or other clinical databases. Values include pathogenic, likely pathogenic, benign, likely benign, uncertain significance, or conflicting interpretations.

attributes.name: consequence
attributes.description: Predicted functional consequence of the variant on the transcript using Sequence Ontology terms (e.g., missense_variant, synonymous_variant, frameshift_variant, splice_donor_variant).

attributes.name: coverage_depth
attributes.description: Mean sequencing coverage depth at this genomic position in the source cohort. Indicator of data quality and confidence in frequency estimates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this population allele frequency record was first ingested into the reference genomics data product. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_source_url
attributes.description: URL or persistent identifier linking to the original source record in the external database (e.g., gnomAD browser link, dbSNP link). Supports audit trail and regulatory traceability.

attributes.name: genome_build
attributes.description: Reference genome assembly version used for variant coordinates. Critical for reproducible genomic analysis and coordinate liftover.
attributes.references: NCBI Genome Reference Consortium, T2T Consortium

attributes.name: hemizygote_count
attributes.description: Number of individuals hemizygous for the alternate allele. Applicable to X and Y chromosome variants in males and mitochondrial variants.

attributes.name: hgvs_coding
attributes.description: HGVS nomenclature for the variant at the coding DNA level (e.g., NM_000277.1:c.1521_1523delCTT). Standard for clinical reporting.

attributes.name: hgvs_protein
attributes.description: HGVS nomenclature for the variant at the protein level (e.g., NP_000268.1:p.Phe508del). Used for clinical variant interpretation and reporting.

attributes.name: homozygote_count
attributes.description: Number of individuals in the population cohort who are homozygous for the alternate allele (carry two copies).

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when this population frequency record was last updated or refreshed from the source database. Critical for version control and reproducibility.

attributes.name: minor_allele_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency of the less common allele in the population. Used for ACMG BA1/BS1 criteria: BA1 if MAF > 5%, BS1 if MAF > 1% in any general population database.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, caveats, or annotations related to this population frequency record. May include information about population-specific considerations or data quality issues.

attributes.name: population_group
attributes.description: Population ancestry group for which the allele frequency is calculated. Standard gnomAD population codes: AFR (African/African American), AMR (Latino/Admixed American), ASJ (Ashkenazi Jewish), EAS (East Asian), FIN (Finnish), NFE (Non-Finnish European), SAS (South Asian), OTH (Other), global (all populations combined). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: global|AFR|AMR|ASJ|EAS|FIN|NFE|SAS|OTH — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Genomic coordinate position of the variant on the chromosome, 1-based coordinate system.

attributes.name: qc_filter_status
attributes.description: Quality control filter status applied by the source database. PASS indicates the variant passed all QC filters; other values indicate specific QC failure reasons.
attributes.references: VCF Specification v4.3, gnomAD QC Pipeline

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this reference data record. Active records are current and approved for use in analysis pipelines; deprecated or superseded records are retained for historical traceability.

attributes.name: reference_allele
attributes.description: The reference allele sequence at this genomic position as defined by the reference genome assembly.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the population frequency data has been independently validated or cross-referenced across multiple databases. Critical for regulatory-grade variant interpretation.

attributes.name: variant_identifier
attributes.description: Standard variant identifier, typically rsID from dbSNP (e.g., rs123456) or HGVS nomenclature (e.g., NM_000277.1:c.1521_1523delCTT). Primary business identifier for the variant.

attributes.name: variant_type
attributes.description: Classification of the variant by structural type. SNP (Single Nucleotide Polymorphism), insertion, deletion, indel (insertion-deletion), MNP (Multi-Nucleotide Polymorphism), or complex structural variant.

products.name: pathway_database

attributes.name: pathway_database_id

attributes.name: annotation_field_schema

attributes.name: approved_for_clinical_use

attributes.name: approved_for_research_use

attributes.name: checksum_md5

attributes.name: citation_reference

attributes.name: data_access_tier
attributes.description: Access control tier for the pathway database: public (open access), licensed (commercial license required), restricted (institutional agreement), internal (proprietary curation).

attributes.name: database_code
attributes.description: Short standardized code or abbreviation for the pathway database used in bioinformatics pipelines and annotation workflows (e.g., KEGG, GO, REACTOME).

attributes.name: database_name
attributes.description: Official name of the biological pathway or gene ontology database (e.g., KEGG, Reactome, Gene Ontology, MSigDB, WikiPathways, BioCarta).

attributes.name: database_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pathway database by its primary biological focus (pathway, gene ontology, molecular signature, disease ontology, drug target, metabolic, signaling, regulatory). attributes.name: deprecation_date

attributes.references: ISO 13485 (Medical Devices Quality Management), FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: download_url

attributes.name: file_format

attributes.name: file_size_mb
attributes.description: Total file size of the pathway database distribution in megabytes. Used for storage planning and download time estimation.

attributes.name: gene_count

products.name: contract
products.description: Master record for executed commercial contracts governing the sale, licensing, and service delivery of Genomics Biotech products — including instrument purchase agreements, reagent supply agreements, software license agreements, master service agreements (MSAs), and evaluation agreements. Captures contract number, contract type, counterparty (customer or channel partner), effective date, expiration date, auto-renewal flag, total contract value, payment terms, governing jurisdiction, contract status (draft, executed, active, expired, terminated), and key commercial terms summary. SSOT for commercial contractual commitments distinct from regulatory or R&D agreements.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the commercial contract record. Primary key for the commercial contract entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or channel partner account that is the counterparty to this contract. Links to the master customer account record.

attributes.name: catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.reagent_catalog. Business justification: Volume purchase agreements and reagent supply contracts specify committed reagent products. Enables contract compliance tracking, committed product validation, and reagent-specific terms enforcement i

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.opportunity. Business justification: Commercial contracts are the legal outcome of closed-won opportunities. Adding opportunity_id FK links the executed contract back to the originating sales opportunity, enabling win-rate analysis, sale

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales territory or region to which this contract is assigned for quota and commission purposes. Links to the sales territory master data.

attributes.name: service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.service_agreement. Business justification: Commercial contracts (MSAs, volume purchase agreements) often reference or supersede service agreements for instrument maintenance and support. Legal and sales operations teams cross-reference contrac

attributes.name: supplier_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier_contract. Business justification: Master commercial contracts with customers may reference underlying supplier contracts for pass-through pricing, supply guarantees, or back-to-back terms. Business process: back-to-back contract manag

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of internal approval workflow for non-standard terms, pricing exceptions, or high-value contracts. Pending indicates awaiting review; approved means all required approvals obtained; rejected means approval denied; conditional means approved with modifications.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the executive or manager who provided final approval for the contract. Typically required for contracts exceeding standard authority limits or containing non-standard terms.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when final internal approval was granted. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract automatically renews for an additional term unless either party provides notice of non-renewal. True means contract will auto-renew; false means contract expires at term end unless explicitly renewed.

attributes.name: confidentiality_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes confidentiality or non-disclosure provisions protecting proprietary information, trade secrets, or sensitive business data. True means confidentiality obligations exist; false means no specific confidentiality terms beyond standard commercial practice.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the contract, used in communications with customers and partners. Typically follows a structured format including year, region, or contract type prefix.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the contract. Draft indicates contract is being negotiated; pending approval awaits internal sign-off; executed means signed by all parties; active indicates contract is in force; expired means term has ended; terminated indicates early cancellation; suspended indicates temporary hold. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|executed|active|expired|terminated|suspended — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contract based on the primary commercial relationship it governs. Instrument purchase agreements cover sequencing systems and hardware; reagent supply agreements govern consumables and kits; software license agreements cover bioinformatics platforms; MSAs establish framework terms; evaluation agreements enable product trials; maintenance agreements cover post-warranty service.

attributes.name: counterparty_legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the customer or partner organization as it appears on the executed contract. Must match official registration documents for contract enforceability.

attributes.name: counterparty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contracting party based on their relationship to Genomics Biotech. Direct customers purchase for their own use; channel partners resell; distributors provide regional coverage; OEM partners integrate products; academic institutions include universities and research centers; government entities include public health and regulatory bodies.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contract record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in the contract. Determines the currency for invoicing and payment.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: Agreed-upon method for resolving disputes arising from the contract. Arbitration is common for commercial contracts to avoid court proceedings; mediation involves a neutral third party; litigation means court-based resolution.

attributes.name: document_repository_url
attributes.description: Link to the executed contract document stored in the document management system (e.g., Veeva Vault). Provides access to the full legal agreement and any amendments.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract terms become binding and enforceable. Typically the date of final signature or a future date specified in the contract. Marks the start of the contract term.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract grants exclusive rights to the counterparty within a defined scope (territory, product line, or customer segment). True means exclusive rights granted; false means non-exclusive. Common in channel partner and distributor agreements.

attributes.name: executed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the contract was fully executed (signed by all parties). Marks the point at which the contract becomes legally binding, which may differ from the effective date.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract term ends unless renewed or extended. Null for perpetual contracts or contracts with no fixed term. Used for contract renewal planning and revenue forecasting.

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of the contract. Typically specified as a state or country (e.g., State of California, England and Wales). Critical for dispute resolution.

attributes.name: insurance_requirements
attributes.description: Summary of insurance coverage requirements specified in the contract, such as general liability, professional liability, product liability, or cyber liability insurance. May include minimum coverage amounts and certificate of insurance requirements.

attributes.name: ip_ownership_terms
attributes.description: Summary of intellectual property ownership and licensing terms, particularly relevant for R&D collaborations, custom development, or co-marketing agreements. Specifies who owns IP created under the contract and any license grants.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contract record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: liability_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum monetary amount of liability that either party may be held responsible for under the contract, excluding certain carve-outs (e.g., IP infringement, gross negligence). Null if no liability cap is specified. Typically expressed as a multiple of contract value or a fixed amount.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_commitment
attributes.description: Minimum monetary value or quantity that the customer commits to purchase over the contract term. Used in volume discount agreements and channel partner contracts. Null if no minimum commitment exists.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special terms, negotiation history, or internal notes relevant to contract management. Not part of the legal contract but useful for operational context.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred or required method of payment specified in the contract. Wire transfer and ACH are common for large transactions; credit card for smaller purchases; purchase order for institutional buyers; letter of credit for international or high-value deals.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms governing when payment is due after invoice. Net terms indicate days until payment due; installment and milestone-based indicate structured payment schedules; subscription terms indicate recurring billing cycles. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: net_30|net_45|net_60|net_90|due_on_receipt|installment|milestone_based|subscription_monthly|subscription_annual — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_scope
attributes.description: Summary description of the products, services, or solutions covered by this contract. May include instrument models, reagent SKUs, software platforms, or service packages. Provides high-level context without listing every line item.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_terms
attributes.description: Summary of regulatory compliance obligations specified in the contract, such as HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA) terms, GDPR data processing terms, FDA Quality System Regulation (QSR) requirements, or GxP compliance for clinical products. Critical for IVD and clinical genomics contracts.
attributes.references: HIPAA, GDPR, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, GxP

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to expiration that either party must provide written notice to prevent auto-renewal or to initiate renewal discussions. Typically 30, 60, or 90 days. Null if contract does not auto-renew.

attributes.name: service_level_agreement
attributes.description: Summary of service level commitments including response times, uptime guarantees, turnaround times (TAT), and performance metrics. Common in maintenance agreements and software license agreements. May reference detailed SLA document.

attributes.name: termination_for_convenience_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether either party may terminate the contract without cause by providing advance notice. True means termination for convenience is allowed; false means contract can only be terminated for cause (breach, insolvency, etc.).

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance written notice required to terminate the contract for convenience or non-renewal. Typically 30, 60, or 90 days. Null if termination for convenience is not permitted.

attributes.name: territory_scope
attributes.description: Geographic territory or market region where the contract terms apply. May be global, regional (e.g., EMEA, APAC), country-specific, or limited to specific sites. Important for channel partner and distributor agreements.

attributes.name: total_contract_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the contract over its full term, including all products, services, and recurring fees. Represents the maximum revenue potential from this contract. Used for pipeline reporting and revenue forecasting.

attributes.name: volume_discount_tier
attributes.description: Pricing tier or discount level applicable to this contract based on purchase volume, strategic relationship, or negotiated terms. Higher tiers typically receive better pricing. Standard indicates list pricing with no volume discount.

attributes.name: warranty_terms
attributes.description: Summary of warranty coverage provided under the contract, including duration, scope, and exclusions. For instrument purchase agreements, typically includes hardware warranty period and terms. For reagents, may reference shelf life and quality guarantees.

attributes.name: master_contract_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on contract (master_contract_id)

products.name: reagent_subscription
products.description: Master record for recurring reagent and consumable supply subscription agreements with customers — including flow cell subscriptions, library prep kit subscriptions, and array consumable programs. Captures subscription ID, customer account, subscribed product family, committed annual volume (e.g., flow cell count, kit quantity), subscription tier, pricing per unit, subscription start/end date, auto-renewal terms, consumption tracking method, and subscription status (active, paused, cancelled, expired). Enables recurring revenue management and reagent pull-through forecasting for genomics platforms.

products.name: price_book
products.description: Master record defining commercial price books used to manage customer-specific, segment-specific, and geography-specific pricing for Genomics Biotech products. Captures price book name, price book type (list, academic, government, biopharma, distributor, OEM), currency, effective date range, applicable customer segments, applicable geographies, approval status, and version number. Serves as the pricing framework container that price book entries reference, enabling multi-tier pricing strategy management across global markets.

attributes.name: price_book_type
attributes.description: Classification of the price book by customer segment or channel. List = standard published pricing; Academic = research institution pricing; Government = public sector pricing; Biopharma = pharmaceutical and biotech company pricing; Distributor = channel partner pricing; OEM = original equipment manufacturer pricing.

attributes.name: pricing_strategy_notes
attributes.description: Internal notes describing the strategic rationale, competitive positioning, and business objectives for this price book. Confidential business information.

attributes.name: requires_contract
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether use of this price book requires an active contract or agreement with the customer. True = contract required; False = no contract required.

attributes.name: sales_organization_code
attributes.description: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) sales organization code that owns and manages this price book.

attributes.name: sap_condition_type
attributes.description: SAP SD pricing condition type code associated with this price book for integration with SAP pricing procedures (e.g., PR00 for list price, K004 for customer-specific price).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the price book, incremented with each revision to track pricing changes over time.

attributes.name: derived_from_price_book_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on price_book (derived_from_price_book_id)

products.name: price_book_entry
products.description: Individual product pricing entry within a price book, defining the commercial price for a specific catalog item or SKU under a given price book. Captures price book reference, catalog item/SKU reference, unit price, currency, minimum order quantity, volume discount tiers, effective start/end date, and entry status. Enables granular price management for sequencing instruments, reagent kits, array products, CRISPR tools, and bioinformatics software licenses across customer segments and geographies.
products.reference: Price Book Entry / Price List Line

attributes.name: price_book_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the price book entry record. Primary key for the price book entry entity.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reagent.reagent_catalog. Business justification: Price book entries must link to reagent catalog items to establish list prices for reagent products. Core commercial master data relationship enabling automated pricing for genomics reagents alongside

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the catalog item or product master record being priced. Links to the product catalog entry for sequencing instruments, reagent kits, array products, CRISPR tools, bioinformatics software licenses, or consumables.

attributes.name: family_id
attributes.description: FK to product.product_family

attributes.name: ivd_test_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.test_catalog. Business justification: Each IVD test in clinical catalog must have corresponding pricing entries for commercial transactions. Fundamental product-to-price relationship enabling quote generation, contract pricing, and revenu

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to instrument.instrument_model. Business justification: Price books contain list prices and discount tiers for specific instrument models. Foundational for quote generation, discount approval workflows, regional pricing strategies, and ensuring sales reps

attributes.name: price_book_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent price book that contains this pricing entry. Links to the price book master record defining the commercial pricing structure for a specific customer segment, geography, or channel.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: FK to product.sku

attributes.name: superseded_by_entry_price_book_entry_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superseded By Price Book Entry Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: Reference to the price book entry that supersedes this entry. Used to maintain pricing history and version control when pricing is updated or replaced. Null for current active pricing that has not been superseded.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval status for this price book entry. Indicates whether commercial or finance approval is required and the current state of that approval workflow. Not Required for standard pricing, Pending for entries awaiting approval, Approved for authorized pricing, Rejected for declined pricing requests.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price book entry was approved. Null if approval is not required or entry is pending approval. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Optional reference to a specific customer contract or master service agreement that governs this pricing. Used for customer-specific negotiated pricing tied to contractual commitments. Confidential commercial information.

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold
attributes.description: The standard cost of goods sold for this catalog item. Used for margin analysis and pricing strategy optimization. Confidential business data used by finance and commercial teams to evaluate pricing profitability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price book entry record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the pricing entry. Defines the currency in which list price and unit price are denominated. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY.

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: The target customer segment for this price book entry. Used to align pricing with customer type and use case. Examples include Clinical laboratories, Research institutions, Pharmaceutical companies, Agricultural genomics, Government agencies, Academic institutions, and OEM partners. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Clinical|Research|Pharmaceutical|Agricultural|Government|Academic|OEM|Other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this price book entry expires and is no longer valid for new quotations or orders. Null indicates the pricing is open-ended with no planned expiration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this price book entry becomes active and available for quotation and order processing. Pricing is valid from this date forward until the effective end date.

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the price book entry. Draft entries are under construction, Active entries are available for use, Inactive entries are temporarily disabled, Expired entries have passed their end date, Superseded entries have been replaced by newer pricing, and Pending Approval entries await commercial approval.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic region or country for which this pricing applies. Enables region-specific and country-specific pricing strategies to account for market conditions, regulatory requirements, and competitive positioning. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or regional designations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Global|North America|EMEA|APAC|LATAM|USA|CAN|GBR|DEU|FRA|CHN|JPN|AUS — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gross_margin_percent
attributes.description: The gross margin percentage for this price book entry, calculated as (unit_price - cost_of_goods_sold) / unit_price * 100. Used for profitability analysis and pricing governance. Confidential business metric.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_name
attributes.description: The name of the user or system process that last modified this price book entry record. Used for audit trail and accountability in pricing governance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price book entry record was last updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: list_price
attributes.description: The standard list price for the catalog item under this price book. Represents the base commercial price before any discounts, volume tiers, or promotional adjustments. Used as the reference price for discount calculations.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The maximum quantity that can be ordered under this price book entry. Used to cap promotional pricing or enforce allocation limits for constrained products. Null indicates no maximum limit.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity that must be ordered for this price book entry to apply. Used to enforce volume commitments or packaging constraints. Null or 1 indicates no minimum order requirement.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about this price book entry. Used to capture pricing rationale, special terms, competitive positioning notes, or other contextual information for commercial teams.

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: The commercial pricing strategy classification for this entry. Indicates whether this is standard list pricing, promotional pricing, volume-based pricing, customer-specific negotiated pricing, channel partner pricing, government contract pricing, or academic/research institution pricing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Standard|Promotional|Volume|Customer Specific|Channel Partner|Government|Academic — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: promotional_code
attributes.description: Optional promotional code or campaign identifier associated with this pricing entry. Links the price book entry to a specific marketing campaign or promotional offer. Null for standard non-promotional pricing.

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: The sales channel through which this pricing is offered. Enables channel-specific pricing strategies for direct sales teams, channel partners, distributors, online e-commerce, government contracts, and OEM partnerships.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for pricing and ordering. Defines the quantity basis for the unit price. Examples include Each for instruments, Kit for reagent bundles, Flow Cell for sequencing consumables, License for software, or Run for service-based pricing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Each|Kit|Cartridge|Flow Cell|Chip|License|Run|Sample|Reaction|Test|Hour|Month|Year — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The effective unit price for a single unit of the catalog item. May differ from list price if volume discounts, promotional pricing, or customer-specific pricing applies. This is the price used in quotation and order processing.

attributes.name: volume_discount_tier_1_percent
attributes.description: The discount percentage applied when the order quantity meets or exceeds the tier 1 quantity threshold. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5% discount). Null if no tier 1 discount applies.

attributes.name: volume_discount_tier_1_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity threshold to qualify for the first volume discount tier. Orders meeting or exceeding this quantity receive the tier 1 discount percentage. Null if no volume discounting applies.

attributes.name: volume_discount_tier_2_percent
attributes.description: The discount percentage applied when the order quantity meets or exceeds the tier 2 quantity threshold. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 10.00 for 10% discount). Null if no tier 2 discount applies.

attributes.name: volume_discount_tier_2_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity threshold to qualify for the second volume discount tier. Orders meeting or exceeding this quantity receive the tier 2 discount percentage. Null if no tier 2 discount applies.

attributes.name: volume_discount_tier_3_percent
attributes.description: The discount percentage applied when the order quantity meets or exceeds the tier 3 quantity threshold. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 15.00 for 15% discount). Null if no tier 3 discount applies.

attributes.name: volume_discount_tier_3_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity threshold to qualify for the third volume discount tier. Orders meeting or exceeding this quantity receive the tier 3 discount percentage. Null if no tier 3 discount applies.

attributes.name: superseded_price_book_entry_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on price_book_entry (superseded_price_book_entry_id)

products.name: discount_approval
products.description: Transactional record capturing the formal approval workflow for non-standard discounts and special pricing exceptions requested by sales representatives for genomics product deals. Captures request date, requesting rep, opportunity reference, product SKU, requested discount percentage, standard discount threshold, approval tier required (manager, director, VP, CFO), approver identity, approval decision (approved, rejected, counter-offered), approval date, business justification, and deal context. Enforces discount governance and deal desk controls.

attributes.name: discount_approval_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the discount approval record. Primary key for the discount approval transaction.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for which the discount is being requested. Links the approval to the customer master record.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manager or executive who reviewed and made the approval decision. Links to the employee or user record of the approver.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales opportunity for which the discount is being requested. Links the discount approval to the deal pipeline.

attributes.name: price_book_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.price_book_entry. Business justification: Discount approvals are for specific product pricing entries in a price book. Adding price_book_entry_id FK links the approval to the specific price book entry being discounted, enabling variance analy

attributes.name: primary_discount_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sales representative who submitted the discount approval request. Links to the employee or user record of the requestor.

attributes.name: quotation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific quote or proposal document associated with this discount request. May be null if discount is requested before formal quote generation.

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales territory or region associated with this discount request, enabling territory-level discount analytics and governance.

attributes.name: approval_comments
attributes.description: Comments or notes provided by the approver explaining the decision rationale, conditions, or guidance for the sales team.

attributes.name: approval_decision
attributes.description: Final decision made by the approver on the discount request: approved as requested, rejected, or counter-offered with alternative terms.

attributes.name: approval_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date by which the approved discount must be used in a closed transaction. After this date, the approval becomes invalid and a new request must be submitted.

attributes.name: approval_request_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the discount approval request, formatted as DA-YYYYMMDD sequence for traceability and reference in communications.

attributes.name: approval_tier_required
attributes.description: The organizational level required to approve this discount request based on the variance from standard thresholds and deal size, as defined by discount governance policy.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the approver made the final decision on the discount request. Used to calculate approval turnaround time and enforce service level agreements (SLA).

attributes.name: approved_discount_percentage
attributes.description: The final discount percentage approved by the decision maker. May differ from the requested percentage if a counter-offer was made. Null if request was rejected.

attributes.name: approved_net_price_amount
attributes.description: The final approved net price after applying the approved discount percentage. This is the price authorized for the sales transaction. Null if request was rejected.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the manager or executive who made the approval decision, included for audit trail and governance reporting.

attributes.name: approver_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the approver at the time of decision, documenting the organizational authority level that approved the discount.

attributes.name: business_justification
attributes.description: Detailed explanation provided by the requesting sales representative describing the business rationale for the discount request, including competitive situation, strategic value, or customer circumstances.

attributes.name: competitive_situation
attributes.description: Description of the competitive dynamics influencing the discount request, such as competing vendor offers, price pressure, or market positioning considerations.

attributes.name: counter_offer_terms
attributes.description: Alternative discount terms or conditions proposed by the approver when the original request cannot be approved as submitted. Populated only when approval_decision is counter_offered.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this discount approval record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this discount approval record, ensuring consistent financial reporting across geographies.

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Market segment classification of the customer account, used to evaluate discount requests against segment-specific pricing strategies and discount policies.

attributes.name: deal_closed_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the opportunity associated with this discount approval was successfully closed and converted to a booking. Used to measure discount approval effectiveness.

attributes.name: deal_size_amount
attributes.description: Total value of the opportunity or deal for which the discount is being requested. Used to assess discount impact on revenue and margin.

attributes.name: discount_variance_percentage
attributes.description: The difference between the requested discount and the standard threshold, representing the magnitude of the exception being requested. Calculated as requested discount minus standard threshold.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this discount approval record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record for audit and synchronization purposes.

attributes.name: product_family
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the product type for which discount is requested, enabling analysis of discount patterns by product line. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sequencing_instrument|reagent_kit|consumable|bioinformatics_service|array_product|gene_editing_tool|clinical_assay|support_service — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the genomics product or service for which the discount is being requested, such as sequencing platform model, assay kit name, or service package.

attributes.name: product_sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit identifier for the genomics product or service for which the discount is requested. May represent sequencing instruments, reagent kits, consumables, or bioinformatics services.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by the approver for rejecting the discount request, such as insufficient justification, margin impact, or policy violation. Populated only when approval_decision is rejected.

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current state of the discount approval request in the workflow, tracking progression from submission through final decision. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|under_review|approved|rejected|counter_offered|withdrawn|expired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the discount approval request was submitted by the sales representative. Serves as the starting point for approval turnaround time (TAT) measurement.

attributes.name: requested_discount_percentage
attributes.description: The discount percentage requested by the sales representative, expressed as a percentage of list price. This is the discount level requiring approval.

attributes.name: requested_net_price_amount
attributes.description: The proposed net price after applying the requested discount percentage. Calculated as list price minus discount for deal evaluation.

attributes.name: requesting_sales_rep_name
attributes.description: Full name of the sales representative who submitted the discount approval request for audit trail and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: standard_discount_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: The maximum discount percentage that can be applied without requiring special approval, as defined by commercial policy for this product category and customer segment.

attributes.name: strategic_value_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this deal has strategic importance beyond immediate revenue, such as market entry, reference customer, or long-term partnership potential.

attributes.name: escalated_discount_approval_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on discount_approval (escalated_discount_approval_id)

products.name: partner_genomic_access_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the authorization contract between channel partners and genomic access control policies. It captures the lifecycle of partner access to genomic datasets, including authorization dates, compliance status, and training requirements. Each record links one channel partner to one genomic access control policy with attributes that exist only in the context of this authorization relationship.. Existence Justification: In genomics biotechnology operations, channel partners (distributors, service providers, resellers) require authorized access to multiple genomic datasets for various business purposes: reference data for product demonstrations, training datasets for partner enablement, and customer genomic data when providing services under partnership agreements. Each partner requires multiple authorizations across different datasets with varying access tiers, and each genomic access control policy governs access for multiple partners. The business actively manages these authorizations as a compliance and data governance function, tracking authorization lifecycle, training completion, audit status, and expiry dates.

products.name: campaign_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the budget allocation relationship between cost centers and marketing campaigns. It captures how campaign budgets are split across multiple cost centers for financial tracking and variance analysis. Each record links one cost center to one campaign with allocation percentages, budget amounts, and actual spend that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In genomics biotech marketing operations, campaigns routinely span multiple cost centers with split budget allocations. A product launch campaign may allocate 40% to Product Marketing (cost center NGS-MKT-001), 35% to Field Marketing (FLD-MKT-002), and 25% to Corporate Marketing (CORP-MKT-003). Each cost center participates in multiple campaigns simultaneously. Finance and marketing teams actively manage these allocations for budget tracking, variance analysis, and cost center P&L reporting.

products.name: campaign_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between employees and marketing campaigns at Genomics Biotech. It captures the operational assignment of employees to campaigns with specific roles, time allocations, and participation periods. Each record links one employee to one campaign with attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship, enabling resource planning, cost allocation, and campaign staffing management.. Existence Justification: In genomics biotech marketing operations, employees participate in multiple campaigns throughout the year (e.g., a Field Application Specialist may support Q1 product launch, attend ASHG conference in Q3, and participate in KOL engagement program in Q4), and each campaign requires multiple employees with different specialized roles (product specialists, bioinformaticians for technical demos, FAS for customer engagement, marketing managers for coordination). It captures the multi-role sales team structure required for complex genomics platform sales, where each opportunity requires multiple employees in different roles (account executive, field application scientist, sales engineer, sales manager) and each employee works multiple opportunities concurrently. attributes.name: issue_description
